content_en: Under Section 7 of the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 (HASWA), what is the statutory duty of every plumbing operative on a site?
content_zh: 根據英國《1974年工作健康與安全法》(HASWA) 第7條，現場所有水暖施工人員的法定責任是什麼？

options_en.A: To provide all required PPE at their personal expense
options_en.B: To take reasonable care for the health and safety of themselves and others affected by their acts
options_en.C: To compile the site health and safety policy file
options_en.D: To conduct statutory building control approvals

options_zh.A: 自費購置現場作業所需的所有 PPE
options_zh.B: 對自身以及可能受其工作行為影響的其他人的健康與安全盡到合理注意義務
options_zh.C: 負責編制工地的健康與安全方針文件
options_zh.D: 執行法定建築監督審批

explanation_en: HASWA 1974 Section 7 mandates that every employee takes reasonable care for the health and safety of themselves and other persons.
explanation_zh: HASWA 第7條明確規定，每位僱員都必須對自身及受其工作影響之其他人員的安全與健康承擔合理注意義務。
source_reference: HASWA 1974 Section 7

content_en: Under the Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999, at what employee threshold must an employer record their risk assessment findings in writing?
content_zh: 根據《1999年工作健康與安全管理條例》，僱主在僱用多少名員工時，必須將風險評估的重要結果予以書面記錄？

options_en.B: 5 or more

options_zh.A: 2 人或以上
options_zh.B: 5 人或以上
options_zh.C: 10 人或以上
options_zh.D: 25 人或以上

explanation_en: Regulation 3 specifies that employers with 5 or more employees must record the significant findings of their risk assessment in writing.
explanation_zh: 該法規第3條規定，擁有 5 名或以上僱員的僱主必須以書面形式記錄風險評估的重大發現與防範措施。
source_reference: Management of Health and Safety at Work Regs 1999, Reg 3

content_en: What type of formal statutory enforcement notice can a Health and Safety Executive (HSE) inspector issue that stops hazardous work immediately?
content_zh: 健康與安全執行局 (HSE) 督察在發現可能造成迫在眉睫的重大傷亡危險時，有權簽發哪種法定通知書立即勒令停工？

options_en.B: Prohibition Notice

options_zh.A: 限期整改通知書 (Improvement Notice)
options_zh.B: 立即禁工通知書 (Prohibition Notice)
options_zh.C: 違章規劃通知書
options_zh.D: 環境諮詢建議書

explanation_en: A Prohibition Notice takes effect immediately to halt activities involving a risk of serious personal injury until rectified.
explanation_zh: 禁工通知書 (Prohibition Notice) 具有即時法律效力，勒令立即停止存在嚴重人身傷害風險的作業。
source_reference: HASWA 1974 Section 22; HSE Enforcement Policy

content_en: How many days does an employer typically have to appeal against an HSE Improvement Notice before an Employment Tribunal?
content_zh: 僱主若對 HSE 督察下達的「限期整改通知書 (Improvement Notice)」有異議，法定可向勞工審裁處提出上訴的期限通常是幾天？

options_en.B: 14 days

options_zh.A: 7 天

explanation_en: An appeal against an Improvement Notice must be lodged within 21 days from the date of service.
explanation_zh: 對整改通知書提出上訴的期限為送達之日起 21 天內，上訴期間整改通知書暫緩執行。
source_reference: HASWA 1974 Section 24; Employment Tribunals (HSE)

content_en: Under CDM Regulations 2015, which key duty holder is responsible for coordinating health and safety during the pre-construction design phase?
content_zh: 根據《2015年建築設計與管理條例》(CDM 2015)，哪一個核心法定責任方負責在施工前設計階段協調健康與安全事宜？

options_en.B: Principal Designer

options_zh.A: 總承包商 (Principal Contractor)
options_zh.B: 主設計協調方 (Principal Designer)
options_zh.C: 水暖專業分包商
options_zh.D: 建築檢驗監督員

explanation_en: The Principal Designer coordinates health and safety during the pre-construction phase, eliminating hazards through design.
explanation_zh: 主設計師 (Principal Designer) 在施工前階段負責統籌健康與安全，在源頭設計中消除危害並協調設計方。
source_reference: CDM Regulations 2015, Reg 11

content_en: Under CDM 2015, what document must be prepared by the Principal Contractor prior to work commencing on site?
content_zh: 根據 CDM 2015，總承包商在現場正式動工前必須編制完成何種法定安全管理綱領文件？

options_en.B: Construction Phase Plan

options_zh.A: 施工前信息手冊
options_zh.B: 施工階段健康安全計劃 (Construction Phase Plan)
options_zh.C: 工程竣工健康與安全檔案
options_zh.D: 建築能效證明書

explanation_en: The Principal Contractor must prepare the Construction Phase Plan setting out site health and safety arrangements before work starts.
explanation_zh: 總承包商必須在施工前制定施工階段安全計劃 (Construction Phase Plan)，載明現場安全規則與應急程序。
source_reference: CDM Regulations 2015, Reg 12

content_en: Under RIDDOR 2013, within how many days must an over-7-day incapacitation injury to a plumbing operative be reported to the HSE?
content_zh: 根據《2013年工傷、疾病及危險情況報告條例》(RIDDOR)，水暖工因工負傷致使喪失工作能力超過7天時，僱主必須在幾天內向 HSE 提交報告？

options_en.B: 7 days

options_zh.A: 3 天
options_zh.B: 7 天

explanation_en: Injuries resulting in over 7 consecutive days of incapacitation must be reported to the HSE within 15 days of the incident.
explanation_zh: 導致連續超過7天無法從事正常工作的工傷，僱主必須在事故發生之日起 15 天內在線向 HSE 申報。
source_reference: RIDDOR 2013, Reg 4; HSE INDG453

content_en: Which of the following injuries is classified as a 'specified injury' that must be reported to RIDDOR immediately without waiting 7 days?
content_zh: 下列哪一項傷害屬於 RIDDOR 法定「特定重大傷害 (Specified Injury)」，必須在第一時間立即向 HSE 申報而無需等待7天？

options_en.B: Bone fracture other than to fingers, thumbs, or toes

options_zh.A: 手指關節扭傷
options_zh.B: 除手指、拇指或腳趾以外的任何骨折（如手臂、腿部、肋骨）
options_zh.C: 前臂輕微擦傷
options_zh.D: 現場感染普通感冒

explanation_en: Specified injuries include bone fractures other than to fingers, thumbs or toes, amputations, and permanent blinding.
explanation_zh: 特定重大傷害包括除手指、拇指、腳趾以外的骨折、截肢、視力喪失、嚴重燒傷及化學灼傷，必須立即通報。
source_reference: RIDDOR 2013, Reg 4(1)

content_en: Which bacterial disease, transmissible through water contaminated by rat urine, is a statutory reportable occupational disease under RIDDOR for sewer plumbers?
content_zh: 下水道或潮濕暗溝作業的水暖工若接觸受鼠尿污染的污水，可能感染哪種法定需向 RIDDOR 申報的職業病？

options_en.B: Leptospirosis (Weil's disease)

options_zh.A: 瘧疾
options_zh.B: 鉤端螺旋體病 / 韋爾氏病 (Leptospirosis / Weil's disease)
options_zh.C: 矽肺病
options_zh.D: 腕管綜合徵

explanation_en: Leptospirosis (Weil's disease) is contracted from contact with rat urine in drainage/sewer work and is reportable under RIDDOR.
explanation_zh: 韋爾氏病 (Weil's disease) 是因接觸受鼠尿污染的水源或土壤而感染的急性傳染病，屬於 RIDDOR 報告範疇。
source_reference: RIDDOR 2013 Occupational Diseases; HSE INDG84

content_en: Under COSHH Regulations 2002, what does the statutory acronym WEL stand for?
content_zh: 在英國《2002年工作場所危險物質控制條例》(COSHH) 中，法定縮寫 WEL 代表什麼？

options_en.B: Workplace Exposure Limit

options_zh.A: 工作場所疏散極限
options_zh.B: 工作場所接觸限值 (Workplace Exposure Limit)
options_zh.C: 水流排放水平
options_zh.D: 工人設備責任

explanation_en: WEL stands for Workplace Exposure Limit, defined under COSHH to protect workers from airborne chemical concentrations.
explanation_zh: WEL 代表工作場所接觸限值，規定空氣中有毒化學煙塵等物質在8小時長期或15分鐘短期的法定最大容許濃度。
source_reference: COSHH Regulations 2002; HSE EH40/2005

content_en: Under the Control of Asbestos Regulations 2012, which type of asbestos is historically known as 'blue asbestos' and poses the most severe health hazard?
content_zh: 根據《2012年石棉控制條例》，哪一種俗稱「藍石棉」的石棉纖維結構最易吸入肺部且致癌風險最高？

options_en.B: Amosite

options_zh.A: 溫石棉 (白石棉 - Chrysotile)
options_zh.B: 鐵石棉 (褐石棉 - Amosite)
options_zh.C: 青石棉 (藍石棉 - Crocidolite)
options_zh.D: 蛇紋石

explanation_en: Crocidolite (blue asbestos) possesses sharp, needle-like amphibole fibres with extreme carcinogenic toxicity.
explanation_zh: 青石棉 (Crocidolite，藍石棉) 纖維呈尖銳針狀，極易刺入胸膜導致間皮瘤與石棉肺，危害最為致命。
source_reference: Control of Asbestos Regs 2012; HSE L143

content_en: What action must a plumbing installer take upon uncovering unlabelled, fibrous thermal insulation around an old cast-iron boiler header?
content_zh: 水暖工人在老舊鑄鐵鍋爐管道保溫層發現未標識的纖維狀保溫材料時，必須嚴格遵守的第一行動準則是什麼？

options_en.A: Douse it with hot soapy water and scrape it off immediately
options_en.B: Immediately stop work, clear the area, seal off access, and report it for testing
options_en.C: Wrap it in black masking tape and proceed with blowlamp soldering
options_en.D: Turn on an extraction fan to disperse the airborne dust

options_zh.A: 用肥皂熱水淋濕後立刻手動刮除清理
options_zh.B: 立即停工、撤離現場、封鎖通道防止他人進入，並向上級報告安排專業採樣確認
options_zh.C: 用黑色膠帶包覆後直接使用噴燈繼續動火
options_zh.D: 開啟強力換氣扇將浮塵吹散

explanation_en: Work must immediately cease and the suspected area must be quarantined to prevent disturbance until tested by an accredited laboratory.
explanation_zh: 依法必須立即停工封鎖，禁止任何人擅自觸碰或擾動，必須由 UKAS 認證機構採樣化驗確認。
source_reference: Control of Asbestos Regs 2012, Reg 5; HSE INDG223

content_en: Under the Control of Noise at Work Regulations 2005, what is the 'Upper Exposure Action Value' requiring mandatory hearing protection zones?
content_zh: 根據《2005年工作噪聲控制條例》，強制僱主劃定聽力保護區並強制佩戴護耳器的「高曝光行動值 (Upper Exposure Action Value)」是多少？

options_en.B: 80 dB(A)

options_zh.A: 75 dB(A)
options_zh.B: 80 dB(A)
options_zh.C: 85 dB(A)
options_zh.D: 95 dB(A)

explanation_en: The Upper Exposure Action Value is 85 dB(A) daily personal exposure. At this level, hearing protection is mandatory and areas must be signposted.
explanation_zh: 高曝光行動值為 85 dB(A)。達到或超過此值時，僱主必須提供強制聽力保護、劃定聽力保護專區並採取降噪工程措施。
source_reference: Control of Noise at Work Regs 2005, Reg 6

content_en: What is the statutory 'Lower Exposure Action Value' where an employer must make hearing protection available upon employee request?
content_zh: 根據噪聲條例，僱主必須向僱員提供防護耳塞並提供噪聲健康安全培訓的「低曝光行動值 (Lower Exposure Action Value)」是多少？

options_en.B: 85 dB(A)

options_zh.A: 80 dB(A)
options_zh.B: 85 dB(A)
options_zh.C: 90 dB(A)

explanation_en: The Lower Exposure Action Value is 80 dB(A). Employers must assess risk, provide information, and make hearing protection available.
explanation_zh: 低曝光行動值為 80 dB(A)。達到該數值時，僱主必須主動備妥防護裝備供員工索取，並提供相關風險培訓。
source_reference: Control of Noise at Work Regs 2005, Reg 6

content_en: Under the Confined Spaces Regulations 1997, what atmospheric oxygen concentration represents a hazardous oxygen deficiency?
content_zh: 根據《1997年受限空間條例》，受限空間（如地下閥門井、排水泵坑）內氧氣體積分數低於多少即被判定為缺氧危險環境？

options_en.B: Below 20.9%

explanation_en: Normal atmospheric air contains 20.9% oxygen. A reading below 19.5% indicates oxygen deficiency requiring breathing apparatus.
explanation_zh: 正常空氣含氧量約為 20.9%。低於 19.5% 屬於缺氧危險，可能迅速導致人員頭暈、昏迷甚至窒息身亡。
source_reference: Confined Spaces Regulations 1997; HSE L101

content_en: Under the Electricity at Work Regulations 1989, what voltage to earth is delivered by a standard yellow 110V site transformer Centre Tapped to Earth (CTE)?
content_zh: 根據《1989年工作用電條例》，施工現場廣泛採用的黃色 110V 中心抽頭接地 (CTE) 變壓器，其任意單相對地的最大電壓是多少？
explanation_en: A 110V CTE transformer has its centre tap referenced to earth, reducing the maximum fault voltage to earth to 55V, which is rarely lethal.
explanation_zh: 110V 中心抽頭變壓器將零位接於大地中點，使人體萬一發生單相觸電時，對地最大電壓僅為 55V，大幅降低致死風險。
source_reference: BS 7671 Section 704; Electricity at Work Regs 1989

content_en: What is the statutory minimum duration of a 'Hot Works fire watch' required after completing blowlamp soldering in a loft space?
content_zh: 在閣樓木質結構空間內使用噴燈完成明火焊接後，水暖工依法必須在現場進行持續火災警戒監視（Fire Watch）的最短時間是多久？

options_en.B: 30 minutes

options_zh.A: 15 分鐘
options_zh.B: 30 分鐘
options_zh.C: 60 分鐘 (1小時)
options_zh.D: 120 分鐘

explanation_en: Standard hot work procedures and insurance warranty conditions require a continuous fire watch for at least 60 minutes after extinguishing the torch.
explanation_zh: 英國熱工動火規範及保險條款嚴格要求，明火熄滅後必須在施工點周圍持續警戒至少 60 分鐘以防陰燃起火。
source_reference: RC7 Joint Code of Practice on Hot Works; C&G Unit 201

content_en: Under the Environmental Protection Act 1990, what statutory document must accompany the transfer of non-hazardous plumbing scrap and waste to a licensed carrier?
content_zh: 根據《1990年環境保護法》，將施工拆卸的無害廢舊管道金屬交由持證廢棄物清運商轉運時，必須隨車簽署的法定文件是什麼？

options_en.B: Waste Transfer Note (Duty of Care)

options_zh.A: 危險廢棄物託運單
options_zh.B: 廢棄物轉移記錄單 (Waste Transfer Note - Duty of Care)
options_zh.C: 建築驗收合格證書
options_zh.D: COSHH 物質安全表

explanation_en: Non-hazardous controlled waste requires a Waste Transfer Note (WTN) maintained for at least 2 years under the Waste Duty of Care regime.
explanation_zh: 無害受控廢棄物依法必須填寫廢棄物轉移記錄單 (WTN) 並存檔至少 2 年，履行嚴格的廢物處置責任（Duty of Care）。
source_reference: Environmental Protection Act 1990 Section 34

content_en: For hazardous waste in England (e.g. asbestos cement or chemical solvents), how long must hazardous waste consignment notes be retained by the plumbing contractor?
content_zh: 在英格蘭地區，對於石棉水泥或化學溶劑等危險廢棄物，承包商依法必須將其「危險廢物託運聯單 (Consignment Note)」保存至少幾年？

options_en.B: 2 years

options_zh.A: 1 年
options_zh.B: 2 年
options_zh.C: 3 年
options_zh.D: 5 年

explanation_en: Hazardous Waste Consignment Notes must be retained for a statutory minimum of 3 years.
explanation_zh: 危險廢棄物託運聯單（Consignment Note）依照《2005年危險廢物條例》必須由各方強制保存歸檔至少 3 年。
source_reference: Hazardous Waste Regulations 2005, Reg 49

content_en: What is the maximum penalty an individual plumber can face in a Crown Court for a deliberate, catastrophic breach of HASWA Section 7?
content_zh: 若個人蓄意或嚴重失職違反 HASWA 第7條並導致致命惡性後果，在英國皇家法院 (Crown Court) 面臨的最高刑罰是什麼？

options_en.B: Unlimited fine and up to 2 years imprisonment

options_zh.A: 最高 500 英鎊罰款並口頭申誡
options_zh.B: 無限額罰款，且可判處最長 2 年有期徒刑
options_zh.C: 吊銷機動車駕照 30 天
options_zh.D: 僅沒收個人手動工具

explanation_en: Breaches of health and safety duties can result in unlimited fines and prison sentences of up to 2 years for individuals in the Crown Court.
explanation_zh: 在皇家法院審理的重大健康與安全犯罪中，違法個人可被判處無上限罰金及最長 2 年監禁。
source_reference: Health and Safety (Offences) Act 2008; HASWA 1974 Section 33

content_en: According to the Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations 1992, who must bear the financial cost of mandatory PPE provided to an employee?
content_zh: 根據《1992年工作個人防護裝備條例》，僱員作業所需的強制性個人防護裝備 (PPE)，費用由誰全額承擔？

options_en.A: The employee via a payroll deduction
options_en.B: The employer completely free of charge

options_zh.A: 由僱員通過工資扣除承擔
options_zh.B: 由僱主完全免費提供，嚴禁收費
options_zh.C: 由總包工會出資
options_zh.D: 由工人和客戶各承擔 50%

explanation_en: Employers are legally prohibited from charging employees for mandatory PPE required for safe site working.
explanation_zh: 法律明文嚴禁僱主向員工收取或變相扣除任何因安全生產所需的個人防護用品費用。
source_reference: PPE at Work Regulations 1992 Section 9

content_en: What European / British Standard specifies the safety requirements and impact rating for safety footwear fitted with 200 Joule protective toecaps?
content_zh: 哪一項英國/歐洲標準規範了具備 200 焦耳抗衝擊鋼頭或複合材質安全鞋的技術要求？

options_en.B: BS EN 397

options_zh.A: BS EN ISO 20345
options_zh.B: BS EN 397
options_zh.C: BS EN 166

explanation_en: BS EN ISO 20345 specifies requirements for safety footwear equipped with 200J toecaps and slip resistance.
explanation_zh: BS EN ISO 20345 是安全鞋的統一標準，規定鞋頭抗衝擊能量須達 200 焦耳，抗壓負荷達 15,000 牛頓。
source_reference: BS EN ISO 20345 Personal protective equipment - Safety footwear

content_en: Which optical filter shade is typically required for oxy-acetylene or high-temperature brazing under BS EN 169?
content_zh: 根據 BS EN 169 標準，進行氧乙炔或高溫火焰硬釬焊時，護目鏡鏡片通常需要幾號濾光遮光等級？

options_en.B: Shade 4 to 5

options_zh.A: 1 號 (全透明)
options_zh.B: 4 號至 5 號 (Shade 4-5)
options_zh.C: 10 號至 12 號 (電弧焊用)
options_zh.D: 14 號極深色

explanation_en: Gas welding and brazing produces infrared and visible glare requiring filter shades 4 to 5 under BS EN 169.
explanation_zh: 氣體焊接與硬釬焊時產生強烈的紅外輻射與眩光，BS EN 169 規定應選用 4 至 5 號遮光鏡片。
source_reference: BS EN 169 Eye protection - Filters for welding

content_en: When cutting or chasing dense masonry walls with an angle grinder to recess pipework, what respiratory protective equipment (RPE) rating is required to guard against respirable crystalline silica (RCS)?
content_zh: 使用角磨機在磚牆或混凝土牆上開槽埋設管道時，為防範微細可吸入晶體矽塵 (RCS)，必須佩戴何種防護等級的防塵口罩？

options_en.B: FFP2 disposable paper mask

options_zh.A: FFP1 普通防塵口罩
options_zh.B: FFP2 一次性紙質口罩
options_zh.C: FFP3 級別高規格防護口罩（或 P3 動力送風過濾呼吸器）
options_zh.D: 日常純棉防風口罩

explanation_en: HSE silica guidelines mandate FFP3 respirators (assigned protection factor 20) with dust extraction when cutting silica-bearing materials.
explanation_zh: HSE 矽塵防護規範嚴格要求，在進行混凝土開槽作業時必須佩戴 FFP3 級別口罩並配合水霧或吸塵裝置。
source_reference: HSE Construction Dust CIS36; HSE EH40

content_en: What is the statutory requirement before an employee is permitted to wear a tight-fitting face mask (such as FFP3) on site?
content_zh: 在現場允許工人佩戴緊密貼合型防護面罩（如 FFP3）之前，依法必須完成何種測試認證？

options_en.B: Face fit testing (qualitative or quantitative)

options_zh.A: 現場血壓測量
options_zh.B: 密合度面部貼合測試 (Face Fit Testing)
options_zh.C: 眼睛虹膜顏色檢測
options_zh.D: 手部握力測試

explanation_en: COSHH requires all users of tight-fitting RPE to pass an accredited Face Fit Test to verify an effective facial seal.
explanation_zh: COSHH 法規強制要求，所有佩戴緊合型呼吸防護面罩的人員必須通過由具備資質機構執行的臉型密合測試。
source_reference: HSE INDG479 Guidance on respiratory protective equipment (RPE) fit testing

content_en: Under the hierarchy of hazard control, which of the following is considered the least effective control measure and should only be used as a last resort?
content_zh: 在職業健康安全的「危害控制層次 (Hierarchy of Control)」體系中，哪一項被列為最末端、最不得已時才採用的防護手段？

options_en.B: Engineering controls

options_zh.A: 從源頭消除危險 (Elimination)
options_zh.B: 工程控制措施 (Engineering Controls)
options_zh.C: 管理規章與警示 (Administrative Controls)
options_zh.D: 個人防護裝備 (PPE)

explanation_en: PPE is at the very bottom of the hierarchy because it only protects the individual wearer and relies entirely on correct fit and compliance.
explanation_zh: PPE 處於控制層次的最底層，因為它不能消除現場危害，完全依賴於使用者的正確佩戴，一旦失效危險直接降臨。
source_reference: Management of Health and Safety at Work Regs 1999; HSE INDG163

content_en: What type of protective glove material should be avoided when using hot blowlamps due to melting onto the operative's skin?
content_zh: 在使用高溫噴燈動火作業時，嚴禁佩戴哪種材質的手套，因其遇高溫極易融化粘連在皮膚上造成嚴重深部灼傷？

options_en.B: Synthetic nitrile or nylon gloves

options_zh.A: 重型牛皮焊接長筒手套
options_zh.B: 丁腈橡膠 (Nitrile) 或尼龍合成纖維手套
options_zh.C: 編織凱夫拉 (Kevlar) 耐高溫手套
options_zh.D: 標準牛皮勞保手套

explanation_en: Synthetic materials (nylon, polyester, nitrile) melt under heat, causing deep, horrific burn trauma to hands.
explanation_zh: 尼龍、丁腈等合成化纖材質遇明火或炙熱管道會劇烈融化收縮並烙印在皮膚上，造成嚴重的三度灼傷。
source_reference: HSE INDG330 Selecting protective gloves

content_en: What safety marking on a construction hard hat confirms compliance with the European/British impact and penetration standard BS EN 397?
content_zh: 建築安全帽內部的合格標識中，哪一項代表其符合歐洲/英國標準 BS EN 397 的抗衝擊和防穿刺要求？

options_en.A: CE or UKCA mark with BS EN 397
options_en.B: ISO 9001 only

options_zh.A: 帶有 BS EN 397 字樣的 CE 或 UKCA 標識
options_zh.B: 僅 ISO 9001 標識
options_zh.C: WRAS 水事認證徽標
options_zh.D: Gas Safe 三角安全徽標

explanation_en: Industrial safety helmets must bear CE / UKCA certification to BS EN 397, indicating standard shock absorption and penetration resistance.
explanation_zh: 工業用防護安全帽必須具有符合 BS EN 397 的 CE/UKCA 壓印標識，確保其通過頂部衝擊和鋼錐穿刺檢驗。
source_reference: BS EN 397 Industrial safety helmets

content_en: Under the Work at Height Regulations 2005, what is the mandatory correct leaning angle for a portable leaning ladder?
content_zh: 根據《2005年高空作業條例》，便攜式直梯與水平地面之間的標準法定傾斜角度是多少？

options_en.B: 60 degrees (1:2 ratio)

explanation_en: The standard safety ratio is 1 out for every 4 up, creating an angle of approximately 75 degrees to horizontal.
explanation_zh: 便攜梯標準安全擺放比例為「上 4 靠 1」（1:4 比例），與地面夾角約為 75 度，能最大限度防止向外滑脫或向後翻倒。
source_reference: Work at Height Regulations 2005; HSE INDG455

content_en: How far above a landing platform or roof edge must a leaning access ladder extend to provide an operative with a safe handhold?
content_zh: 便攜式直梯在作為通往屋頂或操作平台的通道時，梯頂高出著陸邊緣的安全手扶延伸高度至少應為多少？

options_en.B: At least 0.6 meters (2 rungs)

options_zh.A: 至少 0.3 米 (1 個踏棍)
options_zh.B: 至少 0.6 米 (2 個踏棍)
options_zh.C: 至少 1.0 米 (約 3 至 5 個踏棍)
options_zh.D: 至少 2.5 米

explanation_en: Ladders used for access must extend at least 1.0 meter (or 5 rungs) above the landing to provide a safe, secure handhold during transition.
explanation_zh: 直梯作為上下通道時，梯頂必須高出平台平面至少 1.0 米（約 5 級踏棍），確保工人在跨越著陸時有牢固的手把手支撐。
source_reference: Work at Height Regs 2005; HSE INDG455

content_en: When ascending or descending an access ladder, what is the 'three points of contact' rule?
content_zh: 在上下直梯作業時，安全規程中強調的「三點接觸 (Three points of contact)」原則是指什麼？

options_en.A: Two feet and one hand, or two hands and one foot, must always be in contact with the ladder
options_en.B: Two knees and one elbow touching
options_en.C: Both feet and the chest leaning against the rungs
options_en.D: One foot and a safety lanyard clip only

options_zh.A: 任何時刻必須保持雙手一腳或雙腳一手緊密接觸梯身
options_zh.B: 雙膝和一側肘關節接觸梯子
options_zh.C: 雙腳站立且胸部貼緊踏步
options_zh.D: 僅一隻腳踏梯且安全帶掛鉤固定

explanation_en: The operative must maintain continuous contact with two hands and one foot, or two feet and one hand, keeping hands free of heavy loads.
explanation_zh: 攀爬時手中不得搬運重物，身體必須時刻保持至少有三個肢體支點（如雙腳單手或雙手單腳）緊扣梯框或踏步。
source_reference: HSE INDG455 Safe use of ladders and stepladders

content_en: What is the maximum permissible total load (operative plus tools) for a standard BS EN 131 Professional ladder?
content_zh: 符合英國/歐洲最新 BS EN 131 專業級 (Professional) 標準的施工專用梯具，其最大額定安全承重（人員加隨身工具）是多少？

options_en.B: 125 kg

options_zh.A: 100 kg
options_zh.B: 125 kg
options_zh.C: 150 kg
options_zh.D: 250 kg

explanation_en: BS EN 131 Professional ladders are certified for a maximum total static load rating of 150 kg.
explanation_zh: BS EN 131 工業/專業級梯具的標準最大工作負荷評定為 150 kg（包含操作人員體重及隨身攜帶工具）。
source_reference: BS EN 131 Ladders standard; C&G Unit 201

content_en: What is the maximum height-to-base ratio permitted for an untied indoor mobile aluminium tower scaffold according to BS EN 1004?
content_zh: 根據 BS EN 1004 標準，未附著於牆體的室內移動式鋁合金快裝腳手架塔架，其允許的最大「高寬比 (Height to base ratio)」是多少？
explanation_en: BS EN 1004 sets the maximum height to narrowest base dimension ratio at 3.5:1 indoors and 3.0:1 outdoors to prevent overturning.
explanation_zh: BS EN 1004 規範明確要求室內無附著獨立塔架的高寬比最大不得超過 3.5:1（室外受風載影響限制在 3.0:1），否則必須加裝外撐支腿。
source_reference: BS EN 1004 / PASMA Safety Guidelines

content_en: What safety rule must always be observed before attempting to reposition or wheel an aluminium mobile tower scaffold to a new pipe run?
content_zh: 在推動或移動便攜式鋁合金快裝腳手架到新的管道施工點之前，必須嚴格執行的第一安全準則是什麼？

options_en.A: Tie all safety harnesses to the top handrail
options_en.B: Ensure all personnel and loose materials have descended and the tower is completely empty
options_en.C: Keep one plumber on top to guide clearance

options_zh.A: 將所有安全帶掛扣緊鎖在頂部護欄上
options_zh.B: 確保塔架頂部所有人員及工具物料全部撤離著陸，塔架必須完全清空
options_zh.C: 留一名工人在頂端引導天花板障礙物間隙
options_zh.D: 僅鬆開兩側的外支撐腿即可推動

explanation_en: No person or loose equipment is ever permitted on a mobile tower while it is being pushed or relocated.
explanation_zh: 移動腳手架時絕對嚴禁上方有人員停留或放置鬆散工具物料，以防在推動越過地坪縫隙時重心失穩造成坍塌墜亡。
source_reference: PASMA Code of Practice; Work at Height Regs 2005

content_en: According to the Work at Height Regulations 2005, what is the minimum height of a main guardrail on a construction working platform?
content_zh: 根據《2005年高空作業條例》，施工腳手架作業平台的主防護欄杆（Main Guardrail）頂部距操作台面的最低法定高度是多少？

options_en.B: 750 mm

options_zh.A: 450 mm
options_zh.B: 750 mm
options_zh.C: 950 mm (最低標準)

explanation_en: Schedule 3 specifies that main guardrails must be at least 950 mm above the working platform surface (with an intermediate rail and toe-board).
explanation_zh: 法規附錄3明確規定，主護欄頂部高度不得低於 950 mm，中間空隙不得超過 470 mm，且必須配置高度不小於 150 mm 的踢腳擋板。
source_reference: Work at Height Regulations 2005, Schedule 3

content_en: What is the statutory purpose of a 150mm toe-board fitted around the perimeter of an elevated working platform?
content_zh: 在腳手架或高空作業平台四周安裝高度不小於 150mm 的踢腳擋板（Toe-board），其法定核心作用是什麼？

options_en.A: To provide a resting step for operatives' feet
options_en.B: To prevent hand tools, pipe fittings, and rubble from being kicked off the edge onto people below

options_zh.A: 為工人作業時提供歇腳支撐
options_zh.B: 防止扳手、管件、碎磚等落物被腳踢落墜下砸傷下方人員
options_zh.C: 使操作平台保持防水密封
options_zh.D: 用以固定起重滑輪

explanation_en: Toe-boards prevent tools, off-cuts, and debris from rolling or being kicked off the platform, protecting persons working below.
explanation_zh: 踢腳板是防止高空落物傷人的關鍵屏障，能有效阻擋散落工具、截斷管頭或建築碎屑滑出平台外沿。
source_reference: Work at Height Regulations 2005, Schedule 3

content_en: Under BS EN 3, what colour identifier is placed on a dry powder fire extinguisher?
content_zh: 根據 BS EN 3 標準，乾粉 (Dry Powder) 滅火器在標準紅色瓶身外附帶的輔助色標塊是什麼顏色？

options_en.B: Cream

options_zh.A: 黑色 (Black)
options_zh.B: 奶油色 (Cream)
options_zh.C: 法國藍 (French Blue)
options_zh.D: 金黃色 (Canary Yellow)

explanation_en: BS EN 3 assigns color-coded panels on red extinguisher bodies: Blue = Dry Powder, Cream = Foam, Black = CO2, Yellow = Wet Chemical.
explanation_zh: BS EN 3 規定滅火器主瓶身均為信號紅，功能色標塊規定：藍色為乾粉、奶油色為泡沫、黑色為二氧化碳、金黃色為濕式化學劑。
source_reference: BS EN 3 Fire Extinguishers; C&G Unit 201

content_en: Which type of fire extinguisher is strictly prohibited from being used on live electrical equipment and distribution boards?
content_zh: 哪一種類型的滅火器絕對嚴禁用於撲救通電的配電盤或電氣設備火災？

options_en.B: Dry Powder

options_zh.A: 二氧化碳 (CO2)
options_zh.B: ABC 乾粉
options_zh.C: 水基 / 清水滅火器 (Water)
options_zh.D: 全氟己酮潔淨氣體

explanation_en: Water is an electrical conductor and spraying it onto live electrical conductors presents an immediate risk of lethal electrocution.
explanation_zh: 清水滅火器噴出的水柱具有強導電性，向通電設備噴射會瞬間導致強電流經水柱回流至操作者身體造成致命觸電。
source_reference: BS 5306-8 Fire extinguishing installations; C&G Unit 201

content_en: What classification under BS EN 2 describes a fire involving flammable gases such as propane, butane, or natural gas?
content_zh: 根據 BS EN 2 火災分類標準，涉及丙烷、丁烷或天然氣等易燃氣體燃燒的火災屬於哪一類火災？

options_en.B: Class B

options_zh.A: A 類火災 (固體)
options_zh.B: B 類火災 (液體)
options_zh.C: C 類火災 (氣體)
options_zh.D: D 類火災 (金屬)

explanation_en: Class C fires involve flammable gases including LPG (propane/butane) and natural gas (methane).
explanation_zh: BS EN 2 定義：A 類為固體有機物，B 類為易燃液體，C 類為易燃氣體，D 類為可燃金屬，F 類為烹飪動植物油脂。
source_reference: BS EN 2 Classification of fires

content_en: Under the Manual Handling Operations Regulations 1992, what is the guideline maximum lifting weight for a male operative when the load is held close to the body at knuckle height?
content_zh: 根據《1992年人工搬運作業條例》，成年男性在貨物貼近軀幹且處於指關節高度時，推薦的最大常規搬運基準負荷是多少？

options_en.B: 20 kg

options_zh.A: 10 kg
options_zh.B: 20 kg
options_zh.C: 25 kg
options_zh.D: 40 kg

explanation_en: The HSE manual handling guideline lifting filter recommends 25 kg as the maximum load for a male at waist/knuckle height close to the body.
explanation_zh: HSE 人工搬運評估指標指出，成年男性在貼近軀幹、位於關節高度時的推薦起吊過濾數值為 25 kg（女性在同等位置為 16 kg）。
source_reference: HSE L23 Manual Handling Operations; C&G Unit 201

content_en: What four key ergonomic elements are represented by the acronym TILE in manual handling risk assessments?
content_zh: 在人工搬運作業風險評估中，核心評估維度縮寫「TILE」分別代表哪四個要素？

options_en.B: Task, Individual, Load, Environment

options_zh.A: 時間、傷害、責任、費用
options_zh.B: 作業任務 (Task)、個人能力 (Individual)、負載特性 (Load)、作業環境 (Environment)
options_zh.C: 工具、檢查、起重、標高
options_zh.D: 毒性、絕緣、長度、能量

explanation_en: TILE stands for Task (movements, twisting), Individual (fitness, pregnancy), Load (weight, shape), and Environment (space, lighting, floor).
explanation_zh: TILE 是 HSE 評估人工搬運的法定框架：Task（任務性質）、Individual（操作者素質）、Load（重量尺寸體積）、Environment（地面空間環境）。
source_reference: HSE L23 Manual handling guidance; C&G Unit 201

content_en: What is the first action an operative should take if a colleague suffers a serious electric shock and is still in direct contact with a live 230V conductor?
content_zh: 若現場發現同事觸電且身體仍緊緊粘連在 230V 帶電導體上，救援人員必須執行的第一步是甚麼？

options_en.A: Grab their wrist with bare hands and pull with maximum force
options_en.B: Immediately safely isolate the electrical supply at the main switch or unplug the equipment
options_en.C: Throw cold water onto the victim

options_zh.A: 徒手一把抓住其手腕使出全力拉開
options_zh.B: 立即切斷總電源開關或迅速拔掉電源插頭徹底斷電
options_zh.C: 端起一盆冷水潑向觸電者以促其清醒
options_zh.D: 轉身尋找急救箱包紮傷口

explanation_en: Never touch a victim while in contact with a live circuit. Safely isolate the electrical source immediately or push away with a non-conductive object.
explanation_zh: 嚴禁徒手直接觸碰觸電者本體！必須立即斷開總閘或插頭；若無法立即斷電，必須使用乾燥木棒等絕緣物將帶電體挑開。
source_reference: HSE INDG354 Electrical safety; BS 7671

content_en: What must a plumbing contractor maintain on site under the Health and Safety (First-Aid) Regulations 1981?
content_zh: 根據《1981年健康與安全（急救）條例》，水暖承包商在作業現場必須配備的最基本法定應急資源是什麼？

options_en.A: A fully-stocked statutory first aid kit and an appointed person or qualified first aider
options_en.B: A portable hyperbaric oxygen chamber
options_en.C: An inventory of prescription pain relief drugs

options_zh.A: 備有充足應急物資的法定急救箱，並指定現場急救負責人或合格急救員
options_zh.B: 便攜式高壓氧艙
options_zh.C: 各類處方止痛藥品庫存
options_zh.D: 現場外科手術專用帳篷

explanation_en: Employers must provide adequate first aid equipment (a stocked first-aid container) and appoint personnel to take charge in an emergency.
explanation_zh: 僱主必須配備符合規範的急救用品箱，並落實應急負責人（Appointed Person）或持有急救證照的人員。
source_reference: Health and Safety (First-Aid) Regulations 1981, Reg 3

content_en: When storing oxy-acetylene and propane cylinders on a site vehicle, how must the cylinders be legally positioned during transit?
content_zh: 水暖工使用工程麵包車運輸氧氣、乙炔或丙烷氣瓶時，法規要求氣瓶在行駛途中必須如何妥善固定？

options_en.A: Laid horizontally stacked loosely on the floorboards
options_en.B: Stored upright, secured firmly with strapping, and with cylinder valves tightly shut
options_en.C: Inverted upside down to keep the valve oiled

options_zh.A: 水平橫置並鬆散平鋪在車廂底板上
options_zh.B: 直立垂直放置，使用專用綁帶牢牢固定，並緊閉瓶閥擰上保護帽
options_zh.C: 倒立放置以保證閥芯潤滑
options_zh.D: 密封封裝在密不透風的紙箱內

explanation_en: LPG and acetylene cylinders must always be transported vertically upright, firmly secured against movement, with adequate vehicle ventilation.
explanation_zh: 可燃氣瓶及氧氣瓶在運輸中必須直立固定，防止液相外洩或滾動撞擊，且車廂必須具備良好的通風換氣百葉。
source_reference: BCGA Guidance Note GN27; Carriage of Dangerous Goods Regs

content_en: What document generated before a hazardous task details the step-by-step procedure required to execute the work safely?
content_zh: 在施工單位展開高風險作業前，詳細列明施工步驟、潛在危險防範措施及安全操作流程的指導性文件被稱作什麼？

options_en.B: Method Statement (Safe System of Work - RAMS)

options_zh.A: 物料簽收單 (Delivery Note)
options_zh.B: 安全施工工法說明書 (Method Statement / RAMS)
options_zh.C: 水務法規認證單
options_zh.D: 開工備案通知書

explanation_en: A Method Statement sets out the specific safe sequence of work and precautions identified in the risk assessment.
explanation_zh: 施工方法說明書 (Method Statement，通常與風險評估組合成 RAMS) 詳細規範了每一步作業的具體安全步驟與防護責任。
source_reference: HSE Safe Systems of Work; C&G Unit 201

content_en: What does the acronym HSE stand for within the UK workplace regulatory framework?
content_zh: 在英國工作場所法定監管體系中，縮寫 HSE 代表哪一個政府主管執法機構？

options_en.B: Health and Safety Executive

options_zh.A: 衛生與環境局
options_zh.B: 健康與安全執行局 (Health and Safety Executive)
options_zh.C: 住房安全執法處
options_zh.D: 公路與市政工程局

explanation_en: The HSE is the national independent regulator for work-related health, safety and illness in Great Britain.
explanation_zh: HSE (Health and Safety Executive) 是英國法定的國家級工作場所健康、安全及職業病防治獨立執法監管機構。
source_reference: HASWA 1974 Section 10

content_en: Under HASWA 1974 Section 2, what must an employer prepare and bring to the notice of all employees if they employ 5 or more staff?
content_zh: 根據 HASWA 1974 第2條，僱主在僱用 5 名或以上員工時，必須親自編制並向全體員工公示告知的法定文件是什麼？

options_en.A: A written Health and Safety Policy statement and organisation arrangements
options_en.B: A detailed company profit share report

options_zh.A: 書面的健康與安全方針聲明 (Health and Safety Policy) 及組織職責細則
options_zh.B: 公司年度利潤分配報告
options_zh.C: 現場停車位輪流分配表
options_zh.D: 養老金投資組合摘要

explanation_en: Section 2(3) of HASWA mandates that employers with 5 or more staff must have a written safety policy statement.
explanation_zh: HASWA 第2(3)條規定，5人及以上僱主必須制定並更新書面安全方針聲明，詳細闡述公司安全承諾、管理層級與應急安排。
source_reference: HASWA 1974 Section 2(3)

content_en: Under CDM 2015, what must the Client ensure is provided to designers and contractors before tender or construction begins?
content_zh: 在 CDM 2015 規定下，業主（Client）在招標或施工開始前，法定義務必須向設計師和承包商提供何種信息？

options_en.B: CSCS registration fee payment

options_zh.A: 施工前現場已知安全信息 (Pre-construction Information - PCI)
options_zh.B: CSCS 工卡註冊繳費證明
options_zh.C: 工具租賃發票回執
options_zh.D: 建築保險賠付憑單

explanation_en: The Client must assemble and share Pre-construction Information, including existing asbestos surveys, buried services, and site hazards.
explanation_zh: 業主必須搜集並提供施工前信息（PCI），包含既有石棉勘查報告、地下隱蔽管線走向、結構荷載限制等關鍵背景安全資料。
source_reference: CDM Regulations 2015, Reg 4

content_en: Under CDM 2015, who holds the ultimate legal responsibility to assemble the final Health and Safety File upon project handover?
content_zh: 根據 CDM 2015，在工程竣工交付業主時，哪一個法定責任方負責彙總編制《健康與安全檔案 (Health and Safety File)》？

options_en.B: The Principal Designer (or Principal Contractor if PD appointment finishes earlier)

options_zh.A: 地方議會規劃官員
options_zh.B: 主設計師 (Principal Designer，若其任期提前結束則由總承包商接替完成)
options_zh.C: 現場學徒工
options_zh.D: 設備製造商

explanation_en: The Principal Designer must prepare the Health and Safety File containing information required for future maintenance, cleaning, or alteration.
explanation_zh: 主設計師依法負責整理健康安全檔案，收錄設備運維手冊、暗埋管線竣工圖及危險提示，供日後維護裝修使用。
source_reference: CDM Regulations 2015, Reg 12(8)

content_en: Under RIDDOR 2013, how long must an employer keep written records of all reportable accidents, occupational diseases, and dangerous occurrences?
content_zh: 根據 RIDDOR 2013，僱主依法必須將所有法例要求申報的工傷事故、職業病和危險事件記錄妥善保存至少幾年？

options_en.B: 1 year

options_zh.A: 6 個月
options_zh.B: 1 年
options_zh.C: 至少 3 年

explanation_en: RIDDOR Regulation 12 states employers must keep records of reportable incidents for at least 3 years from the date of the record.
explanation_zh: 法規第12條明文規定，所有按 RIDDOR 申報的事故登記簿（包含事故日期、人員信息、簡述）必須保存歸檔至少 3 年。
source_reference: RIDDOR 2013, Reg 12

content_en: What is an HSE Fee for Intervention (FFI)?
content_zh: 什麼是英國 HSE 實施的「干預收費機制 (Fee for Intervention - FFI)」？

options_en.A: A tax on buying brass fittings
options_en.B: A fee billed to a dutyholder when an HSE inspector identifies a material breach of health and safety law
options_en.C: A grant awarded to safe plumbing companies

options_zh.A: 購買黃銅管件徵收的附加稅
options_zh.B: 當 HSE 督察在檢查中發現實質性違法時，向違法責任單位按小時計收的執法成本費用
options_zh.C: 獎勵給優秀施工企業的政府補貼
options_zh.D: 學徒培訓優惠券

explanation_en: Under FFI, if an inspector discovers a material breach, the business must reimburse HSE for the full cost of inspection, investigation, and enforcement.
explanation_zh: 根據干預收費體系，一旦執法人員查明重大安全違規，HSE 將依據其調查、取證和出具處罰所消耗的工時按標準費率直接向企業收取費用。
source_reference: HSE Fee for Intervention guide; HASWA Section 13

content_en: Under the Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations 1992, what basic welfare facilities must an employer ensure are available on site?
content_zh: 根據《1992年工作場所（健康、安全及福利）條例》，僱主在施工現場必須確保提供的法定基本福利設施包括什麼？

options_en.A: Sanitary conveniences, washing facilities with hot/cold water, wholesome drinking water, and accommodation for clothing/rest
options_en.B: Swimming pool, gym, and private cinema

options_zh.A: 衛生間、帶冷熱水的洗手池、衛生飲用水以及更衣休息場所
options_zh.B: 游泳池、健身房和私人電影院
options_zh.C: 三道菜的餐廳和酒吧
options_zh.D: 乾洗服務和桑拿室

explanation_en: Regulation 20-25 requires clean toilets, washing facilities with soap and towels, drinking water, and a sheltered area to rest and eat.
explanation_zh: 該福利條例第20-25條嚴格規定，現場必須具備水沖廁所、潔淨洗手設施、飲用水、更衣及避雨休息取暖場所。
source_reference: Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regs 1992

content_en: Under the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998, what registration body is statutory for all domestic gas engineers in the UK?
content_zh: 根據《1998年燃氣安全（安裝與使用）條例》，在英國境內從事任何家用燃氣設備安裝維修的人員，法律上必須加入哪一個法定註冊機構？

options_en.B: Gas Safe Register

options_zh.A: NICEIC
options_zh.B: 燃氣安全註冊機構 (Gas Safe Register)
options_zh.C: OFTEC 燃油工程協會
options_zh.D: CIPHE 英國特許水暖工程協會

explanation_en: Gas Safe Register is the official statutory registration body under HSE regulations. It is illegal to work on gas without being Gas Safe registered.
explanation_zh: Gas Safe Register 是英國政府 HSE 唯一法定的燃氣行業準入認證機構，無證動火接駁或拆裝燃氣管道屬於重大刑事犯罪。
source_reference: Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regs 1998, Reg 3

content_en: Under the Confined Spaces Regulations 1997, what essential atmospheric test must be performed continuously before and during entry into a deep sewer chamber?
content_zh: 根據《1997年受限空間條例》，水暖工在進入深層污水排水檢查井作業前及作業過程中，必須持續使用多氣體檢測儀檢測哪些氣體？

options_en.A: Oxygen level, flammable gases (methane), toxic gases (hydrogen sulphide, carbon monoxide)
options_en.B: Nitrogen only

options_zh.A: 氧氣濃度、易燃爆炸性氣體 (甲烷)、有毒有害氣體 (硫化氫、一氧化碳)
options_zh.B: 僅檢測氮氣
options_zh.C: 氦氣與氬氣
options_zh.D: 僅檢測氟氣

explanation_en: Multi-gas detectors monitor oxygen content (must be ~20.9%), flammable gases (%LEL for methane), and toxic gases (H2S and CO).
explanation_zh: 多合一氣體檢測儀必須連續監測氧氣含量（確保不缺氧不富氧）、爆炸性甲烷 (CH4) 以及致命毒氣硫化氫 (H2S) 和一氧化碳 (CO)。
source_reference: Confined Spaces Regs 1997; HSE L101

content_en: What is the first step in a dynamic site risk assessment when arriving at a customer's domestic property?
content_zh: 水暖工抵達客戶私人住宅現場時，開展動態風險評估（Dynamic Risk Assessment）的第一步是什麼？

options_en.A: Unload all tools immediately into the front hallway
options_en.B: Visually inspect the premises for immediate hazards (pets, loose floorboards, leaks, electrical risks, asbestos)
options_en.C: Present the customer with an invoice
options_en.D: Disconnect the main incoming electrical fuse

options_zh.A: 立即將所有笨重工具全部卸載到前門走廊
options_zh.B: 目視巡視現場識別即時危險源（寵物、鬆動木地板、漏水潮濕、電線破損、疑似石棉）
options_zh.C: 立刻向客戶出具最終請款發票
options_zh.D: 直接拔下建築物的進戶供電主保險絲

explanation_en: Dynamic risk assessment starts with an immediate visual survey to identify active hazards, aggressive pets, unstable flooring, or electrical defects.
explanation_zh: 動態風險評估的核心在於進入陌生環境後，首先通過觀察確認現場即時危險（如地面积水、裸露線頭、鬆動踏板、受驚寵物），並及時規避。
source_reference: HSE 5 Steps to Risk Assessment; C&G Unit 201

content_en: What class of hearing protector reduces noise exposure across all frequencies by mechanically covering the entire external ear?
content_zh: 哪一種類型的聽力護具通過完全罩住外耳廓的機械方式，在各音頻頻段提供全面的噪聲衰減防護？

options_en.B: Ear defenders / Ear muffs

options_zh.A: 泡沫壓製一次性耳塞
options_zh.B: 罩耳式防噪耳罩 (Ear Defenders / Ear Muffs)
options_zh.C: 普通音樂藍牙耳機
options_zh.D: 棉花球

explanation_en: Ear defenders completely enclose the ears with acoustic seals, providing broad noise attenuation and ease of visual inspection on site.
explanation_zh: 耳罩（Ear Defenders）通過吸音海綿完整包裹耳部周圍骨骼，密封效果直觀易於現場督導，能在大噪聲環境下提供持續保護。
source_reference: BS EN 352-1 Hearing protectors - Ear-muffs

content_en: What European marking on an electrical insulating glove confirms it is tested and safe for working near low voltage circuits up to 1000V AC?
content_zh: 絕緣電工手套上的哪種國際等級標識，證明其經過高壓耐受檢驗並可在最高 1000V AC 帶電迴路附近安全使用？

options_en.A: Class 00 (up to 500V) or Class 0 (up to 1000V) under BS EN 60903
options_en.B: Category 1 garden glove

options_zh.A: 符合 BS EN 60903 的 Class 00 (最高500V) 或 Class 0 (最高1000V) 標識
options_zh.B: Category 1 園藝手套
options_zh.C: BS 7593 阻垢劑檢驗印章
options_zh.D: WRAS 水質認證標籤

explanation_en: BS EN 60903 Class 0 gloves are rated for working with live electrical components up to 1000V AC.
explanation_zh: 根據 BS EN 60903，Class 0 級電工橡膠手套耐壓測試達 5000V，可在最高 1000V AC 交流低壓環境下提供接觸防護。
source_reference: BS EN 60903 Live working - Electrical insulating gloves

content_en: Why should disposable earplugs never be inserted into the ear canal with hands heavily coated in plumbing flux or pipe jointing paste?
content_zh: 為什麼水暖工在手部沾滿焊劑（Flux）或螺紋密封膠泥時，絕對不能直接捏搓並將一次性耳塞塞入耳道？

options_en.A: The earplugs will expand too quickly
options_en.B: Acidic chemicals cause severe chemical dermatitis, inner ear inflammation, and chemical burns inside the ear canal
options_en.C: The noise reduction will increase too much
options_en.D: It permanently changes the colour of the earplug

options_zh.A: 耳塞會過快膨脹失效
options_zh.B: 焊劑中的酸性化學成分會進入狹窄耳道，引發嚴重的耳道化學灼傷、接觸性皮炎及感染
options_zh.C: 會使得降噪係數過高聽不到聲音
options_zh.D: 僅僅會使耳塞表面變色難看

explanation_en: Soldering fluxes contain zinc chloride and acids; transferring them into the ear canal causes acute chemical dermatitis and hearing tissue damage.
explanation_zh: 焊劑含有氯化鋅及強酸成分，用髒手揉捏耳塞會將強烈腐蝕性化學品帶入耳道黏膜，造成不可逆的化學燒傷和耳膜感染。
source_reference: COSHH in Plumbing; HSE INDG363

content_en: What is the designated shelf-life replacement interval for a standard plastic industrial safety helmet that has not received any direct impact?
content_zh: 一個外表未受過任何外力衝擊的標準塑料工業安全帽，常規環境下的建議更換年限通常是多久？

options_en.B: Typically 3 to 5 years from date of manufacture (check manufacturer stamp)
options_en.D: Indefinite as long as it has no scratches

options_zh.A: 1 年
options_zh.B: 自生產之日起通常為 3 至 5 年（以頭盔內部模壓生產日期標籤為準）
options_zh.D: 只要外殼沒有裂縫即可永久使用

explanation_en: UV radiation and chemical vapours degrade polymers; manufacturers specify replacement within 3 to 5 years from date of moulding.
explanation_zh: 紫外線、汗液及空氣中的化學煙塵會使塑料外殼分子鏈老化脆變，製造商通常規定自出廠日期起 3 到 5 年必須強制更換。
source_reference: BS EN 397; RoSPA Safety Helmet Guidelines

content_en: When handling heavy 4-meter lengths of cast iron or commercial steel pipework, what glove property certified under BS EN 388 is critical?
content_zh: 在現場搬運和裝卸重型 4 米長鑄鐵或厚壁無縫鋼管時，根據 BS EN 388 機械防護標準，手套的哪一項性能指標最為關鍵？

options_en.A: High abrasion and tear resistance (mechanical hazard protection)
options_en.B: Thermal insulation against -50°C liquid nitrogen

options_zh.A: 高等級耐磨損 (Abrasion) 與抗撕裂 (Tear) 機械防護等級
options_zh.B: 防範 -50°C 液氮的超低溫防護
options_zh.C: 乳膠過敏隔離性能
options_zh.D: 內置電加熱保暖線圈

explanation_en: BS EN 388 rates protection against abrasion, blade cut, tear, and puncture. Handling heavy pipes requires high abrasion and puncture ratings.
explanation_zh: BS EN 388 規範了手套抗磨損、防割、抗撕裂及防穿刺四項機械指標，搬運粗糙金屬重管需要極高的抗磨與抗撕咬強度。
source_reference: BS EN 388 Protective gloves against mechanical risks

content_en: What specific danger arises from wearing loose-fitting neckties, dangling hoodie cords, or unbuttoned cuffs around a power pipe-threading machine?
content_zh: 在電動套絲機（Pipe Threader）高速運轉作業時，水暖工佩戴散落領帶、衛衣帽帶或敞開衣袖會引發何種致命危險？

options_en.A: Drying out the threading cutting oil
options_en.B: Entanglement of loose clothing into rotating chucks, leading to catastrophic limb amputation or fatal crushing

options_zh.A: 導致冷卻切削油過快揮發
options_zh.B: 寬鬆衣物或繩帶被高速旋轉卡盤絞入，引發嚴重的肢體截斷、頭部絞傷或致命擠壓慘劇
options_zh.C: 使得套絲機電量消耗上升
options_zh.D: 刮花切削出的管螺紋表面

explanation_en: Rotating machinery poses severe entanglement risks. Operators must wear close-fitting clothing with sleeves buttoned and long hair tied back.
explanation_zh: 旋轉動力卡盤具有巨大的旋轉扭矩，寬鬆衣物一旦被捲入，瞬間就能將人體整個拖拽碾壓進去，造成骨折截肢甚至當場死亡。
source_reference: HSE INDG229 Using work equipment safely; PUWER 1998

content_en: What safety device must be fitted to the wheels of a mobile tower scaffold before anyone ascends the access ladder?
content_zh: 在任何人攀登鋁合金移動腳手架之前，其底部萬向腳輪必須啟動何種安全裝置？

options_en.B: Wheel castor brake locks (engaged in locked position)

options_zh.A: 橡膠防濺擋泥板
options_zh.B: 萬向腳輪煞車剎車鎖扣（全部用力踩下鎖定）
options_zh.C: 胎壓實時監測感測器
options_zh.D: 鏈條傳動驅動裝置

explanation_en: All castor wheel brakes must be firmly locked down before climbing or working on an aluminium tower to prevent uncontrolled rolling.
explanation_zh: 在人員登塔或作業前，塔架底部的所有煞車萬向輪必須全部踩下鎖死，嚴格禁止在輪子處於自由轉向或滑動狀態下作業。
source_reference: BS EN 1004; PASMA Operators Code

content_en: When using an extension ladder to reach a flat roof at a height of 6 meters, what horizontal distance should the base of the ladder be placed from the wall?
content_zh: 使用便攜延伸梯通往高度為 6 米的平屋頂時，根據「1:4 安全比例」法則，梯腳距離垂直牆面的水平間距應為多少？

options_en.B: 1.5 meters

explanation_en: Using the 1:4 rule (75-degree angle): Horizontal distance = Vertical height / 4 = 6m / 4 = 1.5 meters.
explanation_zh: 遵循 1:4 比例定理（即地面角約 75 度）：底腳距離 = 垂直高度 ÷ 4 = 6 米 ÷ 4 = 1.5 米。
source_reference: HSE INDG455 Safe use of ladders

content_en: Why should an operative never stand on the top three rungs of an extension ladder?
content_zh: 為什麼水暖工作業時，絕對禁止站立在延伸直梯的最頂端三級踏棍上？

options_en.A: The top rungs are not painted
options_en.B: It leaves no secure handhold, dramatically increasing the risk of overbalancing and catastrophic falling
options_en.C: It breaks the rungs due to lower weight rating

options_zh.A: 頂端踏步通常沒有刷漆標記
options_zh.B: 會導致身體失去可靠的手部抓握支撐點，重心失衡極易造成嚴重的失足高空墜亡
options_zh.C: 頂端踏步的承重標準低會被踩斷
options_zh.D: 會阻擋周圍通風氣流

explanation_en: Standing on the top three rungs eliminates safe handholds and shifts the centre of gravity above the ladder pivot, causing falls.
explanation_zh: 站立在最頂端三階踏棍時，人體軀幹超過了梯架頂部，雙手完全失去握持平衡的依託，極易受氣流或身體微晃而向後倒栽倒地。
source_reference: Work at Height Regulations 2005; HSE INDG455

content_en: When is 'footing' a ladder by a second operative acceptable as the sole method of securing a ladder?
content_zh: 在什麼情況下，由第二名工人在梯腳踩踏梯框（Footing）作為固定直梯的唯一防護手段才是勉強可接受的？

options_en.A: On all ladders over 10 meters height
options_en.B: Only for short duration light work where tying the ladder is genuinely impracticable and the ladder length is under 5 meters
options_en.C: Whenever the plumber is in a hurry
options_en.D: When painting metal roofs in high winds

options_zh.A: 在所有高度超過 10 米的高空大梯作業中
options_zh.B: 僅適用於確無法打釘拉繩固定、作業時間極短（短於30分鐘）且梯長小於5米的輕便作業
options_zh.C: 只要水暖工急於下班即可採用
options_zh.D: 在強風天氣粉刷金屬屋頂時

explanation_en: Footing is the least effective method and is only an acceptable last resort for ladders under 5m during short-duration tasks.
explanation_zh: 人工踩梯是可靠性最低的防護手段，只能在切實無法綁紮固定且作業時間非常短暫（少於30分鐘）、梯子小於5米時作為權宜之計。
source_reference: HSE INDG455 Safe use of ladders and stepladders

content_en: What is the maximum recommended continuous time an operative should work on a ladder before taking a break or changing to a scaffold platform?
content_zh: 水暖工在直梯或人字梯上進行單次持續作業時，HSE 推薦的最長連續作業時間上限是多少？

options_en.B: 30 minutes

options_zh.A: 10 分鐘
options_zh.B: 30 分鐘
options_zh.C: 2 小時
options_zh.D: 4 小時

explanation_en: Ladders are designed for access and short-duration tasks (maximum 30 minutes at a time) to prevent muscle fatigue and loss of balance.
explanation_zh: 梯具在本質上屬於上下通行的通道設備而非作業平台，單次連續作業嚴格限制在 30 分鐘以內，以防肌肉疲勞誘發失足墜落。
source_reference: HSE Work at Height Guide; INDG455

content_en: What PASMA card colour or qualification confirms an operative is formally trained to erect, alter, and dismantle mobile access towers?
content_zh: 在英國建築施工現場，哪一項專業證書（如 PASMA 培訓）證明工人具備合法資質來搭建、改裝和拆卸鋁合金移動腳手架？

options_en.A: PASMA Towers for Users certification card
options_en.B: Driving license Category B
options_en.C: First Aid at Work certificate only
options_en.D: City & Guilds plumbing theory pass sheet only

options_zh.A: PASMA 移動腳手架搭拆考試合格證卡 (PASMA Towers for Users)
options_zh.B: B 類機動車駕駛執照
options_zh.C: 僅紅十字急救員證書
options_zh.D: 水暖理論考試成績單

explanation_en: PASMA (Prefabricated Access Suppliers' and Manufacturers' Association) training proves competence to assemble, inspect, and dismantle towers.
explanation_zh: PASMA 認證是全英公認的腳手架搭拆從業資格證，只有持證人員才有權組裝、安全檢查驗收及拆除移動鋁合金工作平台。
source_reference: PASMA Standard; Work at Height Regulations 2005

content_en: Which type of fire extinguisher is filled with water under pressure containing foaming additives and displays a Cream coloured panel?
content_zh: 哪一種類型的滅火器內部充裝添加了成泡表面活性劑的滅火水溶液，且閥體外壁帶有「奶油色 (Cream)」標識面板？

options_en.B: Carbon Dioxide (CO2)

options_zh.A: AFFF 水成膜泡沫滅火器 (Aqueous Film Forming Foam)
options_zh.B: 二氧化碳滅火器 (CO2)
options_zh.C: 乾粉滅火器
options_zh.D: 哈龍滅火器

explanation_en: AFFF foam extinguishers have a cream-coloured label. They extinguish Class A solids and Class B flammable liquid fires by smothering the fuel.
explanation_zh: 水成膜泡沫滅火器標識色為奶油色，能撲滅 A 類固體火災以及 B 類易燃液體火災，主要原理是在液面形成水膜隔絕氧氣窒息滅火。
source_reference: BS EN 3; BS 5306-8 Fire Extinguishers

content_en: Under COSHH, what document contains mandatory emergency first-aid measures for skin contact or eye splash with acidic flux?
content_zh: 根據 COSHH 法規，哪份技術文件中載明了若皮膚或眼睛不慎濺入酸性助焊劑時必須採取的法定急救措施？

options_en.A: The product Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Section 4
options_en.B: The delivery consignment invoice

options_zh.A: 產品化學品安全技術說明書 (SDS) 第4章節「急救措施」
options_zh.B: 貨物運輸簽收發票
options_zh.C: 燃氣打壓測試合格單
options_zh.D: 客戶收款收據

explanation_en: Safety Data Sheets adhere to a 16-section international format. Section 4 specifically details first-aid measures for skin/eye exposure.
explanation_zh: SDS（安全數據表）第4部分強制詳細列出吸入、皮膚接觸、眼睛濺入和食入時的緊急處理辦法與就醫提示。
source_reference: COSHH Regs 2002; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

content_en: Why should a plumber avoid lifting a 25kg boiler unit with rounded, bent back and straight knees?
content_zh: 為什麼水暖工在搬運重達 25kg 的壁掛鍋爐時，嚴禁彎腰弓背且膝蓋筆直地強行起吊？

options_en.A: It wears out the soles of safety boots
options_en.B: It places massive compressive and shearing stresses on the lumbar intervertebral discs (L5/S1), causing disc herniation
options_en.C: It reduces heart rate too rapidly
options_en.D: It cools the boiler casing too fast

options_zh.A: 會磨損安全鞋的橡膠鞋底
options_zh.B: 會使腰椎椎間盤（尤其是 L5/S1 節段）承受巨大的剪切與擠壓應力，極易誘發急性椎間盤突出
options_zh.C: 會使得心率過快降低
options_zh.D: 會導致鍋爐外殼散熱過快

explanation_en: Lifting with a bent back acts as a lever multiplying forces up to 10-fold on lumbar spinal discs, risking severe permanent spinal damage.
explanation_zh: 彎腰直腿起吊如同槓桿，會將重物重量在腰椎上放大數倍，極易造成腰肌撕裂及腰椎間盤纖維環破裂壓迫坐骨神經。
source_reference: HSE L23 Manual handling guidance; C&G Unit 201

content_en: When cutting cast-iron soil stacks using an electric reciprocating saw, what PPE is vital to protect against high-velocity metal swarf shards?
content_zh: 使用電動往復鋸切割鑄鐵排水立管時，為防範飛濺的高速金屬金屬碎屑，哪種眼部防護裝備是至關重要的？

options_en.A: Ordinary prescription spectacles with thin glass lenses
options_en.B: Impact-resistant safety goggles or a full-face visor certified to BS EN 166 Grade B or F
options_en.C: Reading spectacles worn on the tip of the nose

options_zh.A: 鏡片較薄的日常近視眼鏡
options_zh.B: 符合 BS EN 166 等級 B 或 F 抗衝擊認證的防護護目鏡或全臉面罩
options_zh.C: 掛在鼻尖上的老花鏡
options_zh.D: 透明游泳防水鏡

explanation_en: High-speed reciprocating saw cutting produces sharp flying iron fragments requiring EN 166 rated impact goggles or full face shields.
explanation_zh: 切割金屬會產生大量高溫飛射金屬毛刺，普通眼鏡無抗衝擊能力且易碎裂，必須佩戴抗高速顆粒衝擊的 EN 166 認證護目鏡。
source_reference: BS EN 166 Personal eye-protection

content_en: Under RIDDOR, if an operative contracts occupational asthma after years of breathing rosin-based soldering flux fumes, is this a reportable occupational disease?
content_zh: 根據 RIDDOR 條例，若水暖工因長期吸入含松香（Rosin/Colophony）焊劑煙霧而患上職業性哮喘，這是否屬於必須申報的法定職業病？

options_en.A: No, asthma is never reportable under health and safety legislation
options_en.B: Yes, occupational asthma caused by recognized respiratory sensitisers (such as colophony) is statutory reportable
options_en.C: Only if the operative requires open-heart surgery
options_en.D: Only if contracted outside the UK

options_zh.A: 不屬於，哮喘在任何安全法規中均無需申報
options_zh.B: 屬於，由明確的呼吸道致敏原（如松香煙霧）引發的職業性哮喘屬於 RIDDOR 法定申報職業病
options_zh.C: 僅當該工人需要接受心臟手術時才申報
options_zh.D: 僅當在英國境外發病時才申報

explanation_en: Occupational asthma linked to soldering flux fumes containing colophony (rosin) is a recognized reportable disease under RIDDOR.
explanation_zh: 含松香助焊劑加熱時釋放的酸性煙塵是嚴重的呼吸道致敏原，被確診為職業性哮喘後僱主必須向 HSE 作出 RIDDOR 申報。
source_reference: RIDDOR 2013, Reg 8; HSE EH40

content_en: What is the first step in assessing an unconscious casualty found on a plant room floor?
content_zh: 在鍋爐機房地坪上發現一名意識喪失、倒地不醒的傷員時，急救人員必須落實的第一步是甚麼？

options_en.B: Check for danger to yourself, the casualty, and others before approaching (DR ABC protocol)
options_en.C: Give the casualty a glass of water

options_zh.A: 立即進行胸外按壓心肺復甦
options_zh.B: 在靠近傷員前，首先仔細排查周圍環境是否存在對自己和傷員的危險（遵循 DR ABC 急救原則中的 Danger 排險）
options_zh.C: 給傷員餵飲一大杯溫水
options_zh.D: 脫下傷員的鞋子

explanation_en: The primary first aid survey follows DR ABC: 1. Danger (check for live electricity, gas leak, falling debris), 2. Response, 3. Airway, 4. Breathing, 5. Circulation.
explanation_zh: 急救第一步永遠是「Danger（評估現場危險）」，確認無觸電、毒氣或坍塌等次生危險後再行施救，切忌盲目靠近成為第二名傷員。
source_reference: St John Ambulance / HSE First Aid Protocols

content_en: What is the recommended ratio of chest compressions to rescue breaths during adult Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR)?
content_zh: 在對無呼吸、無心跳的成年傷員實施心肺復甦術 (CPR) 時，胸外心臟按壓與人工呼吸的推薦標準次數比例是多少？

options_en.B: 15 compressions to 2 breaths

options_zh.A: 5 次按壓比 1 次呼吸
options_zh.B: 15 次按壓比 2 次呼吸
options_zh.C: 30 次胸外按壓比 2 次人工呼吸 (30:2)
options_zh.D: 50 次按壓比 5 次呼吸

explanation_en: Resuscitation Council (UK) guidelines mandate 30 chest compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths at a rate of 100-120 compressions per minute.
explanation_zh: 英國急救復甦委員會 (Resuscitation Council UK) 規範標準為 30 次按壓配合 2 次人工吹氣，按壓深度 5-6 cm，頻率 100-120 次/分鐘。
source_reference: Resuscitation Council UK Guidelines; HSE First Aid

content_en: When an automated external defibrillator (AED) arrives at the scene of cardiac arrest, when should it be switched on?
content_zh: 在心臟驟停急救現場，當便攜式自動體外心臟除顫器 (AED) 送達時，應當何時將其開機啟動？

options_en.A: Immediately, and follow its spoken step-by-step audio prompts
options_en.B: Only after the ambulance has driven 10 miles
options_en.C: Wait 30 minutes for the pads to warm up

options_zh.A: 立即開機，並嚴格按照機器發出的語音逐步指引進行操作
options_zh.B: 等待救護車開到現場後才開機
options_zh.C: 等待電極貼片預熱 30 分鐘後開機
options_zh.D: 只有得到醫院急診醫生的電話口頭授權後才能開機

explanation_en: Turn on the AED immediately upon arrival; modern AEDs provide voice prompts guiding electrode pad placement and pulse analysis.
explanation_zh: AED 抵達後應第一時間按下開關鍵或掀開機蓋，機器會發出清晰的語音指示電極貼片位置並自動分析心律。
source_reference: Resuscitation Council UK Guidelines

content_en: What colour coding is used for medical hazardous clinical waste bags (e.g. dressings soiled with human blood or bodily fluids)?
content_zh: 在處理沾染有人體血液或體液的急救敷料等醫療臨床危險廢棄物時，專用的處置垃圾袋通常是什麼顏色？

options_en.B: Yellow (or Yellow with black stripe)

options_zh.A: 透明無色袋
options_zh.B: 黃色（或黃黑相間條紋袋）
options_zh.C: 草綠色袋
options_zh.D: 純藍色袋

explanation_en: Clinical hazardous waste contaminated with human bodily fluids must be placed in biohazard yellow waste sacks for incineration.
explanation_zh: 沾有人體血液、體液等具有生物感染危險的廢棄棉球和繃帶，必須放入專用黃色生物危險廢棄物袋內封存並交由醫療焚化處置。
source_reference: Health Technical Memorandum (HTM) 07-01 Safe management of healthcare waste

content_en: Why must a plumber wear nitrile or chemical-resistant gloves when pouring hydrochloric or sulphamic acid central heating descaler into a system?
content_zh: 水暖工在向供暖管道加入鹽酸或氨基磺酸等強效化學除垢劑時，為什麼必須佩戴丁腈或耐化學腐蝕手套？

options_en.B: To prevent chemical burns, tissue necrosis, and acute acid dermatitis on bare skin
options_en.C: To avoid fingerprint marks on copper pipework
options_en.D: To improve grip on smooth plastic bottles

options_zh.A: 保持雙手低溫
options_zh.B: 防止強烈酸性液體直接腐蝕皮膚組織造成深部化學灼傷及急性皮炎
options_zh.C: 避免在銅管外表面留下指紋痕跡
options_zh.D: 僅為了抓緊光滑的塑料除垢劑瓶身

explanation_en: Chemical descaling acids cause rapid chemical burns and blistering upon contact with skin, requiring chemical barrier gloves complying with EN 374.
explanation_zh: 強效酸性除垢劑具備強腐蝕性，一旦濺到皮膚會立即腐蝕角質層引發潰爛劇痛，必須佩戴符合 BS EN 374 標準的耐化學腐蝕手套。
source_reference: BS EN ISO 374; COSHH Essentials for Descaling

content_en: What is the minimum safe clearance distance when operating metal ladders or scaffolding near low-voltage overhead power cables on wooden poles?
content_zh: 在木質電線桿架設的低壓架空電力線附近立梯或搭設金屬腳手架時，HSE 指南建議保持的最小安全隔離間距是多少？

options_en.B: At least 3 meters (minimum clearance)
options_en.D: No clearance needed if wearing cotton overalls

options_zh.A: 至少 1 米
options_zh.B: 至少 3 米（最低安全間隔距離）
options_zh.C: 100 mm
options_zh.D: 穿著純棉工作服時無需保持間距

explanation_en: HSE GS6 guidance recommends keeping metal access equipment at least 3 meters away from low voltage overhead electric power lines to prevent electrical flashover.
explanation_zh: HSE GS6 規範嚴格指出，金屬梯具或鋼管腳手架距離低壓架空線必須保持至少 3 米的安全避讓距離，防止電弧擊穿或晃動碰觸致死。
source_reference: HSE Guidance Note GS6 Avoidance of danger from overhead electric power lines

content_en: What should a plumber do immediately if liquid petroleum gas (LPG) liquid spills onto their bare skin during cylinder connection?
content_zh: 若水暖工在連接液化石油氣 (LPG) 氣瓶軟管時，不慎將高壓液態石油氣濺灑到裸露皮膚上，應當如何急救處理？

options_en.A: Immediately immerse the affected area in warm (approx 40°C) water to treat cold freeze-burns (frostbite), and do not rub the skin
options_en.B: Apply a hot electric hair-dryer to the area
options_en.C: Rub the skin aggressively with a coarse rag
options_en.D: Spread hot motor oil over the frozen patch

options_zh.A: 立即將凍傷部位浸入約 40°C 的溫水中復溫，切勿搓揉凍傷組織，並尋求緊急就醫
options_zh.B: 使用高溫電吹風猛吹凍傷處
options_zh.C: 用粗糙毛巾拼命搓揉受傷皮膚
options_zh.D: 在受凍皮膚上塗抹滾燙的機油

explanation_en: Liquid LPG evaporates rapidly, dropping to -42°C and causing cryogenic freeze burns. Treat immediately with lukewarm water immersion without rubbing.
explanation_zh: 液態 LPG 在常壓下急劇氣化吸熱，溫度瞬間暴跌至 -42°C，會造成嚴重的深層深部低溫凍傷，應以 40°C 左右溫水溫和復溫，嚴禁搓擦。
source_reference: UKLPG Code of Practice; HSE Chemical Safety

content_en: What safety marking on a pressure relief valve confirms it is manufactured and certified under the Pressure Equipment Directive (PED)?
content_zh: 安裝在熱水或供暖系統上的安全洩壓閥，其外殼上的哪種認證標記證明其符合歐洲/英國《壓力設備指令》(PED)？

options_en.A: CE or UKCA mark followed by the 4-digit notified body number
options_en.B: BS 7671 electrical sign

options_zh.A: CE 或 UKCA 標識並後附 4 位數法定公告機構 (Notified Body) 代碼
options_zh.B: BS 7671 電氣安全標誌
options_zh.C: 僅有風箏標記
options_zh.D: 水事法規第5類圖標

explanation_en: Safety valves falling under PED / Pressure Equipment (Safety) Regulations must display the UKCA/CE mark accompanied by the approved body number.
explanation_zh: 作為超壓保護的安全附件，洩壓閥依法必須通過承壓設備指令認證，標註 CE/UKCA 並附有認證公告機構的 4 位專屬監控編號。
source_reference: Pressure Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016; BS EN 1489

content_en: When a gas pipe joint is tested using a proprietary liquid leak detection fluid (LDF), what indicates a gas leak?
content_zh: 使用專用測漏發泡液（Leak Detection Fluid - LDF）檢驗燃氣管道接頭密封性時，出現何種現象即確證存在燃氣滲漏？

options_en.B: Active foaming or growing continuous bubbling appears at the joint seam
options_en.D: The fluid becomes completely crystal clear

options_zh.A: 檢漏液迅速變為亮紫色
options_zh.B: 在管件接縫處持續產生膨脹的細密氣泡或翻滾泡沫
options_zh.C: 銅管瞬間結冰凍結
options_zh.D: 檢漏液變得完全清澈見底

explanation_en: Leak detection fluid complies with BS EN 14291; escaping gas creates visible, growing continuous foam bubbles at the leak point.
explanation_zh: 符合 BS EN 14291 的微泡檢漏液遇微小燃氣逸出時，氣體會將表面活性劑吹脹成連續冒出的豐富泡沫，直觀指示漏點位置。
source_reference: BS EN 14291 Liquid leak detection fluids for gas installations

content_en: What hazard does an in-line magnetic system filter address in a central heating circuit under BS 7593:2019?
content_zh: 根據 BS 7593:2019 標準，在供暖系統回水管上強制加裝在線磁性過濾器，其核心防範的危害是什麼？

options_en.B: Circulation of black iron oxide (magnetite) sludge which causes boiler heat exchanger blockage and pump failure

options_zh.A: 高壓電氣浪湧衝擊
options_zh.B: 黑色磁性氧化鐵（黑渣 Magnetite）泥漿在系統內循環，導致鍋爐主換熱器結垢堵塞與循環水泵卡死
options_zh.C: 水質硬度受熱蒸發
options_zh.D: 軍團菌超標滋生

explanation_en: Magnetite is magnetic black iron oxide sludge formed by internal corrosion. Magnetic filters capture it, protecting boilers and circulators.
explanation_zh: 氧化鐵沉積物（磁鐵礦渣）具有強磁性，磁性過濾器利用強磁鐵芯將其捕獲分離，防止高效冷凝鍋爐狹窄水道堵塞及水泵磨損。
source_reference: BS 7593:2019 Code of practice for the preparation, commissioning and maintenance of domestic central heating

content_en: Under the Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations (RIDDOR), what constitutes a reportable gas incident?
content_zh: 根據 RIDDOR 條例，涉及燃氣設備的哪一類事件必須第一時間向執行當局進行法定報告？

options_en.A: Replacing a pilot thermocouple during scheduled servicing
options_en.B: An accidental gas explosion or fire, or carbon monoxide poisoning causing hospitalisation or death
options_en.C: Adjusting the gas burner pressure slightly
options_en.D: A domestic customer smelling garlic in the kitchen

options_zh.A: 在日常例行保養中更換點火熱電偶
options_zh.B: 因燃氣故障引發的意外爆炸、火災，或一氧化碳中毒致使人員送醫搶救或死亡
options_zh.C: 微調鍋爐燃燒器的噴嘴進氣壓力
options_zh.D: 客戶在廚房聞到大蒜味

explanation_en: RIDDOR Regulation 14 covers dangerous gas fittings causing death, loss of consciousness, or hospitalization due to fire, explosion, or CO poisoning.
explanation_zh: RIDDOR 第14條專門規定了燃氣事故：任何因燃氣洩漏或不完全燃燒導致的人員傷亡、昏迷送醫、爆炸或火災，必須立即通報。
source_reference: RIDDOR 2013, Reg 14; HSE INDG453

content_en: When selecting a hacksaw blade to cut thin-walled copper tube or electrical conduit, which tooth pitch (teeth per inch - TPI) is most appropriate?
content_zh: 在選擇鋼鋸條鋸切薄壁銅管或電線穿線金屬穿線套管時，最合適的鋸齒齒數密度 (TPI) 是多少？

options_en.B: 18 TPI

options_zh.A: 14 TPI (粗齒)
options_zh.B: 18 TPI
options_zh.C: 24 TPI
options_zh.D: 32 TPI (超細齒)

explanation_en: A 32 TPI blade ensures at least two to three teeth are in contact with thin-walled tube at all times, preventing tooth snagging and stripping.
explanation_zh: 32 TPI 超細齒鋸條能保證鋸齒在鋸切薄壁管時，隨時有至少 2-3 個齒尖貼合管壁，防止卡齒、崩齒及薄壁扭曲變形。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 203; Workshop Processes

content_en: In which direction should the teeth of a standard hacksaw blade point when correctly installed into the frame?
content_zh: 將手動鋼鋸條正確安裝進鋸弓框架時，鋸齒的朝向應當朝向哪一方？

options_en.A: Forward, away from the handle (cutting on the push stroke)
options_en.B: Backward, towards the handle (cutting on the pull stroke)
options_en.D: Direction does not matter on hacksaws

options_zh.A: 向前，背向握把（即推鋸時產生主要切削作用）
options_zh.B: 向後，朝向握把（拉鋸時切削）
options_zh.C: 側向 90 度角安裝
options_zh.D: 鋼鋸條對安裝方向無任何要求

explanation_en: British and European engineering convention specifies hacksaw teeth point forward, cutting on the forward push stroke.
explanation_zh: 英制標準工藝規範規定，常規鋼鋸鋸齒一律向前安裝，人在向前推鋸時施加主要切削下壓力，回拉時輕帶復位。
source_reference: C&G Unit 203 Common Plumbing Processes

content_en: Why is it essential to ream or deburr the internal bore of a copper pipe after cutting with a rotary pipe wheel cutter?
content_zh: 使用旋轉式滾輪割管刀切斷銅管後，為什麼必須使用鉸刀對管口內徑進行徹底的去毛刺修邊（Deburring）？

options_en.A: To make the pipe lighter in weight
options_en.B: To remove the internal ridge that restricts flow and creates localized turbulence leading to erosion corrosion
options_en.C: To heat up the joint before applying flux
options_en.D: To expand the pipe to the next larger size

options_zh.A: 為了減輕銅管本身的淨重
options_zh.B: 消除割管擠壓產生的內收縮凸脊，防止縮窄流通面積引發紊流並導致管壁局部沖刷腐蝕（Erosion Corrosion）
options_zh.C: 在塗抹助焊劑前利用摩擦給管口加熱
options_zh.D: 為了將銅管管口擴大至下一個管徑級別

explanation_en: Wheel cutters displace metal inward, forming a restrictive ridge. Failing to deburr causes turbulence, cavitation, noise, and erosion pinholes.
explanation_zh: 滾輪割管刀在擠壓金屬時會在管內留下明顯縮口毛刺，若不鉸除會造成流道受阻、高流速紊流渦旋及嚴重的沖蝕破孔穿孔風險。
source_reference: BS 8000-13 Section 3; Copper Development Association (CDA) Guide

content_en: When using an adjustable spanner (wrench), how should the tool be pulled to prevent jaw slipping and mechanical damage?
content_zh: 使用活口扳手（活動扳手）緊固管件螺母時，正確的施力方向應當如何，以防扳手打滑並保護工具？

options_en.A: Always push away from yourself with the movable jaw taking the force
options_en.B: Pull towards yourself so the force is applied against the rigid, fixed lower jaw
options_en.C: Spin the adjusting worm gear while torquing
options_en.D: Angle the spanner at 45 degrees so only the corners touch

options_zh.A: 始終背向自己用力推，並由活動顎板承受主要扭矩
options_zh.B: 朝向自己身體方向用力拉，使主要反作用力承受在堅固的固定主顎板上
options_zh.C: 一邊用力旋轉調節蝸桿一邊扭轉
options_zh.D: 傾斜 45 度使扳手僅以邊角接觸螺母

explanation_en: Force should always be directed towards the fixed jaw. Pushing on the movable jaw risks snapping the screw track or slipping off the fastener.
explanation_zh: 活口扳手受力時必須確保固定顎在前方受力，活動顎在後方輔助，嚴禁讓活動鉗口承受主要負載，否則極易滑脫打手或壓壞絲桿。
source_reference: HSE INDG229; Hand Tool Safety Guidelines

content_en: What should be done to a cold chisel or bolster when its striking head develops a flared, mushroomed edge?
content_zh: 當鋼鏨子（扁鏨）或敲擊鑿子的打擊端頂部因長期錘擊出現翻邊變形、形成「蘑菇頭」時，必須進行何種維護處理？

options_en.B: Grind off the mushroomed edge smooth on a bench grinder (dressing the chisel)
options_en.C: Cover it with plastic tape and hit it harder
options_en.D: Weld an extension bar onto the top

options_zh.A: 塗抹礦物潤滑油
options_zh.B: 在砂輪機上將外翻的飛邊毛刺磨平修整圓滑（即鏨頂修整 - Dressing）
options_zh.C: 用塑料膠布緊緊包裹後加大錘擊力度
options_zh.D: 在頂部焊接一根加長鋼筋

explanation_en: Mushroomed metal edges can detach under a hammer blow, flying off as lethal high-speed shrapnel. They must be ground off square.
explanation_zh: 鏨頂蘑菇狀毛邊在鐵錘打擊下極易發生脆性崩裂，形成高速金屬破片飛出刺入眼睛或動脈，必須及時用砂輪磨除倒角修整。
source_reference: HSE INDG229 Hand Tool Safety; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What type of power tool chuck system allows rapid tool-free insertion of hammer-drill masonry bits with retaining grooves?
content_zh: 哪一種電動工具夾頭系統採用帶有定位鎖定凹槽的刀柄結構，無需工具即可快速拔插重型衝擊鑽頭？

options_en.B: SDS (Slotted Drive System / SDS-Plus) chuck

options_zh.A: 傳統齒輪鑰匙夾頭
options_zh.B: SDS 快速卡槽式夾頭系統 (SDS-Plus / SDS-Max)
options_zh.C: 莫氏錐度夾套
options_zh.D: 普通磁性六角批頭座

explanation_en: SDS (Special Direct System / Slotted Drive System) bits have grooved shanks that lock into spring-loaded ball bearings inside the chuck.
explanation_zh: SDS (特種直插卡槽驅動系統) 鑽頭柄部帶有凹槽，直接推入即可被夾頭內的鋼珠彈簧自鎖，能承受強大衝擊震動且裝卸迅速。
source_reference: Power Tool Mechanics; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What voltage and frequency is supplied to site portable tools via a British standard yellow industrial plug (BS EN 60309)?
content_zh: 符合英國標準 BS EN 60309 的黃色工業插頭，專門向施工現場便攜式電動工具提供何種規格的安全電源？

options_en.B: 110V AC (Centre Tapped to Earth at 55V), 50 Hz

options_zh.A: 230V AC, 50 Hz (普通市電)
options_zh.B: 110V AC (中心抽頭接地對地電壓 55V), 50 Hz
options_zh.C: 415V AC, 三相動力電
options_zh.D: 12V 直流電

explanation_en: Yellow plugs denote 110V reduced low voltage supplied by a CTE transformer (55V between either live pole and earth) for maximum site safety.
explanation_zh: 黃色工業插座是 110V 降壓安全電源的法定專用標識，中心點接地使人身最大對地故障電壓僅 55V，從本質上杜絕致命觸電。
source_reference: BS 7671 Section 704; BS EN 60309-2

content_en: What maintenance step must be performed on manual pipe bender formers and guides to ensure smooth bending of copper tube?
content_zh: 為確保銅管在手動彎管器上折彎時圓滑順暢，彎管器的成形輪（Former）和導向滑塊（Guide）應進行何種常規維護？

options_en.B: Keep grooves clean, free of grit, and lightly wipe the guide with light machine oil or silicone spray
options_en.C: Heat them with a blowlamp before each bend
options_en.D: Coat them in thick acidic soldering flux

options_zh.A: 用粗金剛砂布打磨使其粗糙
options_zh.B: 清理凹槽內所有的金屬屑與砂礫，並在導向槽滑塊表面輕抹微量機油或矽油噴劑
options_zh.C: 每次彎管前用噴燈將模具加熱
options_zh.D: 在模具上塗滿厚厚的酸性焊錫膏

explanation_en: Keeping the former clean and applying light lubrication to the guide reduces sliding friction, preventing pipe scuffing and guide galling.
explanation_zh: 成形輪和滑塊必須清潔無砂粒，滑塊導槽表面適度潤滑能極大減少銅管拉伸滑動時的摩擦阻力，防止管身起皺拉傷或滑塊咬死。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 203 Textbook Ch 2

content_en: Under the Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999, which type of solder alloy is legally required for all jointing on wholesome drinking water pipework?
content_zh: 根據英國《1999年供水（水配件）條例》，在所有自來水飲用水管道上進行軟釬焊時，法律強制規定必須使用哪種焊料合金？

options_en.B: Lead-free solder complying with BS EN ISO 9453 (e.g. 99C copper-tin or tin-silver)

options_zh.A: 傳統 60/40 鉛錫焊錫條
options_zh.B: 符合 BS EN ISO 9453 的無鉛焊錫 (Lead-free，如 99C 錫銅或錫銀合金)
options_zh.C: 含鎘高溫釬料
options_zh.D: 屋面鉛皮熔接專用焊料

explanation_en: Lead dissolves into drinking water causing neurotoxicity. Lead-free solders (e.g. 99% Sn, 1% Cu) are mandatory for all wholesome water supplies.
explanation_zh: 鉛是劇烈神經毒素且具累積性。英國法規全面嚴禁在任何飲用水及生活用水管線上使用含鉛焊錫，必須使用無鉛環保焊錫。
source_reference: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999; BS EN ISO 9453

content_en: What is the melting temperature range of modern lead-free soft solders (such as 99C alloy) used in UK plumbing?
content_zh: 英國水暖行業廣泛使用的現代無鉛軟釬焊焊錫（如 99C 錫銅合金），其熔化溫度區間大約是多少？

options_zh.B: 180°C 至 190°C (傳統含鉛焊錫熔點)
options_zh.D: 600°C 至 800°C (硬釬焊高溫區)

explanation_en: Lead-free plumbing solder melts at approximately 227°C to 230°C, requiring slightly more heat than obsolete leaded solder (183°C).
explanation_zh: 99C 無鉛焊錫（99.3% 錫 + 0.7% 銅）的共晶熔點約為 227°C，比老式含鉛焊錫高出約 45°C，需要稍高的加熱熱量。
source_reference: Copper Development Association Guide; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What physical phenomenon causes molten solder to be drawn into the narrow gap between a copper pipe and fitting socket?
content_zh: 在軟釬焊加熱過程中，熔融的液態焊錫被自動吸入銅管外壁與管件承口之間極微小間隙的物理現象被稱作什麼？

options_en.B: Capillary attraction (action)

options_zh.A: 離心力作用
options_zh.B: 毛細管吸附吸引現象 (Capillary Action)
options_zh.C: 靜電排斥作用
options_zh.D: 重力下沉流動

explanation_en: Capillary attraction draws liquid solder into the clearance gap (typically 0.05-0.15mm) driven by adhesive surface tension against clean copper.
explanation_zh: 毛細作用利用液體表面張力與金屬濕潤性，當管口間隙在 0.05 至 0.15mm 理想公差時，液態焊料會逆重力均勻吸滿整個承插套接面。
source_reference: C&G Unit 203 Common Plumbing Processes; CDA

content_en: Why must self-cleaning active soldering fluxes be thoroughly wiped from external pipe surfaces and flushed from the pipe bore immediately after soldering?
content_zh: 在焊接完畢後，為什麼必須立刻將銅管外表殘留的自清潔型強效酸性助焊劑擦拭乾淨，並在通水時徹底沖洗管道內部？

options_en.A: Flux turns into hard cement that blocks taps
options_en.B: Residual acid creates severe chemical corrosion, leading to external green verdigris pitting and pinhole leaks
options_en.C: Flux causes the water to boil instantly
options_en.D: Flux makes the pipe change diameter

options_zh.A: 助焊劑會凝固成堅硬水泥堵塞水龍頭
options_zh.B: 殘留的酸性化合物會持續腐蝕銅管金屬，生成大量綠色銅銹蝕斑並最終導致針孔穿孔洩漏
options_zh.C: 助焊劑會導致管內水溫瞬間沸騰
options_zh.D: 助焊劑會導致銅管直徑發生收縮變形

explanation_en: Active fluxes contain zinc chloride and hydrochloric acid; uncleaned residues trigger accelerated pitting corrosion (pinholing) of copper.
explanation_zh: 自潔型焊劑含氯化鋅等強酸鹽，焊接後若殘留未擦除，會在數週至數月內持續侵蝕銅管基體，形成銅綠潰瘍坑乃至針眼狀高壓噴水。
source_reference: BS 8000-13 Section 3; Copper Development Association

content_en: Under BS EN 1254, what is the key mechanical difference between a Type A and a Type B compression fitting?
content_zh: 根據英國/歐洲標準 BS EN 1254，Type A（A 型）與 Type B（B 型）卡壓/卡套管件的核心機械結構差異是什麼？

options_en.A: Type A uses glue; Type B uses threads
options_en.B: Type A is non-manipulative (compresses olive onto plain pipe); Type B is manipulative (pipe end must be mechanically flared or belled)
options_en.C: Type A is only for plastic; Type B is only for lead
options_en.D: Type A cannot be tightened with spanners

options_zh.A: A 型管件使用膠水；B 型管件使用螺紋密封
options_zh.B: A 型為非變形型（通過卡環/橄欖環直接緊箍在平齊管壁上）；B 型為變形型（銅管端部必須用專用沖子擴口成喇叭形）
options_zh.C: A 型僅能用於塑料管；B 型僅能用於鉛管
options_zh.D: A 型卡套嚴禁用扳手擰緊

explanation_en: Type A uses an olive compressed onto straight pipe. Type B requires manual mechanical flaring or cupping of soft copper, providing high pull-out resistance.
explanation_zh: Type A（非變形式）利用雙錐形銅卡環（Olive）受壓緊咬直管壁；Type B（變形擴口式）需將退火軟銅管端擴口，被壓緊在管件喇叭錐面上，抗拔力極高。
source_reference: BS EN 1254-2 Plumbing fittings - Compression ends

content_en: When assembling a new, precision Type A compression fitting on copper pipe, what practice should be avoided regarding the threads?
content_zh: 在銅管上組裝全新的高品質 Type A 銅卡套接頭時，針對接頭的緊固螺紋，應當避免何種不規範操作？

options_en.B: Wrapping layers of PTFE tape around the male threads of the compression body
options_en.C: Checking that the olive sits square on the pipe
options_en.D: Tightening by hand until snug before using tools

options_zh.A: 使用尺寸合適的開口扳手
options_zh.B: 在卡套接頭本體的公螺紋外圈上纏繞多層 PTFE 生料帶
options_zh.C: 檢查銅卡環是否平正垂直地套在銅管上
options_zh.D: 在上工具前先用手將螺帽旋緊至緊密貼合

explanation_en: The mechanical seal is made by the olive wedging into the machined internal taper, NOT the threads. Thread tape adds no seal and causes cross-threading.
explanation_zh: 卡套接頭的密封完全依靠卡環（Olive）被螺母擠入本體內部的精加工錐孔形成密封，外螺紋本身不接觸水流，纏繞生料帶毫無意義且易導致滑絲。
source_reference: C&G Unit 203; Master Plumbers Good Practice Guide

content_en: What occurs if a plumber overtightens a compression nut excessively on a 15mm copper pipe?
content_zh: 水暖工在緊固 15mm 銅管卡套螺母時，若施加過大力矩進行過度擰緊（Overtightening），會引發何種損壞？

options_en.B: The brass olive bites too deeply into the copper wall, cutting into or collapsing the pipe, causing a permanent leak
options_en.D: The fitting changes from Type A to Type B

options_zh.A: 銅管受壓膨脹擴徑為 22mm
options_zh.B: 黃銅卡環過度咬入銅管管壁，造成管壁被割裂或擠扁塌陷，導致接頭永久性滲漏無法修復
options_zh.C: 管道水流流速會異常暴增 100%
options_zh.D: 管件屬性會自動轉化為 B 型

explanation_en: Excess torque crimps and scores the copper wall, thinning the tube and deforming the olive seating face, resulting in persistent weeping leaks.
explanation_zh: 過度擰緊會使堅硬的卡環像刀刃一樣切入相對較軟的銅管壁甚至將管口擠凹，破壞了錐面接觸密封帶，反而引發無法止漏的滲水。
source_reference: BS 8000-13; C&G Unit 203

content_en: Why must a rigid plastic or metal pipe insert (support sleeve) ALWAYS be inserted into polybutylene (PB) or PEX pipes prior to making a push-fit or compression joint?
content_zh: 在組裝快插式（Push-fit）或卡套式接頭之前，為什麼聚丁烯 (PB) 或 PEX 塑料管口內部必須強制裝入剛性內襯套管（Insert）？

options_en.A: To color-code the hot and cold supplies
options_en.B: To prevent the thermoplastic pipe wall from creeping, softening, or collapsing inwards under radial sealing pressure
options_en.C: To filter out sediment in the water stream
options_en.D: To insulate the joint against static electricity

options_zh.A: 用以區分冷水和熱水管路顏色
options_zh.B: 防止熱塑性塑料管壁在卡爪或卡環的持續徑向壓力及熱水軟化下向內徑收縮潛變塌陷導致接頭脫落
options_zh.C: 過濾自來水中的顆粒泥沙雜質
options_zh.D: 防止接頭產生靜電積聚

explanation_en: Plastics exhibit viscoelastic creep under continuous compressive stress. The internal insert provides internal hoop stiffness to prevent blowout.
explanation_zh: 塑料具有黏彈性蠕變特性，受熱受壓時管壁會向內退縮。金屬或高剛性內襯套管能為管口提供堅實支撐，防止密封失效或高壓脫管炸裂。
source_reference: BS 7291; Manufacturer Installation Instructions (Hep2O, JG Speedfit)

content_en: What is the operating principle of a modern press-fit (crimp) plumbing joint on copper or multilayer pipe?
content_zh: 現代銅管或多層複合管的機械卡壓式接頭（Press-fit / Crimp joint），其核心工作密封原理是什麼？

options_en.A: The pipe is melted using ultrasonic friction
options_en.B: A calibrated battery-powered pressing tool compresses a contoured fitting socket and internal EPDM O-ring permanently around the pipe
options_en.C: An explosive cartridge drives a rivet into the water stream
options_en.D: Thermal heat shrink bands contract around the fitting

options_zh.A: 利用超聲波摩擦將管道熔接
options_zh.B: 採用經過力矩校準的電動卡壓鉗，將帶有特製凹槽的金屬管件及其內置的 EPDM 橡膠密封圈永久性塑性擠壓變形緊固在管道上
options_zh.C: 使用爆炸發射擊針將鉚釘打入水流中
options_zh.D: 利用熱縮帶加熱收縮在管件外壁

explanation_en: Press-fit machines use hydraulic jaws to deform the fitting collar and pipe simultaneously, creating an airtight mechanical interlock around an elastomeric O-ring.
explanation_zh: 電動卡壓鉗口按特定幾何輪廓（如 M 齒或 V 齒）施加數噸衝程擠壓力，使金屬承口與內部管材同時發生永久塑性變形，並由彈性 O 型圈確保零洩漏。
source_reference: BS EN 1254-7 Press fittings; BESA TR/20

content_en: What feature is built into reputable press-fit fittings to ensure an un-crimped joint is immediately detected during hydrostatic pressure testing?
content_zh: 知名品牌的卡壓管件（Press-fit）內部通常具備何種專利安全設計，以確保未經卡壓的疏漏接頭在注水打壓測試時能被立即察覺？

options_en.A: An electric alarm beeper that sounds when wet
options_en.B: A 'leak before press' profiled O-ring design that deliberately allows water to weep under low pressure until crimped
options_en.D: A spring that shoots the fitting across the room

options_zh.A: 遇水發出蜂鳴聲的內置微型報警器
options_zh.B: 特製的「未壓即漏 (Leak Before Press)」異形 O 型密封圈設計，在未實施卡壓鉗夾緊時故意在低壓下滲水示警
options_zh.C: 自帶紅色 LED 發光二極體燈
options_zh.D: 彈射裝配彈簧將管件彈開

explanation_en: Leak-path O-rings guarantee that an unpressed fitting weeps during filling/pressure testing (0.1 to 3 bar), preventing concealed unpressed joints in service.
explanation_zh: 未壓即漏技術通過在密封圈表面預留微小引流槽，只要安裝工漏壓了接頭，系統注水試壓時該處便會主動滴水報警，防止暗埋後爆管。
source_reference: BS EN 1254-7; Geberit Mapress / Viega Profipress Technical Manual

content_en: When solvent welding PVC-U or ABS waste pipework, what must be done to the pipe end immediately before applying solvent cement?
content_zh: 在對 PVC-U 或 ABS 塑料排水管進行溶劑型化學膠接（Solvent Welding）時，在刷塗膠水前必須對管口進行何種關鍵處理？

options_en.A: Dip the pipe in boiling water to soften it
options_en.B: Deburr and clean the pipe end using a dedicated chemical solvent cleaner/primer to remove grease and release agents
options_en.C: Apply copper flux to the outside
options_en.D: Score deep cross-hatch groves with a wood saw

options_zh.A: 將管頭浸入沸水中燙軟
options_zh.B: 倒角去毛刺，並使用專用溶劑型清潔去膜劑（Cleaner/Primer）擦拭，徹底清除表面的油污脫模劑及光澤氧化層
options_zh.C: 在外壁塗抹銅管焊接酸性焊錫膏
options_zh.D: 用木工鋸在管壁上鋸出深十字交叉溝槽

explanation_en: Solvent cleaner cleans dirt and breaks down the surface gloss, allowing the solvent cement to dissolve and chemically weld the two polymer matrices together.
explanation_zh: 專用清潔劑能溶解管材出廠時的蠟質脫模劑並活化塑料表面分子；隨後塗抹的溶劑膠才能有效軟化溶融雙方塑料，形成強固的分子交織化學冷焊。
source_reference: BS EN 1455-1; BS 5255 Plastics waste pipe

content_en: Why should petroleum-based grease or oil never be applied to rubber ring seals in push-fit soil and waste pipe systems?
content_zh: 在組裝承插橡膠圈密封的排污立管及排水管道時，為什麼絕對嚴禁在橡膠圈上塗抹礦物黃油、凡士林或石油基潤滑油脂？

options_en.A: Petroleum hydrocarbons attack and degrade elastomeric rubber seals, causing swelling, softening, and premature seal failure
options_en.B: Petroleum smells too pleasant on site
options_en.C: Petroleum prevents water from freezing in winter

options_zh.A: 石油烴類化合物會強烈侵蝕並降解合成橡膠，導致密封圈溶脹、軟化潰爛並迅速喪失彈性引發漏水漏臭
options_zh.B: 石油油脂散發的氣味過於好聞
options_zh.C: 石油類油脂會阻止冬季管道結冰
options_zh.D: 會導致排水管變為透明材質

explanation_en: Petroleum hydrocarbons cause swelling and degradation of natural and EPDM rubber. Installers must use approved silicone lubricant or water-soluble lubricant.
explanation_zh: 石油基油脂是橡膠密封圈的頭號殺手，會使橡膠分子鏈破壞導致膠圈脹大變形甚至爛成爛泥，安裝必須使用專用矽油潤滑劑或水溶性肥皂液。
source_reference: BS EN 1329-1; BS EN 1451-1 Plastics piping systems

content_en: When sealing British Standard Pipe (BSPT) taper-threaded steel heating pipe joints with PTFE tape, in which direction must the tape be applied looking directly at the open pipe end?
content_zh: 使用 PTFE 生料帶對英制標準管螺紋 (BSPT) 錐螺紋低碳鋼供暖管進行密封時，正視管口端面，生料帶必須沿什麼方向纏繞？

options_en.B: Anti-clockwise around the threads

options_zh.A: 沿順時針方向（Clockwise）順著螺紋旋緊方向纏繞
options_zh.B: 沿逆時針方向纏繞
options_zh.C: 垂直跨過管口端面縱向纏繞
options_zh.D: 纏繞方向對螺紋密封毫無影響

explanation_en: Applying tape clockwise ensures that screwing on the female fitting tightens the tape into the threads rather than unwinding and unravelling it.
explanation_zh: 順時針纏繞能確保母接頭順時針旋入時，摩擦力會將生料帶進一步向螺牙根部壓緊抹平；若逆時針纏繞，旋入管件時生料帶會被全部推擠倒卷脫落。
source_reference: BS 7786 Specification for PTFE tape; C&G Unit 203

content_en: According to BS 8000-13, what is the maximum recommended horizontal support spacing (clipping distance) for 15mm copper pipework?
content_zh: 根據英國施工工藝標準 BS 8000-13，輸送冷熱水的 15mm 外徑銅管，其推薦的水平支架最大固定間距是多少？

options_en.B: 1.2 meters

options_zh.B: 1.2 米 (最大推薦間距)

explanation_en: BS 8000-13 Table 3 specifies 1.2m as the maximum horizontal spacing for 15mm copper pipe (and 1.8m for vertical runs).
explanation_zh: BS 8000-13 規範規定 15mm 銅管水平管卡間距最大為 1.2 米（垂直立管間距最大為 1.8 米），以防自重及水流重力導致管身下垂彎曲。
source_reference: BS 8000-13 Table 3; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What is the maximum recommended horizontal clipping distance for 22mm copper pipework under BS 8000-13?
content_zh: 根據 BS 8000-13 標準，22mm 外徑銅管在水平敷設時，管卡支撐點之間的最大推薦間距是多少？

options_en.B: 1.8 meters

options_zh.B: 1.8 米 (最大水平間距)
options_zh.C: 2.4 米 (垂直最大間距)

explanation_en: BS 8000-13 states 22mm copper pipe requires support at maximum intervals of 1.8m horizontally and 2.4m vertically.
explanation_zh: 22mm 銅管管壁抗彎截面模量較大，規範要求水平方向每隔不超過 1.8 米設置一個管卡，垂直立管每隔不超過 2.4 米設置一個管卡。
source_reference: BS 8000 Part 13; Copper Pipe Standards

content_en: For 15mm polybutylene or PEX plastic pipework carrying hot water, what is the maximum horizontal clipping distance?
content_zh: 對於輸送熱水的 15mm 聚丁烯 (PB) 或 PEX 塑料管道，其水平敷設時管卡的最大支撐間距通常為多少？

options_en.B: 1.0 meter

explanation_en: Plastic pipes soften when hot and have low rigidity, requiring horizontal clipping every 300 mm (0.3m) to prevent unsightly sagging.
explanation_zh: 塑料管遇熱水溫度上升時剛度會顯著下降，若支撐間距過大會產生嚴重的熱下垂「香蕉垂」，因此水平管卡間距不得超過 0.3 米（立管為 0.5 米）。
source_reference: BS 7291-1; Manufacturer Installation Guides

content_en: What is the standard European temper designation for standard half-hard straight copper tubes (Table X / EN 1057) supplied for scissor-bender bending?
content_zh: 在英國水暖中最常用於手工機械剪式彎管器進行折彎的標準半硬態直條銅管（原 Table X），其歐洲標準 EN 1057 態別代號是什麼？

options_en.B: R250 (half-hard straight lengths)

options_zh.A: R220 (全軟退火態盤管)
options_zh.B: R250 (半硬態直管 - Half Hard)
options_zh.C: R290 (硬態拉拔管)
options_zh.D: R360 超硬態

explanation_en: R250 copper represents half-hard temper straight tubing, engineered to be bent cold on hand-operated bending machines without prior annealing.
explanation_zh: R250 銅管為半硬態，兼具足夠的結構剛性與冷加工塑性，水暖工可直接放入手動雙手剪式彎管機冷折 90 度而無需熱退火。
source_reference: BS EN 1057 Seamless, round copper tubes for water and gas

content_en: When bending soft annealed (R220) coiled copper pipe by hand, what tool is inserted inside the tube to prevent the bore from collapsing?
content_zh: 在手工彎曲退火軟銅管 (R220 盤管) 時，通常在管身內部置入何種工具以支撐管壁防止截面折癟凹陷？

options_en.B: Internal bending spring

options_zh.A: 鋼制鉸刀
options_zh.B: 內彎管彈簧 (Internal Bending Spring)
options_zh.C: 實心木銷
options_zh.D: 柔性橡膠軟管

explanation_en: An internal bending spring supports the inner tube walls against ovality and kinking, and is withdrawn using an attached wire loop after bending.
explanation_zh: 內置緊密螺旋彈簧能為軟態銅管內壁提供均勻的徑向彈性支撐，折出所需弧度後稍加反向扭轉放鬆即可拉著繫帶將彈簧抽出。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 203; Hand Bending Techniques

content_en: What is the minimum center-line bend radius permitted for cold-pulled bends on copper pipework according to British Standards?
content_zh: 根據英國水暖工藝標準，對銅管進行冷拉彎曲時，彎曲中心線允許的最小彎曲半徑通常是銅管外徑的幾倍？
