options_en.B: At least 3 to 3.5 times the outside diameter of the tube

options_zh.A: 銅管外徑的 1 倍
options_zh.B: 至少為銅管外徑的 3 至 3.5 倍 (3D ~ 3.5D)
options_zh.C: 銅管外徑的 10 倍
options_zh.D: 銅管外徑的 20 倍

explanation_en: Standard machine formers produce bends with a centreline radius of 3 to 3.5 times the outside tube diameter, preventing excessive wall thinning.
explanation_zh: 標準彎管器成形輪的設計半徑為 3 至 3.5 倍管外徑（例如 15mm 管彎曲半徑約 45-50mm），低於該半徑外弧側管壁減薄率將超標脆裂。
source_reference: BS EN 1057 / BS 8000-13; CDA Guidelines

content_en: What type of pipe offset bend is used to carry a pipe neatly over another perpendicular intersecting pipe run?
content_zh: 當一根明裝管道需要跨越另一根正交穿過的水管時，水暖工在管身手工折彎做出的專用弧形跨越彎被稱作什麼？

options_en.B: Pass-over bend (bubble set or crossover)

options_zh.A: 直角直彎
options_zh.B: 跨越彎 / 拱橋彎 (Pass-over Bend / Crossover)
options_zh.C: 熱膨脹補償環
options_zh.D: 鵝頸存水彎

explanation_en: A pass-over (crossover) bend comprises a central reverse curve flanked by two opposite sets, bridging across an intersecting pipe cleanly.
explanation_zh: 跨越彎（Pass-over / Bubble set）是由兩個反向淺折角和一個中心回折角組成的對稱幾何彎，使管道能緊貼牆面完美跨越垂直相交的管線。
source_reference: C&G Unit 203 Copper Tube Fabrication

content_en: When copper pipework passes through an internal brick or block wall, how must the pipe be protected according to Water Regulations?
content_zh: 當銅管需要穿過內部磚石或混凝土砌體牆時，根據水事法規要求，必須對管道採取何種保護措施？

options_en.A: Plaster directly over the bare copper pipe
options_en.B: Encase the pipe in a continuous plastic or copper sleeve (conduit) that allows thermal expansion movement
options_en.C: Solder the pipe securely to the wall bricks
options_en.D: Flatten the pipe to reduce the hole size

options_zh.A: 用石膏水泥直接將裸銅管抹死在牆內
options_zh.B: 將銅管穿入一根連續的塑料或金屬套管（Sleeve）內，使銅管能在套管中自由伸縮滑動
options_zh.C: 將銅管用焊錫牢牢焊死在牆面膨脹螺栓上
options_zh.D: 將管身敲扁以減小開孔直徑

explanation_en: Water Regulations require pipes penetrating walls to pass through non-corrosive sleeves to allow axial expansion and prevent chemical attack from mortar.
explanation_zh: 穿牆管道必須加裝耐腐蝕過牆套管，防止砂漿中的鹼性物質直接腐蝕銅管外壁，並允許管道在熱脹冷縮時無阻礙地軸向伸縮滑動。
source_reference: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999 Schedule 2

content_en: Why should plumbing pipes never be clipped so rigidly that axial thermal movement is completely prevented on long straight runs?
content_zh: 為什麼在長距離直管段上安裝管卡時，絕對不能將管道完全卡死固定以致徹底喪失軸向熱伸縮自由度？

options_en.A: It stops the water from circulating
options_en.B: Thermal expansion creates immense compressive stress, resulting in pipe buckling, loud creaking noises, or joint shearing failure
options_en.D: It cancels the manufacturer guarantee of the pump

options_zh.A: 這會徹底阻止管內水流循環
options_zh.B: 熱脹冷縮會產生巨大的內應力，導致管道嚴重起拱弓起變形、發出刺耳的木地板摩擦噪聲，甚至拉裂剪斷管件接頭
options_zh.C: 這會改變水質的硬度成分
options_zh.D: 這會導致循環水泵質保失效

explanation_en: Hot water causes thermal expansion. Rigid clamping restrains movement, inducing massive stress that buckles pipes and pulls soldered fittings apart.
explanation_zh: 熱水流經時銅管和塑料管均會顯著伸長。若所有管卡全部咬死，熱脹力無處釋放便會將管路頂彎崩裂或在管卡處刮出巨大熱脹冷縮異響。
source_reference: BS 8000-13; Institute of Plumbing Technical Manual

content_en: What safety feature on an angle grinder stops the disc from spinning automatically as soon as the operator releases their hand grip?
content_zh: 角磨機（砂輪切割機）上的哪一項必備安全聯鎖裝置，確保一旦操作者的手鬆開開關，切割砂輪便會立即斷電停轉？

options_en.B: Dead-man switch (non-locking trigger paddle)

options_zh.A: 持續常開鎖定按鈕
options_zh.B: 死人開關 / 握發自動復位撥片 (Dead-man's switch)
options_zh.C: 飛輪齒輪鎖
options_zh.D: 無級變速旋鈕

explanation_en: A dead-man's switch immediately cuts electrical power when released, preventing catastrophic injuries if the operator drops the tool.
explanation_zh: 死人開關是一種防失控自復位扳機，只要工人的手部因觸電、滑倒或失手鬆脫，動力電路瞬間切斷，砂輪迅速減速停轉。
source_reference: HSE INDG229 Safety in the use of abrasive wheels; PUWER 1998

content_en: What is the purpose of an SDS chuck adaptor when fitted to an SDS rotary hammer drill?
content_zh: 在 SDS 重型旋轉衝擊電錘上加裝 SDS 轉接夾頭（Chuck Adaptor），其主要功用是什麼？

options_en.B: To allow the use of standard smooth round-shank drill bits for wood or metal in rotary-only mode
options_en.C: To convert the drill into an oxy-acetylene torch
options_en.D: To ground the drill against high voltage

options_zh.A: 將打孔轉速提升 500%
options_zh.B: 使電錘在純旋轉無衝擊模式下，能夠夾持木工或金屬加工用的普通光滑圓柄麻花鑽頭
options_zh.C: 將電鑽改裝為氧乙炔氣焊噴炬
options_zh.D: 為電鑽提供高壓接地保護

explanation_en: The adapter permits standard plain-shank twist drill bits to be clamped, provided the hammer action is disabled to prevent damaging the chuck.
explanation_zh: SDS 轉換夾頭能讓電錘兼具普通電鑽功能，但切換後嚴禁開啟衝擊檔位，否則衝擊力會瞬間震碎普通三爪夾頭內部的傳動螺紋。
source_reference: Power Tool Usage Guidelines; C&G Unit 203

content_en: Which hand tool is specifically engineered to tighten or remove the large slotted retaining nut securing a basin waste or bath waste fitting from below?
content_zh: 哪一種專用手動水暖工具，專為伸入洗面盆或浴缸底部的狹窄死角拆裝固定排水下水器的大型沉頭或開槽螺母而設計？

options_en.B: Basin wrench / Adjustable tap wrench

options_zh.A: 大力鉗 (Mole Grips)
options_zh.B: 盆底扳手 / 龍頭立柱開關扳手 (Basin Wrench)
options_zh.C: 八角手錘
options_zh.D: 鐵皮剪刀

explanation_en: Basin wrenches feature long vertical shafts and spring-loaded swivelling serrated jaws designed to reach up behind confined basins to grip nuts.
explanation_zh: 水盆專用扳手具備長握桿與帶有彈簧咬合齒的 90 度自適應萬向卡頭，能輕鬆伸入台盆背部極度狹小的深孔死角擰緊龍頭緊固螺母。
source_reference: C&G Unit 203 Common Plumbing Processes

content_en: When cutting 40mm ABS plastic waste pipe, why is a dedicated wheel-type plastic pipe cutter or fine-toothed hand saw preferred over a blunt wood saw?
content_zh: 切割 40mm ABS 塑料排水管時，為什麼推薦使用專用滾輪塑料切管器或細齒手鋸，而不是齒距較大的粗木工鋸？

options_en.A: To create smoke that cleans the plastic
options_en.B: To ensure a perfectly clean, square cut without ragged burrs that obstruct fluid flow and weaken solvent weld sockets
options_en.D: To avoid needing to measure the pipe

options_zh.A: 鋸割產生的煙霧能淨化塑料表面
options_zh.B: 確保切口完全垂直平整且無碎裂飛邊毛刺，防止堵塞流道並確保承插化學焊接時無縫嚴密貼合
options_zh.C: 提高施工現場環境溫度
options_zh.D: 免去測量管材長度的繁瑣步驟

explanation_en: Square cuts without tears provide full socket insertion depth and maximum surface area for solvent cement bonding.
explanation_zh: 粗齒鋸會撕裂塑料管口形成鋸齒狀崩口，使管口無法垂直插到底部定位台階，極大削弱膠接接觸面積並誘發日後接頭滲漏。
source_reference: BS EN 1455; C&G Unit 203

content_en: Why must lead-free soft solders never be overheated with excessive continuous blowlamp flame?
content_zh: 使用噴燈明火進行無鉛軟釬焊時，為什麼嚴禁對管件持續施加過高溫度的過度烘烤？

options_en.A: Overheating burns and chars the flux, causing instant copper oxidation which completely repels solder flow
options_en.B: It causes the copper to turn into liquid gold
options_en.C: It increases the pressure inside the room
options_en.D: It cools down the solder wire

options_zh.A: 過熱會燒焦碳化助焊劑，使銅表面急劇氧化形成黑色氧化層，導致熔化焊錫徹底被排斥無法浸潤流動
options_zh.B: 會使銅管熔化變成黃金
options_zh.C: 會使得房間內的大氣壓急劇升高
options_zh.D: 會使焊錫絲急劇降溫冷卻

explanation_en: Overheating oxidises the flux, turning it black and crusty. Oxidised copper will not allow solder to wet or draw via capillary action.
explanation_zh: 助焊劑具有特定的活性溫度區間，一旦被高溫烈焰燒焦燒乾，便會喪失除氧保護能力，銅管表面迅速氧化變黑形成拒焊層。
source_reference: Copper Development Association Installation Guide

content_en: What is the purpose of wire wool or synthetic abrasive pads (Scotch-Brite) used on copper pipe prior to fluxing?
content_zh: 在塗抹助焊劑前，使用鋼絲絨或尼龍研磨百潔布（Scotch-Brite）擦拭銅管端部外壁的目的是什麼？

options_en.A: To reduce the pipe diameter by 2mm
options_en.B: To mechanically abrade and remove the invisible metal oxide layer and tarnish, exposing bright bare copper
options_en.C: To coat the pipe in grease
options_en.D: To create static electricity to attract solder

options_zh.A: 將銅管外徑打磨縮小 2mm
options_zh.B: 機械打磨去除銅表面肉眼看不見的鈍化氧化膜與污垢，裸露出純淨發亮的活性銅金屬基底
options_zh.C: 給銅管表面塗佈一層抗氧化油脂
options_zh.D: 產生靜電用以吸附焊錫

explanation_en: Solder can only bond atomically to bare, unoxidised metal. Abrading removes the protective cuprous oxide film.
explanation_zh: 釬焊金屬結合屬於原子層級的相互擴散。研磨能徹底破壞銅管暴露在空氣中生成的緻密氧化銅膜，為焊劑活化與焊料漫流奠定基礎。
source_reference: CDA Technical Guidelines; BS 8000-13

content_en: When making a silver brazed joint (hard solder) on commercial copper pipe, at what temperature does the filler metal melt?
content_zh: 在商用厚壁銅管上採用含銀銅磷合金進行硬釬焊（Brazing）時，釬料的熔化溫度通常在哪個區間？

options_en.B: Around 220°C

options_zh.A: 100°C 以下
options_zh.B: 220°C 左右 (軟釬焊熔點)
options_zh.C: 450°C 以上 (通常在 600°C 至 800°C 區間)

explanation_en: By definition under BS EN ISO 17672, brazing processes use filler alloys with melting points exceeding 450°C.
explanation_zh: 根據國際標準定義，硬釬焊（Brazing）與軟釬焊（Soldering）的分界線為 450°C，銀釬料熔點在 600-800°C，接頭具有極高的機械強度與耐疲勞度。
source_reference: BS EN ISO 17672 Brazing - Filler metals

content_en: Why is brazing rather than soft soldering preferred on medical gas and refrigeration copper pipeline systems?
content_zh: 在醫療氣體管道（如純氧）或高壓製冷劑銅管工程中，為什麼強制採用高溫硬釬焊而非低溫軟釬焊？

options_en.A: Brazed joints offer significantly higher mechanical shear strength and thermal fatigue resistance under extreme vibration and pressure
options_en.B: Brazing uses cold water

options_zh.A: 硬釬焊接頭具有遠高於軟焊的機械抗剪強度、耐壓極限及極佳的抗劇烈震動熱疲勞性能
options_zh.B: 硬釬焊完全採用冷水黏合
options_zh.C: 硬釬焊無需任何外部加熱源
options_zh.D: 軟釬焊焊錫具有核輻射危害

explanation_en: High-pressure gases and refrigeration compressors subject pipework to intense cyclic vibration and thermal stress that soft solder joints cannot withstand.
explanation_zh: 製冷及醫用氣體工作壓力高達數十個大氣壓且伴隨壓縮機長期脈動震動，軟焊錫剪切強度不足易發生疲勞開裂，必須採用強韌的硬釬焊熔接。
source_reference: HTM 02-01 Medical gas pipeline systems; BS EN 378

content_en: What type of compression olive material is recommended when connecting chrome-plated copper pipe to prevent slippage?
content_zh: 在連接外表極其光滑堅硬的鍍鉻銅管時，為防止卡套在承壓時滑脫，推薦使用何種特性的卡環或處理方式？

options_en.B: Copper or annealed brass olive, with the chrome plating carefully scraped off the olive seating area with emery cloth

options_zh.A: 普通辦公橡膠筋
options_zh.B: 純銅或退火黃銅卡環，並在組裝前用砂布仔細將卡環著座區域的堅硬鍍鉻層刮除乾淨
options_zh.C: 塑料尼龍自鎖紮帶
options_zh.D: 陶瓷脆性環

explanation_en: Chrome plating is exceptionally hard and slippery, preventing the olive from biting. Scraping down to bare copper allows the olive to achieve mechanical grip.
explanation_zh: 鉻電鍍層硬度極高且摩擦係數極小，銅卡環根本無法咬合生根。必須用砂布打磨剝離卡套部位的鍍鉻層露出真銅，才能咬緊防脫。
source_reference: Copper Development Association; Good Plumbing Guide

content_en: When installing a push-fit plumbing fitting onto copper tube, how is the insertion depth verified before completing the connection?
content_zh: 將快插式管件（Push-fit）安裝到銅管上時，在插管前應當如何標記核驗插入深度，以確保管端完全插到底部台階？

options_en.B: Use a depth gauge or measure and mark the full insertion socket depth on the outside of the tube with a pencil
options_en.C: Cut the pipe at a 45-degree angle
options_en.D: Heat the copper pipe to glow red

options_zh.A: 憑眼睛目測大概感覺
options_zh.B: 使用專用插深規（Depth Gauge）或用直尺量取接頭內插槽深度，並用鉛筆在銅管外壁精確畫出插入深度定位線
options_zh.C: 將銅管端口鋸成 45 度斜角
options_zh.D: 用噴燈將銅管烤至櫻紅放鬆

explanation_en: Marking the insertion depth guarantees visual proof that the pipe has passed through both the stainless grab-ring and the EPDM O-ring into the stop-shoulder.
explanation_zh: 快插管件內含咬合抓簧與 O 型圈雙重結構，若未插到底極易在注水承壓時瞬間脫扣爆管。預先畫線能在插緊後目視確證到位。
source_reference: Hep2O / JG Speedfit Technical Installation Guide

content_en: What tool is used to remove a push-fit fitting from a copper or plastic pipe without damaging the pipe surface?
content_zh: 當需要拆卸已安裝的快插管件時，應使用何種工具在不傷及管壁的前提下平穩釋放內部的抓環不銹鋼卡爪？

options_en.B: Manufacturer release aid (collet clip or demounting tool)

options_zh.A: 重型八角大鐵錘
options_zh.B: 製造商專用的管件拆卸卡夾工具 (Demounting Tool / Collet Release Tool)
options_zh.C: 高溫噴燈烈焰烘烤
options_zh.D: 手持高速角磨機

explanation_en: Demounting tools compress the collar into the body, disengaging the teeth of the stainless steel grab ring from the pipe surface.
explanation_zh: 專用拆卸夾具（Demounting Clip）能均勻向內平推壓下接頭端部的浮動卡套，使咬死在管壁上的不銹鋼彈簧片向外張開，即可輕鬆拔下管材。
source_reference: Manufacturer Demounting Instructions

content_en: What causes a solvent-welded joint to fail under water testing if the assembly was handled too early after joining?
content_zh: 在溶劑膠接作業完成後，若過早搬動晃動管路或加壓測試，為什麼會導致接頭試水時徹底失效滲漏？

options_en.A: The plastic pipe turns brittle like glass
options_en.B: Disturbing the joint before the solvent evaporates breaks the forming molecular polymer chains, creating permanent micro-channels
options_en.C: The solvent turns into solid steel

options_zh.A: 塑料管會變得像玻璃一樣脆化
options_zh.B: 在化學溶劑完全揮發前擾動接頭，會撕裂正在重新交織凝結的高分子聚合物分子鏈，留下永久微觀滲漏裂縫
options_zh.C: 溶劑會轉化為堅硬的實心鋼
options_zh.D: 塑料管會瞬間失去顏色塗層

explanation_en: Solvent welding relies on solvent evaporation to fuse the polymer chains. Movement during the initial set destroys the weld integrity.
explanation_zh: 溶劑化學焊接本質是高分子塑料溶解後重新凝固的結晶過程。在初凝期內強行扭動或施壓，會扯斷未硬化的塑態接合面形成沙眼暗隙。
source_reference: BS 5255; C&G Unit 203

content_en: Which pipe material cannot be joined using standard PVC-U solvent cement due to chemical resistance?
content_zh: 下列哪一種常見塑料管道材質，由於具有極強的化學惰性耐腐蝕性，絕對無法使用常規 PVC-U 溶劑型膠水進行膠接？

options_en.B: ABS (Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene)

options_zh.A: PVC-U (硬質聚氯乙烯)
options_zh.B: ABS (丙烯腈-丁二烯-苯乙烯共聚物)
options_zh.C: 聚丙烯 (PP) 與聚乙烯 (PE)
options_zh.D: MuPVC (改性聚氯乙烯)

explanation_en: Polypropylene (PP) and polyethylene (PE) are polyolefins resistant to chemical solvents. They require mechanical push-fit or electrofusion welding.
explanation_zh: 聚丙烯 (PP) 和聚乙烯 (PE) 屬於聚烯烴高分子材料，分子結構極端穩定，任何溶劑膠水均無法將其表面溶脹，必須採用橡膠圈承插或電熔熱熔對接。
source_reference: Plastics Piping Materials Guide; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What British Standard governs threaded pipe fittings and threads where pressure-tight joints are made on the threads (BSPT)?
content_zh: 哪一項英國標準規範了利用錐形螺紋自身牙型機械過盈緊密咬合來實現承壓密封的英制管螺紋 (BSPT)？

options_zh.A: BS EN 10226-1 (原 BS 21 英制管螺紋標準)
options_zh.B: BS 7671 電氣規範
options_zh.C: BS 5422 保溫標準
options_zh.D: BS EN 12828 供暖系統標準

explanation_en: BS EN 10226-1 specifies pipe threads for tubes and fittings where pressure-tight joints are made on the mating taper/parallel threads.
explanation_zh: BS EN 10226-1（替代原 BS 21）規範了英制密封管螺紋尺寸、錐度（1:16）及公差，是低碳鋼蒸汽及供暖管道螺紋連接的法定標準。
source_reference: BS EN 10226-1 Pipe threads for tubes and fittings

content_en: Why is anaerobic pipe thread sealant paste often preferred over traditional hemp and paste on modern domestic central heating valves?
content_zh: 在現代家用中央供暖管道閥門螺紋密封中，為什麼厭氧型管道密封膠（Anaerobic Sealant）越來越普遍替代傳統麻絲（Hemp）加白厚漆？

options_en.A: Hemp decomposes in hot water over time and loose strands can migrate into the circuit to jam circulator impellers and motorized valves
options_en.B: Hemp is illegal under building regulations
options_en.C: Anaerobic sealants melt at room temperature
options_en.D: Hemp increases water pressure beyond safety limits

options_zh.A: 麻絲在熱水中長期浸泡會腐爛水解，散落的植物纖維游離進迴路會纏繞卡死循環水泵葉輪並堵塞電動二通閥閥芯
options_zh.B: 麻絲已被建築法規明文立法取締
options_zh.C: 厭氧膠會在常溫下自動融化
options_zh.D: 麻絲會導致水壓超壓爆裂

explanation_en: Loose hemp fibres shred into the heating water, fouling fine clearances in electronic pumps, thermostatic radiator valves, and plate heat exchangers.
explanation_zh: 傳統麻絲若包裹不當極易脫落細碎纖維，流經現代高效節能屏蔽泵或板式換熱器狹窄水道時會迅速造成嚴重卡阻，厭氧膠則無雜質殘留。
source_reference: BS 7593:2019; Heating and Hotwater Industry Council (HHIC)

content_en: When bending 22mm half-hard R250 copper tube on a floor-standing hydraulic or ratcheting bender, what is the primary risk of pulling the bend too quickly without adequate lubrication on the guide?
content_zh: 在立式液壓或棘輪彎管機上冷折 22mm 半硬態 R250 銅管時，若導向滑槽缺乏潤滑且折彎過急過猛，會引發何種主要的管材缺陷？

options_en.A: The copper pipe turns into lead
options_en.B: Severe throat rippling (corrugation) along the inner radius and excessive stretching or splitting along the outer wall
options_en.C: The pipe becomes twice as long
options_en.D: The water will refuse to flow through it

options_zh.A: 銅管材質退化為金屬鉛
options_zh.B: 內弧喉部出現嚴重的波浪狀起皺摺疊，外弧受拉伸過度壁厚急劇變薄甚至拉裂開縫
options_zh.C: 銅管總長度會不可思議地翻倍
options_zh.D: 水流將無法在管內前進

explanation_en: Unlubricated rapid pulling increases friction, causing the pipe to buckle into ripples on the inside throat and tear open on the stretched outer spine.
explanation_zh: 乾磨擦產生的巨大阻力會使金屬無法均勻延展流動，內側受壓管壁會像手風琴一樣疊起起皺，外側管壁則被拉扯至極限導致開裂報廢。
source_reference: Copper Development Association Installation Guide

content_en: What is the maximum horizontal support clipping spacing for a 110mm PVC-U soil stack running horizontally suspended below a ceiling?
content_zh: 懸吊敷設在天花板下方的 110mm PVC-U 塑料排污橫支管/總橫管，其水平吊架管卡的最大支撐間距是多少？

options_en.B: 0.9 meters (approx 1.0 m)

explanation_en: BS EN 12056-2 and BS 8000-13 specify a maximum horizontal clipping distance of 0.9m for 110mm plastic soil pipe to prevent sag holding foul waste.
explanation_zh: 110mm 塑料排污橫管在滿水沖洗時自重極大，標準規定水平管卡間距最大為 0.9 米，以防管材受重下垂形成反坡積存糞便沉渣導致淤堵。
source_reference: BS EN 12056-2 Gravity drainage systems inside buildings; BS 8000-13

content_en: When installing horizontal 32mm and 40mm plastic waste pipes, what is the maximum recommended clipping spacing to prevent sagging?
content_zh: 在水平安裝 32mm 和 40mm 塑料排水支管時，為防止管道下垂形成局部氣袋或積水，推薦的管卡最大間距是多少？

options_en.B: 1.2 meters

explanation_en: BS 8000-13 specifies 0.5m maximum horizontal spacing for 32mm and 40mm plastic waste pipes due to high thermal sag from hot waste discharge.
explanation_zh: 32mm 及 40mm 塑料廢水管經常承受排放洗碗熱水的高溫考驗，極易軟化塌腰，標準要求水平管卡最大間距為 0.5 米（垂直間距為 1.2 米）。
source_reference: BS 8000-13 Section 3; Approved Document H

content_en: What type of pipe clip is designed with an internal rubber lining to dampen vibration and acoustic transmission from circulating water pumps?
content_zh: 哪一種特製管卡內部內嵌了橡膠隔音減震襯墊，專門用於吸收抑制循環水泵運轉引起的振動與管道流水噪音傳遞？

options_en.B: Rubber-lined acoustic split-band metal clip (Munsen ring with EPDM lining)

options_zh.A: 普通塑料單邊自鎖扣卡
options_zh.B: 帶 EPDM 橡膠減震襯墊的金屬對開抱箍管卡 (Rubber-lined Acoustic Munsen Ring)
options_zh.C: 開放式開口鐵絲吊鉤
options_zh.D: 尼龍敲擊膨脹管卡

explanation_en: Rubber-lined Munsen rings decouple the vibrating pipe from the building structure, providing acoustic attenuation to comply with Building Regs Part E.
explanation_zh: 內襯 EPDM 彈性橡膠的對開金屬管卡能阻斷水泵高頻振動沿建築結構傳導，消除噪音共鳴，符合建築法規 Part E（防噪聲標準）。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document E; BS 8233 Sound insulation

content_en: What is an expansion loop used for in a long straight run of copper or steel heating pipework?
content_zh: 在長距離直線敷設的銅管或低碳鋼供暖管道工程中，特意製作的「U 形膨脹補償彎（Expansion Loop）」的功用是什麼？

options_en.A: To slow down the water flow rate to zero
options_en.B: To safely absorb linear thermal expansion and contraction without overstressing fixed joints and anchor points
options_en.C: To act as a secondary filter

options_zh.A: 將管內水流流速強行降為零
options_zh.B: 安全吸收並補償金屬管道受熱伸長產生的線性軸向膨脹應力，防止拉裂固定支架與焊接口
options_zh.C: 作為輔助過濾器沉澱雜質
options_zh.D: 用以專門收集水流中的氣泡

explanation_en: Long pipe runs experience massive linear growth when heated. Flexible U-shaped loops deflect elastically to absorb this movement safely.
explanation_zh: 長距離熱水管道受熱時伸長量顯著。U 型補償彎利用金屬自身的彈性形變來吸收直管段的軸向膨脹推力，保護系統免於受壓失穩屈曲爆裂。
source_reference: BS EN 12828 Heating systems in buildings; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What marking on a brass plumbing fitting indicates it is manufactured from Dezincification Resistant brass suitable for aggressive or acidic water areas?
content_zh: 黃銅水暖管件外表若刻有哪種法定識別代號，證明其採用了專門抵禦酸性或軟水侵蝕的「耐脫鋅黃銅 (DZR Brass)」？

options_en.B: GAS only

options_zh.A: DZR 或 CR (耐腐蝕 Corrosion Resistant 認證印記)
options_zh.B: 僅標註 GAS
options_zh.C: 標註 PVC
options_zh.D: 標註 ALU

explanation_en: Dezincification resistant brass fittings comply with BS EN 12165 (CW602N) and are marked 'CR' or 'DZR' to prevent zinc leaching in aggressive waters.
explanation_zh: 在某些軟水或微酸性水質地區，普通黃銅中的鋅會被電化學溶解析出（脫鋅），留下多孔脆弱的純銅海綿體；DZR 黃銅帶有 CR/DZR 標識以防此類腐蝕。
source_reference: BS EN 12165 (CW602N); Water Regulations Schedule 2

content_en: What is the function of a dielectric insulating union when connecting copper pipework to a galvanized steel water storage tank?
content_zh: 將銅水管連接到鍍鋅鋼板儲水箱時，在兩者接口處加裝「絕緣介電接頭 (Dielectric Union)」的關鍵作用是什麼？

options_en.B: To electrically isolate dissimilar metals, preventing severe galvanic (electrolytic) corrosion of the steel tank

options_zh.A: 提高進水水溫
options_zh.B: 實現不同金屬之間的電絕緣隔離，阻斷電化學微電池迴路，防止較活潑的鋼板水箱發生嚴重電偶腐蝕穿孔
options_zh.C: 防止管道內形成氣塞
options_zh.D: 提高水流通過流速

explanation_en: Galvanic action occurs when copper (noble cathode) contacts steel/zinc (active anode). Dielectric fittings break the electrical contact path.
explanation_zh: 在金屬電化學活性序列中，銅電位高於鐵和鋅。若直接物理接觸，鋅鐵會作為陽極快速犧牲溶解；絕緣墊片能切斷電子通路保護鋼材。
source_reference: BS 8000-13; Institute of Plumbing Design Guide

content_en: When utilizing an electric or CO2 pipe freezing kit to isolate a pipe for valve replacement without draining down, what condition must be verified first?
content_zh: 使用電動或乾冰 (CO2) 管道冷凍套件在不停水放空的情況下冰凍管道更換閥門時，必須預先嚴格確認的首要條件是什麼？

options_en.A: The water in the pipe must be completely static (zero flow)
options_en.B: The water must be running at high velocity
options_en.D: The pipe must be made of glass

options_zh.A: 管內水流必須處於完全靜止狀態（零流速）
options_zh.B: 管內水流必須處於高速奔流狀態
options_zh.C: 管內水溫必須處於沸騰狀態
options_zh.D: 管道必須由玻璃材質製成

explanation_en: Pipe freezing requires stationary water. Any active flow continually brings fresh heat across the freeze head, preventing ice plug formation.
explanation_zh: 冷凍冰塞的形成完全依賴熱傳導。若管內水流哪怕存在極微小的流動，帶來的熱量都會徹底抵消冷凍劑的製冷量，導致冰塞無法封凍爆管。
source_reference: Rothenberger Freeze Kit Manual; C&G Unit 203

content_en: In central heating and underfloor heating plastic piping, what is the purpose of the internal EVOH (Ethylene Vinyl Alcohol) barrier layer?
content_zh: 在現代中央供暖及地板輻射採暖專用塑料管道（如 PEX-a 或 PE-RT）中，內嵌的 EVOH 高分子阻氧層的關鍵作用是什麼？

options_en.B: To prevent atmospheric oxygen from diffusing through the plastic wall into the heating system water, thereby halting boiler corrosion

options_zh.A: 增強塑料管的柔軟彎曲度
options_zh.B: 阻止空氣中的氧分子滲透穿透塑料管壁溶入供暖循環水中，從根本上遏制鍋爐金屬部件氧化腐蝕
options_zh.C: 吸附過濾水中顆粒雜質
options_zh.D: 將塑料管外壁染成醒目的黃色

explanation_en: Standard polyolefins are permeable to oxygen gas. EVOH oxygen-barrier layers prevent oxygen ingression complying with DIN 4726, preserving steel boilers.
explanation_zh: 普通聚乙烯管壁看似密閉，但微觀下氧分子能持續透過管壁滲入循環水，造成散熱器與鍋爐劇烈生鏽。符合 DIN 4726 的 EVOH 阻氧層能徹底阻隔氧氣滲透。
source_reference: DIN 4726 / BS 7291; Central Heating Installation Guide

content_en: What hand tool is used by copper pipe fabricators to expand the end of a copper pipe so it can receive another pipe of identical diameter without a coupling fitting?
content_zh: 銅管施工人員使用何種專用手動擴口工具，將一根銅管端部均勻向外擴張，使其能直接插入另一根同規格銅管而無需採購直通管件？

options_en.B: Hacksaw frame

options_zh.A: 手動擴口脹管器 / 縮脹管鉗 (Swaging Tool / Expander)
options_zh.B: 鋼鋸弓
options_zh.C: 管鉗
options_zh.D: 煙氣分析儀

explanation_en: Swaging/expanding tools expand the tube socket with precision dies, forming an integral capillary cup directly on annealed copper pipe.
explanation_zh: 脹管擴口器利用六角分瓣模頭，能將退火軟銅管端部精確擴大出一個具備標準毛細間隙的承插母口，直接省去銅直接管件，降低成本並減少漏點。
source_reference: C&G Unit 203 Workshop Tools; CDA

content_en: When tightening a 15mm or 22mm brass compression fitting onto copper tube, what is the general rule of thumb for spanner rotation past finger-tight?
content_zh: 在組裝 15mm 或 22mm 黃銅卡套接頭時，用手將螺母旋至貼緊卡套後，使用扳手旋轉擰緊的常規通用經驗圈數是多少？

options_en.B: 5 to 6 full turns
options_en.D: Tighten until the brass splits in two

options_zh.A: 大約擰緊 3/4 圈至 1 整圈（最多不超過 1.25 圈）
options_zh.B: 用力旋轉 5 至 6 整圈
options_zh.C: 旋轉 10 整圈
options_zh.D: 一直死擰直至黃銅螺母開裂成兩半

explanation_en: Compression fittings require only 3/4 to 1 full turn past finger-tight to crimp the olive. Overtightening cuts the tube and causes leaks.
explanation_zh: 卡套接頭在手動擰不動後，扳手通常只需旋轉約 270 度至 360 度（3/4 圈到 1 圈），即可使卡環產生足夠的自鎖變形；過擰只會切傷銅管引發滲漏。
source_reference: BS 8000-13 Section 3; Copper Development Association

content_en: What tool is used to temporarily seal the open end of a 110mm underground drainage pipe during an air pressure or water head test?
content_zh: 在對 110mm 地下排水管道進行氣壓密封性試驗或注水試驗時，使用何種工具對管口進行可靠的臨時封堵？

options_en.B: Expanding mechanical rubber-ring drain test plug (bung)

options_zh.A: 浸透機油的破抹布
options_zh.B: 帶中央螺桿膨脹橡膠圈的專用管道試壓堵頭 (Drain Test Plug / Bung)
options_zh.C: 用鐵錘敲入的木製尖塞
options_zh.D: 一卷普通封箱膠帶

explanation_en: Expanding mechanical bungs have rubber rim seals compressed between steel plates via a central wing-nut, sealing against test pressures.
explanation_zh: 排水試壓專用膨脹塞（Bung）通過旋轉中央翼形螺母擠壓橡膠外圈向外膨脹，緊緊咬合在排污管內壁，中央自帶打壓氣門嘴供打氣測漏。
source_reference: Approved Document H Section 2; BS EN 1610

content_en: Why is hydrostatic pressure testing (using water) universally preferred over pneumatic testing (using compressed air) for high pressure plumbing lines?
content_zh: 在對高壓水暖管路進行強度和嚴密性打壓試驗時，為什麼行業標準普遍優先推薦「水壓試驗 (Hydrostatic)」，而非「壓縮空氣氣壓試驗 (Pneumatic)」？

options_en.A: Water is much cheaper than free air
options_en.B: Water is virtually incompressible, storing minimal explosive energy in the event of joint rupture, whereas compressed air stores catastrophic explosive energy

options_zh.A: 水比大氣中的免費空氣更加便宜
options_zh.B: 水幾乎不可被壓縮，管件破裂時釋放的衝擊能量極小；而壓縮空氣被高度壓縮儲存了巨大的爆炸能量，破裂時會像炸彈一樣射出碎片造成人員傷亡
options_zh.C: 空氣會立即將銅腐蝕分解
options_zh.D: 所有試壓泵只能注入液體

explanation_en: Gases compress exponentially, releasing violent shockwaves upon mechanical failure. Incompressible water depressurizes instantly with minimal hazard.
explanation_zh: 水是不可壓縮流體，管件一旦開裂壓力瞬間洩盡至零；而壓縮氣體蘊含巨大的氣體膨脹功，接口爆開時管件會如同炮彈碎片高速飛射，極度危險。
source_reference: HSE Guidance Note GS4 Safety in pressure testing; BS 8000-13

content_en: Under BS 7786, what colour spool is typically used for heavy-duty gas-rated PTFE thread sealing tape to distinguish it from water-grade tape?
content_zh: 根據 BS 7786 標準，用於易燃燃氣管螺紋密封的加厚高密度 PTFE 生料帶，其專用塑料外殼或色標通常是什麼顏色以區別於普通水用生料帶？

options_en.B: White spool casing

options_zh.A: 黃色塑料殼包裝 (Yellow Spool)
options_zh.B: 白色普通外殼
options_zh.C: 粉紅色外殼
options_zh.D: 透明外殼

explanation_en: Gas-grade PTFE tape is thicker and denser to prevent gaseous molecule migration and is supplied in yellow spools conforming to EN 751-3.
explanation_zh: 燃氣專用 PTFE 生料帶（如符合 BS EN 751-3 等級）厚度與密度均遠高於普通水用生料帶，外殼採用統一黃色標識，嚴禁用水用白生料帶代替。
source_reference: BS 7786; BS EN 751-3 Sealing materials for metallic threaded joints

content_en: When cutting large penetrations for 110mm soil pipes through brick cavity walls, which power tool accessory is safest and cleanest?
content_zh: 在磚砌夾心牆上為 110mm 排污立管開鑿穿牆大圓孔時，使用何種電動工具附件施工最為安全、規整且震動最小？

options_en.B: Dry diamond core drill barrel on rotary-only mode (with clutch-protected machine)

options_zh.A: 木工手斧
options_zh.B: 純旋轉無衝擊模式下的乾式金剛石薄壁金剛石水鑽/開孔器 (Diamond Core Barrel)，配合帶過載扭矩離合器的專用鑽機
options_zh.C: 風鎬氣動扁鏟
options_zh.D: 木工鏈鋸

explanation_en: Diamond core cutters grind a clean circular core without shattering structural brickwork, provided the hammer action is strictly turned OFF.
explanation_zh: 金剛石開孔筒能切出光滑規整的圓孔而不破壞磚牆結構。鑽孔時必須關閉衝擊功能（純旋轉），且電鑽必須具備機械安全離合器以防鑽頭卡死扭傷手腕。
source_reference: Power Tool Safety Guidelines; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What is the function of plastic collet clips fitted onto push-fit fittings after installation?
content_zh: 快插接頭在組裝到位後，卡入插頭根部的「防拆鎖定卡扣（Collet Clip）」的核心作用是什麼？

options_en.B: To lock the collet in the extended position, preventing accidental release if pipes are pulled or knocked behind wall cavities

options_zh.A: 保持管件表面光潔度
options_zh.B: 將伸縮卡爪鎖定在彈出外張位置，防止管道在暗埋吊頂或管道井中受外力碰撞拉扯時發生誤碰縮回脫扣
options_zh.C: 抵禦雷擊浪湧
options_zh.D: 提升管內自來水壓力

explanation_en: Collet clips prevent the release mechanism from being compressed accidentally by surrounding cables, expansion movement, or building debris.
explanation_zh: 鎖定夾（Collet Clip）能墊實外圈彈性套筒，杜絕在隱蔽工程暗埋後，周圍電線穿插或管道熱膨脹滑動意外壓下卡套釋放環引發脫管跑水災難。
source_reference: JG Speedfit / Hep2O Technical Guidance

content_en: When soldering in close proximity to timber structural floor joists, what protective equipment must be deployed behind the pipe?
content_zh: 在靠近木質結構地板承重托樑處使用噴燈明火進行軟釬焊時，銅管後方必須強制墊置何種防護裝備？

options_en.B: Certified flame-retardant heat shield mat (rated up to 1000°C+ to BS 476)

options_zh.A: 沾濕的舊報紙
options_zh.B: 符合 BS 476 阻燃標準、耐高溫 1000°C 以上的專業防火隔熱毯 / 防火墊 (Heat Shield Mat)
options_zh.C: 硬紙板瓦楞紙包裝箱
options_zh.D: 聚乙烯塑料防塵布

explanation_en: Flame mats withstand temperatures over 1000°C, shielding wood from direct flame impingement and radiant heat during hot works.
explanation_zh: 高規格陶瓷纖維或玻璃纖維防火隔熱擋板能經受噴燈烈焰直接烘烤，阻隔熱量向易燃乾燥木托樑傳遞，是落實熱工動火規範的基本底線。
source_reference: RC7 Joint Code of Practice on Hot Works; C&G Unit 203

content_en: When bending a copper pipe using an internal bending spring, in which direction should the spring be twisted as it is withdrawn from the finished bend?
content_zh: 使用內彎管彈簧彎折銅管完畢後，在將彈簧從管內抽出時，應朝什麼方向旋轉彈簧以便於拔出？

options_en.A: Twist in the direction that tightens the coils, reducing the spring diameter slightly to release its grip against the internal pipe wall
options_en.B: Twist in the direction that uncoils and expands the spring
options_en.C: Never twist the spring; pull straight with a vehicle
options_en.D: Heat the spring with a torch

options_zh.A: 順著旋緊彈簧鋼絲的方向旋轉，使其外徑微量收縮變細，從而脫離管壁緊箍卡阻順暢滑出
options_zh.B: 朝著鬆開彈簧使其外徑脹大的方向旋轉
options_zh.C: 絕對不要旋轉，用工程車死死直線拉拽
options_zh.D: 用噴燈將彈簧燒紅變軟後拔出

explanation_en: Twisting the spring to tighten its coil reduces its outside diameter, disengaging it from the inner throat for effortless extraction.
explanation_zh: 彎管彈簧受折彎擠壓後會死死咬在銅管內弧。順著繞線方向稍微旋轉能收緊螺旋圈直徑，使彈簧脫扣變細，拉動牽引金屬環即可輕鬆抽出。
source_reference: Copper Tube Bending Techniques; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What occurs to polybutylene (PB) pipe if it is exposed to direct natural sunlight for prolonged periods on a construction site?
content_zh: 聚丁烯 (PB) 塑料管材若被長期隨意露天暴晒在工地陽光直射下，會引發何種材料性質劣變？

options_en.B: Ultraviolet (UV) radiation breaks down the polymer molecular chains, causing photo-degradation, surface embrittlement, and micro-cracking

options_zh.A: 變得堅不可摧刀槍不入
options_zh.B: 陽光中的紫外線 (UV) 會切斷高分子聚合物分子鏈，造成光化學老化降解，管材表面泛白脆化並產生微裂紋承壓能力驟降
options_zh.C: 材質自動蛻變為純銅
options_zh.D: 塑料耐熱熔點大幅升高

explanation_en: Polybutylene and PEX tubes lack UV stabilisers and degrade under sunlight. They must be stored indoors or under UV-opaque coverings.
explanation_zh: 熱塑性塑料管道對紫外線極度敏感。長期暴晒會導致聚合物分子鏈斷裂脆裂，若未經避光保護直接安裝入牆，日後在常規水壓下極易脆性破裂爆管。
source_reference: BS 7291-1 Specification for plastic pipes; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What is the purpose of an adjustable torque-limiting clutch on a modern cordless battery drill/driver when screwing pipe clips into timber joists?
content_zh: 現代充電式鋰電鑽/起子機在向木托樑上擰自攻螺絲固定管卡時，其內置的可調扭力限制離合器（Torque Clutch）的作用是什麼？

options_en.A: To limit drill bit speed to 1 RPM
options_en.B: To disengage the drive at a preset torque, preventing stripping the screw head, snapping the screw, or crushing the plastic pipe clip

options_zh.A: 將鑽頭轉速精確限制在每分鐘 1 轉
options_zh.B: 在達到預設扭矩時自動跳齒脫開動力傳動，防止擰花螺絲十字槽、擰斷螺絲桿或將塑料管卡本體壓裂壓碎
options_zh.C: 輸出 230V 交流市電
options_zh.D: 自動向螺釘螺紋注入潤滑油

explanation_en: Setting the mechanical clutch slips the drive once the screw is seated, protecting plastic fittings from being cracked by over-torquing.
explanation_zh: 扭矩調節環通過彈簧鋼珠離合器控制最大扭矩，在螺釘剛剛鎖緊時及時打滑脫扣，防止電動機強大慣性將塑料管卡耳座壓斷破壞。
source_reference: Power Tool Operational Safety; C&G Unit 203

content_en: Why should solvent cement never be thinned using petrol, turpentine, or water if it has begun to dry out in the can?
content_zh: 當一罐溶劑膠水（Solvent Cement）在施工中因開蓋過久揮發變稠乾涸時，為什麼絕對不能使用汽油、松節水或清水進行稀釋調和？

options_en.B: Foreign solvents alter the chemical formulation, preventing proper dissolution of the plastic and rendering the adhesive joint completely defective
options_en.C: It turns the solvent into solid gold

options_zh.A: 會散發出過於芳香的氣味
options_zh.B: 外來稀釋劑會徹底破壞膠水的專用化學組分配比，無法正常溶脹塑料分子，導致膠接接頭在承壓時完全脆化剝離脫扣
options_zh.C: 會將膠水轉化為純金液體
options_zh.D: 會導致房間氣溫下降

explanation_en: Solvent cement relies on a precise balance of active ketones and esters. Adding uncontrolled chemicals destroys bonding capability; thickened cans must be discarded.
explanation_zh: 溶劑膠水必須維持嚴格的特定酮類與酯類溶劑溶融平衡。一旦乾涸稠化必須直接整罐報廢更換新膠，嚴禁任何擅自稀釋，否則接頭必漏。
source_reference: BS EN 14814 Adhesives for thermoplastic piping systems

content_en: When installing vertical copper or plastic discharge pipes through floor joists, why must a minimum clearance be maintained around the pipe?
content_zh: 當垂直排水管穿過樓板穿洞時，為什麼穿孔周圍必須保留足夠的均勻間隙而不能卡死或打釘夾緊？

options_en.B: To allow thermal axial movement and prevent squeaking noises as hot water discharges cause the pipe to expand against the joist
options_en.C: To let light shine through floors

options_zh.A: 為了方便管道井內的昆蟲上下爬行
options_zh.B: 留出足夠的軸向熱脹冷縮游隙，消除高溫生活熱水排放時管道伸長與木地板托樑擠壓摩擦產生的劇烈木作嘎吱異響
options_zh.C: 讓光線能夠穿透樓層照明
options_zh.D: 減輕水管的自重負荷

explanation_en: Plastics and copper expand rapidly when discharging domestic hot water. Tight holes pinch the pipe, causing loud acoustic clicks and joint strain.
explanation_zh: 廢水管在排出 60°C 以上洗碗熱水時會劇烈伸長。若開孔過窄或緊靠木料，管壁會因摩擦發出刺耳的咯吱熱脹異響，甚至拉偏接頭引發漏水。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document E & H; BS 8000-13

content_en: What is the maximum service temperature permitted for standard plastic waste pipes manufactured from ABS and PVC-U under BS EN 1455?
content_zh: 根據 BS EN 1455 標準，由普通 ABS 和 PVC-U 材質製造的室內塑料排水管，其允許承受的連續生活廢水排放最高安全溫度通常是多少？

options_en.B: Intermittent short-term discharges up to approx 75°C to 80°C (MuPVC or Polypropylene preferred for continuous boiling discharges)

options_zh.A: 僅限 30°C 以下常溫水
options_zh.B: 允許間歇性短暫排放最高約 75°C 至 80°C 熱水（若排放連續沸水應選用改性 MuPVC 或高耐溫聚丙烯 PP 管）
options_zh.C: 300°C 高溫水
options_zh.D: 1000°C 熔融金屬

explanation_en: Standard PVC-U and ABS soften at higher temperatures. For continuous high-temp kitchen discharges (commercial dishwashers), PP or MuPVC is selected.
explanation_zh: 普通 PVC-U 熱變形溫度在 65-75°C 之間。家用短暫排熱水無妨，但商用廚房排放沸水會導致 PVC 管道軟化塌陷，需選用聚丙烯 (PP) 或銅管。
source_reference: BS EN 1455-1; C&G Unit 203

content_en: Why should the operator never apply excessive body weight or leverage onto a hand pipe cutter when rotating around a copper tube?
content_zh: 水暖工使用手動旋轉割管器切割銅管時，為什麼在每轉一圈時嚴禁過猛過快地下旋進刀旋鈕或施加過度槓桿體重？

options_en.B: Excessive feeding deforms the pipe out-of-round (ovality), crushes thin walls, and can fracture the hardened steel cutting wheel

options_zh.A: 這會導致房間燈光變暗
options_zh.B: 過猛進刀會將圓形管身強行擠壓成橢圓形失圓、壓癟薄壁管材，並極易將淬火高硬度的切削滾輪刀刃崩裂崩口
options_zh.C: 會導致管內水壓不可控上升
options_zh.D: 會使銅管長度不可控拉長

explanation_en: Gradual light feeding (tightening 1/4 turn per revolution) ensures a clean circular cut without flattening the tube into an oval profile.
explanation_zh: 正確割管手法是「輕進刀、勤旋轉」，每轉一到兩圈微調旋鈕四分之一圈，確保割輪平穩切入金屬，維持管口完美真圓度以便於後續承插。
source_reference: Copper Development Association Installation Guide; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What specialized tool is used to form the bell flare on annealed soft copper pipe for Type B manipulative compression joints?
content_zh: 在組裝 Type B 變形擴口式卡套管件時，水暖工使用何種專用工具將退火軟銅管端部沖壓擴成均勻對稱的喇叭口？

options_en.B: Cold chisel

options_zh.A: 擴口沖子 / 喇叭口擴口器套裝 (Flaring Drift / Tool)
options_zh.B: 鋼鏨子
options_zh.C: 活口台盆扳手
options_zh.D: 金剛石水鑽

explanation_en: A flaring tool (drift) is driven into the annealed tube end within a split clamp to form a precise 45 or 90-degree flare matching the fitting cone.
explanation_zh: 擴口工具包含分瓣夾管模具與帶精密錐度的沖子，敲擊或旋緊螺桿將軟銅管口沖壓擴成精確的喇叭口，使其與接頭金屬錐面完美貼合密封。
source_reference: BS EN 1254-2; C&G Unit 203

content_en: What is the International System of Units (SI) base unit for thermodynamic temperature?
content_zh: 在國際單位制 (SI) 的基本單位中，熱力學溫度的基準測量單位是什麼？

options_en.B: Degree Fahrenheit (°F)

options_zh.A: 攝氏度 (°C)
options_zh.B: 華氏度 (°F)
options_zh.C: 開爾文 (K - Kelvin)
options_zh.D: 蘭氏度 (°R)

explanation_en: Kelvin (K) is the SI base unit for thermodynamic temperature. Absolute zero is 0 K (-273.15°C).
explanation_zh: 開爾文 (K) 是國際單位制規定的七個基本物理量之一，絕對零度為 0 K（相當於 -273.15°C）。
source_reference: SI Brochure (BIPM); C&G Unit 202

content_en: Which derived SI unit is defined as the force that imparts an acceleration of 1 m/s² to a mass of 1 kilogram?
content_zh: 哪一個國際導出單位被定義為：使 1 千克質量的物體產生 1 米/秒² 加速度所需的力？

options_en.B: Joule (J)

options_zh.A: 帕斯卡 (Pa)
options_zh.B: 焦耳 (J)
options_zh.C: 牛頓 (N - Newton)
options_zh.D: 瓦特 (W)

explanation_en: One Newton (N) is defined as 1 kg·m/s², the SI unit of force according to Newton's Second Law (F = m × a).
explanation_zh: 牛頓 (N) 是力的國際標準單位，由牛頓第二定律 F = m × a 導出，1 N = 1 kg·m/s²。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 202 Scientific Principles

content_en: How many Pascals (Pa) are equivalent to an operating water pressure of 1 bar?
content_zh: 在水壓與水暖計量中，1 bar（巴）的壓力精確等同於多少帕斯卡 (Pa)？
explanation_en: 1 bar is defined exactly as 100,000 Pascals (100 kPa or 0.1 N/mm²), roughly equal to atmospheric pressure at sea level.
explanation_zh: 1 bar 定義為 100,000 Pa（即 100 kPa 或 0.1 MPa），常作為工程水壓的標準常用單位。
source_reference: BS EN ISO 80000-4; C&G Unit 202

content_en: What is the SI derived unit of electrical power, defined as the rate of energy transfer of one joule per second?
content_zh: 定義為每秒傳遞 1 焦耳能量的電功率國際導出單位是什麼？

options_en.B: Ohm (Ω)

options_zh.A: 伏特 (V)
options_zh.B: 歐姆 (Ω)
options_zh.C: 瓦特 (W - Watt)
options_zh.D: 庫侖 (C)

explanation_en: The Watt (W) is the SI unit of power, representing 1 Joule of energy consumed or delivered per second (1 W = 1 J/s).
explanation_zh: 瓦特 (W) 是功率的國際單位，1 W = 1 J/s（1 焦耳/秒），在水暖中常表示散熱器散熱量或鍋爐輸出熱功率。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Basic Science

content_en: What is the mass of water contained in a fully filled 180-liter domestic unvented hot water cylinder? (Assume density of water = 1 kg/L)
content_zh: 一個裝滿純水的 180 公升家用閉式熱水儲水罐，其內部所儲存的水的淨質量是多少？（取常溫水密度為 1 kg/L）

options_en.B: 90 kg

options_zh.A: 18 kg
options_zh.B: 90 kg
options_zh.C: 180 kg

explanation_en: Mass = Volume × Density. 180 L × 1 kg/L = 180 kg (excluding the weight of the steel/copper cylinder shell).
explanation_zh: 質量 = 體積 × 密度。180 升水對應淨重 180 千克（kg），此承重計算在規劃樓板安裝荷載時至關重要。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Density & Mass

content_en: What is the relative density (specific gravity) of natural gas (methane) compared to atmospheric air (air = 1.0)?
content_zh: 與標準大氣空氣（相對密度取 1.0）相比，天然氣（主要成分為甲烷 CH4）的相對密度大約是多少？

options_en.B: 1.0 (identical to air)

options_zh.A: 約 0.6 (顯著輕於空氣，洩漏時向上升騰飄散)
options_zh.B: 1.0 (與空氣密度完全一致)
options_zh.C: 1.5 (重於空氣)
options_zh.D: 2.0 (重於空氣)

explanation_en: Natural gas has a relative density of approx 0.6, meaning it is lighter than air and rises naturally towards ceilings/vents.
explanation_zh: 天然氣比重約為 0.55-0.6，顯著輕於空氣，一旦發生微量洩漏會迅速向房間天花板上方積聚飄散。
source_reference: Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regs; C&G Unit 202

content_en: What is the relative density of commercial Propane gas (LPG) compared to air (air = 1.0)?
content_zh: 商用丙烷氣體（LPG 液化石油氣）相對於空氣（空氣 = 1.0）的相對密度大約是多少？

options_en.B: 0.6 (lighter than air)

options_zh.A: 0.3 (輕於空氣)
options_zh.B: 0.6 (輕於空氣)
options_zh.C: 約 1.5 (顯著重於空氣，洩漏時向地面及地溝沉降)

explanation_en: Propane has a relative density of ~1.5 (and Butane is ~2.0). Both are heavier than air and sink to floors, drains, and basements.
explanation_zh: 丙烷比重為 1.5（丁烷約為 2.0），比空氣重 50%。洩漏時會像水一樣貼地流淌並沉積在地下室、排污溝和地漏等低窪死角。
source_reference: UKLPG Code of Practice; C&G Unit 202

content_en: At what temperature does pure water achieve its maximum physical density before expanding as it cools towards freezing?
content_zh: 純水在溫度降低接近冰點的過程中，在攝氏幾度時達到其物理密度的最大峰值？

options_zh.B: 4°C (最大密度峰值點)

explanation_en: Water displays anomalous expansion; its maximum density occurs at 4°C (1000 kg/m³). Cooling below 4°C causes it to expand.
explanation_zh: 水具有罕見的反常膨脹特性，在 4°C 時體積最小、密度最大；由 4°C 降溫至 0°C 時體積不縮反脹。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 202 Textbook Ch 3

content_en: By approximately what percentage does the volume of water expand when it freezes from liquid water at 0°C into solid ice at 0°C?
content_zh: 當水在 0°C 下由液態水凝結轉變為 0°C 的固態冰晶時，其體積大約會劇烈膨脹百分之幾？

options_en.B: 8% to 10% (approx 9%)

explanation_en: Water expands by approximately 9% upon freezing. In confined rigid pipes, this volumetric expansion exerts immense hoop stress that ruptures copper and plastics.
explanation_zh: 水結冰時水分子形成開放式六角晶格，體積急劇膨脹約 9%~10%，在封閉管腔內產生高達數千 bar 的巨大膨脹力，導致管道凍裂爆管。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Properties of Water

content_en: By approximately what percentage does a volume of liquid water expand when heated from 4°C to 100°C under normal atmospheric pressure?
content_zh: 在一個標準大氣壓下，液態水由 4°C 加熱升溫至 100°C 時，其體積總共會膨脹大約百分之幾？

options_en.B: 4.2% (approx 4%)

explanation_en: Water expands by approx 4.2% when heated from cold (4°C) to boiling point (100°C), necessitating expansion vessels or expansion cistern volume.
explanation_zh: 冷水受熱升溫至沸騰體積膨脹約 4.2%~4.3%。這正是熱水系統和閉式供暖系統必須精確配置膨脹水箱（Expansion Vessel）的理論依據。
source_reference: Institute of Plumbing Design Guide; BS EN 12828

content_en: What is the definition of the 'Specific Heat Capacity' of a substance?
content_zh: 物理學中，一種物質的「比熱容 (Specific Heat Capacity)」是如何科學定義的？

options_en.A: The maximum temperature a substance can reach before vaporizing
options_en.B: The amount of heat energy required to raise the temperature of 1 kilogram of the substance by 1 degree Celsius (or 1 Kelvin)
options_en.C: The electrical resistance of the material when hot
options_en.D: The rate at which heat moves through a vacuum

options_zh.A: 物質在氣化沸騰前所能達到的最高極限溫度
options_zh.B: 使 1 千克質量的該物質升高 1 攝氏度（或 1 開爾文）所需的熱能量數值
options_zh.C: 該材料在高溫下的直流電阻值
options_zh.D: 熱量在真空中輻射傳播的速度

explanation_en: Specific heat capacity (c) is the energy needed to increase the temperature of 1 kg of a substance by 1°C (for water, c = 4.187 kJ/kg·°C).
explanation_zh: 比熱容衡量物質吸收或釋放熱量的能力，指單位質量（1 kg）升高或降低 1°C 所吸收或放出的能量，水的比熱容約為 4.187 kJ/(kg·°C)。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Thermodynamics

content_en: What is the accepted standard specific heat capacity of pure liquid water used in UK plumbing calculations?
content_zh: 在英國水暖與供暖工程計算中，純液態水的標準比熱容常數通常取何值？

options_en.B: 2.50 kJ/kg·°C

options_zh.A: 1.00 kJ/kg·°C
options_zh.B: 2.50 kJ/kg·°C
options_zh.D: 10.0 kJ/kg·°C

explanation_en: The specific heat capacity of water is 4.187 kJ/kg·°C (or 4187 J/kg·K), which is exceptionally high compared to metals (copper is 0.385 kJ/kg·°C).
explanation_zh: 水的比熱容取 4.187 kJ/(kg·°C)（或 4187 J/(kg·K)）。極高的比熱容使得水成為建築供暖系統中最理想、經濟且高效的載熱循環介質。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 202 Textbook Ch 3

content_en: How much heat energy is required to raise the temperature of 100 kg of water from 10°C to 60°C? (Using c = 4.187 kJ/kg·°C)
content_zh: 將 100 千克的水從 10°C 加熱升溫至 60°C，理論上需要輸入多少熱能？（水的比熱容取 4.187 kJ/kg·°C）

options_en.B: 20,935 kJ (approx 20.9 MJ)

source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Heat Energy Calculations

content_en: What is the definition of 'Latent Heat'?
content_zh: 在熱力學中，「潛熱 (Latent Heat)」的定義是什麼？

options_en.A: Heat that causes a measurable change in temperature on a thermometer
options_en.B: Heat energy absorbed or released by a substance during a change of physical state that occurs without any change in temperature
options_en.C: Heat lost through an uninsulated attic window
options_en.D: The heat output of a domestic gas cooker

options_zh.A: 能在溫度計上直接讀出溫度變化的熱量（顯熱）
options_zh.B: 物質在純物理相態轉變（如冰變水、水變汽）過程中吸收或釋放、但溫度保持恆定不變的隱蔽熱量
options_zh.C: 通過未保溫窗戶散失的熱量
options_zh.D: 燃氣灶火焰的額定熱負荷

explanation_en: Latent heat ('hidden' heat) breaks or forms intermolecular bonds during phase change (melting/boiling) at constant temperature.
explanation_zh: 相對於顯熱（Sensible Heat），潛熱只改變物質聚集狀態（固-液-氣相變），在相變完成前體系溫度計數值完全維持不變。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Thermodynamics

content_en: What is the latent heat of fusion of ice at 0°C into liquid water at 0°C?
content_zh: 在標準大氣壓下，0°C 的固態冰熔化轉變為 0°C 的液態水時，其「熔化潛熱 (Latent Heat of Fusion)」大約是多少？

options_en.B: 334 kJ/kg

options_zh.A: 4.187 kJ/kg
options_zh.B: 334 kJ/kg (約 334 焦耳/克)
options_zh.C: 2,260 kJ/kg (汽化潛熱)

explanation_en: The specific latent heat of fusion of water is approximately 334 kJ/kg, representing the massive energy required to break the solid crystal lattice.
explanation_zh: 水在 0°C 時的熔化潛熱約為 334 kJ/kg。融化 1 公斤冰所消耗的熱量，足以將 1 公斤 0°C 的冷水加熱至近 80°C 高溫。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 202 Scientific Principles

content_en: What is the latent heat of vaporisation of water boiling at 100°C into steam at 100°C?
content_zh: 在標準大氣壓下，100°C 的沸水氣化轉變為 100°C 的水蒸氣時，其「汽化潛熱 (Latent Heat of Vaporisation)」大約是多少？

options_en.B: 850 kJ/kg

options_zh.A: 334 kJ/kg (熔化潛熱)
options_zh.B: 850 kJ/kg
options_zh.C: 2,260 kJ/kg (約 2.26 MJ/kg)
options_zh.D: 4,187 kJ/kg

explanation_en: The latent heat of vaporisation of water is 2260 kJ/kg. This high value explains why modern condensing boilers recover huge efficiency by condensing flue steam.
explanation_zh: 水的汽化潛熱高達 2260 kJ/kg。現代冷凝鍋爐正是通過冷卻煙氣中的水蒸氣使其凝結成液態水，將這部分巨大潛熱回收回供暖水，使熱效率超 90%。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Latent Heat & Boiler Efficiency

content_en: How does an increase in system pressure affect the boiling point of pure water inside an unvented hot water cylinder?
content_zh: 在承壓運行的閉式熱水系統（Unvented Cylinder）中，系統內部工作壓力的升高會對水的沸點產生何種影響？

options_en.B: The boiling point remains unchanged at exactly 100°C
options_en.C: The boiling point increases significantly above 100°C (e.g. approx 138°C at 3.5 bar)
options_en.D: The water can never boil under any circumstance

options_zh.A: 水的沸點會急劇降低至 100°C 以下
options_zh.B: 水的沸點保持不變始終精確為 100°C
options_zh.C: 水的沸點會顯著升高至 100°C 以上（例如在 3.5 bar 工作壓力下沸點升至約 138°C）
options_zh.D: 水在任何情況下均永遠無法沸騰

explanation_en: Higher ambient pressure forces water molecules closer together, raising the boiling point. At 3.5 bar gauge, water boils at roughly 138°C, which poses severe explosion risks if ruptured.
explanation_zh: 外壓增大會壓制水分子脫離液面氣化。在 3.5 bar 壓力下水溫可加熱至 138°C 仍保持液態；若容器突然破裂降壓，過熱水會瞬間閃蒸爆炸。
source_reference: Approved Document G3; C&G Unit 202

content_en: What chemical compound is primarily responsible for 'temporary hardness' in domestic water supplies?
content_zh: 自來水供應中的「暫時硬度 (Temporary Hardness)」，主要由水中溶解的哪種化學化合物所引起？

options_en.B: Calcium bicarbonate (calcium hydrogen carbonate - Ca(HCO3)2)

options_zh.A: 氯化鈉 (普通食用鹽)
options_zh.B: 碳酸氫鈣 (Ca(HCO3)2) 及碳酸氫鎂
options_zh.C: 硫酸銅
options_zh.D: 氧化鉛

explanation_en: Temporary hardness is caused by dissolved calcium and magnesium bicarbonates, which precipitate out as insoluble limescale when heated above 61°C.
explanation_zh: 暫時硬度源於雨水穿透石灰岩地層溶入的碳酸氫鈣/鎂。當水溫被加熱超過 61°C 時，碳酸氫鹽分解析出不溶性碳酸鈣，形成堅硬水垢。
source_reference: Water Regulations / BS 7593; C&G Unit 202

content_en: At what critical water temperature does dissolved temporary hardness begin to precipitate out rapidly as hard limescale inside heat exchangers?
content_zh: 在熱水加熱器或鍋爐換熱器內部，溶解的暫時硬度離子在水溫達到攝氏幾度臨界點時，開始急劇分解析出結晶成為堅硬水垢？

options_zh.D: 只有在 100°C 沸點時

explanation_en: Thermal decomposition of calcium bicarbonate accelerates sharply above 61°C, depositing calcium carbonate scale on heating elements.
explanation_zh: 化學反應 Ca(HCO3)2 → CaCO3↓ + H2O + CO2 在水溫超過 61°C 時急劇加速。這就是為什麼將儲水溫度控制在 60°C 既能殺死軍團菌又能減緩結垢。
source_reference: BS 7593:2019; Domestic Heating Design Guide

content_en: Which water treatment process removes 'permanent hardness' (calcium and magnesium sulphates) by replacing them with sodium ions?
content_zh: 哪一種水質軟化處理技術，通過利用鈉離子置換水中的鈣、鎂離子，從根本上徹底消除水中的「永久硬度」？

options_en.B: Ion-exchange water softener with sodium chloride resin bed regeneration
options_en.D: Passing water through a copper pipe

options_zh.A: 在敞口水壺中煮沸
options_zh.B: 離子交換樹脂軟水機 (Ion-exchange Water Softener，利用工業鹽氯化鈉鹽水進行樹脂再生)
options_zh.C: 普通金屬濾網機械過濾
options_zh.D: 直接讓水流穿過普通銅管

explanation_en: Ion-exchange softeners swap calcium and magnesium hardness ions with sodium ions on a polystyrene resin bed, fully removing both temporary and permanent hardness.
explanation_zh: 永久硬度（硫酸鈣等）無法通過加熱沉澱去除。離子交換軟水器利用帶鈉離子的樹脂基團吸附鈣鎂離子，定期用食鹽濃鹽水沖洗再生。
source_reference: Water Regulations Guide; BS 14743

content_en: What is the mathematical relationship between static water pressure (P), fluid density (ρ), acceleration due to gravity (g), and vertical head (h)?
content_zh: 在流體靜力學中，靜水壓強 (P)、流體密度 (ρ)、重力加速度 (g) 與垂直水頭高度 (h) 之間的標準數學公式是什麼？

options_en.B: P = ρ × g × h

options_zh.A: P = ρ + g + h
options_zh.B: P = ρ × g × h (壓強 = 密度 × 重力加速度 × 垂直高度)
options_zh.C: P = (ρ × h) / g
options_zh.D: P = m × c × ΔT

explanation_en: Hydrostatic pressure equals fluid density multiplied by gravity multiplied by vertical column height (P = ρgh).
explanation_zh: 流體靜壓基本公式為 P = ρgh。其中 ρ 為水密度 (1000 kg/m³)，g 取 9.81 m/s²，h 為水面至測點的垂直落差高度（米）。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Fluid Mechanics

content_en: In standard UK plumbing practice, what convenient rule of thumb converts 1 meter of vertical static water head into water pressure?
content_zh: 在英國水暖工程日常經驗估算中，1 米垂直靜態水頭落差通常快速等同於多少工作壓強？

options_en.B: 1 meter head ≈ 0.1 bar (10 kPa or 9.81 kPa)

options_zh.A: 1 米水頭 ≈ 0.01 bar (1 kPa)
options_zh.B: 1 米水頭 ≈ 0.1 bar (10 kPa，精確值為 9.81 kPa)
options_zh.C: 1 米水頭 ≈ 1.0 bar (100 kPa)
options_zh.D: 1 米水頭 ≈ 10 bar

explanation_zh: 1 米水頭產生的靜壓約為 9.81 kPa（約 0.098 bar），工程現場常口算簡化為「1米水頭約等於 0.1 bar（或 10 kPa）」。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 202 Textbook Ch 3

content_en: A pressure gauge at a kitchen tap situated 8 meters vertically below the operating water level in a cold water storage cistern measures static pressure. What is the reading?
content_zh: 某廚房水龍頭安裝在閣樓冷水儲水箱工作水位線垂直下方 8 米處。在水龍頭關閉時，壓力表測得的靜態壓力是多少？

options_en.B: 0.8 bar (approx 80 kPa)

options_zh.A: 0.08 bar
options_zh.B: 0.8 bar (約 80 kPa)
options_zh.C: 8.0 bar
options_zh.D: 80 bar

explanation_en: Static pressure = Head × 0.1 bar/m = 8m × 0.1 = 0.8 bar (or exactly 8 × 9.81 kPa = 78.5 kPa).
explanation_zh: 靜壓計算：8 米水頭 × 0.1 bar/米 = 0.8 bar（精確值為 8 × 9.81 = 78.48 kPa）。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Pressure Calculations

content_en: Why does the static water pressure at a downstairs tap remain identical whether the cold water storage cistern in the loft holds 50 liters or 500 liters of water?
content_zh: 為什麼不論閣樓上的儲水箱容量是 50 公升還是 500 公升，只要水箱水面至樓下水龍頭的垂直高度相同，水龍頭處的靜態水壓就完全一樣？

options_en.B: Hydrostatic pressure depends solely on vertical liquid height (head) and fluid density, completely independent of the water volume, cistern surface area, or cistern shape
options_en.C: The water meter regulates the pressure automatically

options_zh.A: 因為冷水管道包裹了保溫層
options_zh.B: 流體靜水壓（帕斯卡流體靜力學悖論）僅取決於液體垂直深度與密度，與容器的蓄水容積、表面積或幾何形狀完全無關
options_zh.C: 水錶自動將壓力調節為恆定值
options_zh.D: 水受熱時體積會膨脹

explanation_en: Hydrostatic pressure (P = ρgh) depends solely on vertical depth, not on cistern width, shape, or total stored volume (hydrostatic paradox).
explanation_zh: 流體靜力學定律證明，靜壓只與垂直水頭 h 相關。大水箱與小水箱只要水面到出水嘴的垂直標高差相同，出水嘴處產生的靜態壓強分毫不差。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Fluid Mechanics

content_en: What is the difference between 'static pressure' and 'dynamic (working) pressure' in a water distribution pipe?
content_zh: 在給水管網中，「靜態水壓 (Static Pressure)」與「動態/工作水壓 (Dynamic Pressure)」的本質區別是什麼？

options_en.A: Static pressure is measured with the taps open; dynamic pressure is measured with the taps closed
options_en.B: Static pressure is measured when water is stationary (all taps closed); dynamic pressure is measured when water is flowing through the system (taps open)
options_en.C: Dynamic pressure is always higher than static pressure
options_en.D: There is no difference in plumbing systems

options_zh.A: 靜壓是在水龍頭完全開啟時測量；動壓是在水龍頭緊閉時測量
options_zh.B: 靜壓是管內水流完全靜止（所有龍頭關閉）時測得的壓力；動壓是水流在管中持續流動（龍頭開啟）時測得的實際工作壓力
options_zh.C: 動壓永遠高於靜壓
options_zh.D: 在水暖系統中兩者毫無任何區別

explanation_en: Static pressure is stationary pressure. Dynamic pressure is measured under flow conditions and is always lower due to frictional resistance.
explanation_zh: 靜止時測量值為靜壓；一旦龍頭打開流水，管壁摩擦阻力、管件折彎阻力及流體動能消耗會導致壓力下降，此時測得的殘餘壓力為動態壓力。
source_reference: BS EN 806-2; C&G Unit 202

content_en: What factor causes dynamic water pressure at a tap to drop substantially lower than the static pressure when multiple appliances are turned on?
content_zh: 當多個用水器具同時開啟時，導致水龍頭處的動態水壓比靜態水壓出現大幅跌落（掉壓）的主要物理原因是什麼？

options_en.B: Frictional resistance along the pipe bore, fittings, and valves which increases exponentially with higher water velocity

options_zh.A: 室內大氣壓突然暴增
options_zh.B: 水流在管道內壁、管件及閥門處產生的沿程阻力與局部水頭損失，且該阻力損失隨流速增大而呈平方級劇增
options_zh.C: 自來水突然轉變為強酸性
options_zh.D: 銅管外徑發生物理收縮

explanation_en: Frictional head loss in pipework varies approximately with the square of the flow velocity (Darcy-Weisbach equation), causing severe dynamic pressure drops at peak demand.
explanation_zh: 流速越高摩擦阻力越大。高流量下管道沿程水頭損失急劇上升，若管徑選用過細（如用 15mm 供應多個龍頭），動態水壓將暴跌至涓涓細流。
source_reference: BS EN 806-3 Pipe Sizing; C&G Unit 202

content_en: What is the standard atmospheric pressure at sea level in Pascals and in bar?
content_zh: 在海平面標準狀態下，地球大氣產生的標準大氣壓強（1 atm）換算為 Pa 和 bar 分別是多少？

options_en.B: 101,325 Pa (approx 1.013 bar / 101.3 kPa)

explanation_en: Standard atmospheric pressure is 101.325 kPa (1.013 bar), equivalent to supporting a column of mercury 760mm high or approx 10.3 meters of water.
explanation_zh: 標準大氣壓定義為 101,325 Pa（約 1.013 bar），相當於 760 mmHg 水銀柱或約 10.3 米純水柱所產生的靜壓。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Fluid Mechanics

content_en: What is the theoretical maximum height to which atmospheric pressure can lift water via pure suction under a perfect vacuum at sea level?
content_zh: 在海平面標準大氣壓及絕對真空條件下，大氣壓力理論上能夠將水通過吸力提升的最高極限垂直高度是多少？

options_en.B: 7.0 meters

options_zh.B: 7.0 米 (實際自吸泵工程極限)
options_zh.C: 10.3 米 (理論物理極限柱高)

explanation_en: 101,325 Pa / (1000 kg/m³ × 9.81 m/s²) = 10.33 meters. In practice, pump friction and water vapor pressure limit practical suction lift to ~7m.
explanation_zh: 計算高度 h = P / (ρg) = 101325 / (1000 × 9.81) ≈ 10.33 米。任何離心自吸泵因汽化壓及機械損耗，現場實際吸程極限通常僅為 6-7 米。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 202 Textbook Ch 3

content_en: What physical principle governs the operation of a hydraulic pipe bender where a small manual pump piston generates a massive bending thrust on a large ram?
content_zh: 手動液壓彎管機利用微小活塞輸入輕微手動力，即可在大型液壓油缸推桿上產生數噸強大推力的物理學原理是什麼？

options_en.B: Pascal's Principle of fluid pressure transmission

options_zh.A: 波義耳氣體定律
options_zh.B: 帕斯卡流體靜壓傳遞定律 (Pascal's Principle)
options_zh.C: 阿基米德浮力定律
options_zh.D: 歐姆定律

explanation_en: Pascal's Principle states that pressure exerted on a confined fluid is transmitted undiminished. Because P = F1/A1 = F2/A2, a large area ram yields huge force.
explanation_zh: 帕斯卡原理指出密閉液體壓強處處相等。輸入小活塞產生的壓強傳遞到截面積為其數十倍的大活塞上時，輸出力被成倍放大（F2 = F1 × A2 / A1）。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Hydraulics & Mechanics

content_en: What is the principle of a siphon in domestic drainage and cold water tanks?
content_zh: 在衛生器具排水及水箱虹吸放水中，「虹吸 (Siphon)」作用的物理驅動機制是什麼？

options_en.B: Atmospheric pressure pushing fluid over a crest higher than the reservoir into an outlet situated below the reservoir level

options_zh.A: 塑料管壁之間的毛細吸附作用
options_zh.B: 大氣壓力推動液體跨越比液面更高的彎管頂點，並向出水端低於容器液面的方向持續自流洩出
options_zh.C: 水中離子之間的電磁引力
options_zh.D: 管道摩擦受熱膨脹驅動

explanation_en: A siphon operates when liquid weight in the longer descending discharge leg creates a partial vacuum at the crown, allowing atmospheric pressure to sustain continuous flow.
explanation_zh: 虹吸原理依賴下降段管內液柱重量形成的微負壓，大氣壓持續將液體壓入管口翻過最高點。出口標高必須低於上游進水液面且中途無空氣漏入。
source_reference: Approved Document H; C&G Unit 202

content_en: Which mode of heat transfer involves the direct transfer of thermal kinetic energy through atomic and molecular collisions within a solid material?
content_zh: 哪一種熱傳遞方式涉及固體物質內部相鄰原子、分子及自由電子的劇烈微觀碰撞與動能直接傳導？

options_en.B: Natural Convection

options_zh.A: 熱傳導 (Conduction)
options_zh.B: 自然對流 (Convection)
options_zh.C: 熱輻射 (Radiation)
options_zh.D: 相變冷凝

explanation_en: Conduction is heat transfer through direct molecular contact without bulk motion of the material, predominant in metals like copper.
explanation_zh: 熱傳導是在無宏觀物質位移的情況下，微觀粒子熱運動的能量相互傳遞。金屬（如銅、鋁）富含自由電子，是極佳的熱導體。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Heat Transfer Modes

content_en: Which common plumbing metal has the highest thermal conductivity?
content_zh: 在常見的水暖與供暖金屬管道材料中，哪一種金屬具有最高的導熱係數（Thermal Conductivity）？

options_en.B: Mild steel (Fe)

options_zh.A: 金屬鉛 (約 35 W/m·K)
options_zh.B: 低碳鋼 (約 50 W/m·K)
options_zh.C: 純銅 (約 390 W/m·K)
options_zh.D: 鑄鐵 (約 55 W/m·K)

explanation_en: Copper has an exceptionally high thermal conductivity of approx 390 W/m·K, making it ideal for boiler heat exchangers and cylinder heating coils.
explanation_zh: 純銅導熱係數高達 390 W/(m·K)，分別是低碳鋼的近 8 倍、不銹鋼的 25 倍，因此廣泛應用於燃氣鍋爐主換熱器及熱水水箱的內置盤管。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 202 Scientific Principles

content_en: Which mode of heat transfer occurs through the bulk movement of fluids (liquids or gases) driven by density differences caused by temperature variations?
content_zh: 哪一種熱傳遞方式依靠流體（液體或氣體）內部因溫差引起的密度差異，產生浮力並推動流體產生宏觀流動？

options_en.B: Convection

options_zh.A: 熱傳導
options_zh.B: 熱對流 (Convection)
options_zh.C: 紅外熱輻射
options_zh.D: 電解離子轉移

explanation_en: Convection transfers heat via fluid circulation. Warm water or air expands, becomes less dense, and rises, while cooler dense fluid sinks.
explanation_zh: 熱對流由密度流驅動：受熱流體膨脹變輕而向上浮起，冷流體密度大而下沉，形成持續循環的對流環流（如重力循環熱水管路或暖氣片升溫）。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Heat Transfer

content_en: Why does natural gravity circulation (thermosiphon) circulate hot water from a boiler to a domestic cylinder without a mechanical pump?
content_zh: 在老式重力循環熱水系統中，為什麼無需任何機械動力水泵，熱水就能依靠「自然對流虹吸（Thermosiphon）」自動在鍋爐和水箱之間循環？

options_en.B: Water heated in the boiler expands, decreases in density, and rises up the primary flow, while cooler, denser water falls down the primary return
options_en.C: Atmospheric pressure pushes the water up
options_en.D: The boiler magnetic filter attracts the cold water

options_zh.A: 銅管自發產生高頻微振動
options_zh.B: 鍋爐內被加熱的水受熱膨脹、密度降低，沿供水管自然上升；而水箱換熱放熱後的冷水密度增大，沿回水管下沉返回鍋爐形成重力浮力壓頭
options_zh.C: 室內大氣壓強行將水向上壓入水箱
options_zh.D: 鍋爐磁性過濾器將冷水吸回

explanation_en: Density difference between hot flow (low density) and cold return (high density) creates a small natural circulation head driving flow.
explanation_zh: 重力循環完全依靠熱水與冷水的密度差（天然浮力壓頭）。供水管熱水輕向上升，回水管冷水重向下落，構成閉合的重力對流迴路。
source_reference: BS 6700; C&G Unit 202 Scientific Principles

content_en: Which mode of heat transfer can travel across a perfect vacuum without requiring any physical medium or matter?
content_zh: 哪一種熱傳遞方式能夠穿越絕對真空環境，且傳播過程中完全不需要任何固體、液體或氣體物理介質？

options_en.B: Convection

options_zh.A: 熱傳導
options_zh.B: 熱對流
options_zh.C: 熱輻射 (Thermal Radiation - 紅外電磁波)
options_zh.D: 蒸發傳導

explanation_en: Thermal radiation travels as electromagnetic waves at the speed of light and requires no matter (how solar energy travels through space to Earth).
explanation_zh: 熱輻射以紅外線等電磁波形式向外發射能量，光速傳播且完全無需傳熱介質，太陽熱能穿越外太空真空照射地球即為典型實例。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Scientific Principles

content_en: Which surface finish emits and absorbs radiant thermal energy most efficiently according to radiation physics?
content_zh: 根據熱輻射物理學定律，哪一種表面處理工藝向外發射及吸收熱輻射的效率最高？

options_en.B: Matt black finish

options_zh.A: 拋光鏡面鍍鉻表面 (發射率低於 0.05)
options_zh.B: 啞光黑色粗糙表面 (Matt Black - 發射率高達 0.95~0.98)
options_zh.C: 光亮白色搪瓷釉面
options_zh.D: 拋光純銅裸面

explanation_en: A matt black surface is an ideal 'black body' absorber and emitter of thermal radiation, with an emissivity near 1.0 (chrome is under 0.05).
explanation_zh: 黑體輻射定理指出：粗糙啞光黑表面輻射發射率近乎 1.0（極佳輻射體與吸收體）；拋光鍍鉻表面反射率極高，輻射發射能力極差（散熱量反而較低）。
source_reference: BS EN 442; C&G Unit 202

content_en: Why does a polished chrome designer towel radiator produce significantly less heat output than an identical steel radiator painted with white powder coating?
content_zh: 為什麼一組拋光鏡面鍍鉻外表的毛巾架散熱器，其熱輸出散熱量顯著低於一台外形尺寸完全一致的啞光/粉末噴塗白色鋼製散熱器？

options_en.B: Polished reflective chrome has an exceptionally low emissivity (approx 0.05), severely restricting heat emission via thermal radiation
options_en.C: Chrome destroys the hot water inside
options_en.D: The white paint boils the water

options_zh.A: 鉻金屬完全不具備導熱能力
options_zh.B: 拋光鏡面鉻的表面熱發射率極低（約 0.05），極大抑制了以熱輻射形式向室內釋放熱量的能力（散熱量可低 20%~30%）
options_zh.C: 鉻金屬會分解管內的熱水
options_zh.D: 白色油漆能將水再次加熱沸騰

explanation_en: Chrome plating reduces radiant heat emission to a fraction of painted radiators (which have emissivity around 0.9), lowering overall output by 20-30%.
explanation_zh: 散熱器散熱包含對流與輻射。拋光鉻面發射率僅約 0.05，而普通噴漆表面發射率在 0.9 以上，導致鍍鉻毛巾架輻射散熱能力暴跌。
source_reference: BS EN 442 Radiators and convectors; C&G Unit 202

content_en: What is the mathematical formula used to calculate the linear thermal expansion (ΔL) of a straight metal pipe?
content_zh: 計算金屬直管段在升溫時產生的線性熱膨脹伸長量 (ΔL) 的標準物理公式是什麼？

options_en.A: ΔL = L × α × ΔT (Original length × coefficient of expansion × temperature change)
options_en.B: ΔL = (L + α) / ΔT

options_zh.A: ΔL = L × α × ΔT (原始管長 × 線膨脹係數 × 溫度變化量)
options_zh.B: ΔL = (L + α) / ΔT
options_zh.C: ΔL = m × c × ΔT
options_zh.D: ΔL = P × V

explanation_en: Linear expansion equals original length multiplied by the material's linear expansion coefficient multiplied by the temperature rise (ΔL = L·α·ΔT).
explanation_zh: 線性膨脹計算公式為 ΔL = L × α × ΔT。其中 L 為初始長度，α 為管材線膨脹係數，ΔT 為運行工作水溫與安裝時環境溫度的溫差。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 202 Scientific Principles

content_en: A straight 10-meter run of copper pipe (coefficient of expansion α = 0.000017 /°C) is installed at 10°C and subsequently carries heating water at 70°C. What is its linear expansion in millimetres?
content_zh: 一根長度為 10 米的純銅供暖直管（線膨脹係數 α = 0.000017 /°C）在環境溫度 10°C 下安裝，通入 70°C 熱水後，其管身長度理論伸長了多少毫米？

options_zh.B: 10.2 mm (約 1 厘米)
options_zh.C: 102 mm

source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Thermal Expansion Calculations

content_en: How does the coefficient of linear thermal expansion of plastic pipe (such as PEX or Polybutylene) compare to that of copper?
content_zh: 塑料管道材質（如 PEX 或聚丁烯 PB）的線性熱膨脹係數，與金屬銅管相比大約處於何種比例關係？

options_en.A: Plastic expands 10 times less than copper
options_en.B: Plastic expands identically to copper
options_en.C: Plastic expands approximately 8 to 10 times more than copper

options_zh.A: 塑料的熱膨脹係數比銅小 10 倍
options_zh.B: 塑料的熱膨脹係數與銅完全相同
options_zh.C: 塑料的熱膨脹係數比銅大約大 8 至 10 倍
options_zh.D: 塑料受熱時體積會反向收縮

explanation_en: PEX/PB plastics have expansion coefficients around 0.00015 /°C (approx 8-10 times higher than copper at 0.000017 /°C), requiring generous expansion allowances.
explanation_zh: 塑料高分子材料受熱劇烈伸長，其線膨脹係數是金屬銅的 8 到 10 倍，長距離明裝時若未留伸縮彎或滑動卡扣，受熱時會像波浪一樣嚴重蛇行下垂。
source_reference: BS 7291; Plastics Piping Design Guide

content_en: According to Boyle's Law, what happens to the pressure of a fixed mass of gas when its volume is halved at constant temperature?
content_zh: 根據氣體實驗定律中的「波義耳定律 (Boyle's Law)」，在溫度保持恆定不變時，若將一定質量的氣體體積壓縮減半，其氣體壓力會發生何種變化？

options_en.B: The pressure is halved

options_zh.A: 壓力徹底歸零
options_zh.B: 壓力同步減半
options_zh.C: 壓力精確翻倍（P1·V1 = P2·V2 恆定）
options_zh.D: 壓力暴增 1000 倍

explanation_en: Boyle's Law states P × V = constant. Halving volume doubles the frequency of molecular collisions with the walls, doubling pressure.
explanation_zh: 波義耳定律（等溫過程）：壓強與體積成反比（P1·V1 = P2·V2）。這正是膨脹水箱橡膠氣囊受水壓擠壓容積縮小、氣囊背壓成比例上升的物理原理。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Gas Laws

content_en: According to Charles's Law, what happens to the volume of a fixed mass of gas when its absolute temperature is doubled at constant pressure?
content_zh: 根據氣體實驗定律中的「查理定律 (Charles's Law)」，在壓力保持恆定時，若將一定質量的氣體絕對溫度（以開爾文計）提高一倍，其氣體體積會如何變化？

options_en.B: The volume doubles (V1/T1 = V2/T2)

options_zh.A: 氣體體積減半
options_zh.B: 氣體體積同步翻倍 (V1/T1 = V2/T2)
options_zh.C: 氣體體積保持絕對不變
options_zh.D: 氣體瞬間凝結為液體

explanation_en: Charles's Law states volume is directly proportional to absolute temperature (in Kelvin) at constant pressure (V1/T1 = V2/T2).
explanation_zh: 查理定律（等壓過程）：氣體體積與熱力學絕對溫度（K）成正比。受熱時氣體分子動能增大、劇烈向外膨脹擴散，煙囪熱煙氣自然上升排氣亦基於此。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 202 Textbook Ch 3

content_en: What conversion is required to calculate gas law equations using temperature in degrees Celsius (°C)?
content_zh: 在運用查理定律或理想氣體狀態方程進行物理計算時，必須將日常的攝氏溫度 (°C) 轉換為哪種絕對溫標？

options_en.B: Subtract 273 from the Celsius value

options_zh.A: 在攝氏度數值上加上 273（T_Kelvin = °C + 273.15）
options_zh.B: 在攝氏度數值上減去 273
options_zh.C: 將攝氏度數值乘以 10
options_zh.D: 將攝氏度數值除以 2

explanation_en: Gas laws require thermodynamic absolute temperature measured in Kelvin: K = °C + 273.15. Using raw Celsius produces false results.
explanation_zh: 氣體定律的嚴格數學表達必須基於以絕對零度（0 K = -273.15°C）為起點的開爾文溫標，計算時必須將所有溫度統一換算為 K 才能代入公式。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Gas Laws

content_en: In the electrochemical (galvanic) series, what occurs when copper pipe is placed in direct electrical contact with galvanized mild steel in the presence of water?
content_zh: 在金屬電化學腐蝕（電偶序列）中，若將銅管與鍍鋅低碳鋼管在水中直接接觸相連，會發生何種腐蝕現象？

options_en.A: The copper pipe corrodes rapidly while the steel is protected
options_en.B: The more reactive zinc and iron become sacrificial anodes and corrode rapidly, while copper acts as a protected cathode
options_en.D: Both metals instantly turn into aluminium

options_zh.A: 銅管作為陽極急劇腐蝕穿孔，而鋼管得到保護
options_zh.B: 電化學活性更高的鋅和鐵充當犧牲陽極發生劇烈加速腐蝕，而貴金屬銅作為陰極受到保護
options_zh.C: 兩種金屬均完好無損不受任何影響
options_zh.D: 兩種金屬瞬間化合為金屬鋁

explanation_en: Copper is more noble (cathodic). The less noble zinc and steel (anodic) suffer accelerated galvanic corrosion, eroding and leaking.
explanation_zh: 在電偶腐蝕中，電位較負的活潑金屬（鐵/鋅，陽極）失去電子加速溶解破壞，電位較正的鈍性金屬（銅，陰極）得到陰極保護。
source_reference: BS 7593; C&G Unit 202 Corrosion Chemistry

content_en: Under British Standards and Water Regulations, why must water NEVER flow from a copper pipe into an upstream or downstream galvanized steel pipe?
content_zh: 根據英國國家標準與水事條例，為什麼在管道管網中，自來水絕對嚴禁先流經銅管、隨後流入鍍鋅鋼管（銅後鋼禁忌）？

options_en.B: Traces of copper ions dissolved into the water will deposit out onto the galvanized zinc surface, setting up intense localized galvanic pitting cells that perforate the steel pipe
options_en.C: Water flow velocity drops to zero

options_zh.A: 水流會立即凍結成冰
options_zh.B: 微量溶解在水中的銅離子置換沉積在鍍鋅層表面，形成無數微觀電偶腐蝕原電池，引發嚴重的局部點蝕穿孔爆管
options_zh.C: 水流在接口處流速歸零
options_zh.D: 水流中所有的溶解氧被徹底抽乾

explanation_en: Cupric ions in water plate out on zinc via displacement: Cu²⁺ + Zn → Cu + Zn²⁺. This creates aggressive bimetallic galvanic pitting that destroys the steel.
explanation_zh: 微量銅離子進入鍍鋅管後會置換出微粒金屬銅，附著在鋅表面形成無數微小的銅-鋅腐蝕電池，數月內即可將鍍鋅鋼管蝕穿漏水。
source_reference: Water Regulations Guide; BS 8000-13

content_en: What is the recommended maximum flow velocity for cold water flowing continuously through domestic copper pipework under BS EN 806?
content_zh: 根據 BS EN 806 供水規範，為防止銅管內壁發生沖刷磨損腐蝕（Erosion-Corrosion）與水流噪聲，冷水在室內銅管中的推薦最大流速上限是多少？

options_zh.C: 10 m/s
options_zh.D: 50 m/s

explanation_en: BS EN 806-3 specifies maximum velocities: cold water mains max 1.5 to 2.0 m/s (and hot secondary circulation max 0.5 to 1.0 m/s) to prevent copper erosion.
explanation_zh: 銅管內壁極易被高速紊流沖刷剝離保護性氧化膜。規範限制冷水最大流速為 1.5-2.0 m/s，熱水循環更嚴格限制在 1.0 m/s 以下以防管壁沖刷減薄穿孔。
source_reference: BS EN 806-3; Copper Development Association

content_en: What occurs to the velocity of water flowing through a pipeline if the pipe diameter is reduced from 22mm to 15mm while maintaining the same constant flow rate (L/min)?
content_zh: 根據流體連續性方程（Q = A × v），在總流量 (L/min) 保持恆定的前提下，若水流從 22mm 管道流入 15mm 變徑管道，管內水流流速會如何變化？

options_en.B: The velocity remains identical
options_en.C: The velocity increases substantially (by more than double)

options_zh.A: 水流流速顯著降低
options_zh.B: 水流流速保持完全一致
options_zh.C: 水流流速大幅增加（增加超過一倍以上）
options_zh.D: 水流流速降為零

explanation_en: Continuity equation: Q = A1·v1 = A2·v2. Reducing cross-sectional area forces fluid velocity to increase inversely proportional to area (v ∝ 1/d²).
explanation_zh: 連續性定理指出流速與管道截面積成反比。管徑從 22mm 縮減至 15mm，截面積縮小一半以上，為通過相同水量，流速被迫急劇飆升至原來的 2 倍以上。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Fluid Mechanics

content_en: What type of corrosion in brass fittings is characterized by the preferential electrochemical leaching of zinc, leaving behind a weak, porous, spongy copper structure?
content_zh: 在黃銅管件中，由於鋅被電化學選擇性優先浸出溶解，只留下脆弱、多孔的海綿狀純銅骨架並最終導致斷裂滲漏的腐蝕被稱作什麼？

options_en.B: Dezincification (De-zincing)

options_zh.A: 局部點蝕 (Pitting)
options_zh.B: 脫鋅腐蝕 (Dezincification)
options_zh.C: 縫隙腐蝕 (Crevice)
options_zh.D: 大氣表面氧化

explanation_en: Dezincification leaches zinc from standard duplex brass in soft or acidic waters, weakening the fitting. DZR brass is specified to prevent this.
explanation_zh: 普通黃銅是銅鋅合金。在特定水質下，化學反應會將鋅溶解流失，黃銅外觀泛紅、結構變得像餅乾一樣鬆脆易碎，稱為「脫鋅腐蝕」。
source_reference: BS EN 12165; C&G Unit 202

content_en: What is the pH value of pure chemically neutral water at 25°C?
content_zh: 在 25°C 基準溫度下，純淨化學中性水的 pH 酸鹼度數值是多少？

options_en.B: pH 7.0

options_zh.A: pH 0 (強酸極限)
options_zh.B: pH 7.0 (標準化學中性)
options_zh.C: pH 14.0 (強鹼極限)
options_zh.D: pH 5.5

explanation_en: On the logarithmic pH scale (0 to 14), pH 7.0 indicates exact neutrality where hydrogen [H⁺] and hydroxide [OH⁻] concentrations are equal.
explanation_zh: pH 值是氫離子濃度的負對數，以 7.0 為嚴格中性界限；小於 7.0 呈酸性，大於 7.0 呈鹼性。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Water Chemistry

content_en: Under BS 7593:2019, what is the recommended pH range for domestic central heating system water containing aluminium heat exchangers?
content_zh: 根據 BS 7593:2019 供暖水處理標準，對於配備有鋁合金主換熱器的家用壁掛爐系統，其循環供暖水推薦的 pH 酸鹼度控制區間是多少？

options_en.B: pH 6.5 to 8.5 (slightly buffered neutral to mild alkaline)
options_en.D: pH does not matter in heating

options_zh.A: pH 3.0 至 5.0 (酸性環境)
options_zh.B: pH 6.5 至 8.5 (弱鹼性微緩衝區間，防止鋁受強酸或強鹼兩性腐蝕)
options_zh.C: pH 12.0 至 14.0 (強鹼環境)
options_zh.D: 供暖水無需關注 pH 值

explanation_en: Aluminium is amphoteric and dissolves in both acid (<6.5) and alkaline (>8.5) water. BS 7593 requires inhibitor buffering to keep pH between 6.5 and 8.5.
explanation_zh: 金屬鋁具有兩性化學性質，既溶於酸又溶於鹼。供暖水若 pH 低於 6.5 會遭酸腐蝕，高於 8.5 會遭鹼腐蝕，必須精確調配阻垢緩蝕劑維持在 6.5-8.5。
source_reference: BS 7593:2019; HHIC Water Treatment Guidelines

content_en: If a rectangular cold water storage cistern has internal dimensions of 1.2m long, 0.8m wide, and is filled with water to a depth of 0.5m, what is the volume of water stored?
content_zh: 一個長方體冷水儲水箱的內部尺寸為長 1.2 米、寬 0.8 米，水深注至 0.5 米。此時箱內儲存的水體積是多少公升 (L)？

options_en.B: 240 liters

options_zh.A: 48 公升
options_zh.B: 240 公升
options_zh.C: 480 公升
options_zh.D: 960 公升

explanation_en: Volume = Length × Width × Height = 1.2m × 0.8m × 0.5m = 0.48 m³. Since 1 m³ = 1000 liters, 0.48 × 1000 = 480 liters.
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Calculations

content_en: What is the total mass of the water in the cistern described above (480 liters)?
content_zh: 上述水箱內儲存的 480 公升水的總淨質量是多少？

options_en.B: 240 kg

options_zh.A: 48 kg
options_zh.B: 240 kg

explanation_en: Pure water has a density of 1 kg per liter (1000 kg/m³). Therefore, 480 liters of pure water has a mass of 480 kg.
explanation_zh: 水的密度為 1 kg/L。480 升水對應 480 公斤（相當於近半噸），結構設計時必須確保閣樓木托樑受力經過加固計算。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Volume and Density

content_en: A vertical open vent pipe on a vented domestic hot water cylinder terminates 12 meters above the drain-off valve at the cylinder base. What is the static pressure at the drain valve?
content_zh: 開式開頂熱水儲水系統的排氣通風管，其頂端彎頭高出水罐底部放水閥垂直落差 12 米。放水閥處承受的靜水壓力是多少？

options_en.B: 1.2 bar (approx 120 kPa)

options_zh.A: 0.12 bar
options_zh.B: 1.2 bar (約 117.7 kPa)
options_zh.C: 12 bar
options_zh.D: 120 bar

explanation_en: Static Pressure = Head × 0.1 bar/m = 12m × 0.1 = 1.2 bar (or 12m × 9.81 kPa/m = 117.7 kPa).
explanation_zh: 靜態水壓換算：12 米靜水頭 × 0.1 bar/米 = 1.2 bar（或 12 × 9.81 = 117.72 kPa）。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Fluid Mechanics

content_en: If the static pressure gauge at a ground floor shower reads 1.5 bar, what is the equivalent vertical water head in meters above the gauge?
content_zh: 若一樓淋浴閥門處的壓力表測得靜態水壓為 1.5 bar，這相當於上方儲水箱水位線高出測量點多少米的垂直靜水頭？

options_en.B: 7.5 meters

options_zh.C: 15.0 米 (精確值約 15.3 米水頭)

explanation_en: Head = Pressure / (0.1 bar/m) = 1.5 bar / 0.1 = 15.0 meters (or 150 kPa / 9.81 = 15.29 m).
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 202 Textbook Ch 3

content_en: In a hydraulic press, an input piston has a cross-sectional area of 10 cm² and is pushed with a force of 200 N. The output ram has an area of 200 cm². What thrust force is exerted by the ram?
content_zh: 在一個液壓千斤頂中，小活塞面積為 10 cm²，受到 200 N 的下壓力。大液壓柱塞面積為 200 cm²。大柱塞產生的輸出頂升力是多少？
explanation_en: P = F1/A1 = 200 N / 10 cm² = 20 N/cm². Force on output ram: F2 = P × A2 = 20 N/cm² × 200 cm² = 4,000 N (4 kN).
explanation_zh: 帕斯卡定律：系統內壓強 P = 200 / 10 = 20 N/cm²。大活塞輸出推力 F2 = P × A2 = 20 × 200 = 4,000 N（放大了 20 倍）。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Pascal's Law Calculations

content_en: A 200-liter hot water cylinder is heated from 15°C to 65°C. How much energy in MegaJoules (MJ) is absorbed by the water? (Specific heat capacity = 4.187 kJ/kg·°C)
content_zh: 一個 200 公升的家用熱水罐，水溫由 15°C 加熱升溫至 65°C。水總共吸收了多少兆焦耳 (MJ) 的熱量？（比熱容取 4.187 kJ/kg·°C）
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Energy Calculations

content_en: If the 200-liter cylinder in the question above is heated by a 3 kW electric immersion heater operating at 100% efficiency, how long will it take to heat up?
content_zh: 若上述 200 公升水箱由一根 3 kW 的電加熱棒進行加熱（假設熱效率為 100%），將水溫從 15°C 升至 65°C 需要多久？

options_en.B: Approx 3.88 hours (approx 3 hours 53 mins)

options_zh.A: 約 1 小時
options_zh.B: 約 3.88 小時（約 3 小時 53 分鐘）
options_zh.C: 約 10 小時
options_zh.D: 整整 24 小時

explanation_en: Energy = 41,870 kJ. Power = 3 kW = 3 kJ/s. Time = 41,870 / 3 = 13,957 seconds / 3600 = 3.877 hours (3h 53m).
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Power and Energy

content_en: A sealed heating circuit has an initial pressure of 1.0 bar gauge (2.0 bar absolute) when filled cold at 10°C (283 K). If the water/air temperature increases to 70°C (343 K), what is the new theoretical absolute pressure? (Assuming constant volume, P1/T1 = P2/T2)
content_zh: 某封閉供暖系統在 10°C (283 K) 冷態注水時表壓為 1.0 bar（絕對壓力為 2.0 bar）。若水溫升高至 70°C (343 K) 且體積恆定，其新的理論絕對壓力約為多少？

options_en.B: 2.42 bar absolute

options_zh.A: 2.12 bar 絕對壓力
options_zh.B: 2.42 bar 絕對壓力 (相當於表壓約 1.42 bar)
options_zh.C: 5.0 bar 絕對壓力
options_zh.D: 14.0 bar 絕對壓力

explanation_en: P2 = P1 × (T2 / T1) = 2.0 bar abs × (343 K / 283 K) = 2.0 × 1.212 = 2.424 bar absolute (1.42 bar gauge).
explanation_zh: 查理/蓋·呂薩克定律：P2 = P1 × (T2 / T1) = 2.0 × (343 / 283) ≈ 2.42 bar 絕對壓強（表壓上升約 0.42 bar）。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Gas Laws

content_en: Why does air bubble out of solution when cold mains tap water is heated inside a domestic kettle or boiler?
content_zh: 當低溫自來水在燒水壺或供暖鍋爐內被加熱時，為什麼水中會持續析出大量細密的小氣泡？

options_en.B: Gases (such as dissolved oxygen and nitrogen) have significantly lower solubility in warm water than in cold water, forcing dissolved air out of solution

options_zh.A: 水在 20°C 時已經沸騰
options_zh.B: 氣體（氧氣、氮氣）在水中的溶解度隨溫度升高而顯著下降，高溫迫使溶解在水中的空氣分子析出形成氣泡
options_zh.C: 電熱絲電解水產生了氫氣
options_zh.D: 水壺金屬外殼受熱分解

explanation_en: Gas solubility decreases with temperature. Cold water holds high levels of dissolved gases which are driven off upon heating, causing air pockets in radiators.
explanation_zh: 氣體溶解度定律（亨利定律）：水溫越高氣體溶解度越低。自來水受熱會將溶解的氧氣逼出，這正是新裝供暖系統初次加熱必須頻繁給暖氣片排氣的根本原因。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Properties of Fluids

content_en: What phenomenon causes loud hammering or thumping sounds in a circulating pump when water pressure at the impeller drops below the liquid's vapor pressure?
content_zh: 當循環水泵葉輪中心處的動態局部壓力驟降至低於該水溫對應的飽和蒸汽壓時，導致泵體發出劇烈撞擊噪聲和震動的現象是什麼？

options_en.B: Cavitation (pump cavitation)

options_zh.A: 水錘效應 (Water Hammer)
options_zh.B: 氣蝕現象 / 汽蝕 (Cavitation)
options_zh.C: 熱對流虹吸
options_zh.D: 電解作用

explanation_en: Cavitation occurs when local pressure falls below vapor pressure, creating vapor bubbles that violently collapse against the impeller, pitting metal.
explanation_zh: 汽蝕是由於局部極低壓導致水在常溫下瞬間閃蒸產生微汽泡，汽泡隨後流經高壓區急劇內爆潰滅，產生的超微衝擊波會打碎葉輪金屬並發出刺耳異響。
source_reference: BS EN 12828; C&G Unit 202 Fluid Dynamics

content_en: What is the thermal transmittance (U-value) a measure of in building heat loss calculations?
content_zh: 在建築供暖熱負荷計算中，「傳熱係數 (U-value)」衡量的是哪一項物理傳熱指標？

options_en.A: The rate of heat transfer through 1 square meter of a building element for every 1 degree Kelvin temperature difference (W/m²K)
options_en.B: The weight of the insulation in kg
options_en.C: The acoustic noise level through glass
options_en.D: The percentage of water absorption in brickwork

options_zh.A: 當兩側溫差為 1 開爾文 (K) 時，通過建築構件每 1 平方米表面積的熱傳遞速率 (單位: W/m²K)
options_zh.B: 保溫材料以千克計的單位質量
options_zh.C: 透過玻璃傳播的聲學噪聲分貝
options_zh.D: 磚砌體結構吸水率百分比

explanation_en: U-value (W/m²K) measures the overall rate of heat loss through walls, roofs, or windows. Lower U-values represent superior insulation.
explanation_zh: U 值即傳熱係數（單位 W/(m²·K)），數值越小代表圍護結構保溫性能越好，熱量流失越慢（例如雙層中空玻璃 U 值約 1.4，老式單玻達 5.0）。
source_reference: Approved Document L; BS EN 12831

content_en: If an external wall of a room has a surface area of 15 m², a U-value of 0.30 W/m²K, and the temperature difference between inside (21°C) and outside (-1°C) is 22 K, what is the continuous rate of heat loss through this wall?
content_zh: 若某房間一面外牆的面積為 15 m²，傳熱係數 U 值為 0.30 W/m²K。室內設計溫度 21°C，室外計算溫度 -1°C（內外溫差 ΔT = 22 K）。通過該牆體的連續散熱損失功率是多少？

options_en.B: 99 Watts

options_zh.B: 99 瓦特 (W)

explanation_en: Heat loss = Area × U-value × ΔT = 15 m² × 0.30 W/m²K × 22 K = 99 Watts.
explanation_zh: 計算公式：熱損失功率 = 面積 × U 值 × 溫差 = 15 × 0.30 × 22 = 99 W。這是散熱器熱負荷選型計算的核心基本功。
source_reference: BS EN 12831 Heating systems in buildings - Method for calculation of design heat load

content_en: What material property is denoted by the Greek letter Lambda (λ) representing the rate of heat flow through a unit thickness of material?
content_zh: 在建築物理與保溫計算中，希臘字母 Lambda (λ) 代表保溫材料的哪一項固有熱工屬性？

options_en.B: Specific heat capacity

options_zh.A: 導熱係數 / 導熱率 (Thermal Conductivity，單位: W/m·K)
options_zh.B: 比熱容
options_zh.C: 相對密度
options_zh.D: 抗拉強度

explanation_en: Lambda (λ) represents thermal conductivity in W/m·K. Lower lambda values indicate better thermal insulating performance (e.g. PIR insulation λ ≈ 0.022 W/m·K).
explanation_zh: 導熱係數 λ 表徵材料本身的導熱本領，數值越低保溫效果越好（如高效聚異氰脲酸酯 PIR 泡棉 λ 僅為 0.022 W/(m·K)，普通混凝土約 1.3）。
source_reference: BS 5422 Thermal insulation of pipework

content_en: What is the equivalent volume of 1 cubic meter (1 m³) in liters?
content_zh: 1 立方米 (1 m³) 的空間體積，換算為公升 (Liters) 精確是多少？

options_en.B: 100 liters

options_zh.A: 10 公升
options_zh.B: 100 公升

explanation_en: 1 cubic meter equals exactly 1,000 liters (and 1 liter equals 1,000 cm³ or 1 dm³).
explanation_zh: 1 m³ = 1000 dm³ = 1,000 升。大中型蓄水箱或雨水收集池容量通常以立方米計量，1 立方米水重達 1 噸。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Units of Measurement

content_en: What is the relationship between the cross-sectional area of a 15mm internal diameter pipe and a 30mm internal diameter pipe?
content_zh: 若一根內徑為 15mm 的管道與另一根內徑為 30mm（內徑剛好為前者2倍）的管道相比，後者的通流截面積是前者的幾倍？

options_en.B: 4 times larger (Area proportional to d²)

options_zh.A: 2 倍
options_zh.B: 4 倍 (截面積與直徑平方成正比)
options_zh.C: 8 倍

explanation_en: Area = π·(d/2)². Doubling the pipe diameter multiplies cross-sectional area by 4 (2² = 4), quadrupling carrying capacity at constant velocity.
explanation_zh: 圓截面積公式 A = πr² = πd²/4。直徑翻倍，通流截面積擴大 4 倍（2 的平方），在同等流速下水流量提升 4 倍。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Pipe Sizing Physics

content_en: Why does installing pipe insulation (lagging) on an unheated copper pipe located in a sub-zero attic fail to prevent water from eventually freezing during a prolonged winter property vacancy?
content_zh: 若一棟房屋在極寒冬季長期空置且無供暖，為什麼僅在冷水管外包裹厚厚的保溫棉（Lagging），仍然無法阻止管道最終徹底結冰？

options_en.B: Thermal insulation only retards the rate of heat loss; without an active internal or external heat input, the pipe will eventually reach the ambient sub-zero temperature
options_en.C: Insulation absorbs ice from the air

options_zh.A: 保溫棉會使銅管自發變冷
options_zh.B: 保溫層的作用只是「延緩」熱量散失速率，它本身無法發熱；在長期無供暖且無水流動的極寒環境下，管內水溫終將降至與環境相同的冰點以下
options_zh.C: 保溫棉會主動吸收空氣中的冰晶
options_zh.D: 塑料在保溫棉內結冰更快

explanation_en: Insulation slows conductive heat transfer but cannot stop it completely. In unheated buildings over days, water in insulated pipes still reaches 0°C and freezes.
explanation_zh: 保溫棉只能增加熱阻、延長凍結時間（如將結冰時間從 4 小時推遲到 12 小時）。長期無熱源輸入的空房必須放空排淨管內存水或加裝伴熱帶。
source_reference: BS 5422; Water Regs Frost Protection Guide

content_en: What is the mathematical relationship between Absolute Pressure (P_abs) and Gauge Pressure (P_gauge)?
content_zh: 在工程流體力學中，「絕對壓力 (P_abs)」與壓力表測得的「表壓 (P_gauge)」之間的數學換算關係是什麼？

options_en.B: P_abs = P_gauge + Atmospheric Pressure (approx P_gauge + 1.013 bar)

options_zh.A: P_abs = P_gauge - 大氣壓
options_zh.B: P_abs = P_gauge + 當地大氣壓 (約 P_gauge + 1.013 bar)
options_zh.C: P_abs = P_gauge × 10
options_zh.D: P_abs = P_gauge / 2

explanation_en: Gauge pressure measures pressure relative to atmospheric ambient zero. Absolute pressure adds atmospheric pressure (P_abs = P_gauge + P_atm).
explanation_zh: 壓力表在未通壓前讀數為 0，其基準是環境大氣壓。絕對壓力是以絕對真空為零點計算，因此絕對壓力 = 表壓 + 大氣壓（約 1.01 bar）。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Fluid Mechanics

content_en: When a Bourdon tube pressure gauge on an unpressurized heating circuit reads 0.0 bar, what is the actual absolute pressure acting inside the pipe?
content_zh: 當一塊未注水加壓的彈簧管壓力表讀數顯示為 0.0 bar 表壓時，管道內部實際上承受的真實絕對壓力是多少？

options_en.B: Approximately 1.013 bar absolute (atmospheric pressure)

options_zh.A: 0.0 bar 絕對壓力 (絕對真空)
options_zh.B: 約 1.013 bar 絕對壓力（即當前標準環境大氣壓力）
options_zh.C: 10.0 bar 絕對壓力
options_zh.D: -1.0 bar 絕對壓力

explanation_en: A gauge reading of 0 bar indicates zero pressure difference across the instrument; the internal fluid is at atmospheric pressure (approx 1.013 bar abs).
explanation_zh: 表壓為 0 並不等於真空，而是表示內部壓力與外部大氣壓完全平衡，內部受有 1 個標準大氣壓（約 101.3 kPa 或 1.013 bar 絕對壓強）。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 Fluid Mechanics
