options_en.B: A double check valve complying with BS EN 13959 (protecting against Fluid Category 3 risk from garden hose back-siphonage)

options_zh.A: 完全無需安裝任何保護裝置
options_zh.B: 符合 BS EN 13959 標準的雙止回閥 (Double Check Valve)，用以防範軟管插入泥漿積水桶時可能產生的第 3 類流體虹吸倒灌危害
options_zh.C: 造價高達上千英鎊的工業級 RPZ 減壓閥
options_zh.D: 純銅熱膨脹補償環

explanation_en: Garden hoses left submerged in muddy puddles or fertilizer buckets can back-siphon into the drinking supply. A double check valve inside the property isolates this risk.
explanation_zh: 花園水管常接在農藥噴壺或泡在污水桶中，一旦市政降壓極易產生虹吸倒灌。法規強制在室內進水管加裝雙止回閥隔斷回流。
source_reference: Water Regulations Guide Schedule 2; BS EN 13959

content_en: What is a Reduced Pressure Zone (RPZ) Type BA valve used for in commercial plumbing installations?
content_zh: 在大型商用建築與公共設施給水系統中，RPZ 減壓防回流閥 (Type BA Valve) 的主要功能是什麼？

options_en.B: To provide certified mechanical backflow protection against Fluid Category 4 chemical contamination risks in commercial heating, commercial dishwashers, and car wash systems
options_en.D: To heat water with natural gas

options_zh.A: 將管網水壓提升 10 bar
options_zh.B: 為商用供暖鍋爐化學注藥系統、大型商用洗碗機及自動洗車房等可能產生的第 4 類（Fluid Category 4）化學毒性介質提供高可靠性的機械防倒流保護
options_zh.C: 過濾雨水中的泥沙雜質
options_zh.D: 利用天然氣進行快速水加熱

explanation_en: Type BA RPZ valves incorporate two independent check valves separated by an atmospheric relief zone, discharging water if pressure fluctuates.
explanation_zh: RPZ 閥是防範第 4 類化學危害最高等級的機械閥門，由前後兩個止回閥和中間的差壓自動洩水閥構成，一旦上游失壓中間腔立即直通大氣排空。
source_reference: WRAS RPZ Valve Guidance Document; BS EN 12729

content_en: What statutory inspection and maintenance regime is mandatory for all installed RPZ valves in the UK?
content_zh: 在英國境內安裝的所有 RPZ 減壓防回流閥，依法必須接受何種嚴格的法定例行檢測與維護監管？

options_en.B: Mandatory annual commissioning and differential pressure testing by an accredited, WRAS-approved RPZ tester, with formal test certificates submitted to the water undertaker
options_en.C: Checked only after a building burns down

options_zh.A: 安裝後永久無需任何保養檢查
options_zh.B: 必須由具備水務署認可資質的持證專業人員（WRAS-approved Tester），每年強制進行一次差壓氣密性專項年檢，並將檢測合格報告存檔抄報供水公司備案
options_zh.C: 只有當建築物失火燒毀後才需要查驗
options_zh.D: 每週向閥門內部加注機油潤滑

explanation_en: Water undertakers enforce annual RPZ re-testing to verify opening pressure differentials and seal integrity; non-compliant valves are decommissioned.
explanation_zh: RPZ 閥直接攸關公眾自來水管網安全。供水公司建立嚴格電子檔案，逾期未提交年檢合格報告者，水司有權直接強制關停用戶進戶水閥。
source_reference: WRAS AIM-08-01 RPZ Testing Code of Practice; Water Regs 1999

content_en: A bidet fitted with a flexible spray hose that can be hung over or submerged beneath the spill-over level of the WC pan or bidet bowl represents which Fluid Category?
content_zh: 若某坐浴盆（Bidet）配備了活動手持柔性沖洗軟管，且該噴頭長度足以下垂浸沒在馬桶座便器或坐浴盆污水液面溢流邊界以下，這屬於第幾類回流污染風險？

options_en.B: Fluid Category 3

options_zh.A: 第 1 類流體
options_zh.B: 第 3 類流體
options_zh.C: 第 4 類流體
options_zh.D: 第 5 類流體 (Fluid Category 5 - 糞便微生物高危)

explanation_en: Any hose able to enter a toilet or bidet bowl presents a direct path for human pathogens to enter the drinking water system under negative pressure, classified as Category 5.
explanation_zh: 軟管噴頭一旦浸泡在含有糞便尿液的污水中，室外爆管負壓時污水會直接被抽吸入全樓自來水管網，引發嚴重腸道傳染病，屬於極高危的第 5 類流體。
source_reference: Water Regulations Guide Schedule 1; WRAS Guidance on Bidets

content_en: How must the water supply to a bidet with an ascending submerged spray nozzle or flexible bidet douche hose be legally designed under Water Regulations?
content_zh: 根據水事法規要求，對於帶有浸沒式向上噴水嘴或手持婦洗軟管的坐浴盆，其供水管路在法律上必須採用何種系統設計方案？

options_en.A: Connected directly to the kitchen cold water mains
options_en.B: Fed from a completely dedicated, separate header break cistern or storage tank incorporating a Type AB air gap, with no cross-connections to drinking supplies
options_en.C: Connected with a single plastic check valve
options_en.D: Tied into the central heating circuit

options_zh.A: 直接與廚房飲用水高壓自來水管相連
options_zh.B: 必須由一個完全獨立專用的斷流水箱（Header Tank）供水，水箱進水配備標準的 Type AB 物理空氣間隙，且與飲用水管路徹底物理物理隔離
options_zh.C: 僅加裝一個廉價的塑料單向閥接駁
options_zh.D: 直接接在中央供暖暖氣片水管上

explanation_en: Category 5 risks require a separate break cistern with a Type AB air gap, ensuring absolute physical separation between drinking water and potential foul contamination.
explanation_zh: 杜絕噴頭抽吸倒灌的唯一合規途徑是：自來水先流經空氣間隙跌落進入專用斷流水箱，再由水箱出水單獨供應衛洗麗或噴槍，即使倒吸也絕不會污染主管網。
source_reference: Water Regulations Schedule 2 Paragraph 23; WRAS

content_en: What is an 'Air Gap Type AUK1' commonly incorporated into modern domestic cisterns and WC suites?
content_zh: 在現代家用抽水馬桶水箱及冷水儲水箱中廣泛採用的「Type AUK1 空氣間隙」，其結構形式是怎樣的？

options_en.A: A vacuum pump connected to the roof
options_en.B: A weir overflow air gap where water spills freely over an open weir slot if the inlet valve jams, maintaining a vertical clearance above the flood level
options_en.D: A non-return flap on the sewer

options_zh.A: 連接至屋頂的真空抽吸泵
options_zh.B: 溢流堰式空氣間隙（Weir Overflow Air Gap）：當進水閥卡死時，多餘水流直接通過特製的開口溢流堰口向外自由溢灑，維持進水嘴與污水液面之間的安全垂直間隙
options_zh.C: 埋在混凝土裡的封閉暗管
options_zh.D: 排污管上的單向防逆流翻板

explanation_en: Type AUK1 air gaps feature a designated weir overflow slot, ensuring incoming mains water drops through free air even under overflow conditions.
explanation_zh: AUK1 空氣間隙利用開口堰槽溢流，即便排水管堵死，自來水龍頭出水端與水箱最高漫溢液位之間始終保持法定垂直空氣淨距，防止虹吸倒流。
source_reference: BS EN 13077; Water Regulations Guide

content_en: What is the statutory minimum distance (air gap) required between the lowest point of a cold water tap outlet and the top spill-over level of a domestic washbasin?
content_zh: 在普通家用洗臉盆上安裝水龍頭時，龍頭出水嘴最低出水點與洗臉盆最高溢水外緣溢流線之間，法定保持的垂直「空氣間隙 (Air Gap)」不得小於多少？

options_en.B: At least 20 mm (or twice the internal bore of the supply pipe, whichever is greater)

options_zh.A: 5 mm
options_zh.B: 至少 20 mm (或兩倍於供水管內徑，以兩者中較大者為準)
options_zh.C: 100 mm
options_zh.D: 250 mm

explanation_en: Water Regulations require a Type AG/AUK2 air gap of at least 20mm (or 2 × pipe bore) above the flood level rim to prevent basin water from being siphoned back into the tap.
explanation_zh: 龍頭出水口絕對禁止低於台盆溢水邊緣。至少保持 20mm 懸空空氣間隙，即使水塞堵死台盆積滿髒水，髒水也永遠夠不到出水嘴，杜絕虹吸。
source_reference: Water Regulations Guide Schedule 2; BS EN 1717

content_en: What is the primary cause of 'Water Hammer' in high-pressure domestic cold water systems?
content_zh: 在家庭高壓自來水管路中，引發「水錘效應 (Water Hammer)」並發出劇烈金屬撞擊噪聲與管道震動的根本物理原因是甚麼？

options_en.B: The instantaneous deceleration of high-velocity water caused by sudden valve closure (e.g. ceramic lever taps, solenoid valves), generating destructive pressure shockwaves
options_en.C: Low water pressure from the street
options_en.D: Hot water leaking into cold pipes

options_zh.A: 管內水流低溫結冰膨脹
options_zh.B: 高速流動的水流因閥門瞬間關閉（如陶瓷閥芯快開龍頭、洗衣機洗碗機電磁切斷閥）而發生急劇減速，巨大動能瞬間轉化為毀滅性的高壓衝擊波在管內來回反射
options_zh.C: 市政進戶水壓過低
options_zh.D: 熱水滲漏進冷水管

explanation_en: Sudden shut-off converts the kinetic energy of moving water into shockwaves travelling at 1000+ m/s, causing pressure spikes exceeding 30 bar that vibrate loose pipes.
explanation_zh: 高速流動的水具有巨大動量。閥門一瞬間關死，水體撞擊閥板急劇反彈，形成高達數十個大氣壓的液壓衝擊波，震得未固定牢固的管道猛烈敲打牆體。
source_reference: Institute of Plumbing Design Guide; C&G Unit 204

content_en: What mechanical device is installed adjacent to fast-closing washing machine solenoid valves to safely absorb water hammer shockwaves?
content_zh: 在洗衣機或洗碗機快閉電磁閥附近的冷水管路上，通常加裝何種阻尼裝置以安全吸收並平息水錘衝擊波？

options_en.A: Water hammer arrestor (expansion shock arrestor with internal gas cushion/piston)
options_en.B: Non-return gate valve

options_zh.A: 水錘消除器 / 水錘吸震器 (Water Hammer Arrestor，內置氣囊或活塞阻尼緩衝器)
options_zh.B: 單向逆止閘閥
options_zh.C: 機械水錶
options_zh.D: 配重鉛塊

explanation_en: Water hammer arrestors contain a compressible gas chamber or spring-loaded piston that cushions hydraulic shockwaves, absorbing pressure surges locally.
explanation_zh: 水錘消除器內部封閉有耐壓橡膠氣囊或高彈活塞。當衝擊波衝來時，氣囊被壓縮吸收瞬態動能峰值，使水壓平穩衰減，徹底保護管件與焊口不受損。
source_reference: BS EN 12828 / Water Regulations Guide; C&G Unit 204

content_en: If dynamic water pressure at a customer's incoming internal stopcock is measured at an excessive 6.5 bar, what device must be fitted to prevent fitting damage and water hammer?
content_zh: 在客戶進戶自來水總閥處測得動態水壓高達 6.5 bar 嚴重超標時，水暖工應當在進戶總管上加裝何種關鍵調壓設備以保護全屋水件？

options_en.B: Adjustable Pressure Reducing Valve (PRV, typically regulated to 3.0 to 3.5 bar)

options_zh.A: 熱水循環增壓泵
options_zh.B: 可調式管道減壓閥 (Pressure Reducing Valve - PRV，通常將全屋水壓穩壓調節至 3.0 至 3.5 bar)
options_zh.C: 敞口通風膨脹管
options_zh.D: 排污堵頭

explanation_en: High pressure causes joint failure, tap splashing, and valve wear. A PRV regulates excessive mains pressure down to a safe, steady working pressure (e.g. 3 bar).
explanation_zh: 過高水壓會損害陶瓷閥芯、引發劇烈水錘並縮短電器壽命。加裝減壓閥（PRV）將進水恆定穩壓在 3 bar 左右，既保障舒適用水又保護管網。
source_reference: BS EN 1567 Building valves - Water pressure reducing valves

content_en: Why must a temporary filling loop connecting wholesome mains water to a central heating circuit be physically disconnected after system pressurization?
content_zh: 家用採暖壁掛爐補水完畢後，為什麼法規強制要求必須將連接自來水管與供暖管路之間的「臨時金屬編織軟管補水環 (Filling Loop)」徹底手動拆卸斷開？

options_en.A: To save weight on the boiler wall
options_en.B: The central heating water contains chemical inhibitors and black sludge (Fluid Category 3 or 4); disconnecting the hose provides an absolute physical air gap preventing foul heating water from siphoning into drinking supplies
options_en.C: To allow the hose to dry in the sun

options_zh.A: 減輕壁掛爐懸掛在牆體上的自重負荷
options_zh.B: 供暖循環水中充斥著化學緩蝕劑、重金屬防腐劑及黑色鐵鏽黑渣（屬於第 3 類或第 4 類有毒流體）；徹底拆下軟管形成物理斷路，能杜絕因閥門內漏造成毒水倒灌自來水龍頭
options_zh.C: 讓補水軟管在陽光下晾乾防霉
options_zh.D: 軟管會產生靜電干擾鍋爐電路板

explanation_en: Flexible filling loops represent a cross-connection between drinking water and heating chemical sludge. Leaving them connected breaches Water Regs 1999.
explanation_zh: 雙截止閥可能因微小雜質墊住出現隱蔽內漏。一旦室外水壓驟降，含劇毒防腐化學劑的黑泥供暖水會倒吸進全家人飲用水中。法規要求補水後必須拔除軟管！
source_reference: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999 Schedule 2

content_en: Under BS EN 806-3, what is the standard recommended copper pipe outside diameter for supplying a domestic high-flow unvented hot water cylinder from incoming mains?
content_zh: 根據 BS EN 806-3 給水管徑規範，為滿足家用承壓閉式熱水儲水罐（Unvented Cylinder）的大流量進水需求，從市政進戶管引來的冷水供水管推薦標準銅管外徑通常是多少？

options_en.B: 15 mm

options_zh.A: 10 mm
options_zh.B: 15 mm (流量過小易引發水溫波動)
options_zh.C: 22 mm (或大型別墅選用 28 mm 外徑銅管)
options_zh.D: 54 mm (商用消防大管徑)

explanation_en: Unvented cylinders supply multiple powerful showers simultaneously. A 22mm (or 28mm) cold feed ensures adequate volume without crippling dynamic pressure drops.
explanation_zh: 15mm 細管水阻極大，洗澡時一旦有人沖馬桶淋浴便會忽冷忽熱。承壓水罐必須由至少 22mm 銅管專管供水，確保充足的動態通水流量。
source_reference: BS EN 806-3 Pipe sizing; Approved Document G3

content_en: What is the recommended minimum cold water storage cistern capacity for a typical 3-bedroom domestic dwelling with an indirect vented hot water cylinder?
content_zh: 對於一套典型的 3 居室家庭住宅（配備開式熱水水箱），其閣樓冷水儲水箱的推薦最低蓄水容量通常是多少公升？

options_en.B: 50 liters

options_zh.A: 25 公升
options_zh.B: 50 公升
options_zh.C: 230 至 250 公升 (約 50 加侖容量儲水箱)

explanation_en: British Standards recommend a minimum of 230-250 litres storage to supply domestic vented hot water demand and cold outlets with a 24-hour reserve.
explanation_zh: 230-250 升是英倫三居室住宅標配水箱容量，扣除頂部溢流及浮球預留高度後，淨有效蓄水量約為 200 升，足以滿足全家一整天的生活基本用水儲備。
source_reference: BS 8558 / BS 6700; C&G Unit 204

content_en: What is the purpose of installing an internal dip pipe or perforated baffle inside a long rectangular cold water storage cistern?
content_zh: 在大型長方形冷水儲水箱內部，將進水管引至底部或加裝「浸入導流管 (Dip Pipe) / 擋流隔板 (Baffle)」的主要作用是什麼？

options_en.B: To ensure incoming fresh water thoroughly mixes and circulates across the entire tank, eliminating dead stagnation zones that encourage bacterial growth
options_en.C: To keep the float valve dry
options_en.D: To aerate the water with pure oxygen

options_zh.A: 利用摩擦提高水箱儲水溫度
options_zh.B: 引導新注入的活水在整個水箱內部均勻流動循環，徹底消除死角與水流滯留停滯盲區，防止常溫靜水滋生嗜肺軍團菌與藻類
options_zh.C: 使浮球進水閥保持乾燥狀態
options_zh.D: 向自來水中注入高濃度純氧

explanation_en: Stagnation promotes Legionella and biofilm formation. Cross-flow baffles force complete water turnover, preventing dead pockets of aged, warm water.
explanation_zh: 長方形大水箱若進水口與出水口靠得太近，水流只在角落短路流走，另一端死角的水數月不換形成死水臭水。導流板能強制全箱水體活化置換。
source_reference: HSE ACoP L8; BS 8558

content_en: Under BS EN 806-4, what hydrostatic test pressure must be applied when pressure-testing a newly installed metal cold water distribution pipework system?
content_zh: 根據英國/歐洲標準 BS EN 806-4，對新裝的金屬生活冷水管網進行水壓嚴密性打壓試驗時，法定的打壓測試壓力應當是多少？

options_en.B: 1.5 times the maximum design working pressure (typically a minimum of 10 bar or 1.5 × P_design), maintained and inspected for leaks

options_zh.A: 0.5 bar 維持 1 分鐘
options_zh.B: 最大設計工作壓力的 1.5 倍 (通常金屬管路至少打至 10 bar 基準，或 1.5 × P_design)，保壓觀測接口嚴密性
options_zh.C: 50 bar 超高壓
options_zh.D: 自行車打氣筒隨意打出的氣壓

explanation_en: BS EN 806-4 mandates testing metal systems at 1.5 times allowable maximum operating pressure (held for at least 10 minutes, then inspected for 1 hour).
explanation_zh: 嚴格執行 1.5 倍工作壓力驗收標準。常規家用自來水設計壓力按 6 bar 計，試驗水壓打至 10 bar，保壓期間壓降不超標且接頭無任何水珠汗漬方為合格。
source_reference: BS EN 806-4 Commissioning and testing; BS 8000-13

content_en: When commissioning a new cold water distribution pipework installation in a commercial or healthcare building, what disinfection procedure is statutory under BS 8558?
content_zh: 在商用寫字樓或醫療護理建築中對新裝冷水管網進行化學消毒清洗時，根據 BS 8558 標準，通常採用何種標準消毒工藝？

options_en.B: Chlorination with free available chlorine (e.g. 50 mg/L for 1 hour or 20 mg/L for 2 hours), followed by thorough flushing with wholesome water until chlorine returns to normal mains level
options_en.C: Spraying air freshener into the pipes
options_en.D: Filling with soapy detergent for 30 seconds

options_zh.A: 用溫熱的純牛奶沖洗管道
options_zh.B: 向管網注滿含游離有效氯的消毒水（如濃度 50 mg/L 浸泡 1 小時，或 20 mg/L 浸泡 2 小時），隨後用衛生自來水徹底沖洗置換直至餘氯值恢復至市政正常水平
options_zh.C: 向管道內部噴灑空氣清新劑噴霧
options_zh.D: 注入肥皂洗潔精浸泡 30 秒鐘

explanation_en: BS 8558 mandates disinfection using chlorine solution (typically 50 ppm for 1 hour), verified with chlorine test papers, and fully neutralized before flushing to drain.
explanation_zh: 新管內含焊劑殘渣及施工泥菌。通入 50 mg/L 次氯酸鈉溶液浸潤滅菌殺滅所有病原微生物，檢驗達標並經中和脫氯後排乾，最後通潔淨自來水取樣化驗出具水質合格證。
source_reference: BS 8558 / HSG274; C&G Unit 204

content_en: Under Water Regulations, what is the maximum permissible water level in a cold water storage cistern relative to the invert of the overflow/warning pipe?
content_zh: 根據水事法規規定，冷水儲水箱在浮球閥完全關閉時的正常靜止最高工作水位，必須保持在溢流管底邊緣（Invert）下方至少多少距離？

options_en.B: At least 25 mm below the invert of the warning pipe
options_en.D: Water must always pour down the overflow

options_zh.A: 低於溢流口邊緣 1 mm
options_zh.B: 至少保持在溢流警告管管底內邊緣（Invert）下方 25 mm 的安全淨距
options_zh.C: 與水箱最頂部密封蓋板齊平
options_zh.D: 水箱工作時水流必須始終向溢流管漫溢

explanation_en: Operating water level must sit at least 25mm below the overflow invert to prevent minor water ripple/surges from constantly weeping down the warning pipe.
explanation_zh: 調試浮球閥水位時，水面必須低於溢流口下沿至少 25mm（約 1 英寸）。留出足夠安全波紋餘量，杜絕因自來水夜間水壓波動導致警告管莫名滴水。
source_reference: Water Regulations Guide Schedule 2 Paragraph 16

content_en: What is the function of a 'Boundary Box' located in the pavement outside a domestic property?
content_zh: 位於私人住宅前人行道地坪下的市政「路邊水錶邊界井箱 (Boundary Box)」內部通常集成了哪些功能組件？

options_en.B: It houses the Water Undertaker's underground boundary stopcock, concentric water meter, and non-return check valve, marking the legal boundary of responsibility

options_zh.A: 市政垃圾分類收集桶
options_zh.B: 內部集成安裝了自來水公司的邊界停水旋塞、同軸水錶及防回流單向止回閥，也是自來水司與業主產權責任劃分的法定邊界分水嶺
options_zh.C: 電信地下線路交接箱
options_zh.D: 污水地下檢查井

explanation_en: The boundary box contains the isolation stopcock and meter. It demarcates the transition from company-owned Communication pipe to customer-owned Supply pipe.
explanation_zh: 路邊邊界井是產權分界點：井內閥門之前歸水務局，出井之後通往用戶花園的管線若發生漏水則由業主全資負責維修。
source_reference: Water Industry Act 1991; Water Regulations Guide

content_en: What type of backflow prevention device is a Type EA valve complying with BS EN 13959?
content_zh: 符合英國/歐洲標準 BS EN 13959 的「Type EA 閥」，屬於哪一種特定的機械防倒流安全裝置？

options_en.B: Mechanical Double Check Valve

options_zh.A: 帶檢測口的可驗證單止回閥 (Verifiable Single Check Valve - Type EA)
options_zh.B: 機械雙止回閥 (Type EC / ED)
options_zh.C: RPZ 減壓防回流閥 (Type BA)
options_zh.D: 排水透氣閥 (AAV)

explanation_en: Type EA is a single check valve with testing ports, certified to prevent backflow against Fluid Category 2 risks (e.g. temperature change).
explanation_zh: Type EA 閥為可現場接儀表檢測密封性的單向止回閥，廣泛應用於第 2 類流體隔離防護（如防止生活熱水倒竄入市政冷水管路）。
source_reference: BS EN 13959; Water Regulations Guide

content_en: What type of backflow prevention device is a Type EB valve?
content_zh: 在防回流專用閥門標準代號中，「Type EB 閥」代表的是哪種結構？

options_en.B: RPZ valve

options_zh.A: 不可檢測式普通單向止回閥 (Non-verifiable Single Check Valve)
options_zh.B: RPZ 差壓減壓閥
options_zh.C: 非圓形物理空氣間隙
options_zh.D: 手動閘閥

explanation_en: Type EB denotes a non-verifiable single check valve (commonly integrated into the base of domestic mixer taps or shower hoses) for Category 2 protection.
explanation_zh: Type EB 為不可驗證型單止回閥，常小巧地內嵌在混水龍頭冷熱水進口或軟管接頭根部，防止洗澡時冷熱水因壓力差在閥體內互相串水。
source_reference: BS EN 13959; WRAS

content_en: What type of backflow prevention device is a Type EC valve?
content_zh: 在防回流閥門體系中，「Type EC 閥」在技術規範中是如何定義的？

options_en.B: Single check valve

options_zh.A: 帶檢測口的可驗證雙止回閥 (Verifiable Double Check Valve)
options_zh.B: 單向止回閥
options_zh.C: 斷流水箱
options_zh.D: 浮球閥

explanation_en: Type EC is a double check valve equipped with test points between and across the valves to verify individual seat integrity, rated for Category 3.
explanation_zh: Type EC 閥串聯了兩個獨立止回閥芯，並配備有專用壓力檢測旋塞，檢測員可向中間注壓逐個檢驗密封嚴密性，用於第 3 類低毒防護。
source_reference: BS EN 13959; Water Regulations Guide

content_en: What type of backflow prevention device is a Type ED valve, commonly fitted on domestic garden bib taps?
content_zh: 家用室外花園洗車水龍頭上普遍加裝的「Type ED 閥」，其標準定義是什麼？

options_en.B: Air break with overflow

options_zh.A: 不可驗證型雙止回閥 (Non-verifiable Double Check Valve - 家用外接龍頭標準配置)
options_zh.B: 帶溢流的空氣隔斷
options_zh.C: RPZ 減壓閥
options_zh.D: 電動分區二通閥

explanation_en: Type ED is a compact non-verifiable double check valve cartridge, the standard required for domestic garden taps, washing machines, and combi filling loops.
explanation_zh: Type ED 是家庭最常見的雙止回閥，無檢驗孔、體積緊湊、成本低廉，內部由兩個獨立的彈簧式不銹鋼或工程塑料止回閥瓣串聯而成。
source_reference: BS EN 13959; Water Regs Schedule 2

content_en: What is the maximum permissible water pressure delivered to sanitary appliances in domestic properties under BS EN 806 recommendations to avoid premature component failure?
content_zh: 根據 BS EN 806 建築給水標準推薦，為防止潔具陶瓷閥芯、軟管及接頭因長期承壓過高而發生疲勞爆裂，家用給水終端器具承受的工作壓力上限建議控制在多少 bar 以內？

options_en.B: 5.0 bar (typically 3.0 to 4.0 bar optimal)

options_zh.A: 2.0 bar
options_zh.B: 5.0 bar (通常 3.0 至 4.0 bar 為最佳舒適與安全平衡點)
options_zh.C: 16.0 bar
options_zh.D: 25.0 bar

explanation_en: BS EN 806 recommends that dynamic pressure at draw-off points does not exceed 5.0 bar (optimal working pressure is 2.5 to 3.5 bar) to prolong fitting life and prevent splashing.
explanation_zh: 超過 5 bar 的水壓屬於高危超壓，易導致龍頭開水時飛濺水花、沖破塑料接頭並引發夜間爆管，超過 5 bar 必須安裝 PRV 減壓閥調至 3-3.5 bar。
source_reference: BS EN 806-2 Design of installations; C&G Unit 204

content_en: Under Regulation 5 of the Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999, which of the following domestic installations requires advance written notice and formal approval from the Water Undertaker before work begins?
content_zh: 根據英國《1999年供水（水配件）條例》第5條（法定申報規定），下列哪一項住宅管道施工必須在動工前提前以書面形式向供水公司報備並取得批准？

options_en.A: Replacing an existing identical 15mm kitchen tap washer
options_en.B: Installing a bath or tub with a storage capacity exceeding 230 liters, or installing a bidet with an ascending spray
options_en.D: Bleeding an existing central heating radiator

options_zh.A: 更換廚房 15mm 水龍頭內老化的橡膠墊片
options_zh.B: 安裝容水容量超過 230 公升的大型浴缸/按摩浴池，或加裝帶有向上噴射水嘴的坐浴盆 (Bidet)
options_zh.C: 為浴室牆面重新塗刷防水漆
options_zh.D: 為散熱器手動排氣

explanation_en: Regulation 5 requires prior notification for: bidets with submerged sprays, large baths (>230L), pump installations >12 L/min, reverse osmosis units, or rainwater harvesting.
explanation_zh: 法規第5條強制規定：涉及大浴缸（>230升造成市政用水劇增）、坐浴盆洗腸噴頭（第5類污染源）或大功率增壓泵，動工前必須提前向水司申報核准。
source_reference: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999, Reg 5

content_en: What is the maximum criminal penalty under Section 73 of the Water Industry Act 1991 for an installer who unlawfully breaches the Water Regulations by causing water contamination?
content_zh: 根據英國《1991年水工業法》第73條，安裝人員若違法安裝引發自來水管網嚴重污染或浪費水資源，在治安法庭面臨的法定刑事罰則是什麼？

options_en.B: A Level 3 criminal fine (up to £1,000 per separate offence), liability for emergency remediation costs, and potential disconnection of supply
options_en.D: Loss of driving license for 10 years

options_zh.A: 僅給予口頭批評教育
options_zh.B: 3 級刑事法庭定罪處罰（每項違法行為最高罰款 1,000 英鎊），並承擔水司全部緊急排毒搶修費用，水司有權直接強制斷水
options_zh.C: 沒收全部手動水暖工具
options_zh.D: 吊銷機動車駕照 10 年

explanation_en: Violating Water Regulations is a statutory criminal offence punishable by fines up to £1000 per contravention plus civil liability for all decontamination costs.
explanation_zh: 違反水事法規屬於刑事違法行為。水務執法人員有權隨時入戶搜證查扣違章配件，起訴後每項違法開出高達千鎊罰單並追討沖洗管網的巨額損失。
source_reference: Water Industry Act 1991 Section 73; Water Regs 1999

content_en: What type of physical air gap is certified as 'Type AB' under BS EN 13077 for Fluid Category 5 backflow protection?
content_zh: 在英國/歐洲標準 BS EN 13077 中，被認證為能完全抵禦第 5 類極高危污染的「Type AB 空氣間隙」具有何種構造特徵？

options_en.A: An air gap with a non-circular overflow design that maintains free-fall separation even when the overflow is discharging at maximum flow
options_en.B: A mechanical ball valve painted blue
options_en.D: A double check valve with rubber seals

options_zh.A: 帶有非圓形特製溢流口（Non-circular Overflow）的物理空氣間隙，即使溢流口滿負荷洩水，進水管口依然與最高溢流水位保持標準懸空垂直間隔
options_zh.B: 刷上藍漆的普通機械浮球閥
options_zh.C: 埋在黃沙中的過濾暗管
options_zh.D: 帶橡膠密封閥芯的雙止回閥

explanation_en: Type AB air gaps incorporate a non-circular overflow (rectangular or slot) engineered to dump excess water faster than the inlet can deliver, preventing submergence.
explanation_zh: Type AB 是水箱防第 5 類污染的黃金標準：非圓形長條溢流堰口洩水速度遠大於進水管進水流量，確保自來水出水嘴永遠不會被水箱水淹沒，隔絕回流。
source_reference: BS EN 13077 Air gaps with non-circular overflow - Family A - Type B

content_en: What is an 'Air Gap Type AA' under BS EN 13076?
content_zh: 在防回流污染國家標準中，「Type AA 空氣間隙」的工程定義是什麼？

options_en.A: An unrestricted, completely open air break between the lowest inlet point and the top spill-over rim discharging to an open drain
options_en.B: A closed plastic pipe with an air admittance valve

options_zh.A: 進水口最低點與受水容器最高溢水外緣邊界之間完全敞開、無任何阻礙的自由下落空氣間隙 (Air Break with Free Discharge)
options_zh.B: 帶有排水透氣閥的封閉塑料管
options_zh.C: 電動恆溫混水閥
options_zh.D: 膨脹水箱內部的氣囊氣墊

explanation_en: Type AA represents an unrestricted free air gap above a vessel's spillover level, offering the highest level of backflow protection against Category 5.
explanation_zh: Type AA 空氣間隙是完全開敞的垂直自由落體跌水。進水管口高高懸在洗水槽上方，水珠完全通過空氣自由下落，回流物理概率為零。
source_reference: BS EN 13076 Devices to prevent pollution by backflow - Air gap Type AA

content_en: When two or more polyolefin cold water storage cisterns are installed side-by-side in a large building to increase total capacity, how must they be interconnected at the base?
content_zh: 在大型建築中並排安裝多個塑料冷水儲水箱進行聯通以擴大總儲水量時，法規要求水箱底部必須加裝何種平衡聯通管？

options_en.A: Joined with a 10mm microbore plastic hose
options_en.B: Connected at the base by an equalizing balancing pipe sized at least twice the diameter of the largest outlet pipe (or sized to prevent differential head lag)
options_en.D: Connected via the overflow warning pipes

options_zh.A: 用一根 10mm 微口徑毛細軟管相連
options_zh.B: 在水箱底部由一根低位平衡管（Balancing Pipe）連通，其管徑至少為最大出水管管徑的 2 倍（或確保注水排水時兩箱水位相等防滯留）
options_zh.C: 完全無需做任何管道連通
options_zh.D: 直接將兩台水箱的溢流警告管串聯在一起

explanation_en: Balancing balance pipes equalize water levels instantly across linked cisterns, preventing one tank from overflowing while another drains, ensuring unified turnover.
explanation_zh: 水箱並聯若平衡管過細，出水時一側水箱迅速抽空而另一側水位滯後，極易誘發單箱溢流或吸入空氣。大口徑底座平衡管能確保雙箱同步呼吸、水質同新。
source_reference: Water Regulations Guide Schedule 2; BS 8558

content_en: In the twin linked cistern setup above, what float valve arrangement is required under Water Regulations Schedule 2?
content_zh: 在上述多台冷水儲水箱並聯的系統中，關於進水浮球閥的佈置，水事法規有何明確規定？

options_en.A: Fit 10 float valves into every tank
options_en.B: Fit a single float-operated valve in the primary cistern, with the interlink balancing pipe filling the secondary cistern, OR install precisely matched float valves set at identical levels
options_en.C: Leave the lid open to collect rain

options_zh.A: 在每個水箱內部各裝 10 個浮球閥
options_zh.B: 通常在主水箱安裝單個進水浮球閥，由底部平衡大管同步向副水箱補水；或安裝兩組經過精確水位校準的完全同步進水閥
options_zh.C: 敞開頂蓋接天花板漏水
options_zh.D: 多箱並聯時禁止安裝浮球閥

explanation_en: Having multiple ball valves set at slightly different heights causes one valve to stay shut while the other short-cycles, creating water stagnation in the inactive tank.
explanation_zh: 若兩個進水閥調校稍有誤差，水位較高的閥門將長期完全關閉不進水，導致該側水箱進水端死水停滯滋生細菌。因此推薦單閥進水大管平衡。
source_reference: Water Regulations Schedule 2 Paragraph 16; C&G Unit 204

content_en: What fault is indicated when a domestic BS 1212 float-operated valve in a CWSC produces a persistent, slow drip into the warning pipe even when the water level is high?
content_zh: 當冷水儲水箱水位已經升至最高點時，BS 1212 浮球進水閥依然持續向警告溢流管緩慢滴水漏水，最常見的零件磨損故障是什麼？

options_en.B: The rubber diaphragm or seating washer inside the valve body is scored, degraded, or encrusted with limescale, failing to make a water-tight seal against the orifice

options_zh.A: 進水銅管在高溫下融化變形
options_zh.B: 閥體內部的橡膠密封隔膜或平墊片表面出現壓痕割傷、老化硬化，或被碳酸鈣水垢顆粒墊死，無法在閥座孔口上形成嚴密自鎖密封
options_zh.C: 水質突然轉化為強酸性
options_zh.D: 警告溢流管發生泥沙堵塞

explanation_en: Diaphragms degrade over 5-10 years. A scored rubber disc allows water to weep past the seat under full float closure, requiring replacement.
explanation_zh: 微量滴漏 90% 源於橡膠膜片老化脆裂或水垢砂礫壓出凹坑。更換一片標準 BS 1212 橡膠墊片（Washer）或隔膜，幾分鐘即可修復。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 204 Fault Finding

content_en: If the hollow plastic spherical float attached to a brass ball-valve arm cracks and fills with water, what immediate symptom occurs in the cistern?
content_zh: 若黃銅浮球閥槓桿桿臂頂端懸掛的空心塑料浮球出現微裂紋並進水灌滿，水箱內部會立即呈現出何種異常現象？

options_en.A: The valve shuts off permanently and no water enters
options_en.B: The float loses buoyancy and sinks, causing the valve to remain wide open continuously, resulting in massive full-bore water discharge down the overflow pipe
options_en.D: The cistern turns into a steam boiler

options_zh.A: 進水閥永久死鎖切斷，滴水不進
options_zh.B: 浮球喪失空氣浮力而沉入箱底，帶動槓桿使閥門始終處於全開狀態，導致自來水以最大流量瘋狂衝出溢流管向外噴水跑水
options_zh.C: 水箱內部瞬間完全結冰凍死
options_zh.D: 水箱自發轉化為蒸汽鍋爐

explanation_en: A waterlogged float loses buoyancy. Its weight drags the lever arm down, locking the valve fully open and creating continuous overflow flooding.
explanation_zh: 浮球漏水變成「水坨」完全沉底，再無浮力頂起槓桿，自來水長驅直入以最大壓力瘋狂灌水，室外溢流管如噴泉般傾瀉示警。
source_reference: C&G Unit 204 Maintenance; Water Regs

content_en: When jointing an underground 25mm blue MDPE supply pipe using an approved mechanical compression fitting (such as Plasson or Philmac), what critical component must be inserted into the pipe end?
content_zh: 使用經認證的專用塑料卡套管件（如 Plasson 或 Philmac）接駁 25mm 地下藍色 MDPE 供水管時，管口內部必須強制裝入什麼配件？

options_en.B: A dedicated internal rigid plastic or stainless steel pipe liner / pipe stiffener

options_zh.A: 酸性焊接助焊膏
options_zh.B: 專用高剛性工程塑料或不銹鋼內襯支撐套管（Pipe Liner / Pipe Stiffener）
options_zh.C: 普通辦公橡膠筋
options_zh.D: 木工實心圓木塞

explanation_en: MDPE expands and creeps under ground settlement. An internal stiffener supports the pipe bore against radial compression, preventing the pipe pulling out.
explanation_zh: MDPE 管壁具備一定塑性，直埋地下承受土壤壓力和水錘時管徑易內縮。內襯襯套為密封圈提供剛性抵擋面，防止高壓下管材被活生生拔脫爆管。
source_reference: BS EN 12201; Manufacturer MDPE Installation Guides

content_en: What jointing method for large commercial MDPE/HDPE water mains utilizes an electric current passing through internal resistance wire coils embedded in a fitting socket?
content_zh: 在市政大口徑商用 MDPE / HDPE 供水主管接駁中，利用外接專用電焊機向管件承口內預埋的電阻絲通電加熱、使塑料分子熔合為一體的熔接技術被稱作什麼？

options_en.B: Electrofusion welding (EF welding)

options_zh.A: 溶劑化學膠接
options_zh.B: 電熔熔接技術 (Electrofusion Welding - EF 焊)
options_zh.C: 氧乙炔氣焊
options_zh.D: 傳統抹鉛工藝

explanation_en: Electrofusion fittings contain resistive heating coils. An automated electrofusion control unit (typically 39.5V) heats the polymer, forming a monolithic welded joint.
explanation_zh: 電熔焊（EF）是地下供水燃氣最可靠的永久熔接法：掃碼器讀取管件條碼設定電壓與熔接時間，電流加熱微細電阻絲使塑料完全融化共聚，冷卻後強度超母材。
source_reference: BS EN 12201-3 Plastics piping systems; C&G Unit 204

content_en: What warning marker must be placed in an underground service trench above a buried MDPE cold water supply pipe to protect it from future excavator damage?
content_zh: 在開挖的地下管溝中回填土壤時，在直埋 MDPE 藍色自來水管正上方特定高度，必須鋪設何種法定示警標識構件以防日後挖機開挖挖斷？

options_en.A: A layer of broken glass bottles
options_en.B: A continuous blue plastic detectable warning tape (or tape marked 'CAUTION: WATER PIPE BURIED BELOW') laid approx 150-300mm above the pipe crown

options_zh.A: 碎玻璃瓶子防挖層
options_zh.B: 一條連續的藍色示警塑料標誌帶（或金屬可探測示警帶，上面印有「CAUTION: WATER PIPE BURIED BELOW 小心地下供水管」醒目字樣），鋪設在管頂上方約 150-300mm 處
options_zh.C: 廢舊舊報紙層
options_zh.D: 金屬鐵鏈捆紮

explanation_en: Underground utility guidelines require detectable warning tape placed roughly 150-300mm above the pipe to alert future excavator drivers before the shovel strikes the live pipe.
explanation_zh: 示警膠帶是防挖斷的黃金屏障。後續市政工人在開挖土方時，挖斗首先翻出藍色警示帶，立即知曉下方 30 厘米處暗埋高壓自來水主管，停止粗暴機械開挖。
source_reference: NJUG Guidelines for the Positioning of Utilities; BS 8000-13

content_en: Under BS 5422, why must cold water supply pipes routed through an uninsulated attic space be protected with closed-cell tubular insulation (lagging)?
content_zh: 根據 BS 5422 建築保溫標準，敷設在未保溫開放式閣樓空間內的冷水管道，為什麼必須全程嚴密包裹閉孔式柔性保溫管套（Lagging）？

options_en.A: To make the pipe weigh more
options_en.B: To prevent sub-zero winter temperatures freezing and splitting the pipe, AND to prevent hot summer attic temperatures (>40°C) from warming cold water above 20°C (Legionella risk)
options_en.C: To keep the pipes clean from spiders

options_zh.A: 增加管道在托樑上的自重
options_zh.B: 雙重防護：冬季嚴防零下低溫將管道凍裂爆管引發水漫金山；盛夏嚴防閣樓高達 40°C 以上高溫烘熱冷水使其超過 20°C（杜絕滋生嗜肺軍團菌）
options_zh.C: 防止蜘蛛在管道表面爬行結網
options_zh.D: 反射閣樓微弱的檢修燈光

explanation_en: Attic insulation serves a dual purpose: delaying winter freeze rupture and preventing summer thermal gain that fosters bacterial proliferation (>20°C).
explanation_zh: 保溫套管絕非僅僅防凍。英格蘭夏季閣樓酷熱，未保溫冷水管水溫可升至 30°C，直接落入軍團菌滋生黃金區，規範強制要求水溫不得超 20°C。
source_reference: BS 5422; Water Regulations Schedule 2 Paragraph 11

content_en: What is an electric trace heating tape used for on cold water pipework?
content_zh: 在嚴寒地區暴露在室外或地下室迎風處的冷水管道表面加裝「自限溫電伴熱帶 (Trace Heating Tape)」的作用是什麼？

options_en.A: To generate boiling steam for cleaning
options_en.B: To supply controlled electrical low-wattage heat directly to the pipe wall, maintaining water temperature above freezing (e.g. 3°C to 5°C) even during weeks of sub-zero arctic blizzards

options_zh.A: 為管道清洗製造高溫蒸汽
options_zh.B: 直接貼附在金屬管壁向管體補充可控的微小伴熱功率，配合溫控探頭將管內存水始終維持在冰點以上（如 3°C 至 5°C），在極寒暴風雪持續數週時徹底杜絕凍結
options_zh.C: 作為建築防雷接閃線
options_zh.D: 降低水中鈣鎂離子濃度

explanation_en: Self-regulating trace heating cables vary heat output based on surface temperature, providing active energy input to ensure pipes in freezing locations never reach 0°C.
explanation_zh: 單純保溫只能延緩結冰，無法抵禦長期極寒。自限溫伴熱帶隨溫度越低輸出熱量越大，與溫控器聯動，是室外明裝水管防凍的終極保證。
source_reference: BS 6351 Electric trace heating; BS 5422

content_en: What is a 'Type AG' air gap under BS EN 13079?
content_zh: 在防回流空氣間隙標準中，「Type AG 空氣間隙」是怎樣定義的？

options_en.A: An air gap with a minimum-size circular overflow hole, certified to protect against Fluid Category 3 hazards (e.g. washbasins)
options_en.B: A rubber non-return valve

options_zh.A: 帶有最小規定孔徑圓形溢流口（Circular Overflow）的空氣間隙，認證用於抵禦第 3 類中低度流體回流風險（如面盆洗手槽溢水孔）
options_zh.B: 橡膠單向防逆閥
options_zh.C: 地下雨水滲透井
options_zh.D: 純銅軸向補償波紋管

explanation_en: Type AG air gaps incorporate a standard circular overflow (such as the overflow hole in a bathroom washbasin), providing Category 3 protection.
explanation_zh: Type AG 空氣間隙常見於家用陶瓷洗臉盆自帶的圓形溢水孔。只要孔道暢通，水面滿至孔位即向廢水管排走，出水口保持安全空氣間隔。
source_reference: BS EN 13079 Devices to prevent pollution by backflow - Air gap Type AG

content_en: What is a 'Type AF' air gap under BS EN 13077?
content_zh: 在商用水暖設備防回流分類中，「Type AF 空氣間隙」的技術規範是什麼？

options_en.A: An air gap with a circular overflow pipe designed for Fluid Category 4 protection on commercial processing and water treatment plant
options_en.B: A single spring check valve

options_zh.A: 配備專用圓形防溢流管道的大流量空氣間隙，認證用於商用流體處理、透析加藥及化學水處理設備上的第 4 類（Fluid Category 4）回流隔離
options_zh.B: 單彈簧式止回閥
options_zh.C: 塑料花園洗車軟管
options_zh.D: 座便器蓋板鉸鏈

explanation_en: Type AF features a circular overflow sized to handle the maximum inlet capacity, certified for Category 4 hazards where toxic chemicals are present.
explanation_zh: Type AF 適用於商用洗滌機及化學配藥槽。其圓形溢流口通徑經過流體力學測算，超量進水時無壓溢灑，確保進水嘴絕對不浸入第 4 類化學藥劑水中。
source_reference: BS EN 13077 Air gaps with circular overflow - Type AF

content_en: What is the maximum static water pressure rating stamped on standard Class C (or SDR 11) blue MDPE underground pipework under BS 6572?
content_zh: 符合 BS 6572 標準的常見 20mm/25mm 藍色 MDPE Class C（SDR 11）地下自來水給水塑料管，其管身標記的額定最大安全工作壓強（PN rating）通常是多少？

options_en.B: 6 bar
options_en.C: 12.0 to 12.5 bar (or 16 bar for PE100 SDR11)

options_zh.A: 3 bar (室內低壓)
options_zh.B: 6 bar
options_zh.C: 12.0 至 12.5 bar (PE80 等級) 或 16 bar (PE100 SDR11 高壓等級)
options_zh.D: 50 bar

explanation_en: BS 6572 blue MDPE (PE80) is rated up to 12.5 bar at 20°C (PE100 is rated at 16 bar), comfortably handling high municipal mains supply surges.
explanation_zh: 地下直埋塑料管必須承受市政主管網夜間高水壓與水錘脈衝。SDR 11 壁厚規格額定承壓高達 12.5-16 bar，是進戶管防爆防漏的基本技術底線。
source_reference: BS 6572 / BS EN 12201; Plastics Piping Manual

content_en: What is the function of a 'Screened Air Vent' mounted through the lid of a cold water storage cistern?
content_zh: 扣裝在冷水儲水箱密封硬頂蓋上的「帶濾網透氣呼吸孔 (Screened Air Vent)」的核心功用是什麼？

options_en.A: To let sunlight into the tank
options_en.B: To allow air to enter and exit freely as water is drawn down or refilled, preventing internal vacuum pressure or pressure buildup, while blocking insects with a fine mesh
options_en.C: To pour bleach into the water

options_zh.A: 讓陽光直射照入水箱內部
options_zh.B: 在水箱大流量放水或快速補水時，允許空氣自由進出維持箱內常壓，杜絕內部產生微真空負壓抽癟水箱或氣阻，同時防蟲濾網嚴密隔絕蚊蟲飛入
options_zh.C: 方便維護工隨時向水中倒入漂白水
options_zh.D: 用以接駁溢流警報排水管

explanation_en: Large draw-offs create an air displacement vacuum. Screened vents equalize atmospheric pressure without compromising sanitary water protection.
explanation_zh: 水箱用水如同大針筒抽水，若頂蓋完全氣密，放水時箱內會形成負壓阻礙下水甚至壓扁塑料箱體；呼吸帽通氣的同時，孔內金屬微孔紗網阻擋任何蚊蠅飛入。
source_reference: Water Regulations Guide Schedule 2 Paragraph 16

content_en: In domestic plumbing, what is a 'Stopcock Key' (Crutch Key) used for?
content_zh: 在英國水暖維修作業中，水暖工隨車攜帶的專用「T 型長桿停水扳手 (Stopcock Key / Crutch Key)」的用途是什麼？

options_en.A: To unlock front doors of houses
options_en.B: A long-handled T-bar steel tool with a crutch head, used to reach deep into external boundary pavement boxes to operate underground stopcocks
options_en.D: To drill holes in timber joists

options_zh.A: 開鎖師傅用於開啟業主入戶大門
options_zh.B: 一根長達 1 米的 T 型鋼製長柄專用工具，頂端帶有適配閥桿的雙叉槽，專門伸入人行道深層路面水錶井內旋開或關閉埋地進水總閥
options_zh.C: 調節散熱器恆溫閥手柄
options_zh.D: 在木托樑上高速鑽孔

explanation_en: Boundary stopcocks sit up to 1 meter below ground inside small pavement risers. The crutch key reaches down to operate the crutch-head valve spindle.
explanation_zh: 路邊水錶井深達 0.8-1 米且孔徑狹窄，徒手根本夠不到。T 型長桿扳手插到底部卡住旋塞閥柄，順時針旋轉一整圈即可在路邊關死全屋進水。
source_reference: Tooling Standards; C&G Unit 204

content_en: Why is soft water produced by a domestic base-exchange sodium-ion water softener classified as Fluid Category 2 rather than Category 1?
content_zh: 經家用離子交換鈉樹脂軟水機處理後產生的軟化水，在法規分類中為什麼被列為「第 2 類流體 (Fluid Category 2)」，而非直接飲用水的第 1 類？

options_en.B: The ion-exchange process swaps calcium for sodium, raising sodium levels which can exceed statutory drinking water limits for infants and persons on low-sodium diets

options_zh.A: 軟化水中含有微量放射性粒子
options_zh.B: 離子交換過程置換入等摩爾的「鈉離子 (Sodium)」，水中鈉含量超標，對嬰兒消化系統及患有高血壓、心血管疾病需低鈉飲食的特殊人群存在健康隱患
options_zh.C: 軟化水出水水溫極高
options_zh.D: 軟化水會瞬間將銅管金屬溶解

explanation_en: Softened water has elevated sodium concentrations and aesthetic changes, categorized as Fluid Category 2. Separate unsoftened drinking taps are required.
explanation_zh: 軟化水本質改變了化學離子構成。嬰幼兒沖泡奶粉嚴禁使用高鈉軟水。因此法規強制要求軟水機前必須單獨分流一根未經軟化的自來水直通廚房水槽供飲用。
source_reference: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999 Schedule 1; WRAS

content_en: What is the statutory colour and marking required for identifying an underground reclaimed or rainwater harvesting service pipe under British Standards?
content_zh: 根據英國國家標準，直埋地下用於收集雨水或中水回用（Non-potable water）的專用塑料供水管道，其外觀顏色及字樣標識有何法定硬性要求？

options_en.A: Standard bright blue with no writing
options_en.B: Black plastic pipe with green stripes or clearly marked 'RECLAIMED WATER - NOT DRINKING WATER' along its entire length

options_zh.A: 普通純藍色塑料管且無任何印刷字樣
options_zh.B: 黑色塑料管外壁附帶醒目「綠色條紋 (Green Stripe)」，或全管身印有「RECLAIMED WATER - NOT DRINKING WATER (非飲用再生中水)」連續警告字樣
options_zh.C: 純白色給水管
options_zh.D: 透明石英玻璃管

explanation_en: WRAS and BS 8515 mandate black pipe with green stripes to distinguish non-potable harvested rainwater from wholesome blue potable water pipes.
explanation_zh: 嚴格杜絕誤接誤飲！雨水回收管採用黑色帶綠條專用管，並在所有外露閥門噴塗警示標籤，與自來水純藍管形成強烈視覺對比，防止管道錯接交叉污染。
source_reference: BS 8515 Rainwater harvesting systems; WRAS Guidelines

content_en: Under Water Regulations, what component must be incorporated into a domestic kitchen mixer tap supplying both direct mains cold water and indirect hot water from a storage cylinder through a single spout?
content_zh: 在英國住宅廚房混水龍頭中，若冷水端接自市政高壓自來水，而熱水端接自低壓開式儲水箱，為符合水事法規，該龍頭內部必須具備何種特殊結構？

options_en.B: A dual-flow divided spout (biflo spout) keeping the cold mains water and cylinder hot water physically separated until leaving the mouth of the nozzle

options_zh.A: 內置電加熱金屬絲
options_zh.B: 雙通道分流獨立出水嘴 (Dual-flow / Divided Biflo Spout)，冷熱水在龍頭出水嘴內部物理隔離為內外雙層通道，直到流出出水嘴完全脫離時才在空氣中混合
options_zh.C: 活性炭水質濾芯
options_zh.D: 黃銅全通徑手動閘閥

explanation_en: A biflo (divided) spout ensures high mains cold pressure cannot force its way back up the low-pressure hot supply pipe, preventing cross-contamination.
explanation_zh: 若冷熱水在龍頭內部相通，高達 3 bar 的冷水會將僅有 0.2 bar 的低壓熱水硬生生倒頂回閣樓水箱造成溢流。雙管分流噴嘴使兩股水流在管內永不碰面，杜絕串壓倒灌。
source_reference: Water Regulations Guide Schedule 2 Paragraph 15; C&G Unit 204

content_en: Under British Standards and Water Regulations guidelines, what is the design storage allowance per person per day for a cold water cistern in a commercial office building with no canteen?
content_zh: 根據英國國家標準與水事技術指引，在不設集中職工餐廳的普通商用寫字樓辦公建築中，冷水儲水箱的每人每日標準儲水設計定額是多少公升？

options_en.B: 15 liters per person per day

options_zh.A: 每人每天 2 公升
options_zh.B: 每人每天 15 公升 (若自帶熱食餐廳則上調至 20 升/人·日)
options_zh.C: 每人每天 100 公升
options_zh.D: 每人每天 500 公升

explanation_en: BS 8558 specifies 15 litres per person per day for standard commercial offices without canteen facilities (and 20 L/person with canteen).
explanation_zh: 商用寫字樓冷水儲備定額為 15 升/人·日。精確算量能保證停水時滿足沖廁洗手需求，同時杜絕水箱容量過大造成水體長期滯留變質。
source_reference: BS 8558 Guide to the design, installation, testing and maintenance of services supplying water for domestic use

content_en: For healthcare facilities and hospitals, what is the standard 24-hour emergency cold water storage requirement per hospital bed under NHS Health Technical Memoranda (HTM)?
content_zh: 根據英國國家醫療體系衛生技術備忘錄 (HTM 04-01) 規範，綜合醫院住院部為確保突發停水時不中斷醫療運轉，每張病床的 24 小時應急儲水最低配置標準是多少？

options_en.B: 45 liters per bed
options_en.C: 135 to 200 liters per bed per day

options_zh.A: 每床 10 公升
options_zh.B: 每床 45 公升
options_zh.C: 每床每天 135 至 200 公升 (HTM 04-01 應急儲備標準)
options_zh.D: 每床 1,000 公升

explanation_en: NHS HTM 04-01 specifies a minimum of 135 to 200 litres per bed day of cold water storage to guarantee 24 hours of operational resilience.
explanation_zh: 醫院屬於極高連續供水敏感場所。透析、消毒及手術室依賴潔淨自來水，每床配備 135-200 升儲備水，確保市政供水管中斷 24 小時內醫院運轉無礙。
source_reference: NHS Health Technical Memorandum 04-01: Safe water in healthcare premises

content_en: What is a 'Dead Leg' in a cold water distribution system, and why is it considered a severe hygiene violation under HSE ACoP L8?
content_zh: 在冷水管網中，「死水盲端 (Dead Leg)」是指什麼，為什麼在英國 HSE ACoP L8 衛生規範中被定性為極其嚴重的違規隱患？

options_en.A: A pipe that is painted black
options_en.B: A redundant, capped length of pipe containing stagnant, uncirculated water where biocides deplete and Legionella bacteria multiply rapidly
options_en.C: A pipe made of solid lead

options_zh.A: 外表面刷上黑漆的管道
options_zh.B: 一截已廢棄拆除器具但末端僅用管帽封堵的長盲腸管段，內部自來水長期死水停滯、餘氯消毒劑消耗殆盡，成為嗜肺軍團菌與生物膜瘋狂繁殖的溫床
options_zh.C: 純鉛鑄造的水管
options_zh.D: 損壞的放水閥門

explanation_en: Dead legs hold stagnant, lukewarm water that acts as an incubator for Legionella pneumophila. Guidelines mandate cutting back dead legs flush with the running main.
explanation_zh: 「盲管」如同一條裝滿細菌的針筒。死水中的軍團菌滋生後會反向擴散擴散至主管網。規範要求改造拆除設備時，必須將支管齊根鋸平切除，嚴禁留盲腸！
source_reference: HSE Approved Code of Practice L8 / HSG274 Part 2

content_en: What is the difference between a 'Loose Jumper' and a 'Fixed Jumper' in a traditional BS 1010-2 brass screw-down stopcock?
content_zh: 在傳統 BS 1010-2 黃銅螺旋截止閥（Stopcock）中，「活動浮動閥芯 (Loose Jumper)」與「固定閥芯 (Fixed Jumper)」的機械結構與功能差異是什麼？

options_en.A: A loose jumper is made of rubber
options_en.B: A loose jumper is not physically attached to the spindle, allowing it to drop onto the seat to act as a crude non-return valve if pressure reverses; a fixed jumper is mechanically pinned to the stem
options_en.C: A fixed jumper rotates freely in the air

options_zh.A: 活動閥芯由普通生橡膠製成
options_zh.B: 活動浮動閥芯未與旋轉閥桿死鎖鉚接，當上游停水發生背壓反向時，閥芯能在重力與逆流壓力下自動落座貼緊閥孔，兼具原始的單向止回功能；固定閥芯則與閥桿死死相連
options_zh.C: 固定閥芯可在空氣中自由旋轉
options_zh.D: 兩者在結構和功能上完全一模一樣

explanation_en: BS 1010 stopcocks use a loose jumper that acts as a partial check valve. If incoming pressure drops, reverse flow pushes the jumper onto its seat.
explanation_zh: 活動閥芯是水暖精巧機構：開水時水壓頂起閥芯過水；一旦停水倒吸，逆流水流將閥芯壓回閥座，防止全屋存水被市政管網抽吸倒流。
source_reference: BS 1010-2 Draw-off taps and stopvalves; C&G Unit 204

content_en: What causes a high-pitched singing or whistling noise from a domestic cold water screw-down stopcock when a tap is turned on downstairs?
content_zh: 當樓下水龍頭打開時，進戶螺旋截止水閥（Stopcock）突然發出刺耳的高頻「吹哨聲」或劇烈尖叫抖動，最核心的故障機理是什麼？

options_en.A: The water has turned into gas
options_en.B: A worn, loose jumper valve or deteriorated washer vibrating rapidly in the high-velocity water stream at high resonant frequency
options_en.D: The water meter has run out of battery

options_zh.A: 自來水在管內自發汽化為高壓氣體
options_zh.B: 截止閥內部的活動閥芯（Jumper）配合間隙磨損曠量過大，或橡膠墊片磨損鬆動，在高速流水沖刷下產生高頻受迫劇烈諧振拍打閥座
options_zh.C: 銅水管正處於完全結冰狀態
options_zh.D: 水錶內部鋰電池電量耗盡

explanation_en: Water rushing past a worn loose jumper causes rapid aerodynamic flutter against the seat, vibrating at acoustic frequencies (whistling/screaming).
explanation_zh: 高速水流穿過狹窄閥口產生卡門渦街，鬆動的閥芯在水流中如同哨子簧片瘋狂高頻振動，更換一個緊配合閥芯或更換為全通徑球閥即可根除噪聲。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 204 Fault Diagnosis

content_en: Why should a plumber NEVER bend the brass float rod downward with brute force to lower the water shut-off level in a BS 1212 ball valve?
content_zh: 水暖工在調低 BS 1212 浮球進水閥的關水工作水位時，為什麼嚴禁用蠻力將黃銅浮球槓桿連桿向下死死硬掰？

options_en.B: Bending the arm alters the mechanical leverage angle, reducing the vertical closing thrust exerted on the piston/diaphragm and risking failure to shut off against mains pressure; adjust the threaded screw mechanism instead

options_zh.A: 這會削弱浮球自身的物理浮力
options_zh.B: 暴力硬掰會破壞力學槓桿的最佳咬合角度，大幅降低浮球浮起時傳遞至閥芯墊片上的垂直密封頂推力，導致閥門無法克服高壓水壓而關閉不嚴；正確做法是調節槓桿上的微調螺絲或齒形調整卡盤
options_zh.C: 這會導致水質轉變為紅色
options_zh.D: 這會震裂建築物的結構地基

explanation_en: Bending arms alters the mechanical advantage geometry, often resulting in seat leakage under high mains pressure. Use the designed adjustment screw.
explanation_zh: 浮球閥利用槓桿原理（力臂比達 10:1）。野蠻折彎連桿改變了連桿對閥芯的法向推力矢量，使有效關閉力大打折扣，極易在夜間高水壓下漏水。
source_reference: BS 1212 Installation Guidelines; C&G Unit 204

content_en: Under BS 8000-13, what continuous fall is recommended for the overflow warning pipe running from a CWSC to the outside wall?
content_zh: 根據 BS 8000-13 施工工藝規範，從冷水儲水箱引向室外外牆的警告溢流管，其沿途推薦保持的最小連續排水向下坡度是多少？

options_en.B: A continuous downward fall of at least 1 in 200 (approx 5mm per meter) with zero dips, sags, or traps

options_zh.A: 完全水平（零坡度）
options_zh.B: 全程保持至少 1:200（即每米向下傾斜約 5mm）的連續下坡坡度，全程嚴禁有任何下凹塌腰、氣袋或積水窪死角
options_zh.C: 向上反向倒坡 1:10
options_zh.D: 佈置垂直向上翻轉的補償環

explanation_en: Warning pipes must fall continuously towards the outside terminal. Any sagging traps stagnant water that freezes in winter or harbors bacterial sludge.
explanation_zh: 溢流管是重力無壓排空管。若管身下垂塌腰，存積的死水在寒冬閣樓中會率先結成冰塞，當浮球閥真正漏水時，冰塞封堵溢流管導致水漫閣樓塌頂。
source_reference: BS 8000-13 Section 3; Water Regulations Schedule 2

content_en: What is an 'Impact Moling' (trenchless) technique used for when replacing an old lead incoming water supply pipe with new blue 25mm MDPE?
content_zh: 在住宅改造中將老舊含鉛地下供水管更換為全新 25mm 藍色 MDPE 管道時，廣泛採用的「氣動衝擊穿管微開挖技術 (Impact Moling)」具有何種工程優勢？

options_en.A: Digging up the customer's entire landscaped lawn and paved driveway from road to house
options_en.B: Using a pneumatic underground percussive mole fired between two small launch and reception pits to bore a clean horizontal tunnel without trench excavation
options_en.C: Melting the soil with thermal lasers
options_en.D: Running the pipe over the roof slates

options_zh.A: 將客戶私家庭院的精美草坪、昂貴車道地磚從路邊到門口全線挖開深溝
options_zh.B: 利用壓縮空氣驅動的地下氣動穿梭衝擊矛（Mole），僅需在起點和終點開挖兩個小工作坑，即可在地下自動衝擊擠密穿出一條水平光滑隧道並無痕帶入新管
options_zh.C: 使用高能激光將土壤燒結融化
options_zh.D: 將自來水管明鋪在屋頂瓦片上

explanation_en: Moling drives an underground bore pneumatically between two small pits, avoiding the expense and disruption of excavating continuous open trenches through driveways.
explanation_zh: 衝擊穿管矛（Moling）利用衝擊動能排土穿洞，極大保護了客戶昂貴的私家車道和精美園藝花園，施工速度快、路面破壞少，是進戶管更換首選工藝。
source_reference: WRAS Replacement of Lead Pipes Guidance; C&G Unit 204

content_en: What UK certification mark on a plumbing valve or fitting verifies that it has undergone rigorous testing and complies with the Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999?
content_zh: 在水暖閥門、混水龍頭或塑料管配件上模壓的何種英國法定認證徽標，確證該產品通過了國家級水質防污染與機械嚴密性檢測，准予接入自來水管網？

options_en.A: WRAS Approved (Water Regulations Advisory Scheme) or equivalent accredited mark (e.g. Kiwa, NSF Reg 4)
options_en.B: CE toy safety logo

options_zh.A: WRAS 認證標識 (Water Regulations Advisory Scheme) 或同等國家認可檢驗標章 (如 Kiwa / NSF Reg 4)
options_zh.B: 歐盟兒童玩具安全 CE 標誌
options_zh.C: 節能基金會節能燈泡圖標
options_zh.D: CSCS 現場施工工人綠卡

explanation_en: The WRAS Approved Scheme verifies that non-metallic materials do not leach toxins or support bacterial growth, and mechanical fittings resist water leakage.
explanation_zh: WRAS 認證嚴格檢測材料毒理學：橡膠金屬配件浸泡水中絕不能溶出有害物、不能改變口感氣味且不滋生微生物，是全英供水法規準入通行證。
source_reference: Water Regulations Advisory Scheme (WRAS); C&G Unit 204

content_en: What is the operational purpose of a Variable Speed Inverter-Driven Cold Water Booster Set in a multi-story apartment block?
content_zh: 在現代高層公寓住宅樓的集中生活給水加壓泵房中，採用「變頻調速驅動增壓泵組 (Variable Speed Inverter Booster Set)」的核心技術目的何在？

options_en.B: To automatically modulate pump motor speed via pressure transducers, maintaining a constant, rock-solid delivery pressure regardless of fluctuating occupant demand, while cutting energy use
options_en.C: To create musical notes in the pipework

options_zh.A: 將冷水在管網內自動加熱沸騰
options_zh.B: 通過高精度壓力傳感器實時反饋，自動調節水泵電機的交流供電頻率與轉速，在用戶用水量瞬息萬變時始終恆壓供水，消除水壓忽大忽小並大幅降低電耗
options_zh.C: 使水管有節奏地發出音樂音調
options_zh.D: 向水流中直接注入純氯氣

explanation_en: Inverters vary motor frequency (Hz) to match real-time flow rate, eliminating noisy pressure surges, reducing pump mechanical wear, and saving up to 50% electrical power.
explanation_zh: 傳統水泵「要麼停要麼滿載」，水壓劇烈震盪。變頻水泵（VSD）如同汽車無級變速油門：一人開水微轉，百人同時洗澡全速運轉，出水壓力恆定如一。
source_reference: BS EN 806-2; Water Boosting Design Guide

content_en: What water conditioning device is required under Building Regulations Approved Document L (Conservation of fuel and power) on incoming cold mains supplying hot water appliances in hard water areas exceeding 200 ppm (mg/L) calcium carbonate?
content_zh: 根據英國建築節能法規 Approved Document L 強制規定，在水質總硬度超過 200 ppm (mg/L CaCO3) 的高硬度硬水地區，進入熱水加熱設備的冷水供水管上必須強制加裝何種阻垢裝置？

options_en.B: A permanent scale prevention device (such as an in-line electrolytic, magnetic, or water softening scale inhibitor)

options_zh.A: 一桶普通建築黃沙過濾
options_zh.B: 永久性阻垢/除垢裝置 (Scale Prevention Device - 如在線電解式/磁化阻垢儀或離子交換軟水器)
options_zh.C: 純銅膨脹水箱
options_zh.D: 散熱器排氣專用扳手

explanation_en: Part L mandates scale protection in hard water areas (>200 ppm) to stop limescale coating heat exchangers, which degrades boiler efficiency by up to 10-15%.
explanation_zh: 水垢是熱量傳遞的大敵：僅 1mm 厚水垢就會使換熱效率暴跌 10% 以上。Part L 節能法規將硬水防垢列為強制驗收項，未裝阻垢器無法通過節能驗收。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document L1 Section 6; Domestic Building Services Compliance Guide

content_en: When installing a concentric cold water meter in a boundary box or internal manifold, what ensures the meter cannot be accidentally bypassed or tampered with?
content_zh: 在室外邊界井或室內總進水集分水器上安裝同軸自來水錶（Concentric Water Meter）時，通常採取何種防篡改防偷水技術措施？

options_en.B: Fitting tamper-evident security security seals / serialized locking rings through the meter retaining nut flanges

options_zh.A: 用普通塑料快遞膠帶纏繞包裹
options_zh.B: 在水錶連接旋轉壓緊螺母處穿鎖帶有唯一激光防偽編號的「防篡改安全鉛封扣/防盜卡扣 (Tamper-evident Security Seal)」
options_zh.C: 將水錶深埋在爛泥巴下方掩蓋
options_zh.D: 將水錶刻度玻璃表面全部塗黑

explanation_en: Tamper seals provide permanent visual evidence if an occupant attempts to remove or reverse the meter to register fraudulent zero consumption.
explanation_zh: 水錶屬於計量收費法定器具。專用鋼絲封印或防拆自鎖工程塑料卡扣一旦被私自剪斷，即構成破壞計量設備偷盜自來水的刑事違法證據。
source_reference: Water Industry Act 1991; BS EN ISO 4064 Water meters

content_en: What is the statutory minimum height difference required between the invert of the float valve inlet and the spillover level of a CWSC overflow pipe under BS 1212 / BS 4213?
content_zh: 根據 BS 1212 及 BS 4213 標準，冷水儲水箱進水浮球閥噴嘴進水口的中心下邊緣，與溢流管溢水漫溢線之間，必須保持的法定垂直空氣淨距至少是多少？

options_en.B: At least 25 mm (ensuring an unambiguous physical air break to prevent back-siphonage into the nozzle if mains pressure drops)

options_zh.A: 5 mm
options_zh.B: 至少 25 mm (確保自來水出水噴嘴與箱內最高溢流水位之間具備明確的物理空氣隔斷，防止管網負壓時污水吸入噴嘴)
options_zh.C: 100 mm
options_zh.D: 300 mm

explanation_en: The air gap between the inlet orifice and the overflow spill level must be at least 25mm to satisfy Type AG/AUK1 backflow prevention standards.
explanation_zh: 進水口必須高高在溢流口上方至少 25mm。即便下大雨或浮球卡死導致水箱滿水，水流漫過溢流口排出時，水面也絕對觸碰不到進水噴嘴，徹底杜絕虹吸。
source_reference: BS 4213; Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999 Schedule 2

content_en: What is the function of a 'Rotary Piston' (Positive Displacement) water meter commonly installed on domestic UK water supplies?
content_zh: 在全英自來水抄表計量中廣泛採用的「旋轉活塞容積式水錶 (Rotary Piston / Positive Displacement Meter)」，其核心計量特性是什麼？

options_en.A: It counts water using radio lasers
options_en.B: A precision-machined cylindrical piston oscillates within a measuring chamber, capturing and discharging an exact, known volume of water with every cycle, providing extreme accuracy at ultra-low flow rates
options_en.D: It stops the water after 10 liters

options_zh.A: 利用無線電激光束掃描水滴數量
options_zh.B: 高精度柱狀活塞在專用計量室內精確擺動旋轉，每次轉動捕獲並排出完全確定體積的自來水，即使在水龍頭微弱滴漏的超低極小流速下也能精準計量收費
options_zh.C: 僅用於測量自來水實時水溫
options_zh.D: 累計流過 10 升水後自動鎖死關閥

explanation_en: Rotary piston meters (Class C/D) measure discrete volumetric packets, detecting slow tap drips (down to 1-2 L/h) far better than inferential velocity turbine meters.
explanation_zh: 容積式水錶是水司計量首選：活塞被水流推動旋轉，每一轉代表固定毫升水，靈敏度極高，哪怕馬桶水箱有極微小的慢滲漏也能清晰走字記錄。
source_reference: BS EN ISO 4064; Water Metering Guidelines

content_en: Why must structural timber ceiling joists be 'trimmed' (using doubled-up trimmers and trimmer joists) when creating an access opening to install a large 250-liter CWSC in a loft?
content_zh: 在閣樓開鑿檢修孔吊裝 250 公升大型儲水箱時，若切斷了一至兩根木托樑，為什麼被切斷的托樑兩端必須使用雙倍厚度的加強木料進行「托樑收口封頭加固 (Trimming)」？

options_en.A: To make the ceiling smell of pine wood
options_en.B: Cutting joists destroys floor load-bearing capacity; trimmed headers transfer the immense dead and live loads safely onto adjacent reinforced trimmer joists, preventing ceiling collapse

options_zh.A: 使天花板散發出松木芳香
options_zh.B: 鋸斷托樑會切斷樓板受力體系；特製的雙拼橫向承重木樑（Trimmers）能將斷樑端部的全部重力和水箱載荷安全分散傳遞給兩側加厚的加強承重托樑，防止天花板斷裂坍塌
options_zh.C: 防止閣樓熱量流失
options_zh.D: 方便木工安裝石膏板

explanation_en: Water is exceptionally heavy (250 kg). Cutting joists creates structural weakness; Approved Document A requires doubled trimmer timbers to carry transferred loads.
explanation_zh: 滿水水箱加上人體重量可達 300 公斤以上。隨意鋸斷托樑而不做專業雙拼木樑收口加固，集中荷載會使天花板瞬間下沉甚至整體踩塌穿透樓板。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document A Section 2; TRADA

content_en: What occurs to the delivery flow rate at a domestic washbasin tap if dynamic mains pressure drops from 3.0 bar down to 0.75 bar during peak morning neighborhood usage?
content_zh: 在早晨周邊社區集中用水高峰期，若進戶自來水動態工作水壓從正常的 3.0 bar 暴跌至 0.75 bar，水龍頭的出水流量會發生何種劇變？

options_en.B: Flow rate is roughly halved (Flow is approximately proportional to the square root of pressure: Q ∝ √P)
options_en.C: Flow rate drops to zero permanently

options_zh.A: 出水流量暴增 400%
options_zh.B: 出水流量大約直接腰斬減半（根據流體力學孔口出流定律，流量與壓差的平方根成正比：Q ∝ √P，壓降為 1/4 則流量降為 1/2）
options_zh.C: 出水流量立即歸零且永遠不出水
options_zh.D: 水龍頭流出沸水

explanation_en: Flow through an orifice varies with the square root of pressure (Q ∝ √P). Reducing pressure from 3.0 bar to 0.75 bar (a 4-fold drop) halves the discharge flow rate (√0.25 = 0.5).
explanation_zh: 物理學孔流定理 Q = C·A·√(2ΔP/ρ)。壓降跌為原來的四分之一，出水流速和流量跌去整整一半，水龍頭出水瞬間變得疲軟無力、淋浴體驗極差。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 / 204 Fluid Mechanics

content_en: Under Water Regulations, what device must be installed on a domestic combined cold water supply pipe to an unvented hot water cylinder to prevent expansion water back-feeding into the mains?
content_zh: 在承壓閉式熱水系統（Unvented Cylinder）的進口冷水組合控制閥門組中，必須包含何種專用閥件，以絕對阻止受熱膨脹的熱水倒流回市政冷水幹管？

options_en.A: A single non-return (check) valve integrated into the cold water combination valve set
options_en.B: A radiator TRV

options_zh.A: 集成在冷水組合閥組內部的高規格單向止回閥 (Single Check Valve)
options_zh.B: 散熱器恆溫控制閥
options_zh.C: 塑料空心浮球
options_zh.D: 燃氣調壓閥

explanation_en: The cold water combination valve incorporates a check valve that ensures hot water expanding during heating cannot push back into the cold drinking water mains.
explanation_zh: 承壓水罐升溫時水體膨脹體積增大。進水組合閥內置的彈簧止回閥只進不出，死死封住倒流路徑，迫使膨脹水只能被推入專用膨脹水箱，保護自來水管。
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Section 3; BS EN 12897

content_en: When a cold water storage cistern is installed in an unheated loft space with roof insulation located between the ceiling joists, what must be done to the roof rafters directly above the cistern?
content_zh: 當冷水儲水箱安裝在未採暖的坡屋頂閣樓內、且樓板托樑之間已鋪設了厚厚的保溫棉時，在水箱正上方的傾斜屋頂木檁條屋架處，必須增設何種防護保溫構造？

options_en.A: Cut a large hole through the roof slates
options_en.B: Insulate the sloping rafters directly above the cistern with rigid foil-faced insulation (creating an insulated warm-air pocket above the tank)

options_zh.A: 在屋頂瓦片上切開一個巨大的敞開通風洞
options_zh.B: 在水箱正上方的斜屋頂木椽條之間增設鋁箔剛性保溫板（封堵上方冷風，將水箱上方營造為一個局部的封閉暖氣罩口袋 - Insulated Tent）
options_zh.C: 將樓下所有的天花板石膏板全部拆除
options_zh.D: 僅將木椽條刷上黑色吸熱漆

explanation_en: Water Regulations recommend creating an insulated tent over the cistern against the underside of the roof rafters to trap rising room heat around the tank.
explanation_zh: 英倫閣樓保溫標準構造：在水箱正上方屋頂斜面釘上保溫板，與水箱四周保溫圍合形成一個封閉的「保溫帳篷」，徹底阻擋從屋面瓦片滲透進來的刺骨寒風。
source_reference: Water Regulations Schedule 2 Paragraph 11; BS 5422

content_en: Under British Standards (BS 1566 / BS 417), what is the maximum permissible static working head for a 'Grade 3' copper storage vessel or cistern?
content_zh: 根據英國標準（BS 1566 / BS 417），「Grade 3（3級規格）」的儲水箱或開式水罐，其允許承受的最大法定靜態水頭高度是多少？

options_en.B: 25 meters head

options_zh.A: 10 米靜水頭 (約 1.0 bar / 100 kPa 靜壓)
options_zh.B: 25 米靜水頭
options_zh.C: 50 米靜水頭
options_zh.D: 100 米靜水頭

explanation_en: Grade 3 vessels are engineered for low-head domestic applications up to 10m head (Grade 2 is 15m, and Grade 1 is 25m working head).
explanation_zh: 英制標準分級：Grade 3 最大承壓水頭為 10 米（約 1 bar），Grade 2 為 15 米，加厚重型 Grade 1 允許最高 25 米水頭，超壓使用會引發容器鼓脹破裂。
source_reference: BS 1566 Copper indirect cylinders; C&G Unit 204

content_en: Under British Standards (BS 6700 / BS EN 806), what is the statutory minimum internal diameter for the open vent pipe on a domestic vented hot water cylinder?
content_zh: 根據英國國家標準，家用開式（通風型）熱水儲水罐的開頂通風膨脹管（Open Vent Pipe），其法定最小內部直徑是多少？

options_en.B: 15 mm
options_en.C: 19 mm (equivalent to 22 mm outside diameter copper tube)

options_zh.A: 10 mm
options_zh.B: 15 mm (過細易汽塞產生阻力)
options_zh.C: 19 mm (相當於外徑 22 mm 的標準銅管規格)
options_zh.D: 50 mm

explanation_en: BS 6700 specifies that open vent pipes must have a minimum internal bore of 19mm (22mm copper pipe) to release steam safely without pressurisation.
explanation_zh: 開頂膨脹排氣管是開式水箱最後的物理安全洩壓通道。管徑不得小於 22mm 外徑（內徑約 19mm），一旦鍋爐失控沸騰，能毫無阻礙地向水箱噴出大量蒸汽與沸水。
source_reference: BS 6700 / BS EN 806; C&G Unit 205

content_en: How far above the top working water level of the cold water storage cistern must the open safety vent pipe rise before turning down to discharge over the cistern?
content_zh: 開式熱水通風膨脹管（Open Vent）在頂部 U 型彎頭回折向下對準冷水箱之前，其最高頂點高出冷水箱靜止工作水位線的垂直高度至少應為多少？

options_en.B: 150 mm
options_en.C: At least 450 mm (plus 40 mm for every 1 meter of static head)

options_zh.A: 50 mm
options_zh.B: 150 mm
options_zh.C: 至少 450 mm（且水箱水頭每增加 1 米，需額外上浮增加約 40 mm 擴展高度）

explanation_en: The vent pipe must terminate at least 450mm above the cistern water level to prevent hot water from surging or pumping over into the cold tank during pump startup.
explanation_zh: 若彎頭高度不足 450mm，循環水泵啟動的動壓揚程會將滾燙的熱水直接「泵躍 (Pumping over)」打入冷水箱，導致冷水水溫飆升滋生軍團菌並浪費能源。
source_reference: BS 6700 Section 4; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What is the statutory minimum size for the cold feed pipe running from the attic CWSC down to the base of a domestic vented hot water cylinder?
content_zh: 從閣樓冷水儲水箱引出、連接至開式熱水罐底部的專用冷水補水下水管（Cold Feed Pipe），其法定最小銅管外徑是多少？

options_en.B: 15 mm

options_zh.A: 10 mm
options_zh.B: 15 mm (阻力過大嚴格禁止)
options_zh.C: 22 mm (標準外徑)
options_zh.D: 35 mm

explanation_en: The cold feed must be at least 22mm copper tube to ensure adequate replenishing flow and prevent cylinder collapse under rapid draw-off.
explanation_zh: 重力冷水補水管不得小於 22mm 銅管。若誤用 15mm 細管，浴缸大流量快速放水時補水不及，水罐內部會形成負壓甚至將薄壁銅罐抽扁凹陷。
source_reference: BS 6700; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What is the operational difference between a 'Direct' and an 'Indirect' hot water cylinder under BS 1566?
content_zh: 根據 BS 1566 標準，傳統「直接式加熱熱水水罐 (Direct Cylinder)」與「間接式換熱水罐 (Indirect Cylinder)」的核心機械區別是什麼？

options_en.A: A direct cylinder uses natural gas directly
options_en.B: In a direct cylinder, domestic tap water is heated directly by electric immersion or fire back-boiler; in an indirect cylinder, boiler water circulates through an internal closed coil heat exchanger, never mixing with domestic tap water
options_en.C: An indirect cylinder has no insulation
options_en.D: A direct cylinder cannot produce hot water

options_zh.A: 直接式水罐必須直接燃燒天然氣
options_zh.B: 直接式水罐（Direct）通過電熱棒或壁爐後置水箱直接加熱罐內自來水；間接式水罐（Indirect）內部內置閉合螺旋換熱盤管，壁掛爐循環水在管內循環，與洗澡自來水永不混合
options_zh.C: 間接式水罐完全沒有任何外保溫層
options_zh.D: 直接式水罐無法產出生活熱水

explanation_en: Indirect cylinders feature an internal heat exchanger coil. Boiler heating water recirculates closed-circuit, transferring heat without contaminating drinking water.
explanation_zh: 間接式水罐的核心是內置換熱盤管（Heat Exchanger Coil）：供暖鍋爐裡含有防腐黑泥的水在盤管內部走，衛生生活熱水在盤管外壁受熱，兩套水質徹底物理隔離。
source_reference: BS 1566 Copper indirect cylinders; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What specialized brass flange fitting is installed into the top dome of a vented hot water cylinder to eliminate air bubbles entering a dedicated shower booster pump?
content_zh: 在開式熱水罐頂部拱頂開孔安裝何種專用黃銅分流法蘭接頭，能徹底消除空氣氣泡被吸入大功率淋浴增壓泵引發氣蝕與空轉？

options_en.B: Standard compression tee

options_zh.A: 薩里法蘭 (Surrey Flange，或 Warix / Essex 專用法蘭)
options_zh.B: 普通卡套等徑三通
options_zh.C: 散熱器連接短管
options_zh.D: 手動手柄閘閥

explanation_en: A Surrey (or Essex) flange takes water from below the top air-bubble boundary layer, preventing entrained air from entering shower pumps and causing dry-run cavitation.
explanation_zh: 普通三通會把水罐頂端析出的微細氣泡直接吸入增壓水泵，導致水泵發出尖叫甚至空轉燒毀。Surrey 法蘭伸入水面下方抽水，氣泡沿直通通風管排出。
source_reference: Pump Installation Standards; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What is an Essex flange used for on an existing hot water cylinder or cold storage cistern?
content_zh: 在既有熱水儲水水罐或冷水箱側面改裝加裝管道時，專門採用的「埃塞克斯法蘭 (Essex Flange)」具有何種獨特的免拆卸施工優勢？

options_en.A: It can be installed entirely from the outside through a single circular hole without requiring any access to the inside of the tank
options_en.B: It must be soldered with gold solder
options_en.C: It acts as a motorized zone valve

options_zh.A: 僅需在水罐側壁開一個圓孔，所有密封組件均可完全從容器「外部」單面穿入並鎖緊密封，徹底無需將手或扳手伸入封閉水罐內部
options_zh.B: 必須使用純金焊錫高溫熔接
options_zh.C: 能充當電動分區閥門使用
options_zh.D: 能利用溫差發電

explanation_en: Essex flanges feature a clever split-washer or threaded design allowing complete fitting from the external face of sealed tanks where internal access is impossible.
explanation_zh: 老水箱頂部焊死無法伸手進去擰螺母。Essex 法蘭由外向內將下部配件斜著塞入開孔，從外部拉緊螺母並壓實耐高溫橡膠密封圈，在外部即可完成完美密封盲裝。
source_reference: Tooling and Fitting Guides; C&G Unit 205

content_en: Under BS 1566, what does a 'Grade 2' copper indirect hot water cylinder rating specify regarding maximum working head?
content_zh: 根據英國標準 BS 1566，標註為「Grade 2（2級）」的紫銅間接式開式熱水水罐，其最大法定允許靜態工作水頭是多少？

options_en.B: 10 meters head

options_zh.A: 5 米靜水頭
options_zh.B: 10 米靜水頭 (Grade 3 級別)
options_zh.C: 15 米靜水頭 (相當於約 1.5 bar / 150 kPa 靜態水壓)
options_zh.D: 50 米靜水頭

explanation_en: BS 1566 Grade 2 cylinders are rated for a maximum working head of 15 meters (Grade 3 is 10m, and heavy Grade 1 is 25m).
explanation_zh: 銅水罐依銅皮壁厚分為三級：Grade 3 最大 10 米水頭，Grade 2 最大 15 米水頭（適用於絕大多數 2-3 層住宅），加厚 Grade 1 允許高達 25 米水頭。
source_reference: BS 1566 Copper indirect cylinders; C&G Unit 205

content_en: Why does hot water naturally draw from the topmost dome of a storage cylinder while cold water is always introduced at the very bottom?
content_zh: 在所有熱水水罐內部，為什麼熱水出水管永遠從拱頂最高端引出，而冷水補水管始終從最底部注入？

options_en.A: To keep the pipes out of sight
options_en.B: To exploit thermal stratification: heated water is less dense and naturally rises to the top, while cold dense water remains at the base without premature mixing
options_en.C: Plumbing convention has no scientific basis

options_zh.A: 為了將水管隱藏在木板後面美觀
options_zh.B: 充分利用「熱水分層 (Thermal Stratification)」物理原理：熱水密度低自然上浮匯聚在頂部，冷水密度大沉在底部，二者互不干擾，確保隨時放出最高溫度的熱水
options_zh.C: 純屬水暖師傅的習慣，無科學道理
options_zh.D: 防止水罐內部結水垢

explanation_en: Thermal stratification separates hot and cold layers due to buoyancy density differences. Cold entering the bottom leaves the upper hot water undisturbed.
explanation_zh: 密度差在水罐內形成完美的熱水在頂、溫水在中、冷水在底的梯度分層。若從頂部進冷水，整罐水會被瞬間衝散攪涼，出水溫度急劇下降。
source_reference: C&G Unit 202 / 205 Principles of Water Heating

content_en: Under Building Regulations Approved Document G3, what qualification or certification must an operative hold before legally installing, commissioning, or servicing an unvented hot water storage system exceeding 15 liters?
content_zh: 根據英國建築法規 Approved Document G3 強制規定，水暖工在合法安裝、調試或維修容積超過 15 公升的承壓閉式熱水儲水系統（Unvented Cylinder）之前，法律強制必須持有何種資格認證？

options_en.B: A certified, recognized G3 Unvented Hot Water Storage qualification (e.g. BPEC / City & Guilds Part G3 certificate)
options_en.C: First Aid at Work certificate only

options_zh.A: 僅需持有普通機動車駕照
options_zh.B: 持有經英國國家認可的「G3 承壓熱水系統專項從業資格證書 (BPEC / C&G G3 Certification)」
options_zh.C: 僅有紅十字急救員培訓證書
options_zh.D: 大學美術系本科學位

explanation_en: Approved Document G3 requires unvented systems (>15L) to be installed by a 'competent person' holding accredited G3 certification to prevent explosion risks.
explanation_zh: 承壓水罐在高溫高壓下等同於微型壓力容器，一旦失控爆炸威力毀天滅地。法律將 G3 列為法定特種作業準入資質，無證安裝屬於重大違法犯罪。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G3 Section 3

content_en: What catastrophic danger is an unvented hot water storage system engineered to prevent through its three independent tiers of safety controls?
content_zh: 閉式承壓熱水系統通過其配備的「三級獨立安全連鎖控制體系」，其最核心防範的毀滅性災難事故是什麼？

options_en.B: Catastrophic boiling explosion (BLEVE - Boiling Liquid Expanding Vapor Explosion) caused by superheated water flashing instantly into thousands of liters of destructive high-pressure steam

options_zh.A: 自來水口感過於甘甜清脆
options_zh.B: 過熱高壓水瞬間閃蒸爆炸（BLEVE 沸騰液體膨脹蒸汽爆炸）：水在 100°C 以上承壓不沸騰，一旦容器爆裂減壓，全罐過熱水瞬間閃蒸膨脹為數千倍體積的超音速爆炸衝擊波，炸塌整棟房屋
options_zh.C: 水罐在常溫下自發結冰
options_zh.D: 銅管材質變為純金金屬

explanation_en: Water at 3.5 bar boils at 138°C. If a cylinder ruptures, superheated water instantly flashes into steam expanding 1600-fold, completely demolishing buildings.
explanation_zh: 100 公升過熱水爆炸釋放的能量相當於數公斤烈性炸藥，足以將兩層獨立別墅瞬間夷為平地。三級安全保護的終極使命就是絕對杜絕水溫失控超 100°C！
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Section 3; HSE Pressure Systems Safety

content_en: What is the 'First Level of Protection' against overheating in an unvented domestic hot water cylinder?
content_zh: 在承壓閉式熱水水罐的三級防護體系中，「第一級超溫安全防護 (First Level of Protection)」是由何種控制元件實現的？

options_en.B: The adjustable control thermostat (operating typically between 60°C and 65°C)

options_zh.A: 手動機械式手柄
options_zh.B: 可調式運行溫控器 (Control Thermostat，日常將水溫精確控制在 60°C 至 65°C 之間)
options_zh.C: 一桶常溫冷水
options_zh.D: 安全洩壓閥

explanation_en: The primary control thermostat regulates normal operating temperature (60-65°C), cycling the heat source on and off under normal demand.
explanation_zh: 第一級保護是常規運維調控：溫控器探頭感受水溫，當達到 60°C 預設值時自動切斷鍋爐電動閥或電加熱棒電源，水溫下降時重新吸合啟動。
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Section 3.8; BS EN 12897

content_en: What is the 'Second Level of Protection' against overheating in an unvented hot water cylinder if the control thermostat fails in the closed (welded) position?
content_zh: 當第一級溫控器觸點發生熔焊粘連故障、導致持續加熱不跳閘時，觸發啟動的「第二級超溫安全防護」是什麼？

options_en.B: An independent thermal energy cut-out (high-limit safety thermostat) with manual non-self-resetting lock-out, cutting fuel or power at 82°C to 85°C
options_en.C: The user turns on a fan

options_zh.A: 銅管直接受熱炸裂
options_zh.B: 獨立的高溫極限安全熱切斷器 (High-limit Energy Cut-out)，在水溫達到 82°C 至 85°C 時強行切斷燃氣源或電熱電源，且必須手動人工復位（Non-self-resetting）
options_zh.C: 用戶開啟排風扇吹風
options_zh.D: 水錶加速旋轉

explanation_en: The energy cut-out acts as an emergency electrical interlock, cutting power/gas at 85°C. It requires manual reset so the fault must be investigated.
explanation_zh: 第二級是安全硬防線：高溫極限溫控器完全獨立於運行溫控器。一旦跳閘自動死鎖，絕對禁止自動復位，迫使業主必須請合格 G3 技師上門排查故障源。
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Section 3.9; BS EN 60730-2-9

content_en: What is the 'Third Level of Protection' (ultimate mechanical safety barrier) fitted directly to the top third of an unvented cylinder shell?
content_zh: 直接安裝在承壓熱水罐頂部上三分之一殼體上的「第三級安全防護（終極物理機械安全屏障）」是何種安全閥門？

options_en.B: A combined Temperature and Pressure Relief Valve (T&P Valve)

options_zh.A: 塑料空心浮球
options_zh.B: 溫度與壓力雙功能安全洩壓閥 (Combined Temperature & Pressure Relief Valve - T&P 閥)
options_zh.C: 全通徑手動閘閥
options_zh.D: 單向止回閥

explanation_en: The T&P valve provides fail-safe mechanical pressure/temperature relief if both thermostats fail, dumping boiling water before flash explosion.
explanation_zh: T&P 閥是最後的物理救命稻草：無論電路系統如何全面癱瘓，一旦溫度或壓力突破極限，閥門機械彈簧與溫感石蠟包強行開啟，向外排洩沸水卸壓保命。
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Section 3.10; BS 6283 / BS EN 1490

content_en: At what temperature and pressure ratings is a standard UK domestic unvented cylinder T&P Valve set to open automatically?
content_zh: 在英國標準家用承壓熱水水罐上，T&P 安全洩壓閥標定的自動起跳開啟溫度與開啟壓力分別是多少？

options_en.B: 90°C to 95°C (temperature setting) AND 10.0 bar (pressure setting)

options_zh.A: 50°C 及 1 bar
options_zh.B: 90°C 至 95°C (溫度動作起跳點) 或 10.0 bar (壓力動作起跳點，以先達到者為準)
options_zh.C: 150°C 及 50 bar
options_zh.D: 20°C 及 3 bar

explanation_en: T&P valves are certified to open at 90-95°C (preventing water reaching 100°C) OR at 10 bar pressure, whichever safety threshold is breached first.
explanation_zh: 雙重起跳閾值：水溫一旦飆升至 90-95°C，或內部水壓暴漲至 10 bar，閥門無條件瞬間彈開噴洩。只要水溫被死死卡在 95°C 以下，爆炸就絕不可能發生！
source_reference: BS EN 1490 Building valves - Combined temperature and pressure relief valves

content_en: What is the operating set point of the separate cold-water expansion relief valve (pressure relief valve - PRV) on an unvented system inlet group?
content_zh: 在承壓熱水水罐進水端管路上安裝的獨立「膨脹安全洩壓閥 (Expansion Relief Valve)」，其標準額定洩壓起跳壓力通常是多少？

options_en.B: 3.0 bar

options_zh.A: 1.0 bar
options_zh.B: 3.0 bar (減壓閥進水壓力)
options_zh.C: 6.0 bar (膨脹洩壓安全閾值)
options_zh.D: 25.0 bar

explanation_en: The expansion relief valve opens at 6.0 bar to discharge water if the expansion vessel fails or loses its air pre-charge during normal thermal expansion.
explanation_zh: 進口減壓閥通常穩壓在 3.5 bar。當膨脹水箱氣囊漏氣失效時，熱脹多出的水壓升至 6.0 bar 即被該閥平穩洩出，防止超壓衝擊 10 bar 的 T&P 閥。
source_reference: Approved Document G3; BS EN 1489

content_en: Under Approved Document G3, what visible plumbing component must be fitted in the discharge pipework within 600mm of the relief valve outlet?
content_zh: 根據建築法規 Approved Document G3 強制規定，在安全洩壓閥出水管下游不超過 600mm 範圍內，必須垂直安裝何種直觀可見的排水分流配件？

options_en.B: A Tundish (providing a visible air break and anti-siphon gap)

options_zh.A: 機械水錶
options_zh.B: 放水漏斗 / 觀測漏斗 (Tundish，提供清晰可視的物理空氣間隙與防虹吸斷流功能)
options_zh.C: 散熱器手動排氣嘴
options_zh.D: 封閉式膨脹水箱

explanation_en: A tundish provides a visible air break within 600mm of the valve, preventing drain back-siphonage and visually warning occupants of discharge.
explanation_zh: Tundish 漏斗具有兩大核心使命：1. 形成物理空氣隔斷阻隔下水道臭氣；2. 一旦安全閥噴水，透明或開口漏斗能讓業主一眼目視看到水流奔湧，及時報警維修。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G3 Section 3.16

content_en: What are the statutory dimensional requirements for discharge pipe D1 (connecting the relief valve outlet to the tundish) under Approved Document G3?
content_zh: 根據 Approved Document G3 規範，連接安全閥排出口與 Tundish 漏斗之間的「D1 排放短管」，有何法定的尺寸與材質硬性要求？

options_en.A: Plastic flexible garden hose of any length
options_en.B: Metal pipe (copper), same diameter as the relief valve outlet, maximum length 600 mm, with a continuous vertical fall and zero valves

options_zh.A: 任意長度的塑料柔性花園軟管
options_zh.B: 金屬材質（紫銅管），管徑不得小於安全閥排出口公稱通徑，總長度嚴格限制在 600 mm 以內，垂直向下或保持坡度，且嚴禁安裝任何閥門
options_zh.C: 必須採用 50mm 粗鉛管
options_zh.D: 管身必須垂直向上彎曲 2 米

explanation_en: D1 must be rigid metal (copper), at least the valve outlet size (typically 15mm or 22mm), maximum 600mm long, dropping vertically to the tundish.
explanation_zh: D1 是承受接近 100°C 沸水高壓噴射的衝擊管段，嚴禁使用任何塑料管！長度不得超過 600mm，確保洩放水流無阻礙垂直跌入漏斗。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G3 Table G3

content_en: Under Approved Document G3 Table G3, if discharge pipe D1 is 15mm copper tube, what is the minimum required size for discharge pipe D2 after the tundish for equivalent resistance lengths up to 9 meters?
content_zh: 根據 Approved Document G3 表 G3 規定，若 D1 管為 15mm 銅管，在 Tundish 漏斗下方的「D2 排放管」在當量長度 9 米以內時，其最小法定銅管外徑是多少？

options_en.B: 15 mm
options_en.C: 22 mm (one commercial pipe size larger than D1)

options_zh.A: 10 mm
options_zh.B: 15 mm
options_zh.C: 22 mm (比 D1 管大一個標準商業管徑級別)
options_zh.D: 110 mm

explanation_en: D2 carries unpressurized gravity boiling water and steam. To prevent backing up out of the tundish, D2 must be at least one pipe size larger than D1 (22mm for 15mm D1).
explanation_zh: D2 管在漏斗之後屬於重力無壓排放。沸水混合蒸汽急劇膨脹，管徑必須跳大一號（15mm 變 22mm，22mm 變 28mm），否則滾水會直接從漏斗口漫溢燙傷人。
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Table G3; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What is the minimum fall required for discharge pipe D2 running continuously from the tundish to the external discharge point under Approved Document G3?
content_zh: 根據 Approved Document G3 規定，D2 排放長管自 Tundish 漏斗向下傾斜引向室外排出口的過程中，全程必須保持的最小連續排水坡度是多少？

options_en.B: A continuous downward fall of at least 1 in 200 (approx 5mm per meter) with zero uphill rises

options_zh.A: 完全水平（零坡度）
options_zh.B: 全程保持至少 1:200（即每米向下傾斜不小於 5mm）的連續下坡坡度，全程嚴禁有任何反坡上揚或凹坑積水
options_zh.C: 向上反向倒坡 1:10
options_zh.D: 必須加設充水的 U 型存水彎水封

explanation_en: D2 must fall continuously at least 1 in 200 without traps or crests to prevent trapped water that could boil into steam blocks or freeze solid in winter.
explanation_zh: D2 管絕不允許有任何存水彎！積水在冬天會結冰堵死整根排放管；一旦安全閥起跳，洩水無路可走會直接在室內炸開漏斗釀成大禍。
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Section 3.20; C&G Unit 205

content_en: Where is an acceptable, compliant termination point for unvented discharge pipe D2 discharging externally under Approved Document G3?
content_zh: 根據建築法規 Approved Document G3，D2 排放管在室外端頭的法定終端排放位置，下列哪一項是完全合規且安全的？

options_en.A: Spraying horizontally across a public pedestrian pavement at face height
options_en.B: Discharging downwards safely below an external fixed metal gully grating, or terminating low down (within 100mm of ground) facing a masonry wall with protective wire cage
options_en.D: Terminating inside an electrical meter cabinet

options_zh.A: 在人行道人臉高度處向著街面水平凌空噴射
options_zh.B: 向下彎曲安全排入室外固定金屬排水地溝格柵下方，或距地面 100mm 以內朝向耐火磚牆低位排放，並加裝防燙傷金屬絲網防護罩
options_zh.C: 直接排入幼兒園兒童遊樂場沙坑
options_zh.D: 排入樓梯間電錶配電箱內部

explanation_en: Discharge pipe D2 conveys scalding boiling water. It must terminate safely where it cannot endanger pedestrians, ideally low level over a trapped gully.
explanation_zh: 排出的水溫接近 100°C 沸點。排出口必須引導至地面死角低位並背向行人，嚴禁懸空高位噴淋，防止沸水與高溫蒸汽直接澆在過路行人身上造成重度燙傷。
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Section 3.23; BS EN 12897

content_en: According to HSE Approved Code of Practice (ACoP) L8, in what temperature range do Legionella pneumophila bacteria proliferate most rapidly in stagnant water?
content_zh: 根據英國 HSE《預防軍團菌法定實用法規》(ACoP L8)，嗜肺軍團菌在靜止水體中生長、繁殖速度最為猖獗的危險溫度區間是多少？

options_en.B: Between 20°C and 45°C (with optimal rapid growth around 37°C)

options_zh.A: 0°C 以下冰凍環境
options_zh.B: 20°C 至 45°C 之間 (在 37°C 人體常溫附近生長繁殖速度達到極限峰值)
options_zh.C: 70°C 至 90°C 高溫水體
options_zh.D: 100°C 沸點以上

explanation_en: Legionella is dormant below 20°C, thrives aggressively between 20°C and 45°C, and is killed within minutes at temperatures exceeding 60°C.
explanation_zh: 20°C 以下軍團菌處於冬眠休眠狀態；20°C 至 45°C 是細菌溫床；水溫超過 50°C 細菌生長受阻；60°C 條件下 2 分鐘內被徹底殺滅滅活。
source_reference: HSE ACoP L8; HSG274 Part 2

content_en: Under HSE ACoP L8 guidelines, what is the mandatory minimum storage temperature for hot water inside a domestic or commercial storage cylinder?
content_zh: 根據 HSE ACoP L8 規範要求，儲水罐內存儲的生活熱水，其罐體核心水溫必須強制維持在不低於攝氏幾度？

options_zh.C: 至少持續維持在 60°C (60°C 至 65°C)

explanation_en: Hot water must be stored at minimum 60°C to guarantee the thermal eradication of Legionella bacteria within the storage vessel.
explanation_zh: 儲存溫度底線為 60°C：該水溫可在 2 分鐘之內使 99.9% 的軍團菌致死滅活。任何將水箱長期設定在 45°C 的節能做法均屬於重大致死衛生違法。
source_reference: HSE ACoP L8; BS 8558

content_en: Under ACoP L8, what is the minimum distribution temperature that must be reached at every hot water tap outlet within 1 minute of running?
content_zh: 根據 ACoP L8 規範，打開遠端生活熱水水龍頭放水 1 分鐘之內，水龍頭出水水溫必須迅速上升並達到不低於攝氏幾度？

options_zh.C: 至少達到 50°C (在醫院及養老護理機構必須達到 55°C)

explanation_en: Hot distribution pipework must deliver water at minimum 50°C (55°C in healthcare) within 1 minute to prevent bacterial biofilms in pipe runs.
explanation_zh: 輸送管道防護原則：放水 60 秒內水溫必須衝破 50°C 滅菌防線，保證整個熱水支管在流動過程中自發殺滅殘留生物膜，杜絕管道死水滋生細菌。
source_reference: HSE HSG274 Part 2 Section 2; C&G Unit 205

content_en: Under ACoP L8, within what time and at what maximum temperature should cold water be delivered from a cold tap outlet?
content_zh: 根據軍團菌防護規範，開啟冷水龍頭放水 2 分鐘之內，冷水出水溫度最高「不得超過」攝氏幾度？

options_en.B: Below 20°C within 2 minutes of running
options_en.D: Temperature does not matter for cold water

options_zh.A: 10 秒內低於 10°C
options_zh.B: 放水 2 分鐘內出水水溫必須低於 20°C (Below 20°C)
options_zh.C: 5 分鐘內低於 35°C
options_zh.D: 冷水出水溫度沒有任何法規限制

explanation_en: Cold water must remain below 20°C (the threshold below which Legionella remains dormant) within 2 minutes of turning on the tap.
explanation_zh: 冷水防護底線為 20°C：冷水管若被周圍暖氣管烤熱超過 20°C，同樣會爆發軍團菌感染。放水 2 分鐘水溫低於 20°C 確證冷水處於安全低溫帶。
source_reference: HSE ACoP L8; HSG274 Part 2

content_en: Under Building Regulations Approved Document G (Sanitation, hot water safety and water efficiency), what is the statutory maximum hot water delivery temperature permitted for a bath in a new domestic dwelling?
content_zh: 根據英國建築法規 Approved Document G 強制要求，在新建住宅中，浴缸（Bath）出水龍頭混水後允許釋放的最高防燙傷熱水溫度是多少？

options_zh.B: 41°C (淋浴與面盆最高極限)
options_zh.C: 48°C (浴缸出水法定最高防燙傷溫度)
options_zh.D: 60°C (未經混水直出水溫)

explanation_en: Approved Document G Section 3 specifies that baths must be fitted with a TMV limiting delivery temperature to a maximum of 48°C to prevent fatal immersion scalding.
explanation_zh: 成人浸泡在 60°C 水中 5 秒即造成三度深部燙傷，兒童更為脆弱。法規強制浴缸出水端必須加裝 TMV 恆溫閥，將水溫死死封死在最高 48°C 以下！
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G Section 3.7; TMV2 Scheme

content_en: What is the maximum recommended hot water delivery temperature at a thermostatic shower or washbasin mixer tap under UK safety standards?
content_zh: 根據英國水暖安全標準，在淋浴花灑（Shower）或洗臉盆（Washbasin）出水龍頭處，恆溫混水閥推薦設定的最高安全水溫是多少？

options_zh.B: 41°C (最舒適且絕對防燙傷黃金溫度)

explanation_en: The recommended maximum delivery temperature for showers and washbasins is 41°C, providing complete anti-scalding protection while maintaining comfortable thermal washing.
explanation_zh: 41°C 是人體淋浴與洗手的最舒適水溫上限。既能有效去除油脂污垢，又徹底消除了老人幼兒因誤碰高溫龍頭被瞬間燙傷皮肉的風險。
source_reference: Approved Document G; NHS Model Engineering Spec D08

content_en: What is the statutory fail-safe function of a Thermostatic Mixing Valve (TMV2 / TMV3) complying with BS EN 1111?
content_zh: 符合英國標準 BS EN 1111 的恆溫混水閥（TMV），其核心的「故障安全保護 (Fail-Safe)」聯鎖機制是怎樣工作的？

options_en.B: If the cold water supply pressure fails completely, the valve shuts off the hot water flow almost instantaneously (within seconds) to prevent pure boiling water scalding the user
options_en.C: It pours water on the floor

options_zh.A: 發出刺耳的電鈴聲報警
options_zh.B: 當冷水供水突然中斷（如冷水管停水或爆管）時，閥芯內的熱敏元件能在數分之一秒內完全自動「瞬間切斷」熱水出水，杜絕純滾燙熱水直噴人體引發慘劇
options_zh.C: 將熱水直接洩放到浴室地面上
options_zh.D: 向燃氣壁掛爐發送信號關機

explanation_en: A certified TMV shuts down hot water delivery within a second if cold water pressure drops to zero, preventing instant catastrophic scalding.
explanation_zh: 若無 Fail-safe 保護，洗澡時冷水一停，龍頭會噴出 60°C 以上沸水將人燙傷致殘。TMV 內部石蠟感溫包在失冷瞬間膨脹頂死熱水閥口，實現零熱水輸出。
source_reference: BS EN 1111 Sanitary tapware - Thermostatic mixing valves; TMV2 Scheme

content_en: What is the primary difference between a 'TMV2' scheme certified valve and a 'TMV3' scheme certified valve?
content_zh: 在英國恆溫混水閥認證體系中，「TMV2 級認證」與「TMV3 級認證」閥門的核心應用場景與性能差異是什麼？

options_en.A: TMV2 is made of plastic; TMV3 is made of wood
options_en.B: TMV2 is certified for domestic residential installations under BS EN 1111 / 1287; TMV3 is certified to higher NHS Model Engineering Specs (DO8) for healthcare, hospitals, and high-risk commercial care homes

options_zh.A: TMV2 由塑料製成，TMV3 由木材製成
options_zh.B: TMV2 認證面向普通「私人家庭住宅」標準；TMV3 則遵循英國國家醫療體系極其嚴苛的 NHS D08 規範，專門用於「醫院、療養院、失智老人照護中心」等高危場所
options_zh.C: TMV3 閥門不需要通入水流
options_zh.D: TMV2 在英格蘭地區已被立法禁止

explanation_en: TMV2 applies to private domestic homes. TMV3 is engineered to higher thermal sensitivity and faster response times for healthcare and vulnerable care environments.
explanation_zh: TMV3 針對痛覺遲鈍、行動不便的病患和長者，要求更快的斷水響應速度（0.2秒內切斷）、更寬的進水壓差適應範圍及每半年強制校準的嚴格年檢規程。
source_reference: NHS Estates Model Engineering Specification D08; BuildCert TMV Schemes

content_en: What is the purpose of the internal rubber diaphragm (membrane) and nitrogen gas pre-charge cushion in a hot water expansion vessel?
content_zh: 在承壓熱水系統的「隔膜式膨脹水箱 (Expansion Vessel)」內部，橡膠隔膜與氮氣預充氣墊的核心功用是什麼？

options_en.B: To safely accommodate the volumetric thermal expansion of water as it is heated from cold, without lifting the 6 bar pressure relief valve

options_zh.A: 過濾自來水中的泥沙雜質
options_zh.B: 安全吸收全水罐冷水受熱升溫時產生的約 4% 體積熱膨脹增量，維持系統水壓平穩，防止頻繁衝擊 6 bar 洩壓閥跑水
options_zh.C: 使罐內水溫保持低溫狀態
options_zh.D: 成倍提高管內流水流速

explanation_en: Water expands ~4% when heated. Water is incompressible; without an elastic nitrogen gas cushion to compress, pressure spikes would rupture the cylinder.
explanation_zh: 水是不可壓縮的。200 升水加熱膨脹多出約 8 升水，膨脹水箱利用氣體的高度可壓縮性，將多出的水擠入氣囊，使系統壓力平穩受控在 3.5 到 4.5 bar 之間。
source_reference: BS EN 12828 / BS EN 12897; C&G Unit 205

content_en: At what pressure should the air or nitrogen pre-charge of an unvented hot water expansion vessel be set prior to filling and pressurizing the system?
content_zh: 在對承壓熱水系統進行注水加壓之前，空載狀態下膨脹水箱氣囊內預充的空氣或氮氣壓力，應當設定為多少？
