options_en.B: Set equal to the incoming Pressure Reducing Valve (PRV) set-point (typically 3.0 to 3.5 bar)

options_zh.A: 0.1 bar
options_zh.B: 精確設定為與進水減壓閥（PRV）標定出口工作壓力完全相等（通常為 3.0 至 3.5 bar）
options_zh.C: 10.0 bar
options_zh.D: 零壓力（完全放空）

explanation_en: The vessel pre-charge must match the PRV pressure (e.g. 3.5 bar) with water pressure at zero, ensuring maximum diaphragm acceptance volume for hot expansion.
explanation_zh: 預充氣壓必須等於進水冷水壓（如 3.5 bar）。若氣壓偏高氣囊充不進水，偏低則氣囊在冷態時就被自來水過早佔滿，喪失吸收熱水膨脹的能力。
source_reference: BS EN 12897; Manufacturer Commissioning Instructions

content_en: How is the pre-charge pressure of an unvented hot water expansion vessel correctly checked and recharged on site during routine annual servicing?
content_zh: 在對承壓熱水系統進行年度例行維保時，現場應當如何正確檢測並為膨脹水箱補充預充電氣壓？

options_en.A: Check with the system under full 6 bar mains pressure
options_en.B: Depressurize and drain the hydraulic water side of the vessel to atmospheric pressure first, then test and adjust gas pressure at the Schrader valve using a tyre pressure gauge
options_en.C: Hit the vessel with a hammer
options_en.D: Heat the vessel with a blowlamp

options_zh.A: 在系統處於 6 bar 滿載水壓的狀態下直接檢測氣門嘴
options_zh.B: 首先關閉進水總閥並打開熱水龍頭將水側壓力完全洩放至零（直通大氣），隨後使用標準輪胎胎壓計在頂部美式氣門嘴（Schrader Valve）處測量並打氣調節
options_zh.C: 用鐵錘用力敲擊金屬罐體聽聲音
options_zh.D: 使用噴燈明火烘烤水箱外殼

explanation_en: Water pressure distorts gas readings. The water circuit must be depressurized to 0 bar gauge before testing gas pressure at the Schrader valve.
explanation_zh: 帶壓測胎壓完全失真！水壓會反頂氣囊導致測出的是當前水壓而非真實氣壓。必須排空水側壓力至 0 bar，方能準確測出並補足 3.5 bar 氣壓。
source_reference: Benchmark Service Checklist; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What symptom indicates that the expansion vessel on an unvented hot water cylinder has failed or suffered complete loss of its internal gas charge?
content_zh: 當承壓熱水水罐的膨脹水箱橡膠氣囊破裂或內部預充氣體完全漏光時，系統會立即出現何種典型運轉故障？

options_en.A: The water in the cylinder turns cold
options_en.B: Water repeatedly discharges from the 6 bar expansion relief valve (via the tundish) every time the cylinder heats up from cold
options_en.C: The incoming mains pipe freezes solid
options_en.D: The electricity tripping in the street

options_zh.A: 水罐內部的熱水全部變冷
options_zh.B: 每次水罐從冷水加熱升溫時，6 bar 膨脹安全閥都會反覆起跳，通過 Tundish 漏斗向外間歇性大量噴水洩水
options_zh.C: 市政進水管瞬間結冰凍死
options_zh.D: 導致整條街道的電網跳閘

explanation_en: With no compressible gas cushion to absorb thermal expansion, rising water pressure rapidly reaches 6 bar, lifting the expansion relief valve every heating cycle.
explanation_zh: 熱脹多出的水無處可去，不可壓縮的熱水在密閉罐內壓力直線飆升，短短數分鐘即衝破 6 bar 警戒線觸發安全閥排泄，水溫涼下來後壓力又暴跌，週而復始。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 205 Fault Finding

content_en: What is an 'Internal Air Bubble' expansion system (bubble-top cylinder) in an unvented hot water cylinder?
content_zh: 在現代某些免維護承壓熱水罐中採用的「內置氣穴式膨脹系統 (Internal Air Bubble / MegaFlo Type)」是怎樣運作的？

options_en.A: A pump that blows soap bubbles into the water
options_en.B: An engineered permanent air cushion trapped in the top dome of the cylinder by an internal dip-tube, eliminating the need for an external mechanical expansion vessel
options_en.D: A system filled with carbonated soda

options_zh.A: 向水流中持續吹出肥皂泡的微型氣泵
options_zh.B: 利用內部特製浮筒導流管在水罐頂部穹頂自然截留封閉一個永久性壓縮空氣氣穴（Air Bubble），直接在罐內吸收熱膨脹，完全省去了外部金屬膨脹水箱
options_zh.C: 由多孔海綿材質製造的水罐
options_zh.D: 內部充注碳酸氣泡蘇打水

explanation_en: Bubble-top cylinders trap an air volume directly in the top dome, saving space and eliminating external expansion vessels. The air cushion is replenished by draining down partially.
explanation_zh: 經典的 MegaFlo 內置氣囊專利：頂部預留約 10% 氣室吸收熱脹。若長期使用氣穴被微量水吸收消耗，技師只需關進水開出水排空十秒即可重新形成氣穴。
source_reference: Baxi MegaFlo Installation Manual; Approved Document G3

content_en: What is the standard immersion heater thread size universally used on domestic copper hot water cylinders in the UK?
content_zh: 在全英家用紫銅熱水儲水罐上，電加熱棒（Immersion Heater）旋入水罐接口的標準英制螺紋規格是多少？

options_en.B: 1 inch BSP

options_zh.A: 1/2 英寸 BSP
options_zh.B: 1 英寸 BSP
options_zh.C: 2 1/4 英寸 BSP (公稱 2.25 英寸管螺紋，螺紋外徑約 57 mm)
options_zh.D: 4 英寸 BSP 大口徑螺紋

explanation_en: UK domestic cylinders standardize on 2 1/4 inch BSP threaded bosses for immersion heaters, sealed with an EPDM O-ring or flat fiber washer.
explanation_zh: 全英家用熱水水罐統一採用 2 1/4" BSP 粗牙大螺紋盲板座。拆裝必須使用專用六角沉頭熱水棒扳手（Immersion Heater Spanner），配合耐熱墊圈密封。
source_reference: BS 3456 Specification for immersion heaters; C&G Unit 205

content_en: Under Building Regulations and electrical safety standards, what safety control must modern domestic immersion heaters be equipped with under BS EN 60335-2-73?
content_zh: 根據建築法規與電氣安全強制標準 BS EN 60335-2-73，現代家用電熱浸入式加熱棒本體內部必須強制整合何種雙重安全保護？

options_en.B: A secondary, independent, manual-reset thermal cut-out built directly into the thermostat stem to isolate power if the operating thermostat fails

options_zh.A: 僅配備一個彩色霓虹指示燈
options_zh.B: 直接集成在溫控探桿內部的「第二級獨立手動復位熱斷路器 (Manual Reset Thermal Cut-out)」，在主溫控失控時強行熔斷切斷供電防止熱水沸騰
options_zh.C: 手動手搖發電機
options_zh.D: 內置微型軟水濾芯

explanation_en: BS EN 60335-2-73 mandates a non-self-resetting thermal cut-out in the heater head to prevent boiling liquid and unvented steam explosions.
explanation_zh: 老式加熱棒只有單一溫控，觸點黏連後會將水箱燒至沸騰噴蒸汽造成傷亡。現代規範強制加熱棒自帶獨立機械超溫熱熔保險，超溫永久跳閘。
source_reference: BS EN 60335-2-73 Safety of immersion heaters; Approved Doc G3

content_en: Under Approved Document G3, what is the maximum permissible length of horizontal discharge pipe D2 when it is sized one commercial size larger than D1 with a 1 in 200 fall and no bends?
content_zh: 根據 Approved Document G3 表 G3 規範，當 D2 排放管管徑比 D1 大一個規格、且坡度為 1:200 且無折彎時，其允許的最大等效阻力管長是多少？

options_en.B: Up to 9.0 meters

options_zh.B: 最大不超過 9.0 米 (Up to 9 meters)
options_zh.D: 無任何長度限制

explanation_en: Table G3 allows up to 9 meters of D2 pipe sized one commercial size larger than D1. Each bend reduces allowable resistance length (e.g. 90° bend deducts 0.8m).
explanation_zh: 表 G3 嚴格限制：大一號管徑最長走 9 米；若管路更長（如超 9 米或有大量折彎），D2 管徑必須再跳大一級（如由 22mm 放大到 28mm），防止蒸汽背壓頂翻漏斗。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G3 Table G3

content_en: Why should domestic hot water pipework be systematically sized to minimize internal water volume (dead-leg volume) between the water heater and distant outlets?
content_zh: 在家庭熱水管道管徑規劃中，為什麼必須精準縮小從熱水設備到遠端水龍頭之間管道的內徑容積（縮小管道存水量）？

options_en.A: To save weight on floor joists
options_en.B: To reduce wait-time for hot water to arrive at the tap, minimising water wastage down the drain, conserving fuel energy, and reducing Legionella risk

options_zh.A: 減輕木地板托樑的承重荷載
options_zh.B: 大幅縮短龍頭開水至熱水抵達的等待時間（避免放走大量冷水浪費水資源），減少管道散熱能耗，並防止支管殘留溫水過量滋生軍團菌
options_zh.C: 保持水質呈強酸性
options_zh.D: 增加水泵磨損

explanation_en: Smaller bore pipes (e.g. 10mm or 15mm microbore feeds to basins) empty quickly, delivering hot water within seconds and saving thousands of liters of wasted cold water annually.
explanation_zh: 管徑選得過粗（如用 22mm 供面盆），每次開水都要先放掉幾升管內冷水，既浪費水電氣又讓用戶焦躁等待。末端支管應當採用精細管徑快速出熱水。
source_reference: Domestic Heating Design Guide; Approved Document G

content_en: In a commercial building with a secondary hot water return circulation loop, what is the minimum temperature required at the return pipe as it re-enters the calorifier under ACoP L8?
content_zh: 在設有「二次熱水強制循環回水迴路 (Secondary Circulation)」的商用建築中，循環回水在重新流回換熱儲水罐入口處時，其最低水溫必須保持在攝氏幾度以上？

options_zh.C: 至少保持在 50°C 以上 (在醫院及醫療機構必須保持在 55°C 以上)

explanation_en: Secondary return loops must maintain at least 50°C throughout the entire circuit, verifying that water circulating through remote corners never drops into the bacterial zone.
explanation_zh: 循環回水管是整個管網最冷的一環。回水端水溫高於 50°C，證明整個大樓所有死角末梢均處於高溫殺菌安全區，徹底消除了大系統死水感染風險。
source_reference: HSE HSG274 Part 2 Section 2; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What is the function of a 'Warix Flange' when installed on the top tapping of a vented hot water cylinder?
content_zh: 安裝在開式熱水水罐頂部開孔上的「瓦里克斯法蘭 (Warix Flange)」具有何種雙重分流管道接駁功能？

options_en.B: It provides a top-mounted vertical connection for the open safety vent pipe while providing an independent side outlet for the domestic hot draw-off (or shower pump)

options_zh.A: 將銅管分子結構轉化為鋼材
options_zh.B: 頂部直通口向上連接垂直開式安全通風排氣管，側面獨立出水口引向生活熱水供水管（或淋浴增壓泵），兼具自動排氣與防氣阻雙重功能
options_zh.C: 以數字信號計量水流速度
options_zh.D: 過濾自來水中的殘留餘氯

explanation_en: A Warix flange allows the vent pipe to rise straight up off the cylinder crown to clear air, while tapping bubble-free hot water from the side branch.
explanation_zh: Warix 法蘭是英倫經典管件：向上直通排氣管，側枝引出生活熱水，在單一頂部管口上完美解決了排氣與抽水雙重需求，防止淋浴泵吞入氣泡。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 205 Textbook Ch 6

content_en: Under Approved Document G3, can discharge pipe D2 be connected into an internal plastic soil and waste stack inside a domestic dwelling?
content_zh: 根據建築法規 Approved Document G3 規定，承壓熱水系統的 D2 高溫排放管，在何種嚴格條件下才被允許接入室內塑料排水或排污立管？

options_en.B: Only if high-temperature certified plastic (such as polypropylene PP or MuPVC) or copper is used with an approved mechanical waterless trap, resistant to 100°C boiling water and steam
options_en.C: Allowed into any thin plastic pipe using sellotape

options_zh.A: 在任何情況下絕對嚴格禁止接入室內排水管
options_zh.B: 僅當採用耐溫達 100°C 沸水及高溫蒸汽的專用耐高溫管道材質（如高耐溫聚丙烯 PP、改性 PVC 或純銅管），並配合經過認證的耐高溫自封機械防臭裝置時方可接入
options_zh.C: 允許用透明封箱膠帶粘在任何薄塑料管上接入
options_zh.D: 僅在每週二才被允許接入

explanation_en: Standard PVC-U melts at 75°C. Connecting unvented discharge into internal soil stacks requires specialized high-temp pipes (polypropylene/copper) and HEPvO waterless valves.
explanation_zh: 普通下水管遇沸水會瞬間軟化塌陷脫落。若必須室內排污，必須使用耐 100°C 沸水的特殊高溫管件及無水機械防臭膜閥（HepvO），防止高溫熱氣融穿排水管。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G3 Section 3.25; HepvO Technical Manual

content_en: Why is a cast-iron circulator pump strictly prohibited from being installed on a secondary domestic hot water circulation loop?
content_zh: 在家庭或商用生活熱水二次循環回水管路上，為什麼絕對嚴格禁止安裝鑄鐵泵體（Cast Iron）的普通供暖循環水泵？

options_en.A: Cast iron pumps are too light in weight
options_en.B: Domestic tap water contains continuous fresh dissolved oxygen which rapidly corrodes and rusts cast iron, discoloring tap water brown/red and destroying the pump
options_en.C: Cast iron is illegal under building regulations

options_zh.A: 鑄鐵泵體自身重量過輕
options_zh.B: 自來水中富含新鮮的溶解氧，會與鑄鐵金屬發生劇烈的氧化電化學腐蝕，導致流出的熱水變成渾濁的紅褐色鐵鏽水，並在數月內將水泵葉輪徹底銹爛穿孔
options_zh.C: 鑄鐵材料已被建築法規全面取締
options_zh.D: 鑄鐵具有將熱水冷卻結冰的特性

explanation_en: Domestic water is aerated and fresh. Cast iron rusts instantly in open oxygenated water; secondary circulation pumps must be corrosion-proof bronze or stainless steel.
explanation_zh: 供暖水是封閉無氧水可用鑄鐵泵；生活熱水是新鮮充氧水，鑄鐵遇氧必銹。法規強制熱水二次循環泵必須採用耐腐蝕的青銅（Bronze）或不銹鋼（Stainless Steel）泵體。
source_reference: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What is the standard height position on a domestic indirect cylinder where the strap-on or pocket-inserted cylinder thermostat should be located?
content_zh: 在家用間接式熱水儲水水罐外壁或測溫套管內安裝熱水溫控器探頭時，標準的垂直安裝高度位置應當在哪裡？

options_en.A: At the very top dome next to the hot draw-off
options_en.B: Approximately one-quarter to one-third of the cylinder height from the base (just above the primary heating coil)
options_en.C: Directly on the floorboards underneath the cylinder

options_zh.A: 緊貼水罐最頂部熱水出水口旁邊
options_zh.B: 大約位於水罐總高度自底部向上四分之一至三分之一處（剛好略高於內置換熱盤管頂部位置）
options_zh.C: 直接扔在水罐下方的木地板地坪上
options_zh.D: 塞入壁掛爐的排煙管道內

explanation_en: Positioning the thermostat in the lower third (above the coil) ensures the boiler fires until the bulk volume of the cylinder is heated, satisfying daily volume demand.
explanation_zh: 若裝在頂部，上方剛有一小層熱水溫控器就誤以為整罐水已熱提前跳閘；裝在下部 1/3 處，能確保整罐 80% 以上的蓄水容量全部被充分加熱到 60°C 預定水溫。
source_reference: Domestic Heating Design Guide; C&G Unit 205

content_en: A 150-liter domestic indirect hot water cylinder is heated by a 15 kW gas system boiler. Assuming 100% heat transfer efficiency, approximately how long will it take to heat the water from 10°C to 60°C? (Using c = 4.187 kJ/kg·°C)
content_zh: 一個 150 公升的家用間接式熱水水罐由一台 15 kW 的系統燃氣壁掛爐進行加熱。假設換熱效率為 100%，將整罐水溫由 10°C 加熱升溫至 60°C 理論上大約需要多少分鐘？（水的比熱容取 4.187 kJ/kg·°C）

options_en.B: Approx 35 minutes

options_zh.A: 約 5 分鐘
options_zh.B: 約 35 分鐘 (計算值約 34.9 分鐘)
options_zh.C: 約 120 分鐘 (2 小時)
options_zh.D: 整整 24 小時

source_reference: C&G Unit 202 / 205 Cylinder Recovery Calculations

content_en: Under current UK Building Regulations Approved Document L, what is the maximum allowable standing heat loss for a modern factory-insulated 200-liter hot water cylinder?
content_zh: 根據英國最新建築節能法規 Approved Document L 要求，一台出廠自帶發泡保溫層的現代 200 公升熱水儲水水罐，其 24 小時靜態保溫散熱損失上限是多少？

options_en.A: Less than approx 1.6 to 2.0 kWh per 24 hours
options_en.B: Over 10 kWh per 24 hours

options_zh.A: 小於約 1.6 至 2.0 kWh / 24小時 (即每天待機散熱損耗不到 2 度電)
options_zh.B: 每天超過 10 kWh
options_zh.C: 每天 50 kWh
options_zh.D: 零散熱（永久保溫）

explanation_en: Modern cylinders use 50-60mm thick polyurethane foam (PUR) insulation complying with ErP Energy Label B/A, losing under 1.6-2.0 kWh/day.
explanation_zh: 現代高效水罐外殼均整體高壓注塑硬質聚氨酯泡棉，保溫性能極其出色，整罐熱水保溫 24 小時水溫僅下降約 2-3°C，待機熱損失極低。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document L1 Table 17; BS EN 12897

content_en: When an unvented hot water storage cylinder is connected to a modern heat pump, why must the cylinder be specifically manufactured as a 'Heat Pump Cylinder' with a much larger internal heat exchanger coil?
content_zh: 當承壓熱水儲水罐與空氣源熱泵（ASHP）配套使用時，為什麼該水罐必須專門選用「熱泵專用大盤管水罐」，其內置換熱盤管面積遠大於傳統壁掛爐水罐？

options_en.A: Heat pumps produce higher water temperatures (90°C)
options_en.B: Heat pumps operate at lower flow temperatures (typically 50°C to 55°C); a massive coil surface area (2.5 to 3.5 m²) is essential to transfer adequate heat rapidly across the smaller temperature difference (ΔT)

options_zh.A: 空氣源熱泵輸出水溫遠高於傳統鍋爐（達 90°C 以上）
options_zh.B: 熱泵輸出水溫較低（通常僅為 50°C 至 55°C），換熱溫差 ΔT 極小；必須將盤管表面積大幅擴展至 2.5 至 3.5 m²（傳統鍋爐盤管僅約 0.8 m²），方能在低溫差下迅速完成全水箱換熱
options_zh.C: 用以過濾製冷劑氣體
options_zh.D: 增加熱水硬度

explanation_en: Heat transfer equation Q = U × A × ΔT. Because heat pump ΔT is small, the heat exchange surface area (A) must be tripled (to ~3 m²) to achieve rapid hot water recovery.
explanation_zh: 換熱公式 Q = K·A·ΔT。溫差小了，唯有成倍加大換熱面積 A 才能換出足夠熱量。若將普通壁掛爐小盤管水罐接在熱泵上，熱泵會頻繁高溫報警且數小時燒不熱水。
source_reference: MCS Heat Pump Design Guide (MIS 3005); C&G Unit 205

content_en: How is Legionella bacterial growth prevented in a low-temperature heat pump hot water system that normally stores water at 50°C to 55°C?
content_zh: 在日常將水溫維持在 50°C 至 55°C 節能運行的熱泵熱水系統中，如何通過系統控制程序防止嗜肺軍團菌的潛在滋生？

options_en.A: Pouring chlorine into the shower every day
options_en.B: The system programmer initiates an automated weekly 'Pasteurization / Legionella purge cycle', activating an electric immersion heater to boost cylinder water to 60°C to 65°C for at least 60 minutes
options_en.D: Draining the cylinder completely twice a day

options_zh.A: 每天洗澡時向淋浴噴頭人工倒入漂白水
options_zh.B: 控制系統自動啟動每週一次的「巴氏高溫高溫殺菌循環 (Pasteurization Cycle)」，聯動內置電加熱棒將水溫定時強行加熱至 60°C 至 65°C 並持續恆溫至少 60 分鐘
options_zh.C: 每天夜間將水罐徹底冷凍成冰
options_zh.D: 每天將水罐內存水排空兩次

explanation_en: Heat pump controllers automatically schedule a weekly Legionella pasteurization burn, using the immersion heater to elevate water to >60°C to sanitize the vessel.
explanation_zh: 智能防軍團菌程序：每週日凌晨自動啟動電加熱輔熱，將全罐水溫強行拉升至 60°C 保持 1 小時，徹底消滅潛伏在底部的任何細菌，兼顧日常節能與衛生安全。
source_reference: HSE HSG274 Part 2; MCS Domestic Heat Pump Standards

content_en: In a twin-coil solar thermal hot water storage cylinder, how are the two internal heating coils configured vertically inside the vessel?
content_zh: 在配備雙換熱盤管的太陽能專用熱水水罐內部，上下兩個換熱盤管在結構空間上是怎樣高低佈置的？

options_en.A: The solar coil is positioned in the bottom half of the cylinder, while the auxiliary boiler coil is located in the upper half
options_en.B: The boiler coil is at the bottom and solar coil at the top
options_en.C: Both coils are wrapped around the outside shell
options_en.D: The coils are connected in parallel at the same height

options_zh.A: 太陽能集熱盤管安裝在水罐的「最下半部」，而壁掛爐輔助加熱盤管安裝在水罐的「上半部」
options_zh.B: 壁掛爐盤管裝在底部，太陽能盤管裝在頂部
options_zh.C: 兩個盤管均纏繞在水箱外金屬殼上
options_zh.D: 兩個盤管在同一水平高度並排擺放

explanation_en: The solar coil sits at the bottom to preheat the coldest incoming water. The auxiliary boiler coil heats only the top half if solar energy is insufficient, maximizing solar gain.
explanation_zh: 太陽能熱品位低，裝在最底部能最大限度吸納微弱日照預熱進戶冷水；常規燃氣鍋爐盤管只裝在水箱上半截，陰雨天時僅加熱上半部熱水，下部留給太陽能，能效最高。
source_reference: C&G Unit 205 Solar Thermal Installations; Domestic Heating Guide

content_en: What is an 'Unvented Point-of-Use' (POU) electric water heater commonly installed under a commercial office kitchen sink?
content_zh: 在商用寫字樓茶水間水槽下方廣泛安裝的「小型承壓即熱/儲水型小廚寶 (Point-of-Use Unvented Heater)」，其系統特徵是什麼？

options_en.A: A giant 500-liter boiler on the roof
options_en.B: A compact 10 to 15-liter storage heater fed directly from mains pressure, incorporating a mini expansion vessel, pressure relief valve, and tundish
options_en.D: A cold water cistern with no heater

options_zh.A: 安裝在屋頂上的 500 升大型集中鍋爐
options_zh.B: 直接接自市政自來水高壓管的 10 至 15 公升緊湊型小型承壓熱水器，內部配備微型膨脹水箱、安全洩壓閥及排水分流漏斗
options_zh.C: 燃氣驅動的蒸汽機
options_zh.D: 不帶加熱器的普通冷水箱

explanation_en: Small unvented POU heaters (10-15L) supply immediate local hot water. Under G3, they require expansion protection and a relief valve discharging via a tundish.
explanation_zh: 小廚寶也是承壓壓力容器！容量大於 15 升必須完全走 G3 報建驗收；即便是 10-15 升小廚寶，也必須配套安裝止回閥、微型膨脹罐及安全洩壓閥防爆。
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Section 3; BS EN 12897

content_en: What component should be fitted to a secondary domestic hot water return loop to prevent the circulation pump from wasting energy during the middle of the night?
content_zh: 在生活熱水二次循環回水管路上，為防止循環水泵在深夜全家熟睡時無謂空轉耗電並造成管道散熱浪費，必須加裝何種節能控制元件？

options_en.A: A manual valve kept closed forever
options_en.B: A 24-hour / 7-day electronic time programmer (or smart occupancy sensor) paired with a pipe surface pipe-stat

options_zh.A: 一個被永久扳死關閉的手動閘閥
options_zh.B: 定時控制器 (Time Clock / Programmer，或人體感應探頭) 配合管道表面溫度感應開關 (Pipe-stat)
options_zh.C: 散熱器手動排氣閥
options_zh.D: 水錘吸震器

explanation_en: Part L compliance requires secondary circulation pumps to be time-controlled and pipe-stat controlled, ensuring circulation operates only during active waking hours.
explanation_zh: 24小時長流水循環會把整個房屋變成大散熱器，白白損耗燃氣。加裝定時鐘只在早晚用水高峰前啟動循環，回水達到 50°C 溫控器立即停泵，極大節能。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document L1; Energy Saving Trust Guide

content_en: What is the test procedure during commissioning of a Thermostatic Mixing Valve (TMV) to verify its fail-safe thermal shut-off protection?
content_zh: 在對新安裝的恆溫混水閥（TMV）進行竣工驗收調試時，檢驗其「防燙傷故障安全截斷功能 (Fail-Safe Test)」的標準測試流程是什麼？

options_en.A: Pour hot oil over the valve
options_en.B: While water is flowing through the valve at a steady blend temperature, completely isolate the cold water inlet supply; hot water discharge must cease entirely within seconds (trickle <100ml)
options_en.D: Hit the valve with a hammer

options_zh.A: 將高溫熱油潑灑在閥體外殼上
options_zh.B: 在龍頭正常流出預設溫度混水時，迅速手動將「冷水進水隔離閥」完全關死；閥門出水口必須在 1 至 2 秒之內徹底斷流（殘餘涓流洩漏量嚴格小於 100 毫升）
options_zh.C: 拔掉建築物的總供電插頭
options_zh.D: 用鐵錘重重敲擊混水閥

explanation_en: The cold failure test simulates supply disruption. A compliant TMV must shut off completely within 1-2 seconds to guarantee anti-scalding protection.
explanation_zh: 調試必須親自實測「斷冷水試驗」：關閉冷水進口，出水嘴必須在一兩秒內咔噠一聲瞬間斷水，確認無滾燙開水流出後方可簽署驗收合格單交付業主。
source_reference: BS EN 1111 / BS EN 1287; BuildCert TMV2/TMV3 Commissioning Procedure

content_en: What is the function of the line strainer fitted upstream of the Pressure Reducing Valve (PRV) on an unvented hot water cylinder cold inlet group?
content_zh: 在承壓熱水水罐進水減壓閥（PRV）前端上游緊鄰安裝的「管道 Y 型過濾網 (Line Strainer)」的核心保護功能是什麼？

options_en.A: To purify water into mineral water
options_en.B: To trap pipe debris, sand, flux balls, and rust swarf carried in municipal water mains, preventing them from jamming or scoring the precision PRV seat and check valves

options_zh.A: 將自來水直接過濾轉化為礦泉水
options_zh.B: 攔截自來水市政主管網沖入的泥沙顆粒、管道碎屑、焊渣金屬毛刺及水垢硬塊，防止其卡死或劃傷精密減壓閥閥座與單向止回閥芯
options_zh.C: 利用離心力製造超高水壓
options_zh.D: 調節進水水溫

explanation_en: Grit damages PRV seats, causing creep where downstream pressure slowly rises to mains levels. The mesh strainer protects the valve internals.
explanation_zh: 微小沙粒卡在減壓閥密封面會導致「壓力爬升（Pressure Creep）」：龍頭一關水壓慢慢漏到 6 bar 觸發安全閥滴水。定期拆洗 Y 型濾網是維保必做基本功。
source_reference: BS EN 1567; C&G Unit 205

content_en: Why must unvented cylinder discharge pipework D2 NEVER be installed with standard low-temperature push-fit plastic waste pipes manufactured from standard PVC-U or ABS?
content_zh: 承壓熱水系統的 D2 安全排放管，為什麼絕對嚴禁採用普通的 PVC-U 或 ABS 塑料卡插排水管進行敷設？

options_en.B: Standard PVC-U and ABS have heat distortion temperatures of 65°C to 75°C; 95°C boiling water and pressurized steam from an active T&P discharge will melt, collapse, and blow the joints apart violently

options_zh.A: 塑料管受熱時散發出的氣味過於好聞
options_zh.B: 普通 PVC-U 和 ABS 塑料的熱變形軟化溫度僅為 65°C 至 75°C；安全閥噴出的 95°C 沸水和高溫蒸汽會瞬間將管身融化軟化、接頭直接炸脫，沸水在室內噴濺造成災難
options_zh.C: 塑料管會使高溫水產生核輻射
options_zh.D: 塑料管自重大於金屬管

explanation_en: Relief discharge contains boiling water and steam. Standard plastics soften instantly, tearing free of clips and dumping boiling water onto floors. Metal or certified high-temp pipes are mandatory.
explanation_zh: 高溫高壓沸水瞬間能把薄塑料管融化得像軟麵條一樣垂下脫扣。法規硬性要求：D2 管必須採用耐 100°C 沸水衝擊的純銅管或特種高溫聚丙烯管！
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G3 Section 3; BS 8000-13

content_en: What is an 'Instantaneous Multipoint Gas Water Heater' (combi boiler domestic hot water section or gas water geyser)?
content_zh: 在現代家用熱水供應中，「即熱式多點燃氣熱水器 (Instantaneous Multipoint Water Heater / 壁掛爐生活熱水模塊)」的工作原理是什麼？

options_en.A: It heats a 500-liter storage tank overnight
options_en.B: It operates on-demand with zero bulk storage: opening a hot tap triggers a flow switch or turbine, firing high-output gas burners to heat water instantaneously as it flows across a compact plate heat exchanger
options_en.C: It generates hot water using ice cubes
options_en.D: It only supplies a single washbasin with warm water

options_zh.A: 在夜間離峰電價時段慢速加熱 500 升大型儲水箱
options_zh.B: 完全無需龐大儲水水箱，實行「即開即熱」：用戶打開熱水龍頭的瞬間，水流開關或水輪傳感器檢測到流量，瞬間點燃大功率燃氣火排，冷水流經板式換熱器即刻被加熱輸出
options_zh.C: 利用冰塊放熱製造高溫熱水
options_zh.D: 僅能為單一洗手盆提供微弱溫水

explanation_en: Instantaneous multipoint heaters heat water continuously on demand, eliminating standby storage standing heat loss and delivering endless hot water.
explanation_zh: 即開即用零待機熱損：龍頭一開壁掛爐立即切換至生活熱水工況，全功率燃燒加熱板換；水龍頭一關燃燒器立即熄火，無水箱佔地，是中小戶型主流選擇。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 205 Textbook Ch 6

content_en: What type of water tap outlet creates fine, respirable aerosol mists that present the highest clinical transmission route for inhaling Legionella bacteria into human lungs?
content_zh: 在各類生活給水終端用水器具中，哪一種器具出水時會產生微細懸浮的「可吸入氣溶膠水霧 (Aerosols)」，構成人類呼吸吸入軍團菌的最危險臨床感染途徑？

options_en.A: A smooth laminar flow kitchen bib tap
options_en.B: Shower heads, aerated spray nozzles, and jacuzzi whirlpool spa jets
options_en.D: An underground garden hose buried in soil

options_zh.A: 出水呈平緩層流狀的廚房普通洗菜龍頭
options_zh.B: 淋浴噴頭 (Showerheads)、起泡充氣噴嘴 (Aerators) 及水療按摩浴缸噴流噴嘴
options_zh.C: 馬桶水箱底部的浮球進水閥
options_zh.D: 埋在土壤裡的滴灌花園軟管

explanation_en: Legionella cannot be contracted by drinking water; it must be inhaled as microscopic water droplets (<5 microns) produced by showers and spray taps directly into lung alveoli.
explanation_zh: 軍團菌病不會通過飲用感染，唯有通過呼吸吸入含有細菌的微細水霧氣溶膠（粒徑小於5微米直接進入肺泡）才會致病。淋浴噴頭首當其衝，必須定期除垢消毒！
source_reference: HSE Approved Code of Practice L8; NHS HTM 04-01

content_en: How often should domestic and commercial showerheads and flexible hoses be dismantled, cleaned, descaled, and disinfected under HSE HSG274 Legionella guidelines?
content_zh: 根據 HSE HSG274 軍團菌防護指南規定，商用物業及家庭淋浴噴頭和花灑軟管，常規推薦每隔多久應徹底拆卸、清除水垢並進行化學殺菌消毒？

options_en.B: At least quarterly (every 3 months) or more frequently based on risk assessment
options_en.D: Only if the water pressure drops to zero

options_zh.A: 每 50 年拆洗一次
options_zh.B: 至少每季度一次（每 3 個月），或根據硬度結垢與水質風險評估增加頻次
options_zh.C: 永久無需任何清洗消毒
options_zh.D: 只有當出水水壓徹底歸零時才清洗

explanation_en: Quarterly descaling removes limescale matrix that shields bacteria from disinfectants and clogs spray holes, eliminating Legionella breeding sites.
explanation_zh: 淋浴花灑小孔極易結滿水垢，粗糙的水垢表面是微生物生長的天然防護堡壘。每季度將噴頭浸泡在除垢劑和次氯酸鈉消毒液中，徹底消除隱患。
source_reference: HSE HSG274 Part 2 Table 2.1; ACoP L8

content_en: When commissioning a new vented copper hot water cylinder installation, what check must be made regarding the primary gravity flow and return pipe gradients?
content_zh: 在驗收調試一條重力自流循環的鍋爐至開式水罐初級循環管路時，針對供回水管的敷設坡度，必須嚴格核查何種工藝要求？

options_en.A: Pipes must slope downwards with a reverse dip
options_en.B: Primary flow pipes must have a continuous upward slope (rise) towards the open vent with zero air pockets, while the return falls continuously to the boiler
options_en.D: Pipes must be buried in ice

options_zh.A: 管道必須向下傾斜形成下凹的 U 型積水窪
options_zh.B: 一次供水管必須向著開頂通風膨脹管方向保持「連續向上仰坡 (Continuous Rise)」，全程杜絕任何反坡氣袋；回水管則保持連續向下俯坡順暢流回鍋爐
options_zh.C: 管道必須彎折成 M 字母幾何形狀
options_zh.D: 管道必須全程埋在碎冰塊中

explanation_en: Gravity circulation operates on tiny natural buoyancy pressure. Any dip traps air bubbles, instantly breaking the thermosiphon and halting heat transfer completely.
explanation_zh: 重力循環浮力壓頭極其微弱。供水管只要有哪怕一處下垂塌腰，析出的氣泡就會聚集在最高點形成氣阻（Air lock），熱水循環立即瞬間徹底中斷！
source_reference: BS 6700; C&G Unit 205 Gravity Circulation Systems

content_en: What is the maximum static pressure allowed inside a domestic unvented hot water cylinder under normal operating conditions when controlled by its PRV?
content_zh: 在進水減壓閥（PRV）正常穩壓控制下，家用承壓熱水水罐內部在正常冷水靜態時的工作水壓通常被限制在多少數值？

options_en.B: Typically 3.0 to 3.5 bar (and maximum 5.5 bar when heated to full expansion)

options_zh.A: 0.1 bar (重力水箱水壓)
options_zh.B: 通常為 3.0 至 3.5 bar (受熱膨脹峰值受控在 5.0 至 5.5 bar 以內，遠低於 6 bar 洩壓線)
options_zh.C: 15 bar
options_zh.D: 50 bar

explanation_en: Inlet PRVs control pressure to 3.0-3.5 bar. Thermal expansion elevates this to ~4.5 bar, buffered by the expansion vessel safely below the 6 bar relief threshold.
explanation_zh: 減壓閥將進水壓精確限制在 3.5 bar。既為用戶提供星級酒店般的澎湃花灑水流，又給熱膨脹留出足夠安全冗餘，確保系統長治久安。
source_reference: BS EN 12897; Approved Document G3

content_en: Under Approved Document G3 Table G3, if a 90-degree copper elbow bend is installed along discharge pipe D2, by what equivalent resistance length must the total allowable pipe run be reduced?
content_zh: 根據 Approved Document G3 表 G3 阻力折算規定，在 D2 高溫排放管中每增加一個 90 度紫銅沖壓直角彎頭，總允許等效阻力管長必須扣減多少米？

options_en.B: 0.8 meters for each 90-degree bend

options_zh.B: 每個 90 度直角彎頭必須扣減 0.8 米等效管長 (0.8 m deduction)
options_zh.D: 折彎對阻力完全無任何影響

explanation_en: Frictional turbulence around bends creates back-pressure. Table G3 specifies deducting 0.8m from allowable pipe length for every 90° bend to prevent tundish overflow.
explanation_zh: 急折彎會阻礙無壓沸水排出並引起氣阻。規範規定每個 90 度彎頭扣減 0.8 米管長；若管路有 4 個彎頭（扣減 3.2 米），原本 9 米管段就只能走 5.8 米。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G3 Table G3

content_en: Under BS EN 1287, what is the definition of a 'Mechanical TMV' (Type 1) compared to a thermostatic TMV2?
content_zh: 在歐洲標準 BS EN 1287 中，「Type 1 機械手動預調混水閥」與具備溫度補償的 TMV2 恆溫混水閥相比，其性能差異是什麼？

options_en.B: Type 1 provides manual proportioning without dynamic thermostatic compensating feedback, meaning water delivery temperature will fluctuate if incoming hot or cold pressure changes

options_zh.A: Type 1 閥門內置電子計算機芯片
options_zh.B: Type 1 僅為普通機械手動比例調節，內部不具備動態感溫膨脹補償反饋；當冷熱水進水壓力或水溫發生波動時，出水水溫會隨之發生明顯漂移忽冷忽熱
options_zh.C: Type 1 只能產出冰水
options_zh.D: Type 1 在所有場合均已被取締

explanation_en: Type 1 valves are mechanical mixers lacking dynamic feedback. If someone flushes a WC, cold pressure drops and delivery scalding spikes. TMV2 adjusts automatically.
explanation_zh: 普通龍頭開水有人沖廁所洗澡水立即燙得跳腳；而符合 TMV2 的恆溫閥在水壓驟變時，感溫包光速調整開度維持出水溫差不超過 2°C。
source_reference: BS EN 1287; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What occurs to the primary heating circuit if the feed and expansion (F&E) cistern in the loft runs dry due to a jammed ball valve?
content_zh: 在開式供暖鍋爐系統中，若閣樓上的初級「補水與膨脹水箱 (F&E Tank)」因浮球閥卡死失靈而徹底乾涸見底，供暖系統會發生何種嚴重故障？

options_en.B: Air is drawn down the cold feed pipe into the primary circuit, causing severe pump cavitation, radiator airlocks, boiler kettling boiling sounds, and boiler overheat shutdown
options_en.C: The electricity bills drop to zero
options_en.D: The domestic hot water becomes carbonated

options_zh.A: 散熱器暖氣片瞬間完全結冰
options_zh.B: 空氣沿著補水下水管直接被抽吸注入供暖管網，引發水泵嚴重氣蝕失壓、暖氣片形成大面積氣塞不熱、鍋爐換熱器乾燒沸騰發出劇烈水錘爆鳴聲並高溫報警停機
options_zh.C: 全家每月電費直接降為零
options_zh.D: 生活熱水自發轉化為碳酸水

explanation_en: A dry F&E cistern allows the system pump to suck air down the feed pipe, filling the boiler heat exchanger with air pockets, causing severe overheating and kettling.
explanation_zh: 水箱一旦空了，循環水泵巨大的吸力會將空氣吸入鍋爐內部。失去水的冷卻，主換熱器局部分秒內超過數百度，水滴上去劇烈沸騰發出駭人「水壺開水聲（Kettling）」。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 205 / 207 Fault Diagnosis

content_en: What is the function of the 'Balanced Cold Water Take-Off' port integrated into an unvented hot water cylinder's inlet control valve group?
content_zh: 在承壓熱水水罐進水組合閥組上，專門分流出的「平衡冷水取水接口 (Balanced Cold Water Take-off)」具有何種關鍵功用？

options_en.B: To supply cold water to thermostatic mixer showers at the exact same regulated dynamic pressure (e.g. 3.5 bar) as the hot water, preventing sudden temperature fluctuations during pressure swings
options_en.C: To cool down the boiler exhaust
options_en.D: To drain the cylinder in an emergency

options_zh.A: 專門用於花園草坪自動噴灌
options_zh.B: 為浴室恆溫混水淋浴龍頭提供與熱水端「壓強完全嚴格均等」的冷水（如均為 3.5 bar 穩壓水），徹底消除因其他龍頭開水引起的冷熱水壓差失衡與水溫忽冷忽熱
options_zh.C: 為壁掛爐煙道排氣冷卻
options_zh.D: 在緊急情況下快速排空水罐

explanation_en: Supplying showers with balanced cold water from the PRV ensures hot and cold arrive at identical pressures, preventing temperature shocks when taps open elsewhere.
explanation_zh: 淋浴水溫穩定的核心是「水壓平衡」：若冷水直接接未經減壓的 6 bar 市政管，熱水接 3.5 bar 水罐，壓差會導致冷水倒頂熱水。平衡冷水使雙方同壓，淋浴極致舒適。
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Section 3; BS EN 12897

content_en: Why is modern 'Duplex Stainless Steel' (such as grade 2205 / 2101) preferred over standard copper or enamelled steel for manufacturing unvented hot water cylinders?
content_zh: 在製造現代高品質承壓熱水儲水罐（如 Megaflo / Telford Tempest）時，為什麼「雙相不銹鋼 (Duplex Stainless Steel)」被公認為最優越的罐體材料？

options_en.B: It combines exceptionally high mechanical tensile yield strength (allowing lightweight thin-wall construction at 15+ bar burst pressure) with extreme resistance to chloride stress corrosion cracking and pitting

options_zh.A: 它的採購成本比普通塑料還要低廉
options_zh.B: 兼具極高的屈服抗拉機械強度（允許製造輕量化薄壁筒體並承受高達 15 bar 以上的破壞爆破壓力），且對水中氯離子點蝕及應力腐蝕開裂具備超強免疫力，無需陽極棒維護
options_zh.C: 具有完全透光透明的外觀
options_zh.D: 能在水中自發溶解

explanation_en: Duplex stainless steel offers double the mechanical strength of austenitic 304/316 steel and superior pitting resistance, providing 25-year cylinder lifespans without sacrificial anodes.
explanation_zh: 雙相鋼兼有奧氏體和鐵素體雙重顯微金相，既堅硬無比能承受數倍高壓衝擊，又徹底免去了搪瓷鋼罐每兩年必須更換鎂陽極棒的繁瑣維保，經久耐用。
source_reference: BS EN 12897 Water heaters; Materials Engineering in Plumbing

content_en: At a water temperature of 60°C, how many seconds of continuous human skin contact does it take to cause a severe, full-thickness blistering burn (scald) on an adult?
content_zh: 在 60°C 的高溫熱水直接噴淋下，成年人皮膚僅需持續接觸幾秒鐘，就會造成嚴重的全層皮膚起泡起潰瘍的三度燙傷？

options_en.B: Approximately 5 seconds (and under 1 second for infants/elderly)

options_zh.A: 1 小時以上
options_zh.B: 大約僅需 5 秒鐘（對於皮膚幼嫩的嬰兒或皮膚變薄的失智長者，接觸時間不足 1 秒即造成重度燙傷）
options_zh.C: 30 分鐘
options_zh.D: 60°C 水溫下人體絕不會燙傷

explanation_en: At 60°C, deep tissue destruction occurs within 5 seconds on adult skin (instantaneous on infants). This is why TMVs limiting bath temperatures to 48°C are statutory under Part G.
explanation_zh: 燙傷時間與溫度呈對數劇烈反比：50°C 需 5 分鐘才燙傷，而 60°C 僅需 5 秒，65°C 瞬間 1 秒皮開肉綻。這正是法規強制在出水端加裝防燙傷 TMV 的生死依據！
source_reference: RoSPA Scalding Prevention Guide; Approved Document G

content_en: Why must a Tundish always be installed in a strictly vertical orientation under Approved Document G3?
content_zh: 根據建築法規 Approved Document G3 規定，觀測放水漏斗（Tundish）為什麼在安裝時必須始終保持嚴格的「垂直豎立」狀態？

options_en.B: To ensure boiling water and steam falling from D1 drop cleanly through the air break into the centre of D2 without splashing out of the open viewing window onto surroundings

options_zh.A: 節省設備房牆面安裝空間
options_zh.B: 確保 D1 短管噴出的高溫沸水與蒸汽能藉助重力垂直端正地跌落入漏斗咽喉中心並排入 D2，防止熱水從側向開口的觀測視窗向外劇烈飛濺潑灑燙傷他人
options_zh.C: 保持水管低溫
options_zh.D: 方便昆蟲自由爬入

explanation_en: Tundishes must be vertical. If tilted, high-velocity discharge from D1 deflects off the side collar, spraying boiling water out of the observation slots into the room.
explanation_zh: 漏斗開口是為了提供空氣間隔與目視觀察。若傾斜安裝，安全閥高壓起跳時沸水射入漏斗壁會像水槍一樣向外反彈飛濺，開水直接噴灑在配電箱或維修工身上。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G3 Section 3.16

content_en: What is the minimum safe clearance distance between the external termination point of discharge pipe D2 and any opening window, ventilation intake, or plastic guttering?
content_zh: 承壓熱水系統的 D2 室外高溫排放管排出口，與任何可開啟窗戶、通風進氣口或塑料排水天溝之間，法定必須保持的安全間隔距離至少是多少？

options_en.B: At least 300 mm clearance (or 375 mm under certain building details)

options_zh.A: 10 mm
options_zh.B: 至少保持 300 mm（約 1 英尺）以上的安全避讓淨距（某些特殊建築構造要求 375 mm）
options_zh.C: 5 米

explanation_en: D2 conveys high-temperature water and steam. Terminating too close to windows allows steam to enter buildings, and proximity to PVC gutters causes plastic melting.
explanation_zh: 高溫蒸汽會融化塑料天溝並熏黑牆面；若緊靠開口窗戶，滾燙蒸汽會灌入室內房間引發窒息或燙傷。法規要求至少避開開口門窗 300mm 以上。
source_reference: Approved Document G3 Section 3.23; BS EN 12897

content_en: What is the function of a 'Sacrificial Magnesium Anode' in an unvented glass-lined (enamelled) steel hot water cylinder, and what is its inspection interval?
content_zh: 在搪瓷（玻璃塗層）鋼製承壓熱水水罐中，「犧牲鎂陽極棒」的作用是什麼，其法定的例行檢查更換週期通常是多久？

options_en.A: It filters water and is replaced every 50 years
options_en.B: It corrodes electrochemically to protect exposed steel at microscopic enamel cracks from rusting; it must be inspected every 12 to 24 months and replaced when depleted by >50%
options_en.D: It stops the water from expanding

options_zh.A: 過濾水中雜質且每 50 年更換一次
options_zh.B: 作為活性陽極優先電化學溶解，為搪瓷塗層微觀裂紋處裸露的鋼基體提供陰極保護防銹；必須每 12 至 24 個月定期拆出檢查，當金屬棒徑損耗超過 50% 時必須立即更換
options_zh.C: 為全屋輸出 230V 交流電
options_zh.D: 阻止熱水體積膨脹

explanation_en: Magnesium dissolves sacrificially. If the anode completely erodes, water attacks bare steel, causing catastrophic cylinder perforation within months.
explanation_zh: 鎂棒是搪瓷水罐的「保命符」。水中礦物質會消耗鎂棒，若不及時更換，高溫熱水會迅速咬穿鋼板導致水箱徹底報廢漏水，年檢必須拆出查看消耗程度。
source_reference: BS EN 12897; Water Quality in Heating Systems

content_en: Under Building Regulations Approved Document G, what is the maximum hot water delivery temperature allowed at an un-assisted domestic bidet?
content_zh: 根據建築法規 Approved Document G 規定，家用坐浴盆（Bidet）出水龍頭混水後，法定的最高允許出水溫度是多少？

options_zh.A: 38°C (人體最敏感部位法定防燙傷極限上限)
options_zh.B: 48°C (浴缸標準)

explanation_en: Approved Document G Table 2 specifies a maximum delivery temperature of 38°C for bidets, protecting highly sensitive perineal skin from thermal injury.
explanation_zh: 人體會陰部皮膚神經末梢極端豐富且表皮極薄，耐熱能力遠低於手足。法規強制要求婦洗盆水溫不得超過 38°C，防止造成不可挽回的深部燙傷組織壞死。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G Table 2

content_en: When commissioning an electric instantaneous shower unit (e.g. 9.5 kW) over a bath or shower tray, what dedicated electrical protective device is mandatory at the consumer unit under BS 7671?
content_zh: 在浴缸或淋浴房上方安裝並調試一台 9.5 kW 即熱式大功率電熱水器淋浴花灑時，根據 BS 7671 電氣規範，在配電箱處必須強制配備何種專用保護開關？

options_en.B: A dedicated high-amperage circuit breaker (MCB / RCBO, typically 40A to 45A) protected by a 30mA Residual Current Device (RCD) operating within 40ms

options_zh.A: 3A 普通插頭保險絲
options_zh.B: 專用大電流微型斷路器 (MCB / RCBO，通常為 40A 至 45A)，且該迴路必須由動作電流不超過 30mA、動作時間在 40ms 以內的漏電保護器 (RCD) 進行強制保護
options_zh.C: 木製手動隔離開關
options_zh.D: 電話信號插座

explanation_en: High-power showers (9.5kW draws ~41A at 230V). BS 7671 Section 701 strictly mandates 30mA RCD protection for all bathroom circuits to prevent fatal electrocution.
explanation_zh: 大功率電熱水器電流高達 40 多安培且人體處於全身濕透的極低電阻環境。30mA 漏保是絕對的生命防線，能在人體尚未感知室內漏電前 0.04 秒內瞬間切斷電源。

content_en: What device is installed on a domestic hot water cylinder primary flow pipe to prevent gravity thermosiphon circulation from overheating the cylinder when the central heating pump is running for space heating only?
content_zh: 在家庭熱水水罐初級鍋爐供水管上，加裝何種單向閥門配件，以防止在冬季僅開啟暖氣片採暖時，熱水因自然重力對流偷偷滲入水罐導致生活熱水嚴重過熱？

options_en.A: An anti-gravity valve (swing check valve or spring check valve / non-return valve)
options_en.B: A garden bib tap

options_zh.A: 防重力循環單向閥 (Anti-gravity Valve / 重力逆止閥，如帶輕載彈簧的止回閥)
options_zh.B: 花園澆水龍頭
options_zh.C: 純銅膨脹水箱
options_zh.D: 自來水錶

explanation_en: Anti-gravity valves have light internal flaps or springs that block weak natural convection currents, opening only when forced by active pump pressure.
explanation_zh: 重力對流浮力雖小但日積月累能將水罐烤至 80°C。防重力止回閥閥瓣有輕微配重，自然微壓推不開它；只有水泵通電加壓時才頂開閥門供熱，精確鎖住熱量。
source_reference: Central Heating Design Guide; C&G Unit 205/207

content_en: Under what circumstance during cylinder commissioning must an unvented hot water cylinder expansion relief valve be manually tested using its ease handle?
content_zh: 在承壓熱水系統竣工驗收及每次年度保養時，現場技師應當如何手動測試安全洩壓閥的機械啟閉可靠性？

options_en.A: Hit the easing knob with an iron hammer
options_en.B: Manually rotate or lift the easing test knob/lever on the valve to confirm that the seat lifts freely, water discharges violently through the tundish, and the valve snaps shut tightly upon release
options_en.D: Glue the handle closed with epoxy resin

options_zh.A: 用鐵錘用力打擊手動放水旋鈕
options_zh.B: 用手旋轉或扳動閥門頂部的「手動測試旋鈕/扳手 (Easing Lever)」，確認閥芯能夠自由跳起、水流從 Tundish 漏斗奔湧噴出沖洗閥座雜質，且鬆手後閥門能瞬間嚴密回座切斷
options_zh.C: 嚴禁任何人觸碰測試旋鈕
options_zh.D: 用環氧樹脂膠把測試手柄死死粘住

explanation_en: Manually operating the ease lever lifts the rubber seat off the brass orifice, flushing out mineral scale flakes and proving the spring mechanism is not seized solid.
explanation_zh: 水垢和礦物質長期靜止會將橡膠閥芯與金屬閥座黏連咬死。每年手動手動扳動「開閥沖洗」數秒，能沖刷掉密封面雜質並確證閥芯在危急關頭絕不卡死。
source_reference: BS EN 1489 / Approved Document G3 Section 3; Benchmark Scheme

content_en: In standard UK S-Plan central heating and hot water wiring, what are the core functions of the five colored conductors on a spring-return 2-port motorized zone valve?
content_zh: 在英國標準的 S-Plan 系統控制電路中，熱水專用 2 通電動分區閥（2-Port Motorized Valve）的 5 芯控制電纜，各顏色導線的法定接線功能是什麼？

options_en.A: All five wires carry high voltage DC power
options_en.B: Brown = Live signal from cylinder stat to open motor; Blue = Neutral; Green/Yellow = Earth; Grey = Permanent 230V live; Orange = Switched live output from end-switch to fire boiler and pump
options_en.C: Orange is for the telephone line

options_zh.A: 5 根電線均傳輸高壓直流電
options_zh.B: 棕色 (Brown) = 來自水罐溫控器的受控火線訊號（驅動電機旋轉開閥）；藍色 = 零線；黃綠雙色 = 保護地線；灰色 (Grey) = 常火線；橙色 (Orange) = 閥門全開後內置微動開關輸出的閉合反饋火線（點火壁掛爐並啟動水泵）
options_zh.C: 橙色線專門用於連接電話寬帶
options_zh.D: 灰色線專門連接太陽能電池板

explanation_en: Motorized valves use an internal microswitch. When the motor opens the valve fully, the microswitch closes, sending power from Grey to Orange to fire the boiler.
explanation_zh: 電動二通閥機械電氣聯鎖：棕色得電電機帶簧旋轉開閥；閥板 100% 旋轉到位後頂動內部微動開關，常火（灰線）與輔助火（橙線）接通，觸發壁掛爐與水泵啟動。
source_reference: BS 7671 Section 554; Honeywell S-Plan Wiring Specification

content_en: What is the function of the 'Switching Differential' (typically 5°C) built into a domestic hot water cylinder thermostat?
content_zh: 家用熱水水罐機械式或電子式溫控器內部標定的「開關溫差 (Switching Differential - 通常約 5°C)」的作用是什麼？

options_en.B: To prevent rapid 'hunting' and short-cycling of the boiler and motorized valve (e.g. cutting off at 60°C and re-firing only when water cools to 55°C)

options_zh.A: 使壁掛爐故意超溫運行
options_zh.B: 防止壁掛爐與電動二通閥發生高頻頻繁震盪點火與頻繁啟停（如水溫升至 60°C 跳閘停爐，水溫必須跌落至 55°C 才會重新閉合點火，保護設備壽命）
options_zh.C: 將水罐降溫結冰
options_zh.D: 成倍增加燃氣耗量

explanation_en: A 5°C deadband prevents the thermostat from cycling on and off every few seconds around the setpoint, protecting relays and boiler components from premature failure.
explanation_zh: 若無回差溫差（Deadband），水溫一降 0.1°C 鍋爐就點火、一升 0.1°C 就停機，一小時啟停數十次極易燒毀主板。5°C 遲滯回差能保證燃燒工況穩定平順。
source_reference: Domestic Heating Design Guide; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What occurs to the delivery flow rate and water temperature of an electric instantaneous shower (e.g. 8.5 kW) between hot summer and freezing winter conditions?
content_zh: 同一台 8.5 kW 的即熱式電熱淋浴器（Electric Instantaneous Shower），在炎熱盛夏與寒冬臘月時，其出水水溫與水流流量會呈現何種物理必然現象？

options_en.A: Winter incoming water is much colder (approx 5°C vs 20°C in summer); to achieve the same 40°C shower temperature, the user must dial down the flow control knob, resulting in a much weaker winter shower trickle
options_en.B: Winter showers produce 10 times more flow

options_zh.A: 冬季自來水進水水溫暴跌至約 5°C（夏季可達 20°C）；在電加熱功率（8.5 kW）固定不變的前提下，為達到舒適的 40°C 淋浴水溫，用戶必須調小水流旋鈕，導致冬季淋浴出水流量顯著變細變軟
options_zh.B: 冬季淋浴水流流量比夏季大 10 倍
options_zh.C: 出水溫度與流量完全不發生任何變化
options_zh.D: 淋浴器在冬天會自發凍碎破裂

explanation_en: Electric shower power is fixed (P = m × c × ΔT). Heating 5°C water to 40°C requires ΔT = 35°C, reducing water flow to just ~3.5 L/min compared to ~6 L/min in summer (ΔT = 20°C).
explanation_zh: 功率 Q = m·c·ΔT 恆定。冬季溫差 ΔT 高達 35°C，為燒熱水流速被迫減小一半以上，花灑水流變得疲軟細弱；這也是英國大戶型青睞承壓水罐的重要原因。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 205 Textbook Ch 6

content_en: What is the safety function of the 'Pressure Relief Device' (PRD) fitted inside an electric instantaneous shower casing?
content_zh: 安裝在即熱式電熱淋浴花灑外殼內部的「壓力安全釋放裝置 (PRD - Pressure Relief Device)」，其核心防護功能是什麼？

options_en.B: A bursting rubber ball or burst-disc that blows out if the showerhead holes are blocked with limescale or the hose is kinked, venting water safely into the bath tray rather than exploding the internal copper heater canister

options_zh.A: 發出刺耳警報聲響
options_zh.B: 內置防爆橡膠球或爆破洩壓片：當花灑噴頭結滿水垢嚴重堵塞或軟管打折死彎時，內部水壓瞬間飆升，PRD 率先主動爆開將高壓水洩入浴缸，防止內部加熱金屬罐受超壓炸裂
options_zh.C: 向用戶釋放微量安全電流
options_zh.D: 提升淋浴水壓

explanation_en: If spray holes scale over, back-pressure spikes dangerously inside the heating cylinder. The PRD ruptures first, discharging into the tray to prevent violent burst.
explanation_zh: PRD 是電熱淋浴器的「自爆保險絲」：水垢堵塞導致背壓飆升時，橡膠球被水壓頂脫，熱水從淋浴器底盤直接湧出，雖需更換 PRD，但保住了昂貴的加熱罐不受損。
source_reference: Mira / Triton Shower Installation Manuals; C&G Unit 205

content_en: Which alloy material is universally specified for electric immersion heater sheaths installed in areas with aggressive or very hard water to prevent premature element burnout?
content_zh: 在微酸性水質或極度硬水結垢地區，為防止電熱浸入式加熱管外殼在短時間內因水垢包覆高溫乾燒燒毀，推薦選用何種耐高溫耐蝕特種合金護套？

options_en.B: Incoloy 800/825 or Titanium alloy

options_zh.A: 普通裸銅金屬護套 (僅適用於無垢軟水地區)
options_zh.B: 因科洛伊高級鎳鉻鐵耐蝕合金 (Incoloy 800/825) 或純鈦合金 (Titanium)
options_zh.C: 純鉛金屬護套
options_zh.D: 生鐵鑄件護套

explanation_en: Incoloy and titanium withstand extreme surface temperatures under thick limescale blankets without splitting or corroding, outlasting cheap copper elements 5-fold.
explanation_zh: 硬水在加熱棒上結出厚厚水垢外衣，熱量散不出去使電熱絲內核溫度高達數百度。Incoloy 超級耐熱合金在高溫水垢下絕不脆裂氧化，壽命是普通銅加熱管的數倍。
source_reference: BS 3456; Immersion Heater Engineering Specifications

content_en: What is the clinical definition of 'Legionnaires' Disease'?
content_zh: 在職業健康與公共衛生醫學中，「軍團菌病 (Legionnaires' Disease)」的臨床病理特徵是什麼？

options_en.A: A mild skin rash caused by cold water
options_en.B: A severe, potentially fatal form of atypical pneumonia (lung infection) caused by inhaling Legionella bacteria suspended in water droplets

options_zh.A: 接觸低溫冷水引發的輕微皮膚過敏紅疹
options_zh.B: 因呼吸吸入懸浮在微細水霧顆粒中的嗜肺軍團菌而引發的重症急性非典型肺炎（肺部重度化膿感染），死亡率高達 10% 至 15%
options_zh.C: 輕度神經性牙痛
options_zh.D: 暫時性骨骼微裂

explanation_en: Legionellosis is a severe respiratory pneumonia. It causes lung consolidation, respiratory failure, and organ collapse, requiring hospitalization and antibiotics.
explanation_zh: 軍團菌在肺泡中大量吞噬巨噬細胞，導致肺實變、高燒寒顫、呼吸衰竭及多器官衰竭。老年人、吸煙者及免疫低下者病死率極高，屬於法定監管傳染病。
source_reference: HSE ACoP L8; World Health Organization (WHO) Guidelines

content_en: When draining down an unvented hot water cylinder to perform maintenance or replace an immersion heater, why must a hot tap upstairs be opened after turning off the cold mains?
content_zh: 在排空承壓熱水水罐進行檢修或更換電熱管時，當關閉進水總閥並打開罐底排污閥後，為什麼必須同時在樓上打開一個熱水龍頭？

options_en.A: To let water spray onto the ceiling
options_en.B: To admit air into the top of the cylinder, breaking the internal hydraulic vacuum and allowing the heavy stored water to drain freely down through the hose

options_zh.A: 讓高壓熱水噴射到天花板上
options_zh.B: 引入空氣進入水罐頂部，徹底打破水罐內部的流體真空負壓（Vacuum Relief），使數百升沉重的存水能藉助重力順暢沿著底閥軟管快速排乾
options_zh.C: 為了提高管網水壓
options_zh.D: 測試燃氣計量表

explanation_en: A closed vessel forms a vacuum as water drains, halting flow (like a finger over a straw). Opening a high-level tap admits air, breaking the airlock for smooth drainage.
explanation_zh: 封閉容器如同堵住頂端的吸管：水放不出來且強大的負壓甚至能把薄金屬罐抽癟。高位開龍頭破真空，大氣壓推動水箱水順暢排淨，安全高效。
source_reference: C&G Unit 205 Drainage Procedures; BS 8000-13

content_en: In a traditional vented hot water system, what occurs if the open vent pipe mistakenly terminates beneath the surface of the cold water in the storage cistern?
content_zh: 在傳統開式熱水供水系統中，若施工失誤，將開頂通風膨脹管（Open Vent）的管口深浸沒在冷水儲水箱的冷水水面「以下」，會引發何種嚴重隱患？

options_en.B: A dangerous cross-connection that creates a closed siphon loop, allowing non-potable cold water to be siphoned down into the hot cylinder, or hot water to expand continuously into the cold supply
options_en.C: The copper pipe turns green instantly

options_zh.A: 水箱自發沸騰汽化
options_zh.B: 形成嚴重的法規違規交叉連接（Cross-connection），構成虹吸封閉迴路，導致非飲用冷水反向倒吸混入生活熱水罐，或熱水持續漫溢進冷水箱造成全面熱污染
options_zh.C: 銅水管外壁瞬間全部發綠
options_zh.D: 全家電費上漲 500%

explanation_en: Vent pipes must terminate with an air gap above the cistern overflow level. Submerged vents allow siphonage and violate Water Regs backflow prevention rules.
explanation_zh: 通風管必須懸空在溢流水面之上至少 450mm！若插在水下，一旦降溫冷縮會將水箱髒水倒吸進熱水系統，破壞空氣隔斷，屬於嚴重違法安裝。
source_reference: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999 Schedule 2

content_en: Under Approved Document G3, what is the mandatory minimum size of the primary metal discharge pipe D1 when connected to a 3/4-inch (DN20) relief valve on a commercial unvented cylinder?
content_zh: 根據 Approved Document G3 規範，當商用承壓熱水水罐的安全閥排出口通徑為 3/4 英寸（DN20）時，其連接的 D1 一次金屬排放管最小法定管徑是多少？

options_en.B: 22 mm copper pipe (matching the valve outlet nominal bore)

options_zh.A: 15 mm (縮徑嚴格禁止)
options_zh.B: 22 mm 紫銅管 (嚴格與安全閥 3/4 英寸出水口通徑全通徑匹配)
options_zh.C: 28 mm
options_zh.D: 54 mm

explanation_en: D1 must never be smaller than the nominal size of the valve outlet. A 3/4" (DN20) valve requires a minimum 22mm copper D1 pipe to avoid restricting flow.
explanation_zh: 鐵律：安全閥出口絕對嚴禁任何縮徑！3/4" 出口的閥門必須配 22mm 銅管；若私自縮成 15mm，起跳時節流憋壓，洩水速度趕不上產汽速度，水箱必超壓爆裂。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G3 Table G3

content_en: Why is Legionella pneumophila rarely a hazard in domestic instantaneous combi boilers with plate heat exchangers compared to storage cylinders?
content_zh: 與帶大型儲水水罐的系統相比，為什麼在配備板式換熱器的家用即熱式壁掛爐（Combi Boiler）中，軍團菌幾乎不構成任何臨床感染威脅？

options_en.A: Combi boilers kill bacteria with electricity
options_en.B: Instantaneous combi boilers have virtually zero stored hot water volume (<1 to 2 liters in the plate heat exchanger), meaning there is no large lukewarm reservoir for bacterial colonization
options_en.C: Gas fumes sterilize the tap water

options_zh.A: 壁掛爐利用高壓電場將細菌全部電死
options_zh.B: 即熱式壁掛爐內部幾乎「零儲水」（板換及管道內部存水量不足 1 至 2 升），流經即加熱、用完即排空，根本沒有可供細菌長時間安家繁衍的溫水大水槽溫床
options_zh.C: 燃氣煙氣滲入水中殺菌
options_zh.D: 壁掛爐生活熱水中無任何氧氣

explanation_en: Legionella requires time, stagnant lukewarm water, and nutrients to colonize. Instantaneous heaters heat on-demand with minimal water volume, mitigating risk.
explanation_zh: 軍團菌成災需要三大條件：適宜溫度（20-45°C）、長期停滯（數天不動）以及充足養分（沉渣生物膜）。即熱系統無蓄水池，水流呼嘯而過，細菌無處立足。
source_reference: HSE HSG274 Part 2; WHO Legionella Guidelines

content_en: What is the function of the 'Benchmark Hot Water Cylinder Commissioning Checklist' found at the back of every manufacturer unvented cylinder manual?
content_zh: 在每台承壓熱水水罐出廠說明書末尾附帶的「Benchmark 承壓熱水系統調試驗收記錄表」，其法定效力與核心用途是什麼？

options_en.A: A decorative warranty poster for the bathroom wall
options_en.B: A statutory installation record and commissioning log completed and signed by the certified G3 installer, certifying compliance with Building Regulations and validating the manufacturer 25-year warranty
options_en.C: A blank order form for buying copper fittings
options_en.D: An invoice for building control fees

options_zh.A: 張貼在浴室牆壁上的裝飾畫海報
options_zh.B: 由持證 G3 專業技師親筆填寫並簽署的法定竣工驗收記錄表，逐項核驗記錄進水壓、減壓閥標定值、膨脹罐預充氣壓、T&P 起跳測試及水質保護，作為建築法規備案與原廠質保憑證
options_zh.C: 向批發商採購管件的空白訂單
options_zh.D: 地方建築監督局規費發票

explanation_en: The Benchmark checklist is evidence of competent installation under Part G3 and L1. Without a completed, signed checklist, manufacturer warranties are voided.
explanation_zh: Benchmark 是英國給排水行業的法律公信力檔案：詳實記錄調試數據，是地方建築監督局核發合規證明（Compliance Certificate）及廠家兌現保修的唯一憑據。
source_reference: Benchmark Scheme; Building Regulations Approved Document G3

content_en: When installing a standard 114-liter (25-gallon) cold water feed and expansion (F&E) cistern in a loft above an open vented central heating system, what must be its minimum water depth?
content_zh: 在開式供暖系統的閣樓補水膨脹水箱（F&E Tank）中，正常運行冷態下的蓄水深度通常應當保持在多少？

options_en.B: Just deep enough (approx 100mm to 150mm) to submerge the cold feed inlet and ball valve float arm, leaving maximum expansion volume above for water swelling when hot
options_en.C: Filled to within 5mm of the lid

options_zh.A: 始終保持全天候溢流狀態
options_zh.B: 剛好足以淹沒底部補水下水管管口及浮球閥浮球（約 100mm 至 150mm 淺水深），將上方絕大部分容積留作空腔，用以容納供暖管網受熱膨脹湧入的熱水
options_zh.C: 注水注到距離頂蓋僅差 5mm 高水位
options_zh.D: 保持完全抽乾、滴水不存的乾涸狀態

explanation_en: Cold water expands when heated. An F&E tank filled too full cold will overflow outside every time the central heating warms up, wasting treated inhibitor water.
explanation_zh: F&E 水箱是「膨脹緩衝器」。冷態時只需留一層淺水封死管口防止吸入空氣；若冷態就加滿水，一燒暖氣膨脹水無處可去，會把昂貴的防腐藥水全部從溢流管吐掉！
source_reference: BS 5449 Forced circulation hot water central heating systems; C&G Unit 205

content_en: What safety hazard arises if an unvented hot water cylinder expansion relief valve (6 bar) is plumbed to discharge directly into an open rainwater hopper head located right beside a bedroom window?
content_zh: 若安裝工違章將承壓水罐的 6 bar 膨脹安全閥排放管，直接對準臥室窗戶旁邊的敞口金屬雨水漏斗（Hopper Head）凌空排放，會造成何種致命人身危險？

options_en.B: If the safety valve lifts during a major thermal failure, scalding boiling water and blinding 100°C steam will erupt from the open hopper and blast directly into the bedroom window, causing horrific burns to occupants
options_en.D: The boiler flue will catch fire

options_zh.A: 臥室玻璃窗自動變成紫色
options_zh.B: 當系統遭遇嚴重高溫超壓故障安全閥起跳時，滾燙沸水與滾滾高溫蒸汽會從敞口雨水斗處猛烈噴湧爆開，直接灌入開啟的臥室窗戶，造成房內人員遭受毀滅性重度燙傷
options_zh.C: 天降暴雨會倒灌灌滿熱水水罐
options_zh.D: 壁掛爐排煙管引發火災

explanation_en: Approved Document G3 Section 3 prohibits discharging near windows. Boiling steam under high velocity plume will blow into open rooms, risking catastrophic personal injury.
explanation_zh: 法規明令禁止向開口漏斗隨意亂排！安全閥起跳時噴出的是高壓熱浪。若緊挨臥室窗戶，暴烈蒸汽能在一瞬間把窗邊熟睡的嬰兒或老人全身燙爛，屬於嚴重違規。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document G3 Section 3.23

content_en: What temperature should the secondary domestic hot water return loop pipework be insulated to under Building Regulations Approved Document L1?
content_zh: 根據建築節能法規 Approved Document L1 要求，家庭或商用熱水二次循環回水管，其全程保溫厚度必須滿足何種標準？

options_en.B: Insulated to the same high thermal performance standard as the primary hot flow distribution pipework (typically min 15mm to 25mm wall thickness closed-cell insulation)

options_zh.A: 回水管全程無需進行任何保溫
options_zh.B: 必須嚴格比照熱水供水主管的相同高規格保溫標準進行全封閉絕熱包覆（通常採用壁厚不小於 15mm 至 25mm 的難燃橡塑閉孔保溫套管）
options_zh.C: 僅用廚房保鮮膜纏繞兩圈
options_zh.D: 僅在室外明露管段做保溫

explanation_en: Secondary loops circulate water continuously. Uninsulated return pipes act as constant high-output room heaters, bleeding massive energy and overheating hallways.
explanation_zh: 長達數十米的回水管就是一根持續散熱的長暖氣片。若不保溫，每個月白白燒掉數十鎊燃氣費，且夏季會把吊頂管井烤成烤箱，破壞全屋能效。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document L1 Section 4; BS 5422

content_en: Why must unvented hot water cylinders be fitted with a dedicated expansion vessel rather than relying on natural pipe flexibility?
content_zh: 承壓熱水系統為什麼必須強制配置具備足夠膨脹容積的專用金屬膨脹水箱，而絕對不能寄希望於管網材料自身的彈性形變？

options_en.B: Rigid copper and stainless steel pipes have practically zero volumetric expansion capacity; without a compressible gas cushion, thermal expansion pressure spikes instantaneously to destructive rupture levels within seconds

options_zh.A: 金屬管道受熱時會發生物理收縮
options_zh.B: 剛性銅管及雙相鋼水罐的截面擴張彈性幾近於零，而水本身完全不可壓縮；升溫膨脹多出的幾升水若無氣囊可壓縮，水壓在數十秒內便會急劇飆升至數十 bar 炸裂薄弱管件
options_zh.C: 塑料管能主動吸收膨脹水量
options_zh.D: 膨脹水箱兼具除垢功能

explanation_en: Liquids and metals are virtually incompressible. Trapped expanding water generates hydraulic pressures exceeding hundreds of bars without a designated gas cushion.
explanation_zh: 初中物理力學定律：液體受熱強行膨脹產生的液壓推力無窮大。金屬管件無法提供容積形變，唯有依賴充注高壓氮氣的橡膠氣囊提供彈性緩衝空間。
source_reference: BS EN 12828 / BS EN 12897; C&G Unit 202/205

content_en: What is an 'Economy 7' dual immersion heater arrangement in a domestic hot water storage cylinder?
content_zh: 在英國住宅電熱水水罐中，廣泛採用的「Economy 7（離峰七小時雙電熱棒）」節能控制架構是怎樣分工運作的？

options_en.A: Seven heaters running 24 hours a day
options_en.B: A bottom immersion heater wired to off-peak night electricity to heat the full cylinder cheaply overnight, paired with a top booster immersion heater wired to peak day electricity for rapid top-up
options_en.C: A system using 7 volts of electricity
options_en.D: An engine running on diesel fuel

options_zh.A: 7 根加熱棒全天 24 小時不間斷加熱
options_zh.B: 底部長加熱棒接駁「夜間離峰半價電（Off-peak）」定時電錶，在深夜用低廉谷電將整罐水徹底燒熱；頂部短加熱棒接駁「日間平峰火線」，僅在白天熱水耗盡時由用戶手動開啟快速應急補溫
options_zh.C: 採用 7 伏特超低安全電壓供電
options_zh.D: 燃燒柴油驅動的熱水器

explanation_en: Economy 7 utilizes cheap overnight tariffs. The bottom element heats all 200L overnight; the top element provides a quick daytime top-up boost without heating the whole tank.
explanation_zh: 經典英國谷電節能模式：半夜谷電電價僅為白天三分之一，底層大加熱棒把整罐水燒到 65°C；白天洗澡若水量告急，頂層升溫棒只加熱頂部 50 升急用，極度省錢。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 205 Textbook Ch 6

content_en: Under NHS Technical Memorandum HTM 04-01, how long should a sentinel hot water tap in a hospital be run before recording its monthly compliance monitoring temperature?
content_zh: 根據英國國家醫療體系衛生技術備忘錄 (HTM 04-01) 規定，醫院在執行每月的軍團菌水溫法定監測時，前哨出水水龍頭在讀取合規溫度前必須放水持續幾分鐘？

options_en.B: Run for 1 full minute (must achieve at least 55°C within 60 seconds)

options_zh.A: 放水 5 秒鐘
options_zh.B: 放水足 1 整分鐘 (Run for 1 minute，且出水溫度必須在 60 秒內迅速跨越 55°C 警戒線)
options_zh.C: 放水 10 分鐘
options_zh.D: 放水 1 小時

explanation_en: HTM 04-01 mandates testing sentinel taps (nearest and furthest from the calorifier) after 1 minute of running to verify hot circulation integrity across the entire hospital.
explanation_zh: 醫療體系防護鐵律：每月逐一巡檢管網最近端和最遠端「前哨龍頭（Sentinel taps）」，放水 60 秒拿經過校準的數字溫度計測溫，低於 55°C 立即觸發全院管網高溫消毒流程。
source_reference: NHS Health Technical Memorandum 04-01 Part B; HSE HSG274

content_en: What visual inspection must be carried out on an unvented hot water cylinder shell before beginning annual servicing?
content_zh: 在對承壓熱水水罐實施年度例行維保作業時，技師在動工具前首先必須對罐體外殼實施何種外觀目視安全查驗？

options_en.A: Check for signs of external bulging, distortion, structural deformation, rust weeping from seams, or scorching around immersion bosses
options_en.B: Polish the manufacturer logo with wax
options_en.C: Check if the paint matches the wallpaper

options_zh.A: 仔細排查金屬罐體及保溫外殼是否存在異常鼓包起拱、幾何結構失圓扭曲、焊縫滲水冒汗銹跡，或電熱棒螺紋接口處有無過熱焦糊痕跡
options_zh.B: 用汽車蠟擦亮製造商出廠徽標
options_zh.C: 查看外殼顏色是否與房間牆紙搭配
options_zh.D: 僅需測量一下房間空氣濕度

explanation_en: Structural distortion indicates dangerous vessel fatigue or overpressure damage. A bulging cylinder must be decommissioned immediately to prevent fatal rupture.
explanation_zh: 金屬鼓包意味著罐體已承受過災難性超壓屈服變形，晶界分子已經受損拉傷。一旦發現罐體變形失圓，嚴禁二次加壓注水，必須立即整台報廢更換新罐！
source_reference: BS EN 12897 Commissioning; Approved Document G3

content_en: When a domestic hot water storage cylinder is heated by a condensing gas boiler, what is the maximum recommended primary flow temperature from the boiler to ensure the boiler still operates in condensing mode?
content_zh: 當高效冷凝燃氣壁掛爐為熱水儲水水罐加熱時，為確保壁掛爐依然能夠處於高效冷凝模式運行，推薦的鍋爐一次供水水溫上限最好不超過攝氏幾度？

options_en.B: Approximately 70°C to 75°C (with return water temperature below the critical 54°C dew-point)

options_zh.A: 30°C (無法將生活熱水加熱至60°C)
options_zh.B: 大約 70°C 至 75°C 供水水溫 (且回水水溫能迅速冷卻跌落至 54°C 煙氣露點溫度以下以維持冷凝潛熱回收)

explanation_en: Natural gas flue dew point is 54°C. Return temperatures must drop below 54°C for condensing operation. Excessively high primary flow prevents condensation.
explanation_zh: 冷凝鍋爐的秘密在於露點溫度（54°C）：天然氣燃燒產生水蒸氣，回水溫度低於 54°C 煙氣中水蒸氣才能冷凝成水滴釋放巨大汽化潛熱，保證鍋爐運行效率超過 90%。
source_reference: Domestic Heating Design Guide; Energy Saving Trust Guide

content_en: Under BS 1566, what is the maximum permissible static working head for a heavy-gauge 'Grade 1' copper indirect hot water cylinder?
content_zh: 根據英國標準 BS 1566，加厚重型「Grade 1（1級）」紫銅間接式熱水儲水罐，其最大法定允許靜態工作水頭是多少？

options_en.B: 10 meters

options_zh.A: 5 米
options_zh.B: 10 米 (Grade 3)
options_zh.C: 15 米 (Grade 2)
options_zh.D: 25 米靜水頭 (相當於約 2.5 bar / 250 kPa 靜態水壓)

explanation_en: BS 1566 specifies that heavy-gauge Grade 1 copper cylinders are engineered to withstand maximum working heads of up to 25 meters (2.5 bar).
explanation_zh: Grade 1 採用加厚高強度紫銅板打造成型，最大承壓水頭高達 25 米（相當於 2.5 bar 靜壓），常用於高樓底層或大型多層別墅開式熱水系統。
source_reference: BS 1566 Copper indirect cylinders; C&G Unit 205

content_en: Under BS EN 442, what is the design temperature difference (Delta T or ΔT) traditionally used as the testing baseline for rating the heat output of domestic radiators?
content_zh: 根據歐洲/英國標準 BS EN 442，傳統燃氣壁掛爐供暖系統中，用於標定散熱器暖氣片熱輸出額定瓦特數的標準設計溫差（Delta T 或 ΔT）是多少？

options_en.B: Delta T 50°C (ΔT 50 - Mean water temp 70°C minus room temp 20°C)

options_zh.A: Delta T 20°C (ΔT 20)
options_zh.B: Delta T 50°C (ΔT 50，即散熱器平均水溫 70°C 減去室內基準設計溫度 20°C)
options_zh.C: Delta T 80°C
options_zh.D: Delta T 100°C

explanation_en: BS EN 442 defines standard Delta T 50 based on flow 75°C, return 65°C (mean water temp 70°C), and room temperature 20°C (70 - 20 = 50°C ΔT).
explanation_zh: BS EN 442 散熱器行業標準定額：出水 75°C、回水 65°C（平均水溫 70°C），室內 20°C，算得標準溫差 ΔT 50。散熱器廠家彩頁標註的瓦特數默認均以此為準。
source_reference: BS EN 442 Radiators and convectors; C&G Unit 207

content_en: When designing a low-temperature heating system operating with a heat pump (flow 45°C, return 35°C, room 20°C, Delta T 20°C), how does the required radiator size compare to a standard Delta T 50 system?
content_zh: 當供暖系統改用低溫空氣源熱泵運行時（出水 45°C、回水 35°C、室溫 20°C，設計溫差 ΔT 降至 20°C），為達到相同供熱量，散熱器散熱表面積相比於傳統 ΔT 50 系統需要擴大多少？

options_en.A: Radiators can be halved in size
options_en.B: Radiator surface area must be approximately 2 to 2.5 times larger (or fan convectors used)

options_zh.A: 暖氣片尺寸可以直接縮小一半
options_zh.B: 散熱器暖氣片散熱面積必須擴大至大約 2 至 2.5 倍（或改用低溫風機盤管），以補償低水溫下的散熱衰減
options_zh.C: 暖氣片尺寸完全不需做任何變更
options_zh.D: 必須將所有暖氣片全部徹底拆除

explanation_en: At lower ΔT, radiant and convective heat emission falls sharply. Radiators must be roughly double in size to deliver equivalent heat to the room.
explanation_zh: 低溫供暖散熱定律：水溫越低散熱越慢。在 ΔT 20 工況下，相同暖氣片的散熱瓦特數衰減超過 60%，必須換裝加大加厚散熱器才能保證房間溫暖。
source_reference: MCS Heat Pump Design Guide (MIS 3005); BS EN 442

content_en: In standard radiator terminology, what configuration represents a 'Type 22' (K2) panel radiator?
content_zh: 在現代鋼製板式散熱器行業術語中，「Type 22 (或稱 K2)」散熱器代表何種內部結構構造？

options_en.A: Single water panel with no convector fins
options_en.B: Double water panels with double internal corrugated convector fins
options_en.C: Triple water panels with single fin

options_zh.A: 單水道散熱面板，無內部對流散熱鰭片 (Type 10 / P1)
options_zh.B: 雙層水道散熱面板，且兩層面板中間夾裝雙排波紋狀對流散熱翅片 (Double Panel, Double Convector - Type 22 / K2)
options_zh.C: 三層散熱面板配單層翅片
options_zh.D: 帶有 22 根鋼管的散熱器

explanation_en: Type 22 features two water-carrying panels and two rows of welded zig-zag convector fins, maximizing convective airflow output in compact depth.
explanation_zh: 散熱器命名規則：第一位數字代表水道水板層數，第二位代表內部對流翅片排數。Type 22 即「雙板雙翅片」，散熱效率極高，是英國家用主流型號。
source_reference: BS EN 442; Stelrad / Purmo Radiator Technical Catalogues

content_en: What is the mechanical function of corrugated steel 'Convector Fins' spot-welded between the panels of a domestic radiator?
content_zh: 點焊在鋼製散熱器水道面板背部夾層內的波紋狀金屬「對流翅片 (Convector Fins)」，其核心物理功能是什麼？

options_en.B: To vastly increase the total conductive contact surface area exposed to room air, driving vigorous natural convection heat transfer

options_zh.A: 單純增加散熱器的自重防止晃動
options_zh.B: 極大擴展金屬與室內空氣接觸的熱傳導表面積，煙囪效應加速引導冷空氣自下而上流過翅片，形成強勁的自然熱對流循環散熱
options_zh.C: 吸附過濾房間內的懸浮粉塵
options_zh.D: 反射室外強烈陽光

explanation_en: Convector fins increase heat transfer surface area up to 300%, transforming modern panel radiators into powerful natural convective air warmers.
explanation_zh: 雖然俗稱「Radiator 輻射器」，但加裝對流翅片後，暖氣片 75% 以上的熱量是依靠被翅片加熱的對流熱風（Convection）在房間內循環傳遞的。
source_reference: BS EN 442; C&G Unit 207 Central Heating

content_en: What is a 'Two-Pipe Central Heating System' compared to an obsolete one-pipe loop?
content_zh: 與老舊淘汰的單管串聯系統（One-pipe system）相比，現代普遍採用的「雙管並聯供暖系統 (Two-Pipe System)」的核心水力優勢是什麼？

options_en.B: Separate flow and return pipes run in parallel, ensuring every radiator in the property receives water at the same high boiler supply temperature rather than progressively cooler water

options_zh.A: 雙管系統完全不需要燃氣壁掛爐
options_zh.B: 供水管與回水管全程獨立並聯敷設，確保管網中每組暖氣片進水都能直接獲得鍋爐輸出同等高溫的供水，杜絕了單管串聯時下游暖氣片水溫逐個衰減變涼的致命弊端
options_zh.C: 耗電量成倍增加
options_zh.D: 水流永遠在暖氣片內部靜止不動

explanation_en: Two-pipe systems deliver hot water at boiler flow temperature to every emitter, returning cooled water via a common return. In one-pipe systems, return mixes into flow, cooling down-circuit.
explanation_zh: 單管系統「吃前面剩下的溫水」，越往後越涼；雙管並聯系統每組暖氣片進口均為純熱水供水，出水匯入回水幹管，各房間溫度均勻可控。
source_reference: Domestic Heating Design Guide; C&G Unit 207

content_en: What is a 'Microbore' central heating pipework system?
content_zh: 在家庭中央供暖管路佈置中，「微口徑章魚式供暖系統 (Microbore System)」具有何種工藝特徵？

options_en.B: Central flow and return distribution manifolds that distribute heating water to individual radiators via small-diameter, flexible copper or plastic pipe coils (typically 8mm or 10mm outside diameter)
options_en.D: A system for heating water with microwaves

options_zh.A: 全系統採用 100mm 地下大口徑管道
options_zh.B: 由中央供回水分水器（Manifolds）作為核心樞紐，通過 8mm 或 10mm 柔軟可彎曲的小口徑紫銅或塑料盤管，像章魚爪一樣單管直達單獨向每組暖氣片獨立供水
options_zh.C: 完全無管道的空氣供暖系統
options_zh.D: 利用微波爐微波加熱水流的系統

explanation_en: Microbore uses 8mm or 10mm soft coils running from central manifolds directly to radiators, eliminating underfloor joints and enabling rapid installation.
explanation_zh: 微口徑章魚式系統（8-10mm 管徑）盤管極易穿過木地板下穿管，中間零接頭絕無暗埋漏水風險，施工快捷，但對水質清潔度與水力平衡要求極高。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 207 Textbook Ch 7

content_en: What is the function of an Underfloor Heating (UFH) blending (mixing) valve manifold assembly connected to a high-temperature boiler system?
content_zh: 當低溫地板輻射採暖（水地暖 UFH）接入輸出 75°C 高溫水的壁掛爐系統時，地暖分集水器前加裝的「混水溫控閥組 (Blending Valve Assembly)」的功用是什麼？

options_en.B: To blend hot boiler water with cooler UFH return water, regulating flow temperature down to a safe 35°C to 45°C to protect floor finishes from thermal warping and cracking
options_en.C: To filter air out of the floor

options_zh.A: 將木地板直接烘烤至沸騰溫度
options_zh.B: 將壁掛爐輸出的高溫供水與地暖冷回水按比例精密混合，將進入地暖盤管的水溫精準下調調和至 35°C 至 45°C 的低溫安全區，防止實木地板受熱開裂變形或瓷磚空鼓拱起
options_zh.C: 抽走地板夾層內的空氣
options_zh.D: 將地暖水壓升至 50 bar

explanation_en: UFH requires low water temperatures (35-45°C) to prevent damaging wooden timber joists and causing occupant foot discomfort. Blending valves recirculate return water to temper the flow.
explanation_zh: 地暖是低溫大流量供暖：進水超 50°C 人踩上去燙腳，且會烤裂木地板。恆溫混水閥抽取低溫回水混入高溫進水，實現閉環精準溫控。
source_reference: BS EN 1264 Floor heating systems and components; C&G Unit 207

content_en: What is the purpose of 'Hydronic Balancing' across all radiators in a domestic central heating system using their lockshield valves?
content_zh: 在中央供暖系統調試中，利用散熱器回水端的「平衡調節鎖定閥 (Lockshield Valve)」對全屋暖氣片實施「水力平衡調試 (Hydronic Balancing)」的核心目的是什麼？

options_en.A: To make all radiators identical in color
options_en.B: To adjust water flow resistance through each radiator so that every emitter achieves its designated flow rate and designed temperature drop (Delta T, typically 11°C or 20°C), preventing radiators near the boiler from starving distant radiators
options_en.C: To increase the system electricity bill
options_en.D: To vent air from the boiler

options_zh.A: 確保全屋所有暖氣片顏色完全一致
options_zh.B: 調節每組暖氣片的局部通流阻力，使各暖氣片水流量與其散熱負荷精確匹配，均勻達到預設的供回水溫差（如 ΔT 11°C 或 20°C），徹底消除「近水樓台先熱、遠端暖氣片冰涼」的水力失調現象
options_zh.C: 成倍增加全屋供電電費
options_zh.D: 為壁掛爐手動排氣

explanation_en: Water takes the path of least resistance. Unbalanced systems circulate all water through the nearest radiator while distant radiators stay cold. Balancing throttles lockshields to distribute heat evenly.
explanation_zh: 未經平衡的水暖網是災難：水流抄近道全往離鍋爐最近的暖氣片跑，樓上遠端房間凍得發抖。關小近端鎖閉閥、開大遠端，全屋才能均勻升溫。
source_reference: BS EN 14336 Heating systems in buildings - Installation and commissioning; C&G Unit 207

content_en: What is the standard design temperature drop (Delta T) between flow and return across an individual domestic radiator in a traditional boiler system?
content_zh: 在傳統非冷凝或常規燃氣壁掛爐供暖系統中，每組散熱器進出水口之間的標準設計供回水溫差（Delta T）通常是多少？

options_en.B: 11°C (e.g. Flow 75°C, Return 64°C, traditionally used for system sizing)

options_zh.A: 1°C (流量過大)
options_zh.B: 11°C (約 20°F，例如進水 75°C、出水 64°C，傳統水暖調試基準溫差)

explanation_en: Traditional UK wet central heating systems were designed around an 11°C (20°F) temperature drop across radiators, ensuring stable laminar/turbulent heat transfer.
explanation_zh: 經典英國水暖平衡基準：暖氣片進水 75°C，回水 64°C，溫差剛好 11°C。調試時拿紅外測溫槍照進出水管，微調鎖閉閥使溫差穩定在 11°C 即為平衡到位。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 207 Textbook Ch 7

content_en: When commissioning a modern condensing boiler system under BS 7593 / HHIC guidelines, what larger temperature drop (Delta T) between system flow and return is recommended to maximise condensing boiler efficiency?
content_zh: 在調試現代高效冷凝燃氣壁掛爐系統時，行業協會（HHIC）推薦系統總供回水溫差（Delta T）擴大至多少，以確保回水低於露點最大化冷凝能效？

options_en.B: 20°C (e.g. Flow 70°C, Return 50°C, ensuring return is well below the 54°C dew-point)

options_zh.B: 20°C (例如供水 70°C、回水 50°C，確保回水深度跌破 54°C 露點溫度以實現持續冷凝)

explanation_en: Modern condensing boilers operate at peak efficiency with a 20°C ΔT. A 50°C return temperature guarantees the latent heat in flue gases is recovered.
explanation_zh: 現代冷凝爐要求「大溫差、小流量」：供水 70°C、回水 50°C（溫差 20°C）。50°C 的冰涼回水流入主換熱器，才能徹底冷卻排煙使水蒸氣結露凝結，熱效率飆升。
source_reference: Heating and Hotwater Industry Council (HHIC); Domestic Heating Design Guide

content_en: What is an 'S-Plan' central heating and hot water control system?
content_zh: 在英國中央供暖控制電路體系中，經典的「S-Plan 控制系統」的核心管路與閥門配置特徵是什麼？

options_en.A: A single motorized diverter valve sharing heating and hot water
options_en.B: A system utilizing TWO independent 2-port spring-return motorized zone valves (one dedicated to the heating circuit, one dedicated to the hot water cylinder)
options_en.C: A gravity-only system without any electrical controls
options_en.D: A system controlled only by an open fire

options_zh.A: 採用單一的三通分流閥共享暖氣與熱水
options_zh.B: 採用「兩台完全獨立的 2 通（2-Port）彈簧復位電動分區閥門」（一台專門控制暖氣管路，另一台專門控制熱水水罐盤管）
options_zh.C: 完全無任何電氣控制的純重力對流系統
options_zh.D: 僅由壁爐火堆手動控制的系統

explanation_en: S-Plan features two separate 2-port zone valves providing fully independent control of heating and domestic hot water. Both can run simultaneously or separately.
explanation_zh: S-Plan 是全英最經典、最穩定可靠的控制架構：暖氣一個閥、熱水一個閥，互不干涉。開暖氣不影響燒熱水，夏天關暖氣單獨燒水，擴展三區採暖（S-Plan Plus）極其方便。
source_reference: Honeywell Domestic Central Heating Controls Guide; C&G Unit 207

content_en: What is a 'Y-Plan' central heating and hot water control system?
content_zh: 在供暖電氣控制體系中，廣泛應用的「Y-Plan 控制系統」的核心特徵是什麼？

options_en.A: A system powered by yellow batteries
options_en.B: A system using a SINGLE 3-port mid-position motorized valve to divert primary water to Heating Only (Port A), Hot Water Only (Port B), or Mid-Position shared to both simultaneously
options_en.C: A system where all radiators are painted yellow

options_zh.A: 由黃色蓄電池供電的低壓系統
options_zh.B: 全系統僅採用「單個 3 通三位電動閥 (3-Port Mid-position Valve)」：通過電機與內部微動電阻聯動，切換實現單獨暖氣 (A口)、單獨熱水 (B口) 或中間位雙供 (AB雙開)
options_zh.C: 所有散熱器全部塗成黃色的系統
options_zh.D: 完全沒有鍋爐的系統

explanation_en: Y-Plan uses one 3-port mid-position valve. It offers three distinct operating states: Hot Water only, Heating only, or Both simultaneously.
explanation_zh: Y-Plan 節省成本（僅需一個閥），但接線邏輯複雜：靠閥內二極管微動開關在中間位平衡電壓維持開度，若閥芯水垢卡阻維修難度高於 S-Plan。
source_reference: Honeywell Y-Plan Wiring Specification; C&G Unit 207

content_en: Under Building Regulations Approved Document L1, what is the mandatory requirement known as 'Boiler Interlock'?
content_zh: 根據英國建築節能法規 Approved Document L1 強制規定，什麼是所有供暖系統必須具備的「壁掛爐聯鎖控制 (Boiler Interlock)」？

options_en.A: A physical padlock locked around the boiler casing
options_en.B: An electrical wiring control arrangement ensuring the boiler and circulator pump are automatically switched OFF when there is no demand for heat from either the room thermostat or the cylinder thermostat
options_en.C: A valve that locks the water inside the radiator
options_en.D: An anti-theft alarm on the gas meter

options_zh.A: 鎖在壁掛爐外殼上的一把實體防盜掛鎖
options_zh.B: 一種電氣電路控制接線聯鎖機制，確保當室內溫控器與熱水罐溫控器均達到預設溫度（無熱負荷需求）時，壁掛爐燃燒器與循環水泵必須「完全強制自動關停」
options_zh.C: 將水鎖死在散熱器內部的自鎖閥門
options_zh.D: 燃氣表上的防盜防撬報警器

explanation_en: Boiler interlock is an electrical control interlock (not a physical lock). If rooms are warm and hot water is satisfied, the boiler MUST shut down, eliminating dry cycling.
explanation_zh: 聯鎖是節能鐵律：若僅靠散熱器恆溫閥截斷而無牆面溫控器聯鎖，各房閥門雖關閉，鍋爐卻因未得信號仍在自發反覆燃燒打轉。聯鎖徹底杜絕這種能源大浪費。
source_reference: Building Regulations Approved Document L1 Section 5; C&G Unit 207

content_en: Why should a Thermostatic Radiator Valve (TRV) NEVER be installed on the radiator in the same room / hallway where the master wall-mounted Room Thermostat is located?
content_zh: 為什麼在安裝有全屋主牆面溫控器（Master Room Thermostat）的同一個房間或走廊內，該處的暖氣片上絕對嚴格禁止安裝「散熱器恆溫閥 (TRV)」？

options_en.B: The two temperature sensors will 'fight' each other: if the TRV shuts off before the wall thermostat is satisfied, the wall thermostat will never reach setpoint, forcing the boiler to fire continuously 24/7
options_en.C: It is an electrical shock hazard

options_zh.A: 暖氣片會因超壓發生爆炸
options_zh.B: 兩個溫控設備會發生致命的「相互打架/控制衝突」：若暖氣片上的 TRV 提前感知水溫關死，主牆面溫控器周圍永遠達不到設定室溫，導致信號無法切斷，壁掛爐被迫 24 小時晝夜長開瘋狂空燒
options_zh.C: 存在嚴重的觸電致死風險
options_zh.D: TRV 閥頭會自動變藍

explanation_en: Installing a TRV in the reference room defeats the boiler interlock. The room stat never sees warm air, trapping the boiler in continuous maximum burn.
explanation_zh: 主溫控房間暖氣片必須採用手動雙聯閥（Wheelhead）全開！若被 TRV 自行關閉，主溫控器永遠等不來暖氣，下達持續點火指令，全家其他房間被活活烤焦，燃氣費飆升。
source_reference: Domestic Building Services Compliance Guide; C&G Unit 207

content_en: What is the operational function of an Automatic Differential Bypass Valve (ABV) in a modern central heating system under Building Regulations Part L?
content_zh: 根據建築法規 Part L 強制要求，在現代中央供暖系統中加裝「自動差壓旁通閥 (Automatic Bypass Valve - ABV)」的核心功用是什麼？

options_en.A: To vent air to the outside
options_en.B: To maintain a minimum design flow rate of water through the boiler heat exchanger as individual TRVs close across the house, preventing pump cavitation, boiler lockouts, and pipe whistle
options_en.C: To dump water down the sewer

options_zh.A: 將管內空氣排向室外
options_zh.B: 當全屋各房間暖氣片的 TRV 恆溫閥隨室溫上升逐個關閉時，自動感應壓差並打開旁通管路，維持穿過壁掛爐主換熱器的法定最低循環流量，保護水泵免於卡死憋壓並防止鍋爐乾燒停機
options_zh.C: 將系統水全部洩入下水道
options_zh.D: 手動提升房間室溫

explanation_en: When TRVs close, circuit resistance spikes. An ABV modulates open to sustain minimum water flow across the boiler, preventing burner cycling on high-limit overheat.
explanation_zh: 若無旁通閥，全屋 TRV 關閉瞬間水流完全斷絕，水泵頂著死堵狂轉過熱，壁掛爐瞬間乾燒炸鍋。差壓閥在阻力超標時自發開啟短路循環，平穩過渡保護設備。
source_reference: Domestic Building Services Compliance Guide; BS EN 12828

content_en: Under BS 7593:2019, what protective device is now permanently MANDATORY on all domestic central heating system installations in the UK?
content_zh: 根據英國國家標準 BS 7593:2019 最新強制規範，在全英所有新建或更換壁掛爐的家庭供暖系統中，哪一種保護配件被提升為法定的「永久強制必裝件」？

options_en.B: An in-line magnetic system filter (fitted on the primary heating return pipe upstream of the boiler)

options_zh.A: 全自動離子交換軟水機
options_zh.B: 在線磁性系統過濾器 (In-line Magnetic System Filter，強制安裝在緊鄰壁掛爐前端的採暖回水主管道上)
options_zh.C: 純銅膨脹水箱
options_zh.D: 輔助青銅增壓泵

explanation_en: BS 7593:2019 mandates an in-line magnetic filter on the heating return to capture black iron oxide sludge (magnetite) before it enters high-efficiency boiler heat exchangers.
explanation_zh: 2019年修訂的 BS 7593 將在線磁性過濾器（如 MagnaClean / Fernox TF1）列為法律強制項：其內部強磁芯能在黑渣黑泥流回鍋爐前將其 100% 捕獲吸附，保護高效換熱器。
source_reference: BS 7593:2019 Code of practice for preparation, commissioning and maintenance; HHIC

content_en: What is 'Magnetite' (black iron oxide sludge - Fe3O4) formed inside a wet central heating system?
content_zh: 在供暖水力管網內部自發生成的「磁鐵礦黑泥/黑渣 (Magnetite - 黑色四氧化三鐵 Fe3O4)」是怎樣形成的？

options_en.A: Dirt blown in through the boiler flue
options_en.B: A heavy, abrasive, magnetic black sludge produced by the internal electrolytic chemical corrosion of steel radiator panels in the presence of water and dissolved oxygen
options_en.C: Sand mixed in by the plumber

options_zh.A: 由室外強風通過鍋爐煙道倒灌吹入的沙塵
options_zh.B: 鋼製散熱器暖氣片內壁在水與微量溶解氧的共同作用下，發生電化學內腐蝕剝落而生成的極細、具高磨損性與強磁性的黑色氧化鐵淤泥
options_zh.C: 施工人員不慎倒入口內的泥沙
options_zh.D: 塑料管道老化降解產物

explanation_en: Magnetite is magnetic black iron oxide sludge (Fe3O4) formed by internal radiator corrosion. It settles in boiler heat exchangers and circulator impellers, causing blockages and noisy failure.
explanation_zh: 黑泥是壁掛爐的「頭號殺手」：鋼製散熱器生鏽脫落的氧化鐵沉渣顆粒極細且具強磁性，隨水流流經壁掛爐微小換熱扁管和水泵磁電機時會死死吸附結垢，導致燒穿換熱器。
source_reference: BS 7593:2019; Sentinel / Fernox Water Treatment Guides

content_en: Under BS 7593:2019, how often must the chemical corrosion and scale inhibitor concentration in a domestic central heating system be formally tested and refreshed?
content_zh: 根據 BS 7593:2019 供暖水維保法規，中央供暖系統內部注入的化學緩蝕阻垢劑（Chemical Inhibitor）濃度，法定必須每隔多久重新檢測並補充足量？

options_en.B: Tested annually during scheduled boiler servicing, and full re-dosing / top-up refreshed at least every 5 years

options_zh.A: 每 50 年檢測一次
options_zh.B: 在每年例行壁掛爐年檢保養時必須使用試劑或儀器檢測其有效濃度，且至少每 5 年必須進行一次全系統藥劑全量補投與更新
options_zh.C: 永久無需任何檢測補充
options_zh.D: 每 24 小時添加一次

explanation_en: Inhibitor chemicals degrade over time. BS 7593 requires annual concentration testing (using dip strips or test kits) and mandatory refreshing of chemical dosing every 5 years.
explanation_zh: 緩蝕劑分子會隨時間推移逐漸被腐蝕反應消耗失效。規範強制年檢拿試紙測濃度，低於閾值必須立即補加一瓶藥劑，且每 5 年必須全面重新加註，終身保護管網。
source_reference: BS 7593:2019 Section 8 Maintenance of domestic heating systems

content_en: What three sequential commissioning steps are mandatory for chemical water treatment under BS 7593:2019 before signing off a new boiler installation?
content_zh: 根據 BS 7593:2019 標準，在正式驗收簽發一台新壁掛爐之前，供暖水路系統必須依序嚴格落實哪「三步法」標準清洗工藝？

options_en.A: Paint the boiler, polish the taps, wipe the floor
options_en.B: 1. Cleanse (flush with proprietary system cleaner to remove flux and installation swarf); 2. In-line magnetic filter installation; 3. Inhibit (dose with certified chemical corrosion and scale inhibitor)
options_en.C: Fill with tap water and leave forever
options_en.D: Drain the system and leave empty

options_zh.A: 給鍋爐刷漆、拋光水龍頭、擦拭地板
options_zh.B: 第一步：化學清洗（加入專用系統清洗劑動態循環徹底沖刷剝離焊劑殘渣、切削油與鐵鏽）；第二步：安裝磁性過濾器；第三步：加註經認證的化學緩蝕阻垢保護劑 (Inhibitor)
options_zh.C: 注滿自來水後永久封閉不管
options_zh.D: 將系統水全部排空保持乾涸

explanation_en: BS 7593 mandates: 1. Chemical cleaning and power flushing, 2. Installing an in-line magnetic filter, and 3. Dosing certified corrosion inhibitor (tested with an on-site test kit).
explanation_zh: 三步法缺一不可：不洗管路殘留的酸性焊膏幾個月就會腐蝕穿孔主換熱器；不安裝磁性過濾器黑渣無法排出；不加保護劑鋼製暖氣片會加速生鏽。正規調試必須出具加藥憑證。
source_reference: BS 7593:2019; Benchmark Commissioning Checklist

content_en: What is a 'Motorized Diverter Valve' in a W-Plan central heating system?
content_zh: 在供暖控制工程中，採用「W-Plan 系統架構」時使用的三通切換閥（Diverter Valve）具有何種控制特性？

options_en.A: It directs water to either hot water OR heating exclusively (priority hot water), but never to both simultaneously
options_en.B: It generates hot water using solar power

options_zh.A: 它是一種「二選一」的優先切換閥：要麼將全部熱水專供生活熱水水罐（熱水優先模式），要麼全部專供暖氣片採暖，兩者「絕對無法同時雙開供暖」
options_zh.B: 利用太陽能製造高溫熱水
options_zh.C: 調節管內燃氣壓力
options_zh.D: 消除管內水錘衝擊

explanation_en: A diverter valve (W-Plan) directs flow to Port A OR Port B exclusively. It provides priority hot water (diverting all boiler capacity to heat the cylinder rapidly before heating rooms).
explanation_zh: W-Plan 奉行「生活熱水絕對優先」：洗澡燒水時二通閥完全切斷暖氣片，鍋爐全功率幾分鐘燒熱水箱，水箱一滿立即翻轉閥板恢復暖氣供熱，系統成本極低。
source_reference: C&G 6035 Unit 207 Textbook Ch 7

content_en: Why is 15mm copper tube generally limited to carrying a maximum heating load of approx 4.5 kW to 6.0 kW under standard 11°C Delta T conditions?
content_zh: 在標準供回水溫差 11°C 的家用供暖系統中，為什麼 15mm 銅管分支幹管推薦承載的最大供熱負荷上限通常被限制在 4.5 kW 至 6.0 kW 左右？

options_en.A: The copper pipe melts at 6 kW
options_en.B: Exceeding this heat capacity requires a water flow rate where fluid velocity exceeds 1.0 m/s to 1.5 m/s, causing excessive frictional resistance head loss and audible water flow hiss/noise in living rooms
options_en.C: It makes the room too cold
options_en.D: 15mm copper pipe cannot hold hot water

options_zh.A: 銅管在 6 kW 熱負荷下會自發融化
options_zh.B: 超過此散熱負荷所需輸送的水流量，會迫使 15mm 細管內的水流流速飆升突破 1.0 至 1.5 m/s 極限，造成沿程水頭阻力損失急劇飆升並在臥室產生刺耳的水流嘶嘶流動噪音
options_zh.C: 會使房間室溫變得過於寒冷
options_zh.D: 15mm 銅管無法承受熱水輸送

explanation_en: Flow equation Q = m·c·ΔT. High heat loads through narrow 15mm pipes increase velocity above acoustic limits (>1.0 m/s), creating severe pump head loss and noisy pipes.
explanation_zh: 管徑與流速水力平衡：流速超過 1 米/秒，水流摩擦管壁會發出如同蛇吐信般的滋滋水聲，且阻力劇增導致末端暖氣片吃不到水。大於 6 kW 負荷必須升級為 22mm 銅管。
source_reference: Domestic Heating Design Guide; C&G Unit 207

content_en: What copper pipe diameter is universally standard for primary flow and return distribution mains running between the boiler and heating manifolds in typical domestic dwellings?
content_zh: 在典型英國家用住宅中央供暖工程中，連接壁掛爐與各分區閥門/分水器之間的供回水主幹管，普遍標準採用的銅管外徑是多少？

options_en.B: 15 mm
options_en.C: 22 mm (or 28 mm for large boilers exceeding 24 kW)

options_zh.A: 10 mm (微口徑支管)
options_zh.B: 15 mm (單組暖氣片支管)
options_zh.C: 22 mm (或鍋爐功率超過 24 kW 時採用 28 mm 主幹管)
options_zh.D: 54 mm (商用管徑)

explanation_en: 22mm copper handles heat outputs up to approx 12-15 kW at standard design velocities, while 28mm is specified for outputs up to 25-30 kW from modern system boilers.
explanation_zh: 主幹管負責全屋熱量總動脈。22mm 管承載 15 kW、28mm 管承載 30 kW，若主幹管誤用 15mm 粗製濫造，全屋水力循環將遭遇嚴重瓶頸卡阻，暖氣片大面積不熱。
source_reference: Domestic Heating Design Guide Table 4.1; C&G Unit 207

content_en: What is a 'Type 11' (K1) panel radiator?
content_zh: 在鋼製板式散熱器產品代碼中，「Type 11 (K1)」散熱器具有何種幾何截面外觀？

options_en.A: Single water-carrying front panel with a single row of welded internal convector fins
options_en.B: Double panels with no fins

options_zh.A: 單層水道前面板，背部焊接單排金屬對流散熱鰭片 (Single Panel, Single Convector - Type 11 / K1)
options_zh.B: 雙層面板無鰭片
options_zh.C: 老式鑄鐵柱形散熱器
options_zh.D: 由 11 根管組成的散熱器

explanation_en: Type 11 (K1) features a slim profile comprising one water panel and one layer of convective fins, ideal for narrow hallways and small powder rooms.
explanation_zh: Type 11 是最纖薄的標準對流暖氣片（厚度僅約 50-60mm）：單板單翅片，厚度薄不佔過道空間，適合安裝在空間狹窄的小走廊、樓梯間或衛生間。
source_reference: BS EN 442; Stelrad Technical Specifications

content_en: What is a 'Type 21' (P+) panel radiator?
content_zh: 散熱器規格中的「Type 21 (又稱 P+ 型)」散熱器，其內部構造是怎樣的？

options_en.A: Double water-carrying panels (front and back) with a SINGLE row of internal convector fins between them
options_en.B: Single panel with triple fins

options_zh.A: 雙層水道面板（前後各一塊），且兩層面板中間僅夾裝「單排 (Single Row)」對流散熱鰭片 (Type 21 / P+)
options_zh.B: 單塊面板配三排翅片
options_zh.C: 金屬鉛製造的散熱器
options_zh.D: 吊頂排風扇

explanation_en: Type 21 (P+) provides double water panels with one internal fin row, delivering intermediate heat output between a slim Type 11 and a deep Type 22.
explanation_zh: Type 21（P+）是兼顧厚度與散熱量的折中產品：外觀為前後雙水板，中間單翅片，厚度比 Type 22 薄約 30%，在窗台深度受限時廣泛替代 Type 22。
source_reference: BS EN 442; Radiator Engineering Manual

content_en: What is a 'Type 33' (K3) panel radiator?
content_zh: 高熱負荷場所專用的「Type 33 (K3 型)」超強散熱器，其內部由幾層面板和翅片疊加而成？

options_en.A: Triple water-carrying panels with TRIPLE rows of internal convector fins
options_en.B: Single panel with 33 fins

options_zh.A: 三層水道面板（前中後三塊），且夾層內焊接「三排 (Triple Rows)」對流散熱鰭片 (Type 33 / K3)
options_zh.B: 單層面板焊接 33 個翅片
options_zh.C: 長達 33 米的超長暖氣片
options_zh.D: 三根水管簡單焊接
