explanation_en: Type B (3-5x In) handles domestic resistive circuits without nuisance tripping. Type C (5-10x In) tolerates the brief inductive inrush surge when heat pump compressors or motor pumps start up.
explanation_zh: 空開 B 型與 C 型選型考點：普通電暖器電燈用 B 型空開（靈敏度高，超載 3-5 倍立刻跳）；但熱泵壓縮機、大水泵啟動瞬間電機線圈有巨大衝擊電流（啟動浪涌），用 B 型會一開機就跳！必須換 C 型空開（抗 5-10 倍浪涌不誤跳）！
source_reference: BS EN 60898-1; BS 7671 Section 411; C&G Unit 208

content_en: What is an 'RCBO' (BS EN 61009) installed in modern domestic consumer units?
content_zh: 現代家庭配電箱中廣泛採用的「RCBO (複合型漏電斷路器 - 符合 BS EN 61009)」，集成了哪兩大保護裝置的雙重功能？

options_en.B: A single modular device combining the overcurrent/short-circuit protection of an MCB with the earth leakage protection of an RCD in one single din-rail module
options_en.C: A manual light switch and bell

options_zh.A: 無線電廣播收音機與電子時鐘
options_zh.B: 將微型斷路器（MCB）的過載短路保護、與漏電保護器（RCD）的接地漏電保護「二合一完美集成」在單個標準導軌模塊內的獨立全功能保護斷路器
options_zh.C: 手動照明開關與門鈴
options_zh.D: 保險絲與充電電池複合體

explanation_en: An RCBO merges an MCB and an RCD. If a fault occurs on one circuit (e.g. immersion heater leaks to earth), only that individual RCBO trips, leaving lighting and freezers running across all other circuits.
explanation_zh: RCBO 獨立二合一神器：以前半個配電箱共用一個大 RCD，一個插座漏電，全家跳閘陷入黑暗、冰箱化凍！RCBO 是一路一個獨立保險箱：兼具過載 + 漏電雙重功能，哪路出事只跳哪一路，絕不株連全屋其他電器！
source_reference: BS EN 61009 Residual current operated circuit-breakers with integral overcurrent protection

content_en: What fuse rating is universally specified inside the 13A switched Fused Connection Spur (FCU) supplying a domestic central heating gas boiler and its external controls?
content_zh: 在家庭中央採暖燃氣壁掛爐及其外部溫控聯動電路的專用 13A 熔斷保護接線盒（Fused Spur）內部，全英標準指定的保險絲管額定電流是多少？

options_en.B: A 100-Ampere fuse

options_zh.A: 3 安培 (3A) 專用陶瓷管保險絲 (符合 BS 1362 標準)
options_zh.B: 100 安培重載保險絲
options_zh.C: 32 安培大容量保險絲
options_zh.D: 完全不需要安裝任何保險絲

explanation_en: Boiler manufacturers and BS 7671 dictate that central heating controls and boilers must be protected by a 3A fuse. A 13A fuse will not blow quickly enough to protect sensitive PCB electronics during an internal short.
explanation_zh: 壁掛爐 3A 保險絲鐵律必考：壁掛爐開關盒外表雖然是個 13A 盒子，但肚子裡必須裝「3 安培（3A，紅色小保險絲）」！壁掛爐主板全是微電子芯片，若無知換成 13A 粗保險絲，短路時主板直接燒穿化成灰保險絲都不斷！必須嚴格 3A！
source_reference: BS 1362; BS 7671; Domestic Heating Design Guide; C&G Unit 208

content_en: Under BS 7671 Section 701 (Locations containing a bath or shower), what are the designated electrical safety zones recognized in domestic bathrooms?
content_zh: 根據英國電工法規 BS 7671 第 701 節（包含浴缸或淋浴的潮濕場所），家庭浴室內部劃分為哪三個法定電氣安全分區？

options_en.B: Zone 0, Zone 1, and Zone 2 (with the remaining room space designated as Outside the Zones)
options_en.D: Hot Zone, Cold Zone, and Wet Zone

options_zh.A: Alpha 區、Beta 區、以及 Gamma 區
options_zh.B: Zone 0 (0區)、Zone 1 (1區)、以及 Zone 2 (2區)（其餘超出上述邊界的浴室空間統稱為分區外空間 Outside Zones）
options_zh.C: Zone 1、Zone 2、Zone 3、以及 Zone 4
options_zh.D: 熱水區、冷水區、以及潮濕區

explanation_en: BS 7671 Section 701 classifies bathrooms into Zone 0 (submerged), Zone 1 (spray/splash above tray/bath to 2.25m), and Zone 2 (0.6m perimeter radius around Zone 1 up to 2.25m).
explanation_zh: 浴室電氣三防區必背：Zone 0（水底下，浴缸或底盤內部）；Zone 1（浴缸底盤正上方至 2.25 米淋浴噴淋區）；Zone 2（Zone 1 向外延伸 60 公分半徑的防濺緩衝區）。2 區之外叫分區外（Outside zones）。
source_reference: BS 7671:2018 Section 701; C&G Unit 208

content_en: Under BS 7671 Section 701, what is the boundary definition of 'Zone 0' in a domestic bathroom, and what MINIMUM Ingress Protection (IP) rating is mandatory for any electrical equipment installed within it?
content_zh: 根據 BS 7671 第 701 節規定，家庭浴室內的「Zone 0 (0區)」是指何處空間範圍？安裝在該分區內的任何電氣設備必須具備的「最低防水防護等級 (IP Rating)」是多少？

options_en.B: The interior of the bathtub or shower basin; minimum IPX7 (protection against total water immersion up to 1 meter depth)

options_zh.A: 浴室吊頂石膏板天花板；IP20
options_zh.B: 浴缸或淋浴底盤內部的盛水浸沒空間；最低強制防護等級為 IPX7 (具備抵禦深入 1 米水深完全浸泡的卓越水密性能)
options_zh.C: 浴室梳妝鏡背後；IP00
options_zh.D: 浴室大門外側；IP68

explanation_en: Zone 0 is the physical water-holding tub/basin. Because equipment is submerged under water, it demands at least IPX7 (immersion-proof) and may only be powered by 12V AC SELV.
explanation_zh: Zone 0 浸水區防護鐵律：0 區就是洗澡時泡在水裡的缸底！人整個泡在水裡，皮膚電阻幾乎為零。任何水下燈具必須達到 IPX7（耐 1 米水浸泡），且電壓嚴禁超 12V 安全特低電壓（SELV）！

content_en: What is the maximum permissible electrical operating voltage and supply safety type allowed for any electrical equipment (e.g. whirlpool bath jets) located inside Zone 0?
content_zh: 在浴室 Zone 0 (0區) 盛水內部，法規允許安裝的電氣設備（如水療衝浪浴缸水下噴頭）的「最高允許工作電壓與供電安全制式」是什麼？

options_en.B: Safety Extra-Low Voltage (SELV) not exceeding 12 Volts AC rms or 30 Volts ripple-free DC, with the safety isolation source situated outside Zones 0, 1, and 2

options_zh.A: 230 伏特市電交流高壓直供
options_zh.B: 安全特低電壓 (SELV)，額定工作電壓「不超過 12 伏特交流電 (12V AC) 或 30 伏特無紋波直流電 (30V DC)」，且其隔離安全變壓器電源必須深藏在 0、1、2 區之外！
options_zh.C: 10,000 伏特直流電
options_zh.D: 400 伏特工業三相動力電

explanation_en: Zone 0 allows only SELV max 12V AC (or 30V DC). The safety isolating transformer must be sited outside Zones 0, 1, and 2 (e.g. in the ceiling void or outside the bathroom entirely).
explanation_zh: 0 區 12V 生命極限：水下絕對嚴禁進 230V 市電！只能用 12V SELV（安全特低電壓）。變壓器本體必須裝在天花板頂上或浴室門外，只有 12V 弱電能進浴缸底，就算電線皮破了人摸到也絕對死不了！
source_reference: BS 7671:2018 Regulation 701.55; C&G Unit 208

content_en: Under BS 7671 Section 701, what are the spatial dimensions of 'Zone 1' in a bathroom containing a shower tray, and what MINIMUM IP rating is required for electrical fixtures (e.g. an electric shower)?
content_zh: 根據 BS 7671 第 701 節規定，在帶有淋浴底盤的浴室中，「Zone 1 (1區)」的立體空間邊界如何界定？安裝在該分區內的電氣設備（如即熱式電淋浴器）法定的「最低 IP 防護等級」是多少？

options_en.A: From the floor to 5 meters; IP00
options_en.B: Vertically above the shower tray to a height of 2.25 meters above the finished floor level (or the highest shower head if higher); minimum rating IPX4 (or IPX5 if subjected to water jets)

options_zh.A: 從地面向上延伸至 5 米高空；IP00
options_zh.B: 淋浴底盤正上方垂直投影、自完成面地面向上延伸至「2.25 米高處」（若花灑固定點更高則延伸至花灑最高點）；法定最低防護等級為 IPX4 (防濺型，若會遭受高壓水柱衝洗則升級為 IPX5)
options_zh.C: 木地板下方暗處；IP65
options_zh.D: 馬桶圈周圍；IP20

explanation_en: Zone 1 is the active showering zone up to 2.25m high. Fixtures must be minimum IPX4 (splash-proof from all angles). If high-pressure water cleaning jets are used, IPX5 is mandatory.
explanation_zh: Zone 1 淋浴噴霧區必背：花灑下洗澡的區域！從地面向上打到 2.25 米（洗澡水漫天飛舞的地方）。裝在裡面的即熱電熱水器、排風扇最低必須是 IPX4（防任何角度水花潑濺），嚴禁用普通不防水電器！

content_en: Under BS 7671 Regulation 701.55, which electrical equipment is PERMITTED to be installed inside Zone 1 of a domestic bathroom?
content_zh: 根據 BS 7671 第 701.55 條規定，在浴室 Zone 1 (1區) 內部，被法律明確允許固定安裝的電氣設備有哪些？

options_en.A: Standard 13A domestic socket outlets and electric toasters
options_en.B: Fixed and permanently connected equipment specifically rated for Zone 1: electric instantaneous showers, water heaters, shower waste pumps, low-voltage luminaires, and SELV equipment (min IPX4)

options_zh.A: 標準 13A 家用三孔插座與烤麵包機
options_zh.B: 通過認證且永久硬線連接的專用電氣設備：即熱式電淋浴器 (Electric Showers)、貯水式電熱水器、淋浴強排污水泵、特種防水低壓照明燈具、以及 SELV 特低電壓設備（最低防護等級 IPX4）
options_zh.C: 台式液晶電視機與微波爐
options_zh.D: 外露發熱電爐絲的電暖氣

explanation_en: Zone 1 permits only fixed appliances rated for the environment (electric showers, water heaters, shower waste pumps) with min IPX4. Standard 230V socket-outlets are strictly forbidden.
explanation_zh: 1 區准入電器清單：除了洗澡必須的即熱電淋浴器、淋浴底盤強排泵、防水吸頂燈外，嚴禁裝任何普通插座開關！電淋浴器出廠密封達到 IPX4，且必須由專門硬線固定接線，普通插頭插座一律槍斃！
source_reference: BS 7671:2018 Regulation 701.55; C&G Unit 208

content_en: Under BS 7671 Section 701, what are the spatial limits of 'Zone 2' in a domestic bathroom, and what is its minimum required IP rating?
content_zh: 根據 BS 7671 規定，家庭浴室內的「Zone 2 (2區)」空間範圍邊界如何劃定？其最低法定 IP 防護等級是多少？

options_en.B: Extends 0.60 meters (600mm) horizontally beyond the outer perimeter of Zone 1, and vertically up to a height of 2.25 meters above the finished floor; minimum rating IPX4

options_zh.A: 臥室大衣櫃內部；IP20
options_zh.B: 自 Zone 1 外邊界水平向外延伸「0.60 米 (600mm)」，垂直高度自地面延伸至「2.25 米」高度處；最低防護等級為 IPX4 (防濺水型)
options_zh.C: 廚房洗菜盆下方；IP68
options_zh.D: 現代電工法規已取消 2 區

explanation_en: Zone 2 extends 0.6m beyond the bath/shower rim up to 2.25m height. Water splashes can reach this zone, requiring minimum IPX4 splash-proof equipment.
explanation_zh: Zone 2 緩衝防濺區必背：站在浴缸邊緣，向外量 60 公分（0.6 米）、高 2.25 米這一圈！水滴和濕手容易甩到這裡，防護等級依然必須是 IPX4！可以裝帶隔離變壓器的刮鬍刀插座、專用防水壁燈。

content_en: What specific type of electrical socket is legally permitted to be installed inside Zone 2 of a domestic bathroom?
content_zh: 在家庭浴室的 Zone 2 (2區) 範圍內，法律唯一允許安裝的插座類電氣附件是什麼？

options_en.A: A standard 13A switched double socket outlet
options_en.B: A dedicated Shaver Supply Unit incorporating an internal safety isolating transformer complying with BS EN 61558-2-5 (limited to 20VA-50VA)

options_zh.A: 標準 13A 帶開關雙位家用市電插座
options_zh.B: 符合 BS EN 61558-2-5 標準、內置雙重絕緣安全隔離變壓器的專用「刮鬍刀專用插座 (Shaver Supply Unit)」(功率死死限制在 20VA 至 50VA 之間)
options_zh.C: 32A 工業重型防水公母插座
options_zh.D: 大功率電動汽車直流充電插座

explanation_en: Regulation 701.512.3 prohibits standard sockets in Zone 2, but expressly permits shaver units complying with BS EN 61558-2-5. An isolating transformer breaks the earth loop, making accidental contact non-fatal.
explanation_zh: 刮鬍刀插座唯一特權必考：浴室鏡子旁唯一的插座！它肚子裡藏著個 1:1 隔離變壓器，電壓是浮動的、完全不對地形成迴路！即使手濕摸到插孔，電流也不會順著人體流向大地，因此法規特批允許裝在 2 區！

content_en: Under BS 7671 (18th Edition including Amendment 2:2022), under what strict distance and protection rules are standard 230V 13A socket-outlets permitted in a large domestic bathroom?
content_zh: 根據 BS 7671（第 18 版及 2022 年修正案 2）規定，在面積寬敞的大型家庭浴室中，普通 230V 家用三孔插座在何種距離與防護要求下才被法規允許安裝？

options_en.A: Inside the bathtub submerged in water
options_en.B: Permitted ONLY if installed at least 2.5 meters (formerly 3.0 meters) horizontally from the outer boundary of Zone 1, and the circuit MUST be protected by a 30mA RCD
options_en.C: Directly next to the shower head without RCD
options_en.D: Sockets are banned in all rooms

options_zh.A: 直接安裝在浴缸內壁浸沒在水中
options_zh.B: 必須距離 Zone 1 淋浴邊界水平距離「至少 2.5 米以外」（2022 年修正案由原 3.0 米縮小至 2.5 米），且該插座電路必須由 30mA 漏保（RCD）實施快速跳閘保護！
options_zh.C: 直接裝在花灑正下方且不設漏保
options_zh.D: 英國建築法規在所有房間內全面取締插座

explanation_en: Amendment 2 (2022) reduced the minimum distance from 3.0m to 2.5m from Zone 1. Standard 230V socket-outlets are prohibited in small UK bathrooms because typical dimensions cannot satisfy the 2.5m clearance.
explanation_zh: 浴室普通插座 2.5 米紅線：英國小浴室絕不見插座！因為新法規放寬後也死死卡定：普通 13A 插座離花灑 Zone 1 邊緣必須至少 2.5 米遠（防人拿吹風機掉進浴缸）！且必須配備 30mA 漏保。小衛生間根本不夠尺寸！

content_en: Why are ceiling-mounted 'Pull-Cord' switches (for lighting or shower isolation) permitted inside bathroom zones, whereas traditional wall-mounted plate switches are prohibited?
content_zh: 在家庭浴室內，天花板吊頂「拉線式開關 (Pull-Cord Switch)」被法規允許安裝在潮濕分區內，而傳統牆壁普通翹板開關卻被嚴令禁止，其核心安全防護原理是什麼？

options_en.A: Pull cords are cheaper than wall switches
options_en.B: The pull cord is made of flexible non-conducting nylon/polyester cord (an electrical insulator); the user's wet hand operates the mechanical cord without physically touching the live switch mechanism mounted safely at high ceiling level
options_en.C: Pull cords generate light without electricity

options_zh.A: 拉線開關在市場上的採購價格比牆壁開關便宜
options_zh.B: 拉繩採用高絕緣非導電尼龍繩製成（純電氣絕緣體）；洗浴人員濕淋淋的手只觸碰絕緣吊繩，而帶電的 230V 機械開關金屬本體被高高固定在天花板頂上，人體與帶電高壓被物理空間徹底隔絕！
options_zh.C: 拉線開關在拉動時能自發熒光照明無需電力
options_zh.D: 牆壁開關面板遇水蒸氣會自發碎裂

explanation_en: Regulation 701.512.3: Standard plate switches are banned in Zones 1 and 2. Pull-cord switches isolate the user by putting a non-conductive insulating cord between wet fingers and the 230V live contacts.
explanation_zh: 浴室拉繩開關保命絕緣體：洗完澡滿身是水，濕手去按牆上 230V 塑料板開關，水順著縫隙流進去會把人當場電死！拉繩開關把帶電的開關本體死死釘在 2.4 米天花板上，手裡抓的是一根尼龍繩，百分之百絕緣！
source_reference: BS 7671:2018 Regulation 701.512.3; C&G Unit 208

content_en: Why does a high-output domestic electric instantaneous shower (e.g. 9.5 kW or 10.5 kW) typically require a heavy 10 mm² twin and earth cable rather than a standard 2.5 mm² or 6 mm² cable?
content_zh: 一台高功率家用即熱式電淋浴花灑（如 9.5 kW 或 10.5 kW），為什麼通常必須使用粗達「10 mm² 的雙芯帶接地護套電纜 (10mm² Twin & Earth)」，而嚴禁使用普通的 2.5 mm² 或 6 mm² 電線？

options_en.B: A 10.5 kW load draws approximately 45.6 Amps at 230V (I = P ÷ V); high current causes severe I²R overheating, voltage drop, and fire in smaller cables, particularly when routed through thermally insulated roof joists
options_en.C: 10mm² cable conducts water to the shower
options_en.D: Regulations require all wires to be 10mm²

options_zh.A: 10 mm² 粗電纜柔軟極易隨意彎曲
options_zh.B: 一台 10.5 kW 電器在 230V 電壓下的滿負荷運行電流高達約 45.6 安培 (I = P ÷ V)！如此巨大的電流若流經較細電線，焦耳熱效應 (I²R) 會讓電線瞬間燒得滾燙融化外皮引發閣樓大火，必須用 10mm² 粗線！
options_zh.C: 10 mm² 粗電纜內部自帶微型自來水輸水通道
options_zh.D: 英國法規強制全屋所有電線一律統一採用 10 mm²

explanation_en: Current calculation: I = P / V = 10,500W ÷ 230V = 45.65 Amps. Factoring in derating for thermal loft insulation (Installation Method 101), 6mm² cable will overheat and burn. 10mm² copper is essential.
explanation_zh: 電淋浴粗電線必考計算：10.5 千瓦除以 230 伏 = 45.6 安培！電流比全屋其他電器加起來還大！若用細電線，電線像電爐絲一樣發紅，閣樓保溫棉立刻起火把房子燒光！必須拉 10 平方專用粗銅線！
source_reference: BS 7671 Appendix 4 Current-carrying capacities; C&G Unit 208
